description:
THIS CLASS INCLUDES TIRAMISU' AND LIMONCELLO TASTING - UNLIMITED HOME MADE WINE

ARE YOU READY for the highlight of your trip to Rome? A unique foodie experience that you'll never forget with Chef Giuseppe and the Rome Pizza School Team.
Small Groups per Chef, will guarantee a One to One caring for the attendees.
A technical and fun up to 4h course that will allow you in a few hours to know all the secrets for pasta and pizza, taught by a true licensed Mastro Pizzaiolo and Pastaio. You can not miss this incredible experience, the reviews speak for themselves.

what we will do?
1) I will come to pick you up at the metro station
2) let's start with preparing the pizzas with one of my beautiful wood-burning ovens!
3) we will prepare 3 types of dough (pasta with eggs, pasta with water, pizza)
4) I will teach you 10 types of pasta shapes to make when you come back home
5) we will prepare 2 pasta dishes with 2 different sauces
6) Taste my famous tiramisu
7) I will take you back to the subway station
8) you will receive a summary document that explains step by step everything we have done together

All this will take place in a bucolic setting, immersed in the fantastic archaeological area of the Ancient Appia. My own wine will not fail during the class
Vegetarians & Vegans welcome (no dessert and cheese for vegans)
Gluten-free ask for avail (+25 eu pp) CELIAC DISEASE IS NOT ADMITTED
locationDescription:
Welcome to my Cooking School! in the heart of Roman History, my land is situated on Ancient Appian way, far from the chaos of the center, but so close to the Town.
Not just a cooking class, it will be the true highlight of your trip! read my reviews and you will understand that your fun is guaranteed!
Welcome Guys from the RomePizzaSchool.com Crew see more pictures of the experience at facebook.com/romepizzaschool

reviews.text:
The class was ok.... the pizza was good, and I did leave with some new pasta techniques. However, none of the recipes were shared like I have gotten with previous experiences. An improvement would be to provide a small recipe booklet or at least an email with the information. Many of my group wanted the recipe details, but we unable to get them.
Also, I understand that the making jokes at people is something others enjoyed, but I am a beginner and beingade fun of for my pizza breaking was disheartening.

The truth is that this experience I recommend to everyone to know or not know how to cook. Belle is a professional comedian haha makes you feel very comfortable, you laugh a lot and the learning is wonderful. The area is amazing, being cooking outdoors, in the shade, without noise is magical. We ate a lot! You're full! They have free drinks and others to buy! I have nothing bad to say ! They take you and bring you from the subway (a stop that has no loss) and the truth is that they are fabulous hosts! She was the only Spanish speaking person and went out of her way to explain everything to me! Thank you so much! You guys are fantastic! The whole team 10/10!

This experience was great! From start to finish I was able to learn so much about cooking pizza and pasta. The host was very funny and made us laugh— which was a plus. If you were having trouble the host was very helpful. He was also very accommodating to any food restrictions or allergies of the group. I would definitely recommend this experience.

Cooking outdoors is a very special experience… under the azure sky and giant trees. Mersad and Alessandro were so knowledgeable, welcoming and has a great sense of humour and comedic timings. They made the class really fun and at the same time, teaching us a lot about flours, resting, water/flour ratio, etc. do not expect to be making the pizza dough… as that is really a 3 day ahead prep. But we learnt to shape the pizza, top and use the pizza peel, which are also important skills to have. Also do not expect to be cooking the pasta - this is a pasta making class class… we learnt how to make 6, 7 shapes (long, shells, stuffed) using both a gnocchi board and chitarra (pasta guitar). The pasta was then cooked by the teachers and we all enjoyed it together with their yummy home made wines.

What a wonderful day spent making pizza and pasta! Many thanks to Mersad for entertaining us! Also, thank you for accommodating an egg allergy. I would highly recommend this experience - a nice half day outside of the hustle and bustle of Rome.

Hands down the best part of our trip to Rome, would recommend to anyone visiting it’s a must! Very easy location to meet at where transport to the location is provided, very detailed lesson into making the pizza and pasta which tasted so good! Very funny hosts, made us feel very welcome and comfortable and had a good laugh. Even though the location is under construction it was beautiful!

We had an amazing time and Mersad was the best. We learned so much and great. He was thorough, funny and so knowledgeable. Everyone laughed, learned and ate delicious food. I would highly recommend anyone looking for a cooking to book this one. You will not be disappointed.
Anyone who will be in Rome should take these activities! I had a wonderful couple of hours, learned a lot, I met new people, I had a delicious pizza and I had a laugh, I really recommend it!!!

It was a really nice experience ans we learned a lot! But be aware that it is quite far away to get there and because they just moved to a new place everything is quite improvised at the moment but should get better in future ;-) the people are really nice and welcoming!

I loved the experience. The teachers made us have a pleasant time, we laughed a lot, we ate delicious.

The tips are great.

We had so much fun making pizza and pasta with Mersad and the team!
He has a good sense of humour and kept us entertained throughout the class. I definitely recommend this class.
We loved the cooking class. We had lots of laughs and learned a lot. The food was delicious. We would highly recommend this class to everyone!
Very much enjoyed our time learning about making pizza and pasta. He helped each of us through all the steps and made it fun

If you’re deciding on a cooking class to book, choose this one! The location was beautiful and rustic —so peaceful to escape the business of the city. Free drinks, wine and Non-alcoholic choices. The experience was immersive and so fun. My boyfriend is vegan and Mersad made sure to have water based dough especially for him to work with and eat. 10/10 recommend.
Very fun experience to have! The hosts are very engaging and cater to each individual participants. Can’t wait to try out the recipe back at home!
So fun! A great way to get out of the craziness of the city, learn something new, meet cool people and eat well. Really funny hosts! The pizza was the best.

Very concise and detailed explanation of the process of making your pizza and pasta at home ; with dos and donts. Super child friendly; kids enjoyed every moment of the experience. The chefs are very professional and are patient and accommodating.Bottomless wine and pasta at the end of it all.
Highly recommend! It was a great time. The instructors were very friendly and helpful. They didn't hesitate to help someone one on one of they needed it.
Awesome expirence. Got to learn how to make Italian pizza and pasta dough. Mersad made the whole expirence super personable and was very hospitable! Would definitely do it again!!

Good class for beginners. For pizza, you start class by shaping dough, topping it, and putting it in the oven. The pizza quality and taste reminded me of Neopolitan pizza that you can get in the USA (in a good way) at a nice pizza restaurant although it tasted different from the pizza we ate in Florence and Rome. For pasta, you learn to make the dough and shape. After that, they take the pasta and made 2 dishes for the group. Great for beginners, although my biggest issues were the weather and bugs, the quality of the pasta dishes and sauce (sauce needs more flavor and better texture), and the trip to get to the site from the subway (van could have been nicer and it's a bumpy ride).

The experience was perfect !
A combination of great food, humour, nice host and a beautiful location.
It was more of a friendly gathering than a class or a workshop.
We had a good laugh, learned so much and enjoyed a delicious lunch.
I highly recommend this culinary experience .

What an amazing experience by Chef Giuseppe, Mersard and crew in a rustic and charming location. Everybody attending the experience was given equal opportunity and time to perfect the art of pizza and pasta making (most importantly operating a pizza oven). I highly recommend the experience which is set slightly away from the hustles and bustles of Rome. A great place to spend time with like minded people all thanks to the care and format used by Chef Giuseppe
The spot was easy to get to from central Rome, the pizza was absolutely delicious and we loved the class/ learned a lot!

We had a great time learning how to make and cook traditional Italian pizza. The class was engaging and fun, while teaching us the fundamentals of pizza making and nuances of making neopolitan pizza. Would definitely recommend this as a fun way to experience Italian culture!

Great experience! After 2-3 days of visiting Rome, museums and popular public places it really feels good to get out of the city a bit to do something like that. There were only 12 of us and I think it was perfect like that. The pizza and pasta were delicious. It got us out of our comfort zone. Tiramisu and limoncello at the end were the fabulous one. Thanks for your experience!

The experience was amazing. Giuseppe is a really nice guy and chef. He and his team showed us step by step what to do. After preparing we ate the pizza and pasta, and it was just so delicious. I would definitely recommend it!
We really enjoyed this! I wish we learned how to make the sauces for the pasta but all in all it was a great experience.
Amazing experience, talented and friendly hosts, we learnt a lot and left with a better understanding and appreciation for pizza and pasta 😁

It was a great experience with Giuseppe and Mersad! Not only we prepared our own pasta and pizza, but also we could learn the details about making them better. Thank you very much both for this fun experience!

Hands down the absolute best part of our trip! We can’t thank chef Giuseppe and all of his team for such an amazing day. We learnt so much and the food was amazing of course but the best part was the environment they’ve created, lots of laughs in such beautiful surroundings with great company. Also very grateful for the ride from the metro station to the location, so generous of them to do that for us. Thanks so much again, can’t wait to test out our new skills at home :)

Even as someone who colossally failed at a few steps, it was an amazing experience! If you make a few mistakes the team will lightheartedly tease you while telling you how to improve next time. For me, it made me feel very comfortable and okay with making mistakes. Very supportive and fun learning environment :) I learned a lot and would recommend this experience to anyone.

Great experience and learned a lot about pasta! Just make sure you arrive at the pickup or main location a little early to make things as smooth as possible. Great transportation to the main location, which was intimate and lovely. Mersad was very fun, knowledgeable, and hospitable (sorry I didn’t not get more time with you, Giuseppe). You start with pizza and eat it (less is more with toppings), make all kinds of pasta shapes and then they make a meal out of a few. Bottomless wine, lemonade, water, and additional fridge drinks for purchase. Would recommend this experience to anyone coming to Rome.

Absolutely Amazing Experience!! Full of laughs and and new skills!!! The team was amazing, inclusive and fun!! We learnt about pizza and pasta and had fun while doing it! The location made the experience that much more unique!! Highly suggest this activity to anyone who is looking for a fun activity to do with a partner or friends!!

We had a blast during our cooking class in Rome. We made friends that we ended spending the rest of day and night with while also learning a new skill. They give you the recipes at end of class for you to take home with you which is great. The location is far from city center of rome and it is hidden and takes a dirt road to get there. FYI for your taxi if you choose to not use the shuttle!
what a great way to dive into Roman culinary culture! Giuseppe and Mersad are wonderful teachers. if you are looking for an authentic and personal experience this is your place.

The cooking class was pretty awesome! I believe the host combined multiple scheduled classes for some reason which made the experience less personable, compared to other reviews I viewed prior to booking. Class was still cool though! No complaints there. My partner and I made some new friends. I was just expecting less people per “chef” is all. For reference, there were 2 chefs- (one stepped in during the pasta portion) but during the pizza making portion there was like 18 of us to one. I would still say the class overall is worth a booking. Unlimited wine! :)

Giuseppe and Mersad were such amazing instructors! They have a hilarious dynamic that makes you feel like you’re on a cooking show and you’re the star. We learned so much about creating healthy, tasty pizza and pasta. Amazing value with two lunches served (that you cook yourself)!

I am 100% recommending this experience to all of my friends who plan on visiting Rome.

This was a fantastic experience with two great chefs and their staff.

It starts with pickup via shuttle at the Laurentina metro station (I wasn’t super clear on this initially, it’s about 20-30 min from the Roma Termini main station), pickup went in three rounds via a small shuttle van. There were people who used a taxi service as well.

The venue itself is a small structure on a private rural area with olive trees and cats roaming around. The house dog often sat nearby as well. There are picnic tables outside under shade and the inside has fans and misters which kept the temperature good

we started with pizza dough shaping and topping including concepts and physically doing our own. The class was split into two groups of about 16 each and hearing/seeing each instructor was not an issue. We got to cook all our own pizzas in a very hot and nice pair of ovens and eat them.

After the break eating these, we made two types of pasta dough and then we made 8 pasta shapes by hand. There was plenty of practice here. Finally we ate two of the pasta types which were delicious.

We ended with tiramisu and lemoncello and all received rides back to the metro or taxis called for us. The whole experience was fantastic and rustic but enjoyable. The instructors were playful and multilingual. Most people were couples. There was plenty of unlimited white and red wine, water and lemonade. There were also options to purchase soft drinks or other things

I would heavily suggest this to anyone looking to learn from a class like this in the area of Rome. It’s a bit out of the way and in the middle of the day but definitely worth it for the expertise and experience.
Guuseppi was very friendly offered to take photos videos. He had a lot of knowledge about Rome. He was always smiling and helping people from other groups

My partner and I did the pizza and pasta cooking class with Giuseppe on our last day in Rome.

We thoroughly enjoyed the experience, and would recommend it to anyone who is keen to do something a bit more hands on than sight seeing. We learnt a lot from Giuseppe especially in terms of how to make the different pasta shapes.

We had such a great time at this class! Really relaxed and fun experience, and the tutors had such amazing knoweldge and skills of the pizza and pasta making! Delicious food and generous extras, set in the beatiful countryside. It was so hot but they had fans and misters at the ready to keep us comfortable. Highly recommend this experience.

This cooking class was such a great experience! From cooking the pizza to the pasta, to the people we met, to the people who taught and assisted in the class. Everyone was great! It was informative but also so much fun! The energy was light and fun! Mersad was amazing, super funny, and intelligent and made us all feel like we were long time friends! They do have unlimited drinks, and the pizza we cooked was amazing, as well as the pasta. We learned so much about Italy and their authentic food, also lots of tips to take home so that we can replicate it there.
We did this as a couples activity and we both had an amazing time.
The staff takes you and picks you up from the train station, or you can get a taxi to the location and Mersad called one for us for the way back.
Overall, I highly recommend this experience. It’s just something you have to do if you are in Italy. Learn to make authentic pizza and pasta, in a beautiful location.
We will totally be back when we come back to Italy!!

if you want to have fun and learn, book this experience. we had the opportunity to share the class with a large group of very nice young people. our instructor was Mersad. We really enjoyed the class with Mersad, he made everything very relaxed and taught us many details about the preparation of
pizza and pasta. thanks to Mersad's ability to interact with so many people at the same time and keep everyone entertained telling jokes while teaching us how to cook , made all the difference to spend a happy morning in the class. In addition, the class is given
in the outskirts of Rome in a field which gives you the opportunity to separate yourself for a few hours from the rhythm of the city and be even more relaxed to enjoy more. thanks Mersad and Giuseppe !!
If you want to learn how to make amazing pasta and pizza and get bullied mercilessly by sassy Italians this trip is for you. Great fun

Giuseppe and the whole team were fantastic at delivering a really knowledgeable and engaging lesson. At every step they made you feel included and supported, pizza and pasta making, and story telling. It was well worth the money and the food was incredible. The complimentary drinks, dessert and lemon cello were great added touches that really added to the whole experience. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Rome. Getting to the place was also super easy, the metro is very quick and they were prompt to collect you from the metro station to drive you to the location. 10/10.

We learned a lot and the participation level was handled beautifully. We all had great opportunities to prepare the pizza and pasta and there was good teasing and praise. I would highly recommend this experience. L
I thought I knew quite a bit about making pasta. Boy was I wrong, I leaned a whole lot of useful info and how to make many different types of pasta

I LOVED THIS EXPERIENCE!!
It was really fun and delicious, the only thing to keep in mind is that you won't learn how to prepare Tiramisu, but you will taste a very good one :) Everything is delicious and its a really fun experience. TOTALLY RECOMMEND IT :D

The experience was globally positive. The balance between practical and theoretical parts was good for me. The atmosphere was friendly.

I would have like having more information about the different toppings combinations, basic sauce preparation for pasta, etc. But this would have make the class maybe too heavy.

Overall, compared to other cooking classes we have done this felt like more of a demonstration. The pizza making was fun and enjoyable but the pasta making left a lot to be desired. We kneaded the dough a little and then it was brought back to us finished and cut for us to shape. The sauces were made by the school and we had nothing to do with the actual cooking of the pasta or sauce. It felt more like a demonstration/tour than the previous informative and intimate classes we have done. We are both home cooks though so maybe our standard is higher than someone who has never made their own pasta or pizza before. Lastly it was outside and much much too hot despite the fans/water spritzer. The staff were lovely, polite and kind but overall would not recommend.

This experience was amazing! We loved getting to make our own pizza, learn about pasta, and hear from the chef about how to make pizza dough. All of thr instructors were funny, personable, and spoke excellent English. We really enjoyed our time and loved getting to know the other people in our session!
Stunning experience, great hosts, magic location (a bit hard to find though 😅). And this food we made... It's maybe the best pizza I've ever eaten

So much fun! Informative, delicious and fun! Make your own pizza and you will place it in the pizza oven! Learn to make pasta too! It has influenced us to make our own pasta at home! We can do it after learning and laughing through the class, definitely recommend!!

A disappointing experience that felt rushed and the dog at the entrance was very intimidating . Would probably be better to focus either on pizza or pasta and complete the chosen process end -to-end in smaller groups so we can all benefit fully from Chef Guiseppe’s expertise and be able to recreate what we learnt back at home.

This cooking class is located in a cute and green environment. We were picked up at the metro station by a van and drove to the location. There we learned everything about making pizza and pasta. Giuseppe is a really temperamental italian chef and knows a lot about making pizza & pasta. His team prepared everything for us and explained everything really nice to us. Even if it was a bit stressful in the end (we needed to catch the van back right after eating), it was a really unique experience that I really recommend to do, when you are in Rome and want to experience something other than the typical sightseeing stuff.
The chef was funny & personable and you can tell he is super passionate about his work. Definitely recommend this class to anyone wanting to make & taste the best pizza on their trip!
One of the highlights of my time in Italy. The vibe was friendly and fun, and the food we made (with their guidance) was delicious. Highly recommend!
Loved it! A fantastic way to spend a day in rome. The pizza was literally the best we had in Italy! Cannot wait to (try) and recreate at home!

I had a wonderful time cooking, laughing and connecting with other tourists. Chef Giuseppe & Mersad and Rossella were great. Incredibly funny and personable. Made us feel very welcome and the experience very natural. I learned a lot which is saying something since my only expectation was to have fun. I did the experience alone since I am on a solo trip and was anticipating some awkwardness but that was not the case. It was a good way to connect with other travelers. The hosts were really efficient and helped coordinate transportation to and from the venue. Food was delicious. Overall once in a lifetime experience.

Our family loved our day making pasta and pizza with Guiiseppe and Mersad. They were both fun and light-hearted! The food was delicious, and we learned a lot. The whole staff was lovely and very friendly. Our kids are 12 and 15 - and they both got so much out of this experience- I would definitely recommend it. It was an afternoon of fun!

Absolutely amazing! We spent 4 days in Rome and booked this experience for our last day. My fiancé and I both agreed that it was the best part of our time here. So much fun, great value for the price, and we left absolutely stuffed with delicious food! We plan to book again if we are ever back in Rome!
Absolutely amazing activity and well worth the money with your own pizza, heaps of pasta, tiramisu and free-flowing wine. Would highly, highly recommend as a way to escape Rome for a few hours.

An amazing experience! Everyone was making jokes and having a great time. All the hosts were super friendly and accommodating. Very delicious food, good learning experience and a great place to meet new people. 100% would recommend!

Very fun experience in a peaceful location. I highly recommend 👌🏾. Mersad was funny, efficient, and ran a clean operation. Surprisingly, pizza is easy to mess up but he was very encouraging and lets you try again. Make sure you put on your bug replant!
Mersad was an amazing chef. We had a great time making pizza and pasta. Along with the guidance and instructions, there was alot of jokes so be prepared to laugh. Definitely recommend this class!

Great cooking class with good instructions and many different things to taste😍
The whole crew was very professional, the flow of the class was good and there was a good introduction to the things we had to do and why. Mersad as was very inclusive and made sure everyone felt seen and in good hands.
We had the pasta tutorial by the girl with the cool hair 🌞 - she was great at explaining and guiding us on how to make pasta.
Thank you for the experience!

This was an amazing experience! We had a wonderful time listening to and learning from Mersad. The structure of the class was easy to follow with plenty of one on one interaction for instructions if needed. The setting was beautiful with cats and a sweet dog roaming the property. I recommended this experience for all ages!

We highly recommend this experience! The chef's are super friendly (and amazing at what they do). Right from the moment they pick you up from the train station, you feel very welcomed!

Recommend going hungry - you'll
be full with great food!!

It was just amazing! The class was well organised from beginning to end and we had so much fun cooking at this beautiful location! The team is really funny and guided us really well through the making of the pasta.
Thank you for this wonderful experience!
All the other reviews were correct! The class is amazing! The tram is super friendly and super nice. Definitely a must do in Rome!

It was a funny pleasure and a great experience to have an Italian cooking class outside with international people in a nice atmosphere and perfect hosts, thank you so much for this adventure between sightseeing and shopping at Rome. We really enjoyed Guiseppe and his team. Grazie from Mikel & Andrea
There were a few of us but despite that everything went in the order and it was super fun and fun to meet so many people from different backgrounds! I recommend

This was a very fun and educational experience. Giuseppe, Mersad and team are great teachers who use humour to keep things light. I learned a lot about pizza making/dough manipulating techniques and I really enjoyed the simple instructions on creating different types of pasta. It was a lot simpler than I imagined and I'll be trying this at home for sure. I highly recommend!

Had a fun time learning with these chefs! They made it a fun, personal experience, and made sure everyone was involved. Would highly recommend this experience for anyone that wants to learn how to make pizza and pasta correctly!
Giuseppe, and Merced had a great sense of humor together with depth of knowledge. We learned so much, and were thoroughly entertained. Our daughter had a blast too.

Easy to find the group leader with sign. Quick bus ride to site.
You start by making the pizza with the dough laid out. I like my hands to get a little dirtier but it was fun. Very informative. After making and then eating the pizza, the pasta portion comes in. This was more interesting since it was from start to finish (you make the pasta from the noodle stage). I didn’t love either of the sauces the two kinds of pasta came in, but overall a good meal. The wine was a bit meh, but the tiramisu and shot of limoncello at the end was great! Very friendly group of people!!
Really fun experience learning to cook pizza and pasta with Giuseppe. The food was delicious and i learned a lot about technique and ingredients.
This was so fun but also super informational, I would highly recommend if you are looking to get out of busy Rome for a few hours.

We went with the family to the pizza class and outdoor pasta.
The whole team is great fun and we had a good time

We had a great day and had lots of fun. We made pizza and 8 kinds of pasta. There is one rescue dog and cat. The atmosphere is very fun and relaxed. The right choice to meet new people and experience Rome. Look for the girl with the Purple Star in her hair in the meeting area. It's an easy way to meet up.

Great experience, it was nice and the setting in an air-conditioned veranda was very friendly, the only small problem being that there is a lot of blah for little practice, indeed I would have liked to have prepared the dough, the activity is nonetheless captivating and nice because we have very good pizzas of good quality as well as pasta that we have shaped ourselves. I recommend but be in good shape to listen to everything!

This was the best thing we experienced on our 3 week trip. My husband and I are very excited to go home and try it out ourselves. We highly recommend this experience to anyone travelling to Rome! These guys truly have it figured out to make your time flow smoothly and to ensure your time is not wasted.

Super awesome class. The instructor was amazing and very thoughtful. Me and my husband enjoyed the class. We had a lot of good laughs. The instructor went above and beyond. I am allergic to cheese but they went above and beyond to make sure I was able to eat everything. And specifically made me a separate pasta dish which also tasted amazing. We had lots of fun and would definitely do it again.

This was hands down the best experience we've had in Rome during our 1 week stay. not only did we learn something new but also laughed and had so much fun. Guiseppe and his team know how to make teaching fun and interesting. We got to make pasta- different shapes, pizza - toppings of our choice and enjoy them afterwards. Mersad made the experience all the more fun with his satirical skills not just cooking!

if you're looking to do something out of ordinary, this will definitely be worth the time and money

This cooking class experience was amazing! The staff were so friendly and knowledgeable - I have learned a lot about the making of pizza and pasta! The atmosphere was lovely and the location was perfect. I must also say that the tiramisu was dreamy - so delicious! Loved the whole experience! Thank you Eleanor, Mersad, Giuseppe and others :)

Such a beautiful class learning how to make 8 different pastas and yummy pizza! I had a veggie one! The place itself if you go by taxi feels like you are being taken into the middle of nowhere. But it is the right way! And it is worth it for the drive!

I went to this experience with my friend Sam. We're both vegan and Merzad was very accommodating and helpful. It was an enjoyable experience; the team is a well - oiled machine, and things are well organised (a rarity in Italy). The chefs definitely add their personal touches to the experience by letting their personalities shine through and jokingly telling you off for the production of particularly ugly food items 😉. Don't go, if you're easily offended! We really enjoyed our time there. The food was delicious, the location was perfect and the pick-up and drop-off service was also very handy. We'd recommend!

Very much worth the time and money. You not only get to cook and eat - but the lessons in pasta and pizza dough are invaluable. Unforgettable experience. All the staff are professional, personable and not to mention Mersad's and Giuseppe's humor are unmatched. I highly recommend this experience.

I highly recommend this! This class was really nice... you make pizza first and then pasta. You'll also learn to create a lot of different forms. But Mersad and Guiseppe are great hosts. They are funny and will help you where needed. Be sure to do this when you're in Rome!
great experience! meet some new people, make some delicious food and learn about the intricacies of real Italian cuisine. highly recommend for anyone in the area!

AMAZING TIME, these guys were great. My wife and I had a great time, what makes this experience even better is if you aren’t that great at making pizza or pasta, because Giuseppe and Mersad will definitely roast you for it, which makes it fun for everyone. Learned a lot on this experience and cannot wait to try out the recipes at home.

Amazing course, well worth the money for an exciting way to experience Roman cuisine and learn details of Italian staples. Entertaining and fun chefs that helped keep the experience upbeat and light hearted. Amazing food and unlimited drink kept us hydrated. Facility also has plenty of fans and misters to keep it VERY comfortable despite the heat.

Fantastic experience with delicious food - made several types of pasta and learned a whole bunch about the art of pizza and pasta making. The transportation option made it very easy to get to from the metro station. Enjoyed myself very much!

I absolutely loved this class. The chefs were very passionate and knowledgeable about what they do and made class fun and exciting. It’s also a great choice for the price. Highly recommend if you’re in Rome

This would be a great experience for families with kids, but I did this experience with a couple friends and we felt that it had too many people in the class and wasn't hands on enough. Besides assembling the pizza and pasta, all the cooking was done by staff behind the scenes. Seeing the pizza cook in the wood fired oven was cool.

Very nice team of chefs .
This was a very nice and professional experience . I learned a lot .
I highly Recommend it when visiting Rome, Italy. 👍😊
An amazing way to spend an afternoon in Rome! The chefs are super fun, they guide you through all the steps in a very interactive and fun manner. Plus, the food was fabulous 😍

Overall pretty good. The hosts picked and dropped us at the Laurentina metro stations- the actual location is 15 minutes away by car.

We first made the pizza shape from the dough and then put toppings. They helped us put the pizza in the oven and cooked it. Then we had the pizza along with a short break. After, we made various pasta shapes and ate some pasta. They gave us tiramisu at the end. Pretty accurate.
We loved this experience. We did it with our kids and they loved it too. Very fun. The pizza and pasta were delicious. Thank you!

My family and I took the cooking class and loved it! My family included my husband and I, my 19 year old daughter and my 5 year old son. This experience was amazing and Mersad made it super fun for my son! My daughter was laughing and she is usually very quiet. Giuseppe was so informative and explained everything amazingly! Elena was so sweet and showed us how to make our pasta! Loved it all! It was hot but we went to Rome in July sooo what do I expect 😂 thank you and our food came out delicious!

Time well spent. Beautiful setting.
I had my best Neapolitan pizza, straight out of the oven onto my plate. A great learning experience. Looking forward to using these recipes at home.
Giuseppe and Mersad were great teachers and good hosts. I highly recommend this experience.

Horrible experience, I do not recommend. I have done multiple amazing experiences through AirBnb,, but in this instance this was not the case. This experience had rude hosts, no clear lesson plan and a class of about 40 tourists (when the lesson indicated about 15 would attend). The head chef left half way through saying he was going to the beach (he wasn’t joking) and he left us with his incredibly rude Sous chef, who continued on to take the Mickey of the rest of us. It was an absolutely horrible experience. 0/10 Do not take this class !!
This is the best thing you can do in Rome and a great relief from all the busy stuff you’ll be doing in Rome. Everything was perfect, it was very engaging, great fun and we learnt a lot!

From the time we met the person at the station to all our cooking and back... it was a wonderful experience. Both Giuseppe and Mersad were amazing and their sense of humour kept us all in great spirits. Excellent pizza and pasta. And yes best Tiramisu xx
Took my mom to Italy for the first time and this was one of our first activities. Lovely time here - humor was great and so was the atmosphere. Would come back for sure!

If you are doing this class, get ready to be roasted on your pasta and pizza making skills. The chefs joke around and tease you a lot but all in good faith. The pizza we made was my favourite and we enjoyed the unlimited lemonade. The atmosphere in the farm is lovely, you may even find a cat sleeping under your table. I suggest hosting these classes in smaller sizes and having more of a storytelling aspect to the class as there is quite a bit of waiting around in between parts of the class.

Everyone seemed a bit affected by the heat which made the group environment a bit difficult (completely understandable). If you’re into “public shaming” style banter then you will have a blast with the instructors. They are very sarcastic and tend to use this as the primary form of engagement with participants. The food was good, the tiramisu was amazing, the venue was lovely and the cooling system was very helpful. I would not recommend going solo, but if you have someone to accompany you I’m sure you can make the best out of the situation.

This was the best part of Rome for our family of 8. We had a great time making pizza and pasta. The chefs were knowledgeable and entertaining. The outdoor atmosphere was perfection. Couldn’t of been happier with this experience. Thank you for your food and hospitality!

The experience as a whole was amazing! Each and every one of the masters and assistants was very helpful and generous! The class was interesting and full of exciting facts and tricks! We hope that this particular workshop has many students for years to come!

My friend and I booked this cooking class and we had a lot of fun! Giuseppe, Mersad and their Team made this experience really unique. The cooking class was held with a lot of information, but also fun! The food was amazing, especially the pizza we made. Thanks for this nice roman experience:)

Really enjoyed the class. The instructors were very friendly and informative. They all had a great sense of humour and the food was delicious. Would highly recommend for anyone of any level of experience in cooking.

Today we took the cooking course and had a little concern because of the heat (35+degrees); Giuseppe and Mersad (and colleagues) have a super nice location with excellent fans and a pollution system that provides sufficient cooling. The course is highly recommended, even with children. Our son is 10 years old and he was designated as "master" and helped well with baking. His pizza was, of course, the best😁. The pasta trays were fun, but less spectacular and it was warm which made the dough quickly dry out. That's right, it's summer! Really a nice daily program with good food and (cheap) drinks, you just have to do this 👍

We had an amazing time learning to make pizza and pasta, Giuseppe and Mersad were amazing teachers and we had so much fun. There were laughs from beginning to end.
There are free refreshments available and you get to try some amazing tiramisu and limoncello at the end.
overall fantastic experience and I would definitely recommend.
Pizza was excellent. Giuseppe is really passionate about food and it showed. they made it nice and simple so all levels of people could enjoy. wonderful mix of people from all around the world.

My expectations were quite high based on reading the other reviews - I was extremely disappointed with this experience. The shuttle van had issues and we were left waiting outside the metro station for over 30 mins on an incredibly hot day. The description of the event was quite inaccurate- it says small groups and individual attention, but we must have had about 40 people attend, and I barely got to interact with the hosts or ask any questions. I could hardly see the pasta making demonstrations and had to guess what to do by watching those seated next to me. This whole process felt very rushed. The description also mentions 10 pasta shapes and 3 doughs - we only made 8 shapes and 1 dough hands on. The pizza dough and the pasta sauces were pre-prepared. The venue was also incredibly hot and sweaty, and if you weren't lucky enough to be seated next to a fan, it was beyond bearable. Overall, I was quite disappointed with this experience and didn't feel like I really learnt much from attending.

A great experience, different than most cooking classes offered in Rome as it is in a beautiful setting in the middle of nature. Giuseppe is a passionate Italian who loves to share his love for cooking pasta and pizza with guests. The group is quite large (40 people) so it takes a bit of time to do everything but the kind staff and beautiful setting make up for that :) thank you!

It was really fun to make the pizza and pasta. Once we learned how to make the pasta and the chefs cooked it and then we got to eat. They also offered lots of drinks. Hosts were really nice to us and gave me a gnocchi board and a nice bottle of wine to compensate our waiting time due to the pick up Can breaking before getting to us.
We were glad we waiting because my son and I really enjoyed this experience.
This experience was purchased and reviewed in part by my son, which tells you that this is a great experience to do with the family.

This experience was much better than expected. I was concerned at first with the location and the description, however, everything was far better than I could have expected. It was an extremely hot day, but the outdoor room was cooled by large fans and water mist system. The team made you feel like family! My wife and I brought my 12 and 7 year old. Both had an absolutely amazing time. They both really enjoyed the pizza and pasta making. I enjoyed the wine! Highly recommend this experience. The only warning I would give is to not eat breakfast. We made the mistake of eating a big breakfast and then a very large pizza and pasta lunch LOL!
It was a great class! Even though it was hot outside, the area was well equipped and shaded and the food was delicious!
I loved learning how to make pizza! The pasta making part was a bit long but I enjoyed the tiramisu (best I’ve ever tasted)
Loved this experience! The pizza was the best I’ve had in Italy. The chefs were super engaging and informative, highly recommend. Super fun!!!
The hosts were all very funny and knowledgeable! A bit far from the city center but the hosts arranged van roundtrip from metro and helped with taxis if needed

Just book it! As Italy was the last leg of my month long Europe trip, I wanted to find a unique experience that I wouldn’t be able to do elsewhere in the States. This experience was exactly that! The pickup from the metro was very easy, as we were greeted immediately with a well labeled sign. Giuseppe and his team were knowledgeable and worked closely with us to ensure the proper techniques were used for our meals. Everything turned out delicious and I appreciated the PDF that was sent after our class with all the info we learned that day. Thank you again Giuseppe!

The team are absolutely fantastic. So super friendly. They make you feel at home and if you get lost during the class, they gently set you on your way again. The location is off the beat but they bring you there and ensure you get home - despite several glasses of free wine. Magical. Keep an open mind. The team are just like my crazy 20 yo daughters. But they will love on you.

The best you can get from Rome is this experience. The art of preparing your food, eating best pasta and pizza, meeting people all around the world, enjoying your time in the nature, great atmosphere and of course, learning from the chefs is all you can desire from the vacation. Worth every cent. Thank you!

This was awesome and delicious! The setting is magical- on a property near the Appian Way. It felt so far outside the city, yet it was minutes by bus or metro. The teachers were warm and hilarious, and we learned a lot about pizza and pasta making. The food we helped make was delicious, and the tiramisu that we didn’t make but got to eat was out of this world! Definitely fun for our whole family!

Great pizza in beautiful landscape. The pizza part of the class was great and the pizza was delicious. The best crust we had in Italy. The pasta section was too fast and not as expected. I think no one in our table was able to follow., but it was very pretty to see how they made them. You do not learn how to make the sauces. The group was also way too many people. Be careful if you have a severe peanut allergy, as when we went they had open cans filled with peanuts on all the tables. This happened even though I told them about my allergy beforehand. I think peanuts do not make much sense with pizza but who am I to judge, eh?

This experience was truly amazing! It was not only delicious but also so informative and simply put a lot of fun! The whole crew was very nice and also funny and entertaining! It was also really easy to get there with the crew members picking one up at the tube station. Highly recommend it!

The hosts are cool, so funny and sarcastic if you’re into that. I learned a lot about making pasta and left feeling like I could go home and make my own. Only con is how far the experience is. It’s not in Rome, more so in the country side which made getting to and from somewhat challenging

Fun class. The pizza we made was really tasty, and it was fun to learn how to make different pasta shapes. There were about 30 people at our class. The guys are nice and fun. I would recommend this activity.

This is a great experience for anyone with a passion for cooking or even just a passing interest. The venue was very cute and despite the heat was perfect for the class. My daughter and I learned many new skills and met new friends along the way. I highly recommend taking some time off the beaten path and trying this!

We loved this pasta & pizza making class! It was so fun learning to make these traditional italian foods & the hosts were very fun & engaging! My only qualm was I wish it was a bit more structured in terms of instructions, but a lovely class regardless!
it's a really fun experience, the hosts are very cute, fun and nice, one of the best tiramisu I've ever had.

We made a great Italian style pizza and learned a lot of tips to be able to replicate it at home. Pasta making was equally interesting, with clear explanation of technics to make different types of pasta. Overly great time with a great food.

PROS: It’s a great experience overall. It’s a great balance between technique and information. They are very personable with the guests and the staff are fantastic, really going above and beyond to entertain and teach. We enjoyed the experience.

CON: The only issue is communication regarding travel and start time. Note that it is 30 minutes by car/ taxi from central Rome to the location and that it’s in the middle of no where. They are able to call a taxi for you after the experience which is helpful. For public transport you need to take a bus and metro from central Rome to the closest station, and then they pick you up from there for a 10 minute shuttle ride to the location. The start time also changed by 30 minutes which was fine but we were told at 10pm before the event.

This experience was amazing and both funny! Giuseppe and his crew were funny, professional and so friendly! The food was delicious and I learnt so much about pasta making and pizza making! Truly an art and my respect for chefs went through the roof!

This is a must!!!!! The whole class was amazing and learnt many new skills. The team are amazing and make the class very enjoyable. Fun was fantastic and can’t wait to start trying out the recipes when I get home

I enjoyed my experience. The ride to and from was a bit bumpy. I got carsick on the way there so I didn’t enjoy it as much in the beginning and needed to keep sitting down. The class was great, the guy Mersad jokes around a lot. There is a lot of banter. This is an all outside experience. You eat and cook outside. I feel like it would be better if they didn’t throw out our pasta we made (that was sad, especially cause we worked hard on it and it felt a little wasteful) and had fans throughout the facility instead of just the sides. But for the price, it was a nice experience. I learned a lot from the pizza portion but not as much from the pasta because everyone made a different kind. The techniques (pasta shapes) that were taught were really amazing. Overall I would definitely do this experience again just not in the summer.

This was such a fun experience! We had such a great time making pizza and pasta with our hosts. The instructors were fun and informative and showed us a variety of methods. The other experience-goers were fun to get to know in the playful environment. It was a bit farther from the city center than we expected, but the location was rustic and beautiful. Definitely recommend the experience (go hungry!!)!

Such an enjoyable class! The instructors were great. Be okay with potentially getting playfully picked on if you mess up. It was hot, but they had some fans and misters going. Still, would suggest bringing a container with some cold water to sip on throughout. They do have some cold drinks (water and sodas and beers) for purchase at reasonable cost. Pizza dough was pre-prepared (as it should be). Pasta we made was eaten for the second course. Fun location and great value!

This class was an incredible experience ! I’d recommend to anyone.
Cooking outside made for a relaxing atmosphere and all of the food was plentiful and delicious…. Simple, quality, & local ingredients made for an almost “farm to table” experience. Huge shoutout to Chef Mersad for making us laugh and teaching us how to make the perfect pizza- it was the best we’ve ever had!

We were a group of four, my husband and I and our two adult children. We had a wonderful time! We loved the humor and the teasing infused in the teaching. We loved the location and the teachers. My husband and I have attended a previous pasta making class in Tuscany which was held at a beautiful villa and was a lovely experience, but the teachers were not Italian, they were transplants from away. We absolutely loved and appreciated the rustic setting of Giuseppe's class. Giuseppe gave a very detailed explanation of the different flours used, the purposes behind certain techniques and ingredients, and just overall helpful information. My son who is an experienced cooked drank in all the details to take home to improve his own skills. Mercad and Elena were such a joy and quite funny, as well. Loved the sparring between the hosts as well as the guests. Overall, a really delightful experience.
Thai was a very fun class . It was well organized and they do a great job of pacing it out so you enjoy both the pizza making and pasta experience .

We had a fantastic time and learned a lot at the pizza and pasta class today. Even though it was an unusually hot day, they kept us cool and hydrated. The pizza and pasta was fantastic and the tiramisu and limoncello were nice touches.

We would highly recommend it.

we had a fantastic time instructors were extremely knowledgeable and entertaining..fulfilled all expectations pertaining to pizza and pasta making…would recommend to anyone with even the slightest interest in pizza or pasta!
It was a really great experience! Would highly recommend when in Rome. Guiseppe and his team were great and thought us how to make the best pizza at home! Thanks for having us!
It was one of the best part of our journey in Rome. It is a good team with great instruktors. Highly recommended for anyone who is interested in gastronomy.
Class was a good introduction. The class size was a bit large, so if you're looking for a very personalized experience, this may not be the best fit.

Great experience with good atmosphere and experienced hosts.
We learned a lot about pizza, pasta and got lots of tips to cook everything from scratch. It was fun, informative and active course. Book it for sure if you love to try new things and are not afraid to coat your hands with flour!

A fantastic experience. The chefs were fun and informative, a beautiful and tranquil location, and the food was delicious. A great way to experience Italian cooking as a solo traveller. Definitely a highlight of the trip.
We loved this cooking experience, the hosts were friendly and helpful and the food that we helped to make was delicious. I highly recommend this one!

This is a super fun experience for anyone wanting to learn to cook. The instructors are hilarious and super friendly. They are knowledgeable as well! The pizza you make is fantastic. I feel like we are better chefs after the class!

I was with my boyfriend there and we really loved it! It was so much fun and you get to know how to make the italian pizza and pasta! You also get some wine and tiramisu:) the people there were really lovely.

This was an excellent activity and a definite must do when in Rome. A great learning experience and opportunity to have great food. The team was lovely to work with and the pizza was fantastic! Highly recommended

We LOVED our experience. 10/10 recommend. We had so much fun. I loved the playful atmosphere and loved how easy everything is. You get make the best pizza I’ve ever had, and tons of different kinds of pasta. Which was delicious.

My daughter and I had a wonderful day with Giuseppe and Mersad! They are masters at what they do and they created an enjoyable experience making pizza and pasta. A must do activity while you are in Rome!!

What can I say, Mersad and Giuseppe were class acts the entire class! They were attentive, knowledgeable and flat out fun! We learned so much about pasta and pizza making, I honestly thought I was a pro pizza maker until Giuseppe told me that my Ooni pizza oven was a toy :). I recommend this to anyone who wants to have a great experience in Rome!

My husband and I absolutely loved making pasta and pizza during our honeymoon! The pizza that we made was hands down the best that we had while in Italy. Can’t wait to try these techniques in our own kitchen at home!

What a great experience! We are people who love experiences a little more than the typical sightseeing and this was perfect. 100% worth going! The hosts are phenomenal, the food is phenomenal, but the experience is priceless.

We had a great time with Giuseppe, Mersad, and Alena! They were funny but extremely knowledgeable and I learned so much about cooking practices I’ve been getting very wrong for my entire life. I’m so excited to bring this new information home and incorporate it in my own cooking and sharing it with my family

A great hands-on experience for learning how to make pasta and pizza! I learned so much of what goes into making pasta and pizza and it was delicious. The instructors were engaging and you can tell they love what they do.

This is a phenomenal cooking class! It is very accessible for the beginners level, or kids, but you learn a lot of valuable techniques you can use afterwards. Even though we were outside the whole time, they had fans and misters so that it was never uncomfortable. there was plenty to eat and drink, and everything was delicious. most importantly, the staff was funny, high energy, helpful, patient, and genuinely interested in making sure everybody had a great time. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone looking for a cooking course in Rome. The phenomenal staff really make this an a++ experience!

Gluten free pizza making class for the win! I really enjoyed the pizza class - place was relaxing and they had misters everywhere so it was refreshing as well even if it was 35 degrees. Highly recommended! even with the big class I got to experience making pizza and pasta hands on!

Thank you so much Giuseppe, Mersad and Elena for a wonderful and educative experience! Mersad was a great teacher (but be prepared to be publicly shamed if you make a mistake😆), the area was lovely, the pickup and all the logistics was smooth. And the pizza and pasta were SO GOOD! Will happily recommend in the future!

Amazing experience! This was mine and my partners first time to Rome and I wanted to do something different and found this, I wasn’t really sure what to expect but it was brilliant! The chefs are lovely and very funny, good entertainers and we learnt the art of pizza and pasta making, definitely worth the money and we have loads of memories to go back with!
Big thank you again!
This class is SO MUCH FUN. Absolutely one of our favorite experiences in Rome. If you want to have good food and a great time look no further. 10/10 recommend

It was a fun experience but I probably wouldn’t do it again. Wasn’t engaging as it needed to. However, Mersad was wonderful and fun! I appreciated his personality and direct instruction and feedback during the first part.
Don’t miss this amazing experience! The pizza and pasta making and eating was delightful but the hosts were the best part, the 3 of them felt like old friends we were visiting! Highlight of the trip!

A very fun experience. It was far removed from town and took about 30 minutes from the station to get there. It was in the middle of nowhere. It was outside and quite warm; but Giuseppe and his team were very knowledgeable and funny. It was a wonderful hands on experience

Amazing experience and for sure a highlight from our time spent in Rome! All the teachers were incredibly entertaining and everyone had a great time and got along very well. Also likely the best pizza I’ve had in my life

I would highly recommend this class! The instructors were fun, helpful, and entertaining, and they all went above and beyond to make this class a truly memorable experience. Shoutout to the wonderful Mercad, Giuseppe, and Elena for being truly amazing!
This was a great experience to try something new in cooking. We have not taken a cooking class like this and we loved it.

This experience was fun for my husband and I on our honeymoon. We met new people and our hosts were hilarious! My tip: Rome is very hot in the summer and this is an outdoor class so drink lots of water! I felt light headed as I didn’t drink much water and the hosts were so accommodating and drove me back into town early so I could go home and rest. The hosts were above and beyond amazing and really made us feel welcome and taken care of! I 100% recommend their pizza and pasta cooking class!! We learned so much about cooking these meals!
What’s great way to celebrate my birthday. This was very fun, interactive, and delicious. Marsed especially made the day enjoyable. Great laughs and great experience!!

There were far too many participants in the course, so you can really talk about mass making without added value.

How we ONLY occupied the pizza, I wanted to know how long the dough had gone, the answer was: "It says in the recipe that we send after the course."
It was then briefly explained in the second part, but the course was not really well organized.
Over and over again, questions have been referred to the recipe that will be sent afterwards.

I can also find a recipe on the Internet myself.

When making pasta, dishes of our pasta were thrown away.
Which I found very disappointing.

Overall, I found the course to be very long from the 4h we only sat 2 and ate the occupied pizza and waited for everyone to take pizza and eat.

Attendee of my appointment about 32
I can't recommend it.

Has fun making the pizza but much room for improvement for pasta making.

Left out certain parts of pasta making such as boiling of the pasta and sauce making. Drinks were also left out in the heat with no ice and taste of pasta was mediocre. Did not learn much about pasta making and class felt very generic. Not worth the price paid.
Awesome experience to learn how different Italian food is made with plenty of time to enjoy a few stories between the locals and other tourists.
This experience was so amazing! Best pizza we had while in Italy and learned lots of great tips for pizza and pasta. Definitely recommend!

We met great people, learned a lot about pizza and pasta making. Giuseppe kept us entertained with his wit and sassiness! There were also great assistants who were very attentive and accommodating. Would definitely recommend doing this experience!
This class was super fun and we made hands down the best pizza I think I have ever had in my entire life. Would highly recommend.

Great experience! The metro was easy to navigate to where a host was waiting to take us to the venue. We started with pizza, which was ready quickly (good because we were hungry!) then we moved onto learning the pasta dough and many shapes! They explain it all in detail, enlugh that I am comfortable to try it at home! We eventually ate the pasta and it was amazing!! The staff are all hilarious and make the class so fun (Phone number hidden by Airbnb)

Great, relaxing course. Perfect if you need a non stressful day in your trip. Lots of fun making the pizza and pasta. Giuseppe gets into the science of the cooking, which we loved. Making pasta was great and harder than it looked. Merced was awesome as our instructor. Finished the day with some of the best tiramisu we have ever had. A great and fun experience, especially if you enjoy cooking.
So glad we booked this experience! It was nice to get out of the city of Rome for a few hours and enjoy a cooking class! The instructors really made this experience fun!

This was such an incredible experience! Giuseppe and his team were all very knowledgeable, personable, and helpful. We learned so much, enjoyed the food greatly, and overall had a very memorable experience. We were worried that the location was going to be difficult to access but it was just one bus ride and then they had a van at the station ready to take us to the location directly. Very clear directions! Thank you Giuseppe & Team, we will remember this experience very fondly 😄!

My friends and I were a group of 9, we really enjoyed ourselves and had a good laugh. Giuseppe and the team are fun. Only thing I’d flag is making sure you organise yourself with transport to and from Rome as it’s quite far.
Nice experience to do if you're visiting Rome. You learn to make pizza and different forms of pasta. Plus, we eat our creations and leave with the recipes from what we've learned!

We really enjoyed our class! The staff had a very fun energy and we learned a lot. It is pretty far away from the city center so it will take a big chunk out of your day when you include transportation. Great fun though!

Our family of 5, including 3 teenage boys, had a great experience at the cooking class. Our kids stayed fully engaged with full bellies. It was so much fun to get tips for making wood burning pizzas at home and learning the art of handmade pasta.

Pizza was lovely and making it was enjoyable. I thought at times we went into too much depth for things, we spoke for a long time about what kind of flour to use for dough but then when we made are own the instructions were to mix and then kneed. I felt we should have been told how to kneed with the techniques shown to us. Also the drinks were warm, the water, wine and juice are left out. On a hot summers day this makes them very Unrefreshing and in turn you end up buying drinks which are refrigerated. I think the price for drinks included is fair but when those drinks are warm you will end up buying the colds one which will add to the price of the day. It is also quite far from the city that in itself is not a problem though.

This experience was far better than I expected, the hosts were really friendly, interactive, and really knew their stuff, although it was a large group it still felt intimate and everyone was attended to.

Wine on tap, your own pizza, 2 pasta course, tiramisu, and lemon cello to enjoy throughout the experience… what more could you ask for!?

Aswell as the opportunity to learn or enhance your pasta/pizza making skills,

Very much a recommend!

Honestly the best part about our trip to Rome - the food was incredible, the pasta and pizza making was super enjoyable, the teachers were really personable and funny, and we made friends with some great people !

This was such a fun experience where we learned how to make pizza and pasta from scratch and even got a taste:)
We were given a very warm welcome on arrival and offered some water, wine, or limoncello until the class began.
All staff were super friendly, funny, and worked so hard especially given how hot it was!
I highly recommend this to anyone visiting Rome and wanting to try something a little different:)
Also great for solo travellers who want to make friends.
To all the staff, thank you so much!

We had such a great time! Giuseppe, Merced and the whole team were so kind and funny. Our 8 year old son was the only child in the class and they were so great at making sure he felt included. Food was amazing and we have such a cool experience to reflect on from our trip. Definitely recommending to any of our friends/family who will be making their travels to Rome!
What a dream in the beautiful country outside of the city! Absolutely magical. I will do this class again if I ever come back this way.

Very nice! You learn how to make dough and you eat a lot but you don’t get all the in between. Which is fine. Italian food is simple and complex. You can’t do it all in two hours from start to finish. But you get useful skills you can use at home a great experience and a lot of food.

This class is amazing! Giuseppe and his team are very thoughtful, funny and have a great didactic. The diversity of the other guests and the team itself made for a unique experience with delicious food and a lot of laughter. I strongly recommend it!
Really great experience! The food was really good and the hosts were both knowledgeable and funny. Felt like a great way to experience a part of Italian culture in a relaxed setting.

Giuseppe goes above and beyond to make sure everyone is able to find the location as well as remains comfortable while others join the class. The class itself is only made better by his candor and sense of humor. My family (included a 4 and 6 year old) and I had a wonderful time. The children were treated like actual guests and engaged throughout the class. It is organized and well run with seamless translations from one activity to the next.

The pasta and pizza class was excellent! We brought our toddler and everyone was very understanding, thoughtful, and patient with us as a family. My son felt included, but everyone was flexible and cool with him when he didn't follow along. It was educational, fun, and the food was delicious. I learned why my pizza at home always burns and how to roll different types of pasta. I highly recommend this class as something to do outside of the city center for a break from being a tourist. It was a fun time for our family. Thank you!!!
Entertaining, educational and so much fun. 100% recommended this experience. The food we made was outstandingly delicious. Truly a highlight of our trip.
Omg this experience was amazing ! Way better than expected . Giuseppe was so funny and made the class fun! Well with the money . This is a must do experience . Book this !
Location is too far and I’m not sure it’s worth it. Funny people, but I took offense for some of their jokes. Your skin can be tougher than mine though:)

The class was great! Very interactive and the Chef’s were very personable.
We learned different pasta making techniques and made an amazing pizza with the enjoyment of a wonderful view.
One detail was the finding transport to the location. They offer a shuttle but it’s a big class and a far location.
So plan ahead to spend taxi or Uber money on top of the class price.
Although the view was worth the money and drive.
Would come back for sure!

Fun experience! The hosts were really funny but they do poke fun at people from the US, so if that offends you don’t go! Each group was about 8 people and they had 3 groups at a time. The experience took longer than expected, so definitely clear your schedule for it.

As for the pizza making, it felt less authentic. The dough was already made and we only shaped it and added toppings. It came out very tasty though, the best pizza I’ve ever had.

The pasta making was more detailed and intricate. We made the dough ourselves and learned how to create 6 pasta shapes. The kneading was very fun! The hosts made 2 sauces, pesto and a cheese white sauce. Both tasted good but the pizza was better.

Just a tip, don’t eat beforehand! By the time we finished cooking and eating the pizza, I was too full for the pasta.

We had so much fun learning from and spending time with Guiseppe and Mersad! You have the opportunity to learn so much and really get your hands dirty. The banter between the students and chefs makes for a really entertaining time. Not to mention the pizza and pasta were AMAZING!

The hardest part about this course is getting to the pickup location. The metro is a cheap option - just make sure you plan ahead and give ample time to navigate the system and arrive on time. Do not be fooled also by the drive from the metro to the class location - once you are at the spot you will see what a great set up Guiseppe has. You will be in for an amazing time!

It is such a lovely experience. I went by myself and made friends with families and couples, the chefs make it really easy to start a conversation with the other participants. Truly a magical location and a once in a lifetime experience, I cannot recommend it enough.

We loved this! Took my two teen daughters and they had a wonderful time. Giuseppe and crew were friendly, knowledgeable, funny, and helpful. Our pasta was delicious, and that pizza! Sooo good. We’d book again for sure.
So fun! Good techniques for pizza and pasta shaping. We got the make the pasta dough and it actually turned out great and was a lot of fun.

So much fun! The instructors were so great and so accommodating with picking up from the metro station. They were also so funny which made it such an enjoyable experience! Would recommend to anyone going to Rome.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND! A great experience and excellent hosts, I was in Mersad's group and it was so much fun. The settings is amazing, a peaceful garden with lots of kitties roaming around, truly felt like an escape from the congested city center. It does take about an hour to get to by bus if you are coming from the center of Rome. Lots of delicious drinks (wine, water, limoncello) and we made some friends during the experience! I would highly recommend to anyone.
A great experience that I would highly recommend to anyone staying in Rome!! The class was super fun and informative and Giuseppe and Mersad are excellent hosts.

Giuseppe is all around amazing. Our Taxi did not drop us off at the correct location Giuseppe saw us picked us up via his car and drove to the meeting location. He was funny, personable, and very kind. I would 100% suggest spending just 5 minutes with this amazing chef and you’ll feel amazing, being able to spend 4 hours with him was out of this world!
Amazing experience. The hosts are fabulous and make it so fun! Such a great time met some amazing people and had amazing food!
Awesome experience to learn how to make pizza and pasta! The chefs were fun and comical making it a unique experience for everyone. Cool location and good wine to learn!

We made pizza, we made pasta, we ate and we drank. It was nice to be part this fun group. We wished there would have been more personal touch to it! We felt a bit in a rush. The dough was already prepared (pizza), so you just form it, put the topping on and then for a few minutes into the pizza oven. For the pasta, we got a lot of information how it should be and how it shouldn’t, then you create to dough and then you form it to different kinds of pasta, but like already mentioned everything in a rush. The steps in between (put it through the pasta machine etc.) we’re left out.

Other than that, great people, great instructors, great food! If you look for something more personal, maybe go for the class with the Italian Mama!

It was ok! So we made some pretty good pizza and after that pasta. The location is cute. The instructors seem to be doing the course several times a day. We would have loved to be a little bit more involved. Especially in cooking the pasta and maybe a different sauce.
One of the best and most pleasant experiences I’ve ever had. Giuseppe was an amazing host, very knowledgeable, funny, and makes sure each person has an amazing experience!
We had a great time during this cooking class! Learned many techniques and shared many laughs with the chefs and our group! Would highly recommend this experience to others!
Such a great experience! The location was super sweet and the chefs were so funny! Had a lot of fun and delicious food. Higly recommended 🇮🇹🍕

This is one of the highlights of my trip to Roma, definitely worth your time and money, if you have the chance just book it. You learn a new cooking skill, you eat pizza, pasta, tiramisu, and finish with a limoncello. You have unlimited homemade wine (do not abuse). You have the opportunity to meet new people from all over the world. Giuseppe and Mersad have incredible knowledge of their art and a sense of humor that is hard to pass. Everything is outside the city, this give you an opportunity to see the beauty of the scenery.
Had a great time learning how to make pizza and pasta, Giuseppe was an entertaining host and the company was great. I made one of the best pizzas I’ve ever had 😎

My husband and I really loved this Rome pizza cooking class we did on our second day at Rome! We met wonderful people from other places, we laughed, we ate so much pizza, pasta, and tiramisu and just had the best time ever. We are so happy we did this experience and will never forget it! Loved it all!

We had a really fun time and food was absolutely delicious. We were a bit worried about not having captured all the explanations but we received a leaflet with the recipes afterwards, which we appreciated. Thanks a lot!
We had a lovely time! To all tourists… Go to colosseum, go to Fontana di trevi.. but make sure you go to this experience aswell.
We loved it. Giuseppe and Mersad's sense of humor helped make this experience the most fun. I can't wait to try recipes and techniques at home. Something I would highly recommend!
My wife and I really had fun with this class. The host is full of personality and teaches in a very fun manner. Go hungry!

Great cooking class for novices like us! In 4 hours, you'll do a lot and also enjoy it.
The atmosphere was super nice, we were a group of 16 and had plenty of room for the group size. Note: classes can go up to 30pax.
If you're looking to explore the Roman countryside and cook outdoors, you've come to the right place!
Wonderful and fun, and hilarious time! Definitely a must go, especially if you want to get away from the craziness of the city for a few hours. And the food is amazing of course!

The cooking class exceeded our expectations and we had a great time. Both hosts were great at explaining the cooking processes as well as the history behind the foods. It was very interesting to learn how to make pizza as well as many types of pasta. Everything that we cooked tasted phenomenal and the wine, tiramisu, and lemoncello were great as well. The location was beautiful and it was fun to talk with the other people in the class. Would definitely recommend to anyone in Rome.

An awesome experience. The instructors made it easy to follow, added humor to help the learning experience. And there was a lot of hands on -- we made a pizza, made several different kinds of pasta and then finished with two kinds of pasta. Great lunch with pizza and the pasta. This is an experience I would pay to do again.

This was THE highlight of our vacation in Rome. We learned so much about pizza dough and how to make pizza and pasta from scratch in a beautiful scenery. You get to eat your home made pizza and pasta in the end as well as home made tiramisu and limoncello, which both were also so delicious.
Also Mersad was a really nice and funny host.
So in total: we definitely enjoyed it and you will too!
Great, great experience. A very Italian place, very Italian food and very Italian chef. Everything is delicious and excellent company.
Very good activity to learn the secrets of Italian pasta and pizza. The idyllic place. I recommend going without breakfast.
I strongly recommend this experience. It was so much fun and I learnt a lot of Italian cuisine secrets thanks to Guiseppe and his team.

We enjoyed the class so much, I would definitely repeat it agin when I come back for the laugh we had and amazing simple instructions we got from the lovely chefs. This is one of the few experiences I could count it as a real life-time experience.

Really fun and wonderful experience. The location is beautiful and the food tastes great. One thing to note though is that it does not necessarily run at the times listed when you book and we ended up having to take a private taxi to make it to our next thing without missing it because they were going long and would not bring us to the metro station without the group.
The most amazing experience! Very knowledgable about food and great value for money. The food was exceptional, we had the best day ever 🙌

If your in Rome, BOOK A COOKING CLASS!!!

If your in Rome, BOOK THIS COOKING CLASS!!!

Amazing, special once in a lifetime experience
hosts were very funny and informative, the cats nearby were very cute too. Well paced experience with lots of good food and drink throughout!

It's been a wonderful day! There was a lot of
Passionate about the ingredients and how they respond to each other. You can make pizza and pasta not just with your hands, but with your heart. Like the Italians love their food. The passion and the fun of it all dropped off. It was very nice and cozy. My son (10 years old) was the youngest of the company but enjoyed it. We will definitely try to make pasta and pizza at home with the things we learned today.
I personally would have liked to know how we could prepare a nice sauce, but that is not the most difficult part I think, so we will definitely come to an agreement. Thank you for the hospitality. The casual atmosphere was very relaxed! It was a very nice experience!!
Giuseppe and his team were very informative and helped us learn to make incredible pizza and pasta. We laughed a lot and met some great people!

This was a really fun experience and it was in a beautiful location. We made our pizza and pasta and received so much knowledge. I enjoyed the humor and jokes by the hosts it was an enjoyable time. After we finished they arranged transportation through taxi and shuttle. We were told we could take a walk through the first street built in the Roman empire and I’m glad I took that option, it was a beautiful walk.
We had a terrific time! The experience teaches you how to make pizza and pasta like a true Italian, in an environment that’s beautiful, welcoming, and FUN.

Giuseppe provided a very fun experience. He has a lot of personality and was very engaging with the class. We learned the basics of making pizza and pasta and everything was delicious. The class was bigger than expected (~30 people) but still felt very personalized
