This class is built for people with tough skin! The teachers are knowledgeable, and have been doing this for a long time. But they have no problem telling you that something looks “absolutely terrible”. It’s always said as a joke, but definitely only take this class if you can handle some negative feedback.

We learned how to spread pizza dough, decorate a pizza, and make two shapes of pasta!

This was such a fun afternoon! Mersad has a wonderful personality and very funny. He was engaging and interactive with all the guests. We spent most of the day laughing and eating. The learning experience was unlike any other in such a peaceful setting. The food we made was delicious and the other guests were fun to get to know. I would highly recommend with a companion or alone.

I liked the experience, the atmosphere was cheerful. However, we didn't make the pizza dough because the dough can't be prepared that far in advance as they told me. ( It was what I wanted to learn). But the atmosphere was very fun and I recommend it with pleasure!
We really enjoyed our day, the set up worked well with pizza making first then learning about making the doughs and pasta shapes. The food was delicious and the setting was stunning.
This experience is well worth the cost. Both hosts are a lot of fun and the food is just wonderful. I would recommend this to anyone who enjoys cooking.
Exceptionally fun experience in rural historical part of Rome. The best Airbnb experience we have had so far in Italy. Highly recommend to everyone.

Book this class now!!! It was such a great experience to learn how to cook a pizza (properly) along with pasta. The hosts were incredibly funny and such a blast to have teach us their traditions. Not only did we leave with our bellies happy, but with new friends as well.

Surprise, surprise, surprise! That is the best way for me to sum up this experience. I came thinking it would be some cooking know-it-all showing off his talents. Instead, I met a great and interesting group of talented, fun and friendly staff! You MUST take time on your trip to Rome to experience this class. It will make your life a little better for sure!

Rich & Linda

Just book this! It was such a great way to spend an afternoon in Rome. Great way to meet people from all over and learn so much. However, it is a little tricky to find as we took a private transfer there so I would recommend just meeting up at the train station with your hosts :)

This is a MUST GO experience. The people are so delightful, the food is exceptional, and doing all of it in a beautiful place equals amazing! Would absolutely recommend to anyone that wants authentic food and great company!
We had an excellent time! Giuseppe and Mersad were fantastic teachers and we got to make and enjoy a delicious meal. Would highly recommend!
We had such a great experience! Funniest hosts and a lovely place. We ate a lot, everything was so tasty. Thank you Mersad and Giuseppe!
It was a wonderful experience and very informative! I highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Rome. A breakmin the countryside away from the city!

Wow! So grateful we got to experience this while in Rome. We only had a few days in town so we were apprehensive to book but we are so glad we did!
Pizza was the best we had in Rome and Mersad was a 5 star host. Highly recommend!
This was a nice excursion out of the city for a few hours. I loved learning how to make pizza and pasta. Mersad was an excellent teacher. His sense of humor was endearing, warm, and welcoming.
Fun for kids (ages 12 and 8) as well as adults. Nice break for kids from all of the traditional and historic sightseeing of Rome. Enjoyable day for us.

This experience is a bit outside of the city center but definitely worth the trip! I was impressed with how hands-on this class was. We each made our own pizza and were even able to take it in and out of the pizza oven. We followed that up with learning how to make 6 different pasta shapes. Giuseppe and Mersad are also hilarious, so that made the class very entertaining (although they were a little intimidating at first).
Nice and good people in a dreamy setting and a lot to see and a lot to learn and a lot to eat😊😅

Authentic experience!... I wanted an old granny yelling at me but Mersad was definitely more enjoyable. He was patient and gave me skills. I have to say this is a CORE MEMORY... We started as strangers and ended eating around the same table, laughing, drinking and living in the moment.

If you are looking for a wonderful experience in Rome, don't miss this one! The setting is a beautiful green countryside. The hosts are knowledgeable and entertaining. The combination of hands on learning and tasting was very well arranged. our group of 4, from 16 to 76 years, had a super fantastic time!

We really enjoyed our day as a group of 7. Most of the experience was very interesting and we laughed all day! The only criticism would be that the pasta making part was slightly too long. However, would recommend as we still thoroughly enjoyed the experience!

We had such an amazing day and would definitely recommend. The two chefs were so funny and the pizzas we made were delicious. Great value for money when you factor in the wine, pizza, pasta and tiramasu! Don’t be deterred by the location, it’s a short taxi ride from the centre of Rome and definitely worth the travel. Would do it all over again!
Amazing!

Excellent day out. Would thoroughly recommend. Hosts made everyone very welcome including my 12 y/o son. Chefs very knowledgable and relaxed which made for a very enjoyable and unique experience. Great food. Worth every penny.

This is a great fun experience and good value for money. Both Mersad and Giuseppe were great teachers and hosts and made it lots of fun and informal with their use of humour. Timings are very loose but that adds to the charm of the experience. Age and experience are irrelevant-it’s good for all. Definitely recommend.

If you are on a trip to Rome this is a great way to experience the city and its signature dishes as well as pick up a new skill! Learn to make pizza Romana and pasta (and later consume the delicious food) in a lovely environment. Mersad was a great teacher, very funny and with heaps of knowledge. It was an unforgettable experience, would highly recommend!

Amazing experience with the great instructors Giuseppe and Mersad!
A fun and easygoing atmosphere which makes the class pleasant. Both Mersad and Giuseppe clearly love what they do and love teaching others.

The pizza was just delicious with a lot of detail on the dough and the pastas were great as well. Not to forget, the delicious tiramisu. It was cherry on top!

Good to know that there are cats on the premises so if you have a cat allergy make sure to take your meds beforehand 😂
All was great. A fun time to get away from the hustle and bustle of Rome and learn a little more about the Pizza and Pasta making process.

Wow. This was the high point of our trip to Rome. Great location. Great team- and great team work. They really have this down. Both fun- and it was educational. Feel a lot smarter on pizza and pasta now and ready to cook. My teen girls loved it too

We had an incredible time today! Mersad and Giuseppe are both very likeable and really fun! It's also a great way to connect with people from all over the world.
You get to know different types of doughs, bake your own pizza in the stone oven, and make your own pasta! Finally, there is a really very tasty tiramisù and a limoncello by Giuseppe. I highly recommend it!

Amazing experience with this cooking class: they come to pick you up from the metro station, give you plenty of tips and trick during the class and take you back at the station at the end of the class.

we cooked (and ate) our pizza, learned to make a few pasta dough/shapes and ate them with 2 sauces : bonus for the tiramisu that was to die for.
Can't recommend this enough!

This was such a great experience and worth the price!! Giuseppe and Mersad were amazing and very funny and they made the class very enjoyable. I recommend not eating a big meal before coming to the class!
So much to learn! I loved being able to practice and learn different pizza doughs and 10 shapes of pasta. I left well fed with new friends.

FANTASTIC EXPERIENCE!! We had a lot od fun, we've met great people and have learnt a lot about real italian pizza and pasta making. Really recommend you that classes - great opportunity for spending awesome moments no matters if you're alone, with children, friends, family or with your other half. It's for everybody!
This class was very entertaining. you learn the basics about pasta and pizza. the instructors we very enthusiastic and made the class fun.

This was a great experience, I had a lot of fun and met new friends. The location is super cute, I couldn’t stop laughing, chef Giuseppe and Mersad are very entertaining and the food was amazing of course!

We had a fantastic time! I highly recommend this class for everyone. We went with our three year old and five year old. The instructors were incredibly kind to our little ones and took the time to personalize their experience.
We had such a blast with Giuseppe and Mersad! Good lads, lots of jokes and new knowledge! Will recommend anyone who is in the area!
i bought this experience to give a gift to someone I love for their birthday. Never a more pleasant and perfect gift. Thank you very much.
this was an authentic cooking experience in a leisurely, tranquil hideaway. The hosts were knowledgeable, sharing techniques and insights on making delicious pizza at home.
We had a wonderful time with our family of 7. It was a welcome getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. The kids LOVED this experience, highly recommended!
It's me second time doing the class with Giuseppe and Mersad, I guess that's all you need to know how I feel about the experience 😉 Highly recommend it!

5* amazing experience! The hosts, food, and location were all exceptional.

Importantly for me - They even catered for a vegan diet, allowing me to bring my own vegan cheese and cooking me a separate pasta dish (without egg) so I didnt feel left out or excluded.

The cooking school is in a beautiful location, 2 minutes from the Appian Way, which you can walk down all the way back to Rome centre.

Thanks Giuseppe and Mersad for an unforgettable experience! ❤️
This was such a wonderful experience! Not only was the learning process educational, but the environment was fun and welcoming! I’d definitely do this again!

Experience was "Perfetto" as my homemade pizzas and pasta from now on. Very informative lessons with all answered questions. Perfect weather outside, sitting in the garden with a few unknown people from all over the world and starting interesting conversations and eating your made pizza and later on pasta --- Thank you, Grazie, Ačiū.

It was really amazing experience. Lots of delicious food prepared under the best advice of joking chefs. :D The softest pizza dough I have ever touched and tasted plus so satisfying to work with, many shapes of pasta and exclusive tiramisu. Beautiful surroundings and all the complex and while sun shining it was just perfect! Plus having the recipes in the pocket for home fun. :D Definitely recommended for everyone!

Exceptional experience. We were celebrating our anniversary and first time in Italy with our 11 year old daughter. We all LOVED!! Everyone was so warm, welcoming, and inclusive. My daughter felt so special❤️. The chefs were very engaging and humorous to say the least. Chef Mersad was my Fave!! He was very personable, upbeat, and energetic. The pizza making was my favorite part of it all. Learned new tips and tricks in this class. Beautiful location,,,, perfect venue.

Five stars to the team! Highly recommend for something different. ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

It was a fun experience located near the Appian Trail. We learned a lot about the history of Napoleon pizza and pasta making.

Chef Mersad was very friendly and made the class more entertaining.

We finally learned the proper way to make pizza and pasta. We will take what we learned and apply it at home.

I would recommend this class to my friends! (:

This cooking class was the highlight of our trip to Rome. They took their time teaching us how to make authentic pizza & many different types of pasta. At the end we enjoyed the homemade pasta in the garden and had delicious tiramisu and limoncello. Giuseppe and Mersad are the best—can’t recommend enough!!

We had a great time making pizza and pasta with Giuseppe and Mersad! They were great hosts and the whole experience was fun. Not only do you get to have a hands on cooking experience, but you also leave with the knowledge of how to do it at home. Highly recommend!

I had such a great experience going to this cooking class. We took a taxi directly to the class (from the Trastevere neighborhood) and it was a quick ride over. The class takes place in a beautiful and lush garden and is very intimate. We got to meet people from all over the world while we made pizzas and pasta. Giuseppe and Mersad were fantastic teachers, guides, and entertainers. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for an experience outside of the chaos of center city Rome.

I have been to Rome a few times so wanted to do something a little differnt this time. This exceeded all my expectations. Right from the moment we met at the metro it was an incredible experience, the guys doing it were so personable and funny. I learned so much and it is set in a fabulous location. I shall be recommending this when ever anyone I know is going over.
One of the best experiences in Rome, 3rd time in Rome and this experience was one of the best experiences, hosts were amazing, knowledgeable and fun!! 10/10 reccomend!

An amazing experience. Both of them were humorous but also great teachers. We had a really great time creating and eating what we made. Plus the location was amazing and Karina the kitty was super cute. 10/10 recommend !
great communication and easy to coordinate getting there, hosts are a lot of fun and deliver really interesting content really well. And the food is of course delicious!
One of the best things we did on our trip to Italy. We were on a mother/son(14 years old) trip and this class was entertaining and fun for both of us!

Die Pizza & Pasta-Class was lovely! Giuseppe and Mersad were wonderful, we had a lot of fun and the food was great. The location really was far away from the busy city center but we were picked up at & driven back to the metro station.

I would have preferred a smaller group though... They started the pizza class in three different groups but we all took the pasta class together. Since we were in the first pizza class, the wait-time was a bit too long.

Incredible experience and worth the money! Giuseppe and his partners were so fun to be around. You learn not only the beat way to make pizza and pasta, but also the science behind how to make the perfect dough. Highly recommend!
We had an amazing day at the cooking class. It was very informative and great fun. It was one of our favourite days in Rome, we loved it! 🍕🍝

Great class for beginners, the banter between the two hosts was so fun! Made everyone feel comfortable and ready to make some excellent food. Tons of cats roaming around the property which is always a plus!
Once in a lifetime experience! This is a must do if you have a free day in Rome. So much value for your money! Plan a day of it and walk Appia Antica afterwards

this cooking experience was truly wonderful! Chef Giuseppe and his assistant Chef Mersad were enthusiastic and took the time to really show you the way to make the pizza, and make the different pasta shapes. We wereable to chat with other guests and take about our time in Rome. the Atmosphere was pleasant and the setting of this class is just wonderful. the weather was so beautiful and sitting outside eating fresh pizza and pasta was the best part of our time in Rome. I would highly recommend this class and this truly one of a kind experience!

Such a fun experience with Mersad! Along with all the fun, we actually learned to prepare pizza and pasta (and drink the wine). It was informative, a delicious meal (best pizza I have had), and entertaining!

We walked the Appian Way back but when traffic became heavy we grabbed a bus.

We had a great experience! 😍
Its a magical place and the staff are funny attentive and explained everything on the best side!
it was the best experience we had in Rome, I recommend to everyone.

A great day in the sun, at a wonderful location, with 2 great chefs of clearly enjoy what they do.
Would recommend to anyone!

this experience is amazing and delicious. Guiseppe and Mersad are wonderful hosts, chefs and teachers. the pizza and pasta you make is easy, delectable and something you can learn for future meals. must do in Rome!
It was great. A bit rushed at the beginning, without any introduction etc. But very overall very pleasant. The environment is calming, the pizza was excellent and both chefs are really nice.

Such a great experience. Mersad was super fun, helpful and informative and kept everyone entertained. Definitely one of the highlights of the entire trip and will recommend to all friends and family traveling to Rome!
My family of 4 (12&14 year old boys+husband) enjoyed it immensely. The chefs were were entertaining and engaging. If you're jet lagged, you won't fall asleep here!

A great experience, an essential taste of Italy. Mersad and Giuseppe provide a warm and friendly environment to learn and experience making pizza and pasta. It is an easy going class to learn the basics, relax and enjoy.

This was an incredible experience and I highly recommend it to all. Both chefs are hilarious while being very helpful. All the food turned out fantastic, and it was great value. Beautiful location as well!
Mersad is a fun and lively instructor! The food was delicious, and it was a pleasure meeting people from all over the world! The location is also a short walk to the first Roman road!

These two chefs are like their own act! They are funny, friendly and talented! They unite the group together and keep a fun energy in the kitchen where we learn to make pizza and pasta from scratch!
The lady driver who collects/drops off at the metro is also friendly. Although the roads and metros in the area are a bit run down, that is not to take from this experience !
We had tiramisu and lemon chello after our pasta& pizza.
One of the chefs recommended a great idea to us after the experience which again worked out really well and helped us all become friends.
Would highly recommend!

Chef Giuseppe & Mersad were a great team of hosts. They were super friendly and took care of transportation and suggested activities for after the class as well. Their banter back and forth with one another and their jokes with the participants were very enjoyable.

I would suggest for anyone wanting to learn how to make pizza and pasta the right way take this class. Make sure you ask Chef Giuseppe about his “love” for Chicago-style pizza, Johnny from Birmingham, and Juventus.

And for anyone who doesn’t like pineapple pizza, ask Giuseppe about what he thinks of it!

It was amazing! We had a blast and ate really well! Don't have breakfast, first meal at 11: 30 a.m.! 49 euros is a little to pay for a good pizza, a big dish of pasta, 1 part of an excellent tiramisu (the best we've had in Rome) and a digestive. Unlimited wine.

We loved our class with Giuseppe and Mersad!! Perfect for families with teenagers who need to be engaged but also learn something. Location is very cute, outside the city, easy on the metro. Loved that we learned pizza and pasta instead of many other classes just focusing on pasta! And it is basically a whole day of activity- we didn’t finish until about 3:30- so great value.

Easily one of the best parts of my trip to Rome. We were taken to a peaceful, remote location with adorable cats wandering around. Our chef Mersad was hilarious and talented; he did an awesome job of bringing energy to the class and making everyone feel comfortable around each other.

The pizza that Mersad showed us how to make was hands-down the best pizza I've ever had, made even more special because I had made it. I made some wonderful memories and friends at this experience. I have nothing but good things to say.

If you're in Rome, you NEED to do this experience.

Now I can go back to my friends and family and make them some authentic Neapolitan pizza!

Thanks so much for the amazing experience.
Great, it was a really fun day, we met new people, practiced our English and learned various secrets of Italian cuisine. Excellent human team. Fully recommended.
This was a great experience. The location was beautiful and we learned a lot about making pasta and pizza. I would highly recommend this.
I highly recommend this cooking class. It was very fun, hands on, and Giuseppe and Mersad provided a lot of information. The food was delicious and the hosts were very personable.

We had a fun morning. It's more a pizza & pasta making class (the host did most of the cooking). We learned to make a good dough and shape pasta etc. I liked that we could ask any questions and get good answers. There are loads of cats around, some are quite friendly, which was just another highlight of our day.
Walking back on Via Appia Antica was the best finish to the experience.

Wonderful experience. Mersad's english is really good and he passes on his knowledge with humor.
We really learned a lot and will try everything at home.
I can recommend this experience.

After reading all the rave reviews, I had high expectations. I am amazed that Giuseppe and Mersad managed to exceed my already absurdly high expectations. My family consists of 7 people, one of which has special needs and is in a wheelchair. Not only did they accommodate our young, special needs kiddo, (Including accommodation with transportation) they managed to interact with each member of the family, both child and adult, in exactly the way they needed, individually. To say they have excellent people-reading skills is putting it mildly. Giuseppe and Mersad continually checked in with us to make sure we were enjoying ourselves and had everything that we needed. The care they put into the class is apparent, their attention to detail is impeccable. We love that they send a PDF of the class materials so we can recreate this wonderful memory at home. Traveling with a medically complex, special needs child is not easy, to say the least. But Giuseppe and Mersad made it just that - EASY! We were able to enjoy our day with our other three kiddos, and have memories that will last a lifetime.

Giuseppe and Mersad-
Our family can not thank you enough!

Shannon

This was an amazing experience! Both cooks were extremely funny and made our time there wonderful. I have a gluten allergy and they were very accommodating I felt very safe eating my food. The van ride there was a little interesting, but honestly made the experience even more one of a kind. Highly recommend!
This was such an amazing experience! The food was delicious and the process of making everything was enjoyable. The atmosphere was fun and full of laughter.
We had an absolutely great time. Giuseppe and Mersad were friendly, funny, but most of all very knowledgeable. They also made everyone feel welcome.
Probably the best experience I have been too. We learnt how to do a pizza in a wooden oven and pasta from scratch. We couldn't stop laughing the whole time! Great chefs and entertainers.

Belle and Mersad were perfect guests, and they taught us the secrets of making great Neapolitan pizza and different kinds of pasta, both water and egg. The best part was, of course, to eat what we made with our own hands (the pizza cooked in the wood oven is absolutely stunning), including two types of pasta that are expertly seasoned by hosts. I recommend this experience to all those who love to immerse themselves in the Italian culinary tradition and who are happy to create something really good with their own hands

We booked this a couple of days before, it exceeded our expectations and we are so glad we picked this particular experience after scrolling through so many.
You are picked up, taken to a beautiful location just outside the city. It really feels like you’ve escaped into the countryside, seeing the real Roma.
Both hosts are incredibly personable and funny, we laughed from start to finish.
After the experience was finished, we sat outside in the sunshine eating what we prepared, followed by the best Tiramisu I’ve tasted (I even managed to get seconds as there was one left). Shortly followed by a shot lemoncello.
As it was such a nice day, we decided to walk back to the city, following the oldest road in Rome, definitely worth doing if you don’t mind a long walk (1.5hr) however there are buses you can catch along the way.

Chef guisiuppe and meras are funny, insightful, professional and knowledgeable! We loved every minute of this booking, we took our hat we applied to class and plan to make all recipes at home! The experience was 4 hours , we ate pizza, pasta, tiramisu (amazing!!!), limoncello and wine. We had so many laughs and learned so much. You will not regret this experience! Do not wait. Book it now!

I don’t know where to start..the hosts were super nice and friendly..the vibes were positive and joyful..I personally joined just for fun not looking for any professional pizza making advices..and it was worth every penny..the pizza came out delicious.. I would recommend this experience to everyone who is visiting (Website hidden by Airbnb) worth it..and the place was the cherry on top
Thank you for having us..till we meet again
Really, really cool experience. Mersad was hilarious, fun, and certainly an expert on pizza and pasta. Met some great people and had an amazing time. Would definitely recommend!

The cooking class as described by reviews was an amazing experience. I am so glad that I came across this specific experience. I will definitely recommend this to friends and family as well as coworkers. Best pizza I ever had and pasta was just as amazing. The laughter was just the added bonus.

This was a great experience ! It was easily accesible by metro as they pick you (Email hidden by Airbnb) munication with host was well and no miscommunication. Everyone present seemed to enjoy their time.
Probably my favourite part of our trip to Rome. We had great conversations and Chef Giuseppe was very funny and knowledgeable. Looking forward to going to his future restaurant in Mauritius!

This was such a great way to spend a Saturday in rome! We loved getting outside the city to the farm and it was much easier to reach than we expected! The transfer from the metro station was a very nice addition and the cooking class itself was awesome! We learned so much and the food was great! The conversations were amazing and both chefs were super friendly. Highly recommend to anyone visiting rome and looking to learn how to make some pasta and pizza!!

I would highly recommend this cooking class, best pizza I have had so far in Rome. The class was great fun and we learned a lot. The teacher Mersad was very funny and knowledgeable. Great value for money.

First of all, this is not just a cooking class. This is an amazing experience. Giuseppe and Mersad, our hosts, are not only great chefs, but entertainers. We made new friends, learned how to prepare pizza and some other pasta types. Communication with them were also excellent. Strongly recommend, even if you have kids - which was my case.

Mersad and Guiseppe are such a fun duo to learn pasta and pizza making. They were greatly informative in showing tips on crafting many types of pasta. I think this class is a great way to get out of the busy city center of Rome and escape to a quite and relaxing location.

The class is so much fun! It was very well done and you learn a lot beyond just how to make the foods. The location made the class feel even more authentic as it is out in farmlands. Everyone should definitely try a cooking class when in Italy, and I highly recommend this one!

We really enjoyed the cooking class. We not only learned a lot, we laughed a lot.
The course takes place just outside, so you can be picked up at the metro station. On the property there is an indoor area where you can prepare the pizza and pasta at tables and an outdoor area with olive trees where you can enjoy them in the sun. We had a lot of fun with our international group and a lot of laughs. Mersad and Guiseppe do a great job and have a lot of patience. Our highlight was the Napolitan pizza, a treat we won't forget in a hurry.
The course is a good balance to the typical sightseeing tours. We highly recommend it!

These two make the perfect duo merging both comedy and thoughtful teachings of how to make a prepare food. My girlfriend and I had a great time talking and hanging out with them, I would highly recommend them to anyone in my life.
100% recommended. I was my family and the children had a great time and the adults had a great time too, in addition to learning, having a very good time and eating very well.

Had a phenomenal time learning how to make pizza and pasta from scratch. Giuseppe and Mersad were incredibly sweet, patient and informative. Everything was delicious and I even met some lovely people along the way. I would definitely recommend this experience for anyone visiting Rome.
This class was a lot of fun and incredibly informative! I learned a lot about pasta, dough and giggle the whole time. Do not miss the opportunity to take this class!!

This experience was magical. The setting is a beautiful wooden and glass structure that allows you to appreciate the nature around you while being sheltered during the colder winter months when we took the class. Our instructors Giuseppe and Mersad - a funny and dynamic duo - guided us through the various parts of the course (1. shape a pizza dough, 2. top it, 3. cook it in a wood burning oven, 4. eat our personal pizza, 5. make dough [3 different types were made a. pizza, b. egg based pasta, c. water based pasta] 6. learn to make many different shapes of pasta, 7. prepare pasta for cooking, 8. eat fresh pasta and dessert!). Giuseppe, a seasoned chef, gave us many pointers, tips, and context and taught from the perspective of best principles; in my view, a much more lasting approach to learning. His hands-on approach to teaching the techniques with the help of his excellent assistant Mersad, we gained great experience and enjoyed lots of laughter. And at the end, we all received a copy of instructions to remember all that we learned.

Overall, I was deeply grateful to have found this experience, to have met our wonderful instructors, and have had the opportunity to be part of the environment they created with laughter, food and beautiful outdoors that attracted lovely people from around the world.

Location is down a very bumpy dirt road in the middle of no where, a taxi company does not like to drop you off or pick you up there so take the shuttle offered from the train station. Looks very sketchy walking up to the location. Really just in their spare barn with a pizza oven. Pizza or pasta toppings didn’t include any meat, which you would think for the price and experience it would. My major issue was the hosts crude sense of humor. Making jokes at the expense of guests and being mildly rude when you are not good at making pizza or pasta. Clearly if I was good at it I wouldn’t be in the class trying to learn. They do not seem eager to actually teach, just make you feel bad for not already knowing how. Also, if you do not speak Italian you will feel entirely left out as most of the class was done in Italian so you miss out of the jokes and addition information as he just translates parts to English. Overall, fine experience just not professional or welcoming for English speaking people without a crude sense of humor. The cats are nice though.

THIS was the highlight of my trip to Italy!! Giuseppe and Mersad made everyone feel welcome! It felt like I was meeting up with old friends that wanted to share their passion: pizza and pasta! Not only will you eat good food, you will have an amazing time where you leave with the warmth of friendship, the pride of making something delicious, and the memories of an amazing time! I cannot wait to start making pasta and pizza with my friends at home! Could not recommend more!!

We did the experience with Mersad and we loved it! The whole experience felt both fun and practical, especially considering that they share information about how to recreate these great recipes at home (with adapted ingredients if needed). A huge plus is that the recipes are shared with you after the class. I would definitely recommend it (especially for those doing it with a partner).

This is so much fun AND educational AND good for the whole family! You get fed well with wine, fruit juice and dessert, your hands are busy, it’s outdoors-y (very well ventilated!) peaceful location, cats and goats out the window were endearing to the children, bathrooms were clean, and sanitation required of all for comfort and safety.
The banter and fun between Chef Giuseppe and Chef Mirsad put everyone in the mood to have fun.
***My daughter has made pizza as a side hustle during CoVid and does pizza very well but she picked up tips and answers to some mysteries she had wondered about. She really loved it- and that’s a 100% success ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ when it comes to teens! Do it!!!

Super experience. Had tremendous fun and also learned how to prepare and make dough for pizza and pasta. Delicious pizza and pasta that satisfy you so don’t have a big breakfast. Afterwards received a document with all information to recreate what we tasted and prepared during the experience. When in Rome and you want a break of the crowded city, this is the thing to do!

Amazing class, probably one of the highlights of our trip.
Really recommend it for anyone that wants to get out of the city for a bit and have an incredible experience.
The class itself is very thorough and the host is very friendly, plus the food is really good.
Again, highly recommended!

My husband and I had an AMAZING experience during this cooking class. I had quite high expectations after reading the raving reviews here and we were not disappointed at all. The location itself was beautiful and unique! Mersad was a very entertaining instructor and kept everyone engaged throughout, with clear explanations and instructions and quite a big dose of humour :) the pizza we made were actually better than many of the pizzas we had in Italy and the pastas were delicious too. Highly recommend attending this cooking class if you are looking for something unique and fun to try while in Rome :)

This class has a lot of potential, but at least part of each of the items are prepared out of sight of the class, so we didn't feel like we could replicate any of it at home, and the PDF that is sent later is not particularly useful in that regard. The directions were given once, and occasionally demonstrated when not everyone could see or hear.
I also think we may have come on an "off" day, but we were uncomfortable with the coarse joking and insults between the teachers and sometimes directed at members of the class.
Also, for those concerned about heath measures- since the weather is cooler, all the sliding doors were closed most of the time, so the class isn't really outdoor or socially distanced (and our greenpass was not requested or verified).
The wine, lemoncello, and tiramisu were really yummy, and interacting with other attendees and the teacher Mersed made the time spent in class pleasant and worth it.
Beautiful experience... perfect mix of professionalism and fun from chef Belle and Mersad, not to mention the good food. Helpful and highly recommended for Romans like me as well.
Great experience and a must have for enyone who wants a taste of a great Italian cuisine and ofcourse mersad gave us a really enjoyable experience!
We had SO much fun and we even made new friends. The whole experience was full of fun and jokes while making amazing food. I would do it again!

Great experience in a great place. The food was delicious, the hosts were very welcoming and super friendly. I would definitely recommend the class.
PS. After the delicious meal you could walk on Via Appia Antica back to the center.

Loved this class! One of the highlights of Rome. This duo is really hilarious with their playful banter. The pizza that we made was the best I had in all of Rome. They were very accommodating of my sister who is gluten free.
The experience was great and I would highly recommend it. Mersad and Giussepe were very funny, we had a lot of fun, learned how to make Pizza and Pasta, and the food was great.
It is a great experience! All of us enjoyed the pizza making and pasta making. Great experience for our large group (13)! Would do it again!
This was an awesome family experience. The food was amazing and we'll use what we learned from the class every time we make pizza. What a cool learning experience!
Excellent experience... better pizza in all of Rome, the way of teaching is unique... I think of the whole trip to Rome was one of the most fun and unique family experience... 110% recommended

Funny experience to learn the basics of pizza NAPOLITENA and pasta cooking, we got a few tips to take back home. The two chefs are making fun of themselves all the way long, and we got engaged too, they can laugh about themselves and that’s appreciate:)

Amazing experience, it’s a fun and different activity to do while in Rome. The pizza we made was one of the best we had in Rome, how awesome is that! Super friendly, and they really took care of my food allergies, 100% recommend.
We really enjoyed out time learning to make pizza and pasta from Chef Giuseppe and Chef Mersad. The experience was very personalized and we got to meet amazing people.
This is a must do Experience when visiting Rome or even for the locals. It will be an experience we'll have for a lifetime. Thank you all for making it so great!

We really enjoyed today’s cooking class. Finding the point of contact at the metro stop was very easy! We started with pizza which was great because we ate almost immediately. The homemade drinks and tiramisu was fantastic. Join this class! Great experience outside the city-center.

Both chefs were very knowledgeable and I like that they provided additional documents/notes for us to take home. Best part was their playfulness. Made the whole experience funny! Great pizza, great pasta, great company, great time.

Amazing experience not to be missed. Highly recommend. Giuseppe and Mersad are very knowledgeable, funny and make the class super fun. Would definitely advise you look into this when you’re in Rome for something a bit different to do. 11/10!!
We had excellent time with Giuseppe and Mersad in their amazing garden. And we made one of the best pizzas we ever tasted.
this class was awesome! So much food! Learned how to make different types of pasta which was cool! Also got a slice of delicious tiramisu! It was a great day!

This was one of the best experiences we had during our 2 weeks in Italy. There is so much to do and see, around Rome, but an interpersonal experience where you have fun and learn a WONDERFUL new skill you can take back home is absolutely recommended. Giuseppe and Mersan were great fun and we lucked out with an extremely interesting and diverse group! 12/10 stars!

This experience exceeded my expectations by far and they were high to begin with. Everyone was so friendly and the food was amazing. I would 100% recommend this to anyone who loves pizza, pasta, and flavor authenticity.

Mersad and Giuseppe are really great hosts that make the experience really personal. It's not just regular cooking. They tell you some background stories about the food and are open to any questions. You're very well taken care of and they make you feel at ease. Definitely recommend going here!!

Could not recommend this experience more. Honestly one of the highlights of the entire trip. Giuseppe and Mersad made such a fun, tasty and enjoyable class. I would highly recommend this to anyone who loves pizza and pasta and is looking for a fun and authentic Italian experience.

Giuseppe and Mersad were excellent and engaging hosts with a great knowledge of their craft, even felt like I was back in chemistry class when Mersad was talking through yeast (this is a good thing not bad!) would definitely recommend this to a friend and anyone that would ask! thanks for a great time & great food
Such a fun cooking experience in a really interesting and eclectic part of Rome! Both hosts were so knowledgeable and personable. I highly recommend!
This is a "must be" point on your visit to Italy/Rome. Great atmosphere during the classes, lot of positive people and calm place outside od Rome center. And of course tasty food;)
We had a great time with Giuseppe and Mersad. Both are excellent teachers and made the class very enjoyable and fun. Highly recommend the class.
We had Merced for our chef, and he was wonderful! He was so personable and made the event so much fun. I would definitely recommend this tour/food experience!

Guiseppe and Mersad were excellent hosts. I was the only person that needed a gluten free accommodation and they came through with flying colors. Guiseppe had just been experimenting with the proportion of ingredients in the GF dough and it turned out to be delicious. We made pizza first, ate it, and then sat down to pasta and ate that. I couldn't finish my pizza but they gave me a box to take it home. Our group joined another group that had started before us, so we were probably 12-15 people in total, but Guiseppe and Mersad were great about talking to and engaging with everyone and kept the laughs coming.
Great experience and the best pizza as a result! Recommend to try to get to know the secrets of great Italian food :) the hosts were knowledgeable, welcoming and attentive!
This class was so fun! Learned a lot and ate even more 😂 The chefs Giuseppe and Mersad are both funny and amicable. It was a great time and we met people from all over the world.

Amazing experience. Giuseppe and Mersad were really nice people and great teachers. They made the experience super personal and really enjoyable. It's definitely one of the highlights of our trip. Highly recommended!
I really enjoyed the hosts were funny and professional. Everyone who reads this must go there! You will not regret it at all !!!

I would 100% recommend this experience to complete your visit to Rome! Giuseppe and Mersad are two great hosts who perfectly transmit all their knowledge so that you leave with a very clear concept of how to make pasta and pizza at home! very complete the whole workshop!

We spontaneously booked this course the evening before due to bad weather.
Guiseppe picked us up at the Laurentina metro station and drove us to green Rome. During the very fun course, we were able to take some new knowledge with us and at the end of the day we were able to test our own pasta (there was pizza at the beginning).

Recommended for someone who likes to walk: a combination with a tour through the catacombs. These are only 45 minutes away on foot and lead over the old Roman road with beautiful surroundings (Mersad tells you the right way, as (Hidden by Airbnb) maps wants to take a detour).
Awesome time! They are funny. Food good too. Beware of the cats, they will get into the cannolis you have in your purse.

We had such a wonderful time. So many nice people and so much good food! Giuseppe and Mersad are great instructors – kind, passionate and so much fun. If you get the chance – book this experience! We would love to come again someday.

Giuseppe was great! He is funny and a wonderful chef. We enjoyed the day at the farm. We each made a delicious pizza and then learned how to make various types of pasta. We then cooked and ate the pasta. The event was ended with tiramisu and limoncello. We are very happy we attended this experience.
A wonderful experience. Giuseppe and Mersad made the whole experience great fun. The food was delicious. And after 18 months of limited travel it was great to meet people from all over the world.
We had a great time at the class and really enjoyed the whole day. Guiseppe and Mersad were great and made it fun and easy. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Rome!

Giuseppe was an incredible host, and along with Mersad we learned so much about the art of pasta and pizza making. The location is amazing, the experience was a 10/10. If you have the time and means, take this class!

Amazing experience, would definitely recommend it to everyone who’s visiting Rome. Perfect to see something else than just the city center, and an amazing experience to make your own delicious pizza and pasta. And most importantly, great atmosphere and Giuseppe and Mersad were amazing. 10/10

Loved the experience. You can tell dedication and attention to craft is what these men take pride in. The time frame may alter as we waited over 15 minutes to leave when they made us stick to a strict time frame. Overall, I would do it again as we met some beautiful people from all over.Quick note. pretty sure a lot of americans do this experience, so making them feel welcome with all of their traditions like taking pictures to capture the moment is essential.

Both Giuseppe and Mersad were very nice and fun to talk to. However, the group feels too big, and the class itself is too shallow when it comes to making the pasta. Making the Pizza was fun and more interesting/in-depth compared to the pasta making.

The experience itself was enjoyable, but too pricey in my opinion.
This experience was awesome. Giuseppe was flexible with timing ( there was a taxi strike) and quick to respond. The class was informative, fun and a great time. Highly recommend!
This was an amazing experience - the food was great, the hosts were great, and we met people from all around the world. Would highly recommend this experience!

Our 2 chefs were great and we liked chatting with them. We felt like the group size was way too big (two groups of 10/11 people, 21/22 total when combined) and the cooking is extremely guided. We were really hoping to learn the measurements and the process to be able to bring that knowledge back to our home countries and we didn’t get that—we made pasta dough in plastic plates with pre-measured cups of water. The people were very nice and engaging but we were disappointed we didn’t pick a more involved cooking experience.

the teachers were very funny and friendly. it Was a great experience and we are thinking now of Göttingen a proportional oben to be able to Cook this fantastisch Pizza
thank you for una buona guornata

We are experienced international travelers and have done multiple "experiences" beyond the typical sightseeing. I can honestly say that this was the most fun (and useful) experience we have had. I make pizza and fresh pasta at home but now I will make them much better. Giuseppe and Mersad are not only great teachers but also great showmen. I cannot recommend this experience more highly!!

We had a wonderful time learning about the art of making different types of pasta and pizza! The class takes place in the quiet country side which is a nice break from the busy streets of Rome. The chefs are hilarious and you can see their passion for food in the way they teach. 10/10 amazing experience!
Totally worthwhile experience. You learn, make, and eat delicious food in a beautiful space and with an amazing and passionate team. Absolutely recommend it!
Fantastic hosts and class. Guiseppe is a very fun and friendly and big thanks to Mersad too for making the experience so enjoyable! Would definitely recommend.
Incredible!!!! Phenomenal no one better than these two. Best value Incredible experience no detail left out. You wont find more caring and wonderful pair for your experience!
It's been a very fun and tasty experience! It's a good start to definitely get to know the quirks of pasta, but above all, to have a fantastic time with friends

One of our favorite parts of our trip to Rome. Mersad and Giuseppe were fun, funny, and personable and made the class full of laughter. We were shocked at how delicious our food was, and enjoyed meeting so many other people from around the world in our class. Would recommend to anyone visiting Rome!

The pizza and pasta making experience with Giuseppe and his team was incredible. Beautiful location, and more than beautiful food. Really enthusiastic with time to explain every detail - excellent value, as well.
We absolutely loved this experience! Very interactive and the chefs were really funny (helps us ease into the making of the pizza and pasta!).

We absolutely loved our cooking class with Giuseppe and Mersad. They were so informative and brilliant fun. They really made the time to get to know us all as well which just made it feel so personal. Would highly recommend this experience for something abit more unique to do whilst you are in Rome 🇮🇹🍕🍝
Giuseppe, Mersad and Elena were nice and kind and it was great learning new things, as well as preparing, cooking and eating our own pizza and pasta.

This was such an amazing experience! They really took the time to engage with everyone and get to know each individual personally. We all shared conversations and had some pretty good laughs. Highly recommend this experience to not only learn how to make amazing pizza and pasta, but to also meet new people. Overall, my fiancé and I had a wonderful time and would strongly recommend it for anyone visiting Rome!

Absolutely great experience!! Mersad was so knowledgeable and took great care in his work. He was kind, funny, and was interested in getting to know us personally, which made the experience so incredible. Oh, and the pizza and pasta was incredible also!!

Fantastic experience! Very well organized! Giuseppe and his team were lovely hosts. They were funny and thoughtful and not least professional. They gave us some great insights into the pizza and pasta making. We enjoyed ourselves and would definitely recommend this experience to everyone who loves making Italian pasta!
Great pizza and pasta cooking class. We did this as a family with our two children and the kids especially like making the pizzas.

The Pizza and Pasta making class with Giuseppe and Mersad was the highlight of our family trip! They were so welcoming and great teachers. Giuseppe picking us up from the train station was a great accommodation. The outdoor classroom was so beautiful. Please make sure to come hungry because you will definitely be full after this experience. I've been practicing my recipes since being home and love the great tips they provided. Don't hesitate, book now!

If I could give them seven stars, I would! Such a wonderful experience. Not only was the food we made fantastic, but I really learned a lot, too. And Giuseppe and Mersad are fabulous hosts. Can’t recommend highly enough.
It was the best pizza I ever eaten. they gave us great techniques for napolitan pizza and pastas for me to practice at home.
I recommend Giuseppe’s class to anyone staying in Rome! It is very fun and informational. You will leave learning a lot about cooking and the history of pizza/pasta.
Giuseppe and mehrsad were great teachers and had a good sense of humor. The vibe was relaxed and the food was great. Would definitely recommend to all.

Incredible experience that I would recommend to anyone. From start to finish Giuseppe and Mersad made the enjoyable and funny! Definitely inspired us to try all the recipes at home and get a pizza oven!

Really good food! Had fun making the pizzas, learned an easy technique. Also had fun learning how to make the different pasta types. Recap:
- learn how to make dough
- learn how to prepare and bake a pizza
- learn how to make pasta shapes
- don’t make any sauces

Giuseppe makes everything very easy to follow and simple for newbies. Great time!

Giuseppe, Mersad and Elena were very very nice people. We learned a lot and had a lovely time with great food and nice people in the class! A great afternoon spend and I would definitely recommend this class. Pizza, pasta, tiramisu, wine, limoncello, everything was great and the ambiance was very nice. Thanks for everything!

Giuseppe and Marsad were so wonderful and funny. They welcomed us and our pasta ignorance with open arms. The experience started with tasty homemade drinks, jokes and facts surrounded the pizza making experience, a break for eating and then a group activity making pasta together with fun and kind travelers. Even when I messed up my pizza dough, Marsad came to the rescue and made me feel better. 10/10 would recommend.
Other than educational, it was sooo much fun and all 3 hosts were friendly, full of energy and happy. It was a very positive and fun experience.

It was an enjoyable experience, the hosts were very nice, we've witness the miracle of Italian cooking in a contry-side environment, with friendly people and good wine. In my opinion, this experience is a must for everybody transiting Rome, even for a day!

This experience was so fun! Giuseppe was hilarious and also so knowledgeable about all the details when it comes to making pasta and pizza. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who’s interested, and the location was so cute and outdoorsy.

Really enjoyed the experience. The location of the place was a little strange, it’s a ten minute drive from the metro station (they pick you up) but it’s in the untidy country part. Little intimidating if you go there solo but since it’s a group tour it was fine. The facilities are fine, the teachers are great and the atmosphere was fun and relaxed.

I would definitely recommend this experience with Giuseppe, Mersad.& Elena They are all very funny and had awesome stories to share! Joe had more fun than he thought he would! We had a wonderful afternoon and met new friends who we will be sure to keep in touch with!! we even saw a couple today during our adventures around Rome today, what are the odds right?
Thank you for an amazing time guys. When we are back in Rome, will be sure to book again!!

This was one of my favorite things I did while in Rome. Such a fun class and I met some amazing people. Mersad, Giuseppe, and Elena were wonderful! And you get to eat pizza, pasta, and tiramisu! What more could you want? So so fun! Would definitely recommend!
It was an absolutely amazing experience. We had so much fun. Giuseppe was an amazing teacher and so friendly. I really recommend this experience to anyone visiting Rome.

Great AirBnB experience! I booked this last minute class with a friend, and it was a great way to spend a Sunday in Rome when so many other attractions are closed. Elena picked us up from the metro station and after only about a 15 minute drive, we were at a remote agricultural site that felt like it was in rural Italy. The class itself was the perfect mix of instructional and experiential, with groups small enough that Giuseppe & Mersad could help when needed and make sure we had a beautiful finished product. We were lucky to have a friendly mix of solo travelers, couples and friends, and got to enjoy our dishes with wine and other beverages. Highly recommend!
Giuseppe, Mersad and Elena were great Hosts amd Instructors! We had a great time cooking, learning and enjoying great wine and very tasty food. We definitely recommend!

I appreciated learning how to cook pizza and the many different types of pasta.

There’s a lot of helpful information to learn and digest and the pizza was amazing!
Guiseppe and the team were fantastic! Such a fun experience for anyone looking to do something a little different! Recommend to anyone visiting Rome

Guiseppe and Mersad are very friendly, knowledgeable and have a great passion for food. It was excellent and insightful experience. I really recommend this class to everyone who wants to learn how to cook real Italian food.

This was an amazing experience, with very kind and friendly people. Giuseppe and his team are very passionate about pizza and pasta and they do their best to teach us what we need to know in order to make great pizza and pasta at home. The location is also very nice, they also offered us wine, natural juice and their delicious tiramisu. They are also very funny, making the learning process even nicer. I loved it!

My boyfriend and I loved meeting Giuseppe and his team and learning the fine art of italian pasta and pizza making. We had so much fun taking the quick 45min train out and seeing another part of Rome outside of the inner city. You really fit a lot in during the time you're there- and you get to eat the most amazing pizza. Would highly recommend!

My husband, 1 year old son and I had such a fun time at this experience learning how to make authentic Italian pizza and pasta!

Mersad was fun to learn from with a lot of dry humor. I wish Giuseppe could have stuck around, as he had a fun energy to him too! We learned a lot and they sent some very thorough details afterwards. Not to mention, we met a ton of great people in the process. It's a 4+ hour experience if you take into an account travel time so you'll get to know the people you're sharing the experience with, which I loved!

We're Americans and met some wonderful German friends, of which we would have hung out with afterwards had we not had to leave just a few hours later.

Thank you again for the wonderful experience!
Mersad is a legend 👍 Absolutely loved the class. Great banter. Super hosts. Great atmosphere and shared the class with nice people. I feel like a pasta pizza jedi now 🤌🤌
It was a wonderful experience… we learned a lot and enjoyed our day in a beautiful location.. we highly recommend this experience 😊

We decided to take the course because we were traveling to Rome for many days and we thought it was a very fun and interesting activity. They picked us up and took us to the place where the course is held, where we made a homemade pizza and different types of pasta. We had a really fun morning and met a lot of people from different places. We've also learned a lot about the mass production process. It is a 100% recommended experience, as it has a team of professionals.

It was amazing! Way better than we even expected. Giuseppe, Elena and Mersad were so nice and funny! They took us from the train station to the little and calm garden (and workspace) they have. Beside the kindness, they master the art of making different kinds of pasta and pizza. You will definitely learn many things and have fun. Eating everything you make + homemade tiramisu/wine. Best experience you can do in Roma.

We loved it.

Thank you again and hopefully we will meet again.
This was a really special experience. It was a great way to get to know people and learn more of Italian history and culture. Our hosts were warm, funny and engaging. We would definitely do it again!

We had a wonderful time during this class. Met great people, learned how to make pizza and pasta, ate delicious food and tiramisu and laughed a lot!! One of the BEST experiences we’ve had during our trip to Italy and recommend this class/experience to everyone who visits Rome! THANK YOU Giuseppe, Mersad, and Elena :)

Giuseppe and his team did a great job making sure everyone felt included and was having a great time. It was easy to meet up with the group and the location for the cooking class was great. Great class for beginners.

A highlight of our trip to Rome. Mersad and Giuseppe hosted the best pizza and pasta making class, and Giuseppe even drove us to the Antica Appia trail at the end. The instructions were excellent and they both had us laughing the entire time. I couldn’t think of a better way to experience authentic cooking in Rome. Bravo!

the experience was great and delicious. you can see Guiseppe's passion for his Profession. "dont mess with the dough" XD
The Team including Elena and Mersad was knowledgeable, patient and fun.
The evening was amazing, thank you
Great experience and probably the best pizza we had on our entire trip in Italy! We learned a lot and had a great time!

This was a GREAT experience! I love to do cooking classes when we travel to learn about the people and this was great. Giuseppe, Mersad and Elena were all very friendly and welcoming, and very hands on to show us how to work the different doughs and different pasta shapes, and also answer many questions on how to find good quality materials where we live.
The place was really wonderful, with a magical feel to it - and very comfortable to work and eat and do social distancing.
Would 100% recommend to do as soon as you land, they were also very kind to even share restaurant recommendations!

Really enjoyable cooking class with Mersad and Elena! The class was structured perfectly, food was delicious, and we learned something (and we get a packet of information to reference at home). I recommend it if you want a more interactive experience! Really enhanced my time in Rome.

If you are into cooking then this experience is a must do in Rome. We had lots of fun with Mersad and Elena…they made pizza and pasta dough making look easy and fun… we liked the outdoor area… in our oppinion there is no way that this cooking class could have turned out any better. Mersad was specifically funny, professional and easy to work with altogether…all in all a great experience…

The hosts were very charismatic and friendly! Super hands on, with the only thing we didn’t make were the pasta sauces or dessert. Location is sort of off the grid and we had difficulty with using driver. Best to ride the metro or train to the location!
I had a good time and it was fun preparing the pizza and pasta as well as consuming it. Our chef was amazing as well as the assistance of the pasta preparation.

Thank you Giuseppe and team for a fun and delicious pasta and pizza adventure! We learned so much about how to make great pizza and pasta and your passion for food made the experience even more impactful.

Highly recommended!

This was a great experience all around from the making of pasta and pizza to the very good information about how to prepare it and what to do and not to do! The crew was very friendly and helpful! Definitely recommend it!

We were so excited about this experience. A real way to discover Italian skills with great tips. Very well animated. In addition, they are small groups which encourage communication and fun. I recommend it 100%.

This was one the best experiences we have had through AirBnB. Giuseppe and Mersad were excellent and experienced hosts. We learned a great deal about Neapolitan Pizza and how prepare several pastas from beginning to end. We especially liked the warm and inviting atmosphere coupled with experienced professional presentation.

If you're looking for something to do in Rome and want to get away from the bustle of the center while learning how to make the best pizza and pasta this is the experience for you.
This was such a fun and amazing experience! My husband and I loved every second of it. Special shout out to Mersad and Elena for being so personable and funny. We LOVED it. 100/10 recommend!

This class was just beautiful. The chef and his team are very educational and we don't even talk about the good atmosphere and laughs that shaped our class. You can only come out satisfied with this. It's THE class to join!!!

Perfect evening! We learned a lot about pizza and the right flour but also how to make different types and shapes of pasta! Guiseppe and his team are also very entertaining! All in all a Perfect evening
We were able to learn some great basics that we can take with us as we come home from our trip in Italy.

Best experience I’ve had in Italy. If you come to Rome, you need to do this experience hands down. Great team. Very knowledgeable and very fun group. Food was great because I cooked it, with great teachers 🙌 the ingredients were super fresh and delicious. Thanks again

Mersad and Giuseppe were amazing! We had a great time learning the ins and outs of Neapolitan and Roman pizza, as well as some great pasta. They went above and beyond. Our driver got lost on our way to pick us up, and they came back to check on us to make sure we made it back to our place safely.

I took my family along and this was the highlight of our time in Rome. A great experience is the best souvenir when traveling. We’re looking forward to remembering our time in Rome for years to come as we make our authentic pasta and pizza at home! If you’re reading this, book it already!
We had a lovely time with Giuseppe and Mersad. We had low expectations going in, but this experience was so worth it. Definitely a highlight to our trip!

Very good I loved it ! Giuseppe is very funny and cool, and it easy to understand what he said,
Would totally recommand it

Absolutely amazing and a must do if you go to Rome.
If you like Italian food and want to know how to do it at home, book this class 🇮🇹
Great experience!!! So much fun learning to make pizza and pasta. Staff is amazing- fun as well as very knowledgeable. I highly recommend this class!

Mersad & Elena made this experience the best it could be. The class is very personalized & they take time to actually help you understand how to prepare the pizza/pasta. Mersad is super funny & brightened our day! Please book if you are thinking of it, you won’t regret it!

It is an experience not to be missed. The ambience and hosts are amazing and make you feel welcomed from the minute you step in. Thank you for the great memories and knowledge to make better pizza and pasta :).

My boyfriend Michael and I had an absolutely incredible day at Giuseppe's pizza and pasta-making course. We really couldn't recommend it more highly! Firstly, the venue was really easy to reach and was beautiful - we felt like we were truly in the countryside despite being very close to Rome! The entire day was extremely entertaining with endless fun, laughter, excitement and smiles. I couldn't speak more highly of Giuseppe and his team Elena and Mersad - they were all so welcoming, friendly, open, kind and patient. They made us feel instantly at home. The course itself was so well organised - everything happened seamlessly and it was also the perfect length. Overall, we would recommend the course to anyone looking for a wonderful day they will truly never forget! I can't wait to practise making pizza and pasta at home now!

If you are looking for a useful and memorable experience... this is something to do! The team is attentive, fun and pedagogue. Everything is done to make yourself at home, that's great. The place is very quiet and pleasant, perfect when you want to leave the big city.

Our day with the chef and his team was a highlight of our trip. We had the chance to cook in a great setting of fresh and high quality products all in a friendly and warm atmosphere. This will still be a great memory for us!

The event was fun, social and informative. There were about 19 participants but Giuseppe and Mersad and a young lady were able to keep things moving in two languages and with only one, wood fire, pizza oven.
This is not really a course where you will walk away and replicate a Roman pizza or making fresh pasta. It's a basic introductory course to familiarize you with how to, from pizza dough to making different shape pastas. Someone else cooked the pasta and told you when to take out the pizza. the food was delish, as was tiramisu and Limoncello.

I was hoping we would learn how to make tomato sauce as that is often talked about in Italian cuisine back home. It wasn't a part of the course.

Great crew, great students, great food. wouldn't hesitate to do this again.

Great day out. The 3 chefs (Giuseppe, Mersad and Elena) were great and seemed like a little family. We had a lot of fun and all the food tasted fantastic. I also left a watch behind and they were kind enough to make sure it found it's way back to me.

This experience was truly one of my favorite memories of my trip to Europe! The food was fantastic, and the atmosphere was really fun to be in! The hosts do a wonderful job of making this exciting for everyone. I can't recommend this experience enough!

What an experience. The whole team is amazing . The location was beautiful, it took me back to my childhood. Giuseppe was funny, informative. Mersad was fantastic as well.

This was for sure the highlight of my Rome trip

The whole day was wonderful. Our whole family loved the experience and the food we made was delicious. We met some lovely people and all had a fantastic day - thank you so much Mersad, Elenor and Giuseppe for an amazing day in Rome!

That was such a great event! I hoped to learn about the pasta and pizza doughs - and this is exactly what I did. Giuseppe and Mersad are not only extremely knowledgeable but also fun and happy to share their knowledge. It was great and the food was delicious!

Giuseppe and his staff are friendly and welcoming. The structure of the class is thorough but not boring. You will leave having learned a lot, having had a ton of fun and having eating a lot of fresh and amazing pizza and pasta! The location is beautiful!
Loved it! Very fun and delicious! The food was fantastic and the education was very personalized! They have to take this experience if they're traveling to Rome

THIS CLASS IS SO GOOD!!! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming. The teachers were kind, respectful, patient, and very helpful. We learned how to make pizza dough, how to properly put toppings on the pizza, and how to cook the pizza in a wood-fired oven. There was a break to eat the pizza, drink wine, and enjoy each other’s company. Then we had a hands on experience learning how to make about ten different types of pasta, followed by another break to eat and hang out. We took this class in the summer, outdoors, and they did a great job of keeping us cool and comfortable. DEFINITELY WOULD RECOMMEND THIS CLASS! Be ready for lots of laughs, lots of food, and a great time!
Such a fun experience! I have learned so much about pasta & pizza. The staff was so kind and funny. I recommend this activity a 100%!
Giuseppe’s cooking class was a real highlight in our Rome trip! We enjoyed it so much and everything was well explained + delicious! I recommend it to everyone!!

Book now!! The cooking class with Giuseppe was such a fun experience! Giuseppe and his team are so welcoming and make you feel truly at home with this experience! We got to learn how to make pizza the true Napoliteon way and you can truly feel Giuseppe’s love and passion just by the way he teaches. The whole experience is well organized and so engaging. The location where the class takes place is beautiful and it was nice to get away from the business of the city for a few hours. Definitely make sure you come with an appetite because you will eat a lot of delicious food! I would definitely book this experience again!

The chef and his acolytes bring some technical advice which has me more. They are educational while sharing moments of friendship.
And the setting remains very pretty, moreover it is possible to walk back via the Roman road.

Definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Rome! This was the highlight of my trip to Rome and would recommend to any of my friends or family. Really great value considering you get to experience the class and the food is more than enough for a meal. Also, most other cooking classes don’t offer the experience of both pasta and pizza so this class was pretty unique
A unique cooking experience outside of the city center in a pastoral atmosphere. Experienced guides and fun going through their workshop

An unforgettable experience in a magical place, out of time. We cut ourselves off from the energy of the city for more than four hours with people who are passionate about their craft; we didn't expect to have such an awesome time. We've learned so much and I can't wait to find my kitchen to replicate the recipes! We spent our time laughing, the energy was so good, we could have stayed there for eternity.

All the chefs are very knowledgeable. Mersad was funny and patient with me. I have never made pizza before nor have I ever cooked. I was embarrassed at first, but he made everything easy and comfortable to follow. Giuseppe is also amazing. He picked us up right on time at the train station. He taught us how to make pasta. I am so terrible at it LOL but it was so fun to have him around and push me to be better. It's an honor to have the best chefs teaching you all the skills. To end the experience, we had his famous tiramisu and wine. You can't go wrong with this experience. It was the highlight of our trip to Rome. ¡¡¡¡Do it!!!!

My husband and enjoyed this experience so much! If you want a break from the touristy things! And feel Italian food in a different way, I would totally recommend this! We learned so much about pizza and pasta. The hosts were both very informative and funny! It was a great time! This is a must do!
I learned a lot of actionable stuff that I will use to make my own pizza and pasta in the future. Also Giuseppe is funny so that made everything that much better.
Great location out of the city. Amazing interactions with the kids. They had a blast. A nice cooler environment outside of Rome too.

This cooking class has been one of the highlights of my trip. Everything from the pick up to the drop off went nice and smooth. The location of the class is in a serene, outdoor setting away from the hectic city, but only a short trip from Laurentina Station. We both felt immediately welcomed by Mersad who gave us multiple drinks to enjoy while we waited to get started and he took the time to get to know us all. Throughout both the pizza and pasta making sections of the class Mersad kept us laughing the entire time, but also educational. He has such a great sense of humor and was so easy to get along with. Even Elena and Giuseppe were hilarious and great to be around, but we were stuck with Mersad for most the class! All three were extremely knowledgeable with what they were teaching. Throughout the class we ate pizza that we made, watermelon, two different pasta dishes using the pasta we made and some great tiramisu. We were both absolutely stuffed afterwards. I loved the document they send afterwards with all of the information we talked about during the class! I cannot wait to try out the things we talked about at home and tell the New Yorkers about all the things they do wrong with Pizza like Mersad called out! This class is an absolutely steal of a value and you would be missing out if you skipped it! Thanks for the great time you three!

Can only recommend this cooking class! It was a lot of fun with Giuseppe and his team! We were explained and shown very well with a perfect English about the secrets of pasta & pizza making! We baked pizza ourselves, as well as shaped a variety of noodles. In addition, we got drinks, melon, tiramisu and limoncello - so we were all happy and rich afterwards! :)
The location outside was different than a usual cooking class inside and it was still not too hot because there was air conditioning!
The only small criticism is that it would have been nice if we made the pasta sauce ourselves!
All in all, it was a great day that we won't forget so quickly! 🍕🍝MILLE GRAZIE GIUSEPPE🍝🍕

The experience with Mersad, Guiseppe and Elena made my trip to Rome even more special. I can recommend it to every food-lover out there seeking to experience a wonderful few hours at an idyllic location with very humorous people.

I love writing reviews and this is going to be a good one. The whole experience, if I could give it 100 stars I would. The hosts, and co-hosts had SUPERB attitudes. Loved the entire experience, they were funny, tried to remember names as they could and were very humble. I’ve already planned my next trip back to Rome and this will be the first and last thing I do when I get back. If you book a vacation to Rome and don’t do this, you’re losing out on one of the best experiences you could imagine.
This experience was one of the best things that we did during our short stay in Rome. I recommend it with all my heart. The hosts were amazing.
Great experience with top teachers in pizza and pasta making, had a lot of fun, enjoyed the roasting, made new friends, great food and drinks. Totally worth it!

This experience was AMAZING. We were apart of Mersad’s group, he’s knowledgeable, charismatic and funny. Giuseppe and Elena were great too. We had two tweens and he kept them engaged and was very patient. We did this on our last full day in Rome, which also happened to be the birthday of my friend, they added a candle to the tiramisu and we all sang HBD.
Overall, TAKE this class! It was an excellent experience communication was seamless, we walked away not only stuffed (the pizza and pasta yummmy) but with SO much knowledge. We want to put our skills to the test, so we are already planning and end of Summer pasta class at our house in the
Amazing experience!! We were able to learn different pasta and pizza cooking technics with a lot of fun!! We are able to meet great people and be ready to eat a lot as well!! Recommend for sure!!
A really fun and unique but also very useful experience. The hosts were very friendly and knowledgable and the atmosphere was great too. Would highly recommend!

We had a great time learning how to make pizza and pasta. All the food was super delicious. You will not leave hungry!
The group size was good and everybody was friendly.

Had a really great time at this class. Eating the food was by far the best part and we also made a few new friends who we went for a drink with that night. Such a good experience I would recommend to any friends visiting Rome!
Perfect for a date day or group event. This experience did not disappoint. We left with a new skill, a full belly and new friends.

Had a wonderful time with Giuseppe, Mersad and Elena in their charming location. We learned so much about pasta and pizza. By far one of the best experiences we had in Rome. This cooking class is highly recommended.

Firstly, I would like to thank the host and other chefs for their positivity, hospitality and magic they put in this activity. From the very beggining, everyone has been polite, smiling and full of love. The location has been absolutely breathtaking, I personally felt over the moon. The cooking school has given me much more than new skills and tricks in the kitchen.. It has given me the memories I will never forget, chance to meet people from around the world and make connection with them. Definitely the best pizza I have ever had, fun making pasta (hard but worth it!😁) and the best tiramisu in the wooorld. Thousand times thank you! Unforgettable❤

We had an amazing time at Giuseppe’s cooking class and learned how to make some interesting pasta shapes and delicious pizza. My kids loved creating the pasta using all the fun tools (they did even better than the adults!) and are now inspired to make it at home. We also had fun getting to know the other people in our group & loved that we were from all over the world (Chile, Slovakia, Mexico and California).

I chose this cooking class specifically because it was outdoors and felt safer doing this type of activity outside during Covid.
