It was a sweltering hot day, but they had misters and fans which helped manage the heat and provided cold drinks the entire time. They really cared about safety and made sure we were washing our hands frequently and provided ample space to social distance.

All in all it was a wonderful experience and one of the highlights of our trip to Rome.

Super fun and informative class! There are others working there so we got a lot of individual attention and instruction.

Pizza was super yummy and we learnt a lot about different t pasta shapes.

Giuseppe, mersad and Elena were spectacular. They provided solid information and provided much entertainment. They were especially helpful in getting me private transport to another tour I was attending that same day. The food and wine were also amazing and fresh. I definitely recommend this experience!

The pasta and pizza cooking class was a lovely experience. Perfect for when you want to do something else besides visiting musea and archeological sites. Giuseppe and his team are professionals, and thus the cooking class teaches you a lot on how to make proper pasta and pizza! The location is set in nature and is thus a nice change from scenery when you are visiting Rome city centre. Giuseppe and his team make you feel very welcome and relaxed and they plan enough time for letting your food digest. Apart from the pasta and pizza (which is just the best you’ll ever had), you are offered nice and cool juices which are very welcome during the summer. Would definitely recommend!

In a remote location of the city and Zen. Away from classic kitchens. We loved the place more relaxing and outdoors. Giuseppe and his team are extras. Attentive, fun, professional.
A great zvec tasting activity. We loved making our pizzas and learning how to make fresh pasta in various forms!
Language barrier has passed. We were able to understand each other and carry out the activities.
I highly recommend it!
One of the best activities we've done in Rome.
Thank you again!

Fun experience! Everything ran smoothly and was such a blast. My husband and I had fun putting a pizza together and learning different pasta shapes. I will say that you don’t actually make pasta or pizza from beginning to end. But it was fun and informative nonetheless. The host is passionate and great. We had a blast and would do it again! The house made olive oil is also delicious! I recommend picking up a bottle if you can bring it home!

Wow what a wonderful pizza and pasta making class! Giuseppe was great in communicating before, during, and after the experience. Meetup was super easy as directions were clear. The pizza that we made was delicious and techniques that we learned were extremely helpful. I’ve made pizza once before but didn’t realize all the mistakes I made in the past. The class is technical which I like but not too esoteric. We learned how to make several pasta shapes and ended with two delicious pastas. Wine, water, and flavored water were free flowing and seemingly unlimited. Met some really cool people as well. Really hot day in Rome but the class was under a covered outdoor cooking area near the Appian Way. Overall, would recommend 100%!

It was a great experience! Giuseppe and his team were amazing hosts - besides the fact that we learned quite a lot about pizza and pasta, we had a really great and fun time! We would definitely recommend this experience - no prior cooking skills or anything is necessary ;). And it is also perfect for vegetarians (and vegans, although you might miss the tiramisu in that case).
Very nice people and good food. We definitely didn’t go home hungry. The atmosphere and scenery was awesome, with cats and chats with the chefs
Thank you for such a great experience! Guiseppe, Mersad and Elena are great teachers and loads of fun to spend the class with!

This was a very fun and relaxing experience. It was nice to be out in nature and do something fun and delicious and make new friends. My 3 young sons had a great time playing fooseball, making pizza, and petting the cats.
Giuseppe and his team are fantastic hosts! Learned so much about pizza and pasta in a serene setting away from the bustle of Rome’s center. The class was well-paced and the food was delicious!
Great experience. Nice and welcoming host. has a lot of experience about pasts and pizza. really recommend for anyone who has the time in Rome

A totally magical experience! You’ll learn a lot about local pizza and pasta from someone who is really passionate and knowledgeable. Thank you, Giuseppe - for such a memorable and fun time, absolute highlight of my time in Rome!

This experience is probably the best choice for a cooking class. Given Covid, I was looking for a class that was outside and the location of this cooking class surpassed my expectation.
Mersad, was extremely knowledgable and made my 13 year old son very comfortable by joking with him and making him feel involved in the mostly adult group.
The knowledge shared by the hosts on pasta types was value added and of course the tiramasu and the limoncello was fabulous.

I highly recommend taking this cooking class it was such a great experience. They make you feel like your cooking with your family they have a great sense of humor explain things correctly. I most definitely recommend taking this class you won’t be disappointed the instructors are awesome.

Great afternoon doing something different in Rome. The pizza & pasta was delicious and we both felt we learnt a lot of new things.
Took us a while to get there from central Rome (about 25 mins on the metro) but would definitely recommend if you have time.

One of the best experiences we have had in Rome! Giuseppe is a very nice and kind person who loves his job. All of the participating persons were very kind and loved the stay, also all of the teachers are super fun, entertaining and experienced. I recommend this course to everyone staying in Rome! There are no wishes left over. Thanks!

Magical experience for a visit to Rome!!! Giuseppe and the other members of the kitchen team are extremely kind, considerate and fun with the participants. This experience will remain a very nice memory for a long time 😍
An amazing and charming experience in a lovely place near Roma. The hosts make everything magic and you will not only cook but also eat the pizza/pasta you will cook. We recommend it to you 100% !
This is really an amazing experience! The hosts are wonderful and entertaining people. We really enjoyed it and I would strongly recommend it! Thank you for everything!

After a short trip from the metro-station we arrived at a wonderful place. Where the hosts gave us a wonderful, exciting and humorous experience with food and its techniques.

Jennifer had a lot to say about the food and it’s crafts. We really liked her banter. So don’t be shy. 10/10. Wonderful location, and hosts. Elena and Jennifer made it the perfect class and activity. We would DEFINITELY do it again! 🌹

Very nice location and cooking instructors! We had a lot of fun and the food turned out great, especially the pizza. Relaxed and fun atmosphere and great tips for cooking at home. We learned a lot and had a very nice time :) the instructors were very welcoming and open, it felt really personal! We recommend this cooking class!!

I hired this experience because I wanted to do something in Rome off the beaten track. My family wasn't quite sure before I went (I have three kids, ages 19, 17 and 14), but after the course they recognized it was worth it.

While looking for a true yet clichéd experience of Italian cuisine is when we stumped across this fun learning experience in the backdrops of Roma. While each moment was relishing, we particularly enjoyed the method of teaching (with a lot of teasing and encouragement), the exchanges about food, culture, and languages, as well as the interactions with other tourists from different parts of the globe. A great way to jumpstart your Italian holidays either by yourself, with friends, family, and your loved one.

Our family enjoyed the cooking class very much! We look forward to trying what we learned at home. It was wonderful that we got to participate throughout the various stages of the class.
Highly recommend Mersad and Elena as instructors! Felt safe & enjoyed ride over in van, too!

We loved our class with Giuseppe and Mersad. They were great with our 8, 11 and 13 year old and kept them giggling and having fun the whole time. My 8 year old said out loud (frequently) “This is so much fun!” Giuseppe has some adorable children who don’t usually make an appearance but were with us under special circumstances and they were icing on the cake. We look forward to eating at his son’s restaurant in 20 years when he is a master chef. The location is fabulous and it is truly delicious food. Definitely worth the trip.

Super nice experience we recommend!
The booker was lovely. We had warned that we had another activity afterwards and he made sure we were on time, perfect.
The setting was nice, there was a good atmosphere, respect for hygiene, it was very good. Hearty meals between pasta and pizza, and super tiramisu as dessert.
The only small downside is that we don't make the pizza dough ourselves. We completely understand the reasons, but this should still be stated in the listing...
But we are delighted to have all the recipes at the end (including pizza dough and tiramisu, nice surprise)!

I recommend this experience, it's suitable for groups as well as solo travelers like me! The recipes take it into account that not all of us have a pizza oven at home! The place where the class takes place is magical

Such an amazing experience! My friends and I thoroughly enjoyed learning from Giuseppe and Elena. This experience gave us a better understanding of the nitty gritty of pasta and pizza making. Alsoooo Giuseppe’s tiramisu deserves a special mention! Absolutely delicious like a little cloud ☁️ Finally, thank you to Elena for being so kind and helpful.

We had a really fun time at the cookingclass since the hosts were very friendly! We learned how to make a good pizza and several types of pasta. Afterwards we had time to eat our creations and they were really good!! It was also very nice to meet other people in the class!

We really enjoyed the activity and meeting new people. The hosts are great and funny, you really lose track of time and enjoy a relaxing and informative session.
And of course the food is great (because you make it ;) )
I recommend this activity to anyone trying to understand why pizza and pasta in Italy will always be the best.

One of the best experiences I’ve booked through Airbnb. Chef Giuseppe, Mersad, and Elena were were great teachers and made the experience fun and full of laughter. It was very clear that they were all highly skilled and knowledgeable in their craft. The learning experience and eating experience was well worth it. The wine was delicious as well! I definitely recommend this to anyone who plans to visit Rome!

This was an incredible experience! I had so much fun and met people from all over! The chiefs were very kind, funny, and knowledgeable. The location is magical! It seems like you are going to the middle of nowhere but just follow the signs and you will enter a huge private land!

Amazing host and really nice experience. Communication before the class was very clear. Next week we will try it by ourselves, hopefully it will as good as in the class (;. We would recommened this class.

Absolutely blew away our expectations. Traveling with small children we are always worried that they will not be as included but Chef Mersad and Chef Giuseppe completely changed that and made them the star of our group. They made sure everyone was included while not distracting from why the adults were there. A one of a kind experience that I would most definitely do again. A must stop for anyone looking to learn to make delicious pizza and pasta while in Rome!

Giuseppe and Mersad are simply wonderful.
The workshop was really interesting, helpful and funny as well!
The surroundings were so beautiful and the food we created together was really delicious!

Grazie per tutto!

We really enjoyed the class with Giuseppe and Mesrat! it packed quite a bit but we did not feel rushed at all, we were guided through every step and the results were incredible. We loved that we got so many great tips both on pizza and pasta making, and we were able to do both. The guys were funny and helpful and it was a unique experience. Whether you share it with your friends, or your significant other, it is not to miss.

Wonderful experience! Had a ton of fun and really created something beautiful and tasty ;) Guiseppe and Mersad were fantastic hosts and made sure we also really learn something along the way. Laughed a lot and ate a lot - what else is there to wish for?! :)
We had a wonderful fun time. 4 hr went by sooo fast, we learned a lot and enjoyed our own food! The two chefs very easy going and fun to be around with. Thank you for a lovely time!

Such a fun and lively class! Giuseppe is extremely knowledgeable and passionate, he not only showed us how to make a pizza but really taught us the why and intricacies of making the dough. We also learnt how to make so many pasta shapes - it was great fun. Would 100% recommend.

Great experience!
Giuseppe and Mersad are great teachers, it's very playful.
We had a great time, to be repeated!

Giuseppe en Mershad were both funny and experts in their own right! I wish we learned many more things from you! Cooking made fun and a skill to take home 10/10 would do it again! Real recommendation to do in Rome! Wish we had a bit more time to finish the tiramisu!

I really enjoyed learning how to make pasta from Giuseppe! He is a fun person and happy to share his secrets. You don't only learn how to make pasta and pizza in general, but he also teaches you variations and how to form different sorts like penne, rigatoni, enz. So cool! Have been making pasta three times already since I am back home and they tasted awsome!

Can not think of a better way to do a cooking course, the mix between fun, great food and actually learning from professionals was amazing. Can't wait to try this at home, and definitely would come back again.

It's a beautiful cooking experience. Belle is very warm and a great conversation starter. It's a great idea to learn how to make a delicious pizza and pasta from this great pizza master in a beautiful natural setting.
So much fun! If you come to Rome and want to learn authentic pizza and pasta making ( or what the real deal should taste like) visit the Rome Pizza School! Grazie Chefs!
Best experience we had in Rome! You won’t regret enjoying your time with these lovely people. Plus what’s better than homemade pasta and pizza?

The location and experience were just stupendous. set outdoors not far from Rome at all.. we were explained pasta pizza and dough making to a lot of detail and personal attention.
Giuseppe also made special arrangements for us and even thoguh fully booked he made a special arrangement just for me and my friend and we felt very welcome and left happy and “full”

Such a lovely experience! We really enjoyed our hosts and thought they did a great job with teaching us how to make various pasta and pizza. They also took the time to get to know us and really made us feel comfortable. The location was lovely and we they even recommended to us a beautiful walk back into the city which was really enjoyable!

Definitely book this experience!

Great experience!
A class with very complete content.
Pasta and pizza, what more could you ask for?
Ah bah the chef's dessert: it tiramisù!


🤩Chef Mersad is the best!

Grazie di cuore!

A really fun day, learning how to prepare and cook brilliantly simple, high quality pizza and pasta, in a beautiful setting. Lots of fun and really engaging. Mersad was an amazing teacher and an engaging host.

I would highly recommend this as a day out. Plus, the Appian way is a must visit afterwards to walk off some of those Italian carbs!

Hi! This is a must book! The location is magical, the set up and the entire class. Mesad made us feel at home and shared many great tips on how to make the perfect pizza and pasta. He didn’t rush and answered all of our questions in detail. The location was incredibly quaint and additional wine and tiramisu was a bonus :-) thanks for a wonderful evening!

Amazing! This was one of the first things that we did on our trip and it set a wonderful tone for the rest of the trip.

The teachers were so much fun and really connected with the kids. He was very patient and helped them work through the process at a good pace.

It was all hands on. We learned how to shape pizza and put the toppings on and then we ate our pizzas and they were delicious. Then we learned to make pizza dough and pasta dough. Learning to shape pasta was so much fun. They were very good at showing how to shape the pasta and share the unique names and stories.

They sent the recipes to us and we have already ordered a pasta board and are ready to try this at home.

We have had an amazing time. Mersad was really nice and explained everything slowly and thoroughly. He answered all our questions. The food we cooked was really tasty, the wine and dessert just delicious. We would recommend this experience 100%.

This was such a fun night for my partner & I. The hosts were extremely friendly, and so knowledgable on everything pasta & pizza related! Mersad and Elena were both very kind and down to Earth and it felt like we really got to know them. I couldn’t recommend this more if you’re staying in Rome. LGBTQ friendly also! 🏳️‍🌈

We both love eating pizza and pasta so it seemed natural for us to love cooking it. With Mersad and Elenas' assistance we had an amazing evening learning about all the details that you wont find in a cookery book! We had a great laugh, plenty wine and left with full bellies and a big smile on our face. Thanks again guys

Dan & Emily

Incredible experience. We really learned a lot, and the food was amazing. The hosts were friendly, funny and incredibly accommodating. Beautiful place to learn something new, make friends, and eat delicious food.

I can't recommend this experience enough!! Mersad had such incredible knowledge about Italian cuisine but what was more made it accessible to us, whilst making sure we did it right! We got so much out of the evening we spent on this experience and it was such a beautiful way to end our trip in Rome. Mersad is so knowledgable and very kindly answered all my questions, as well as having a great humour and personality, not to mention he saved my pizza by making it into a calzone!! - he made the experience even better. We learnt how to make all different shapes of pasta as well as different pasta bases, where to buy good pasta, which flours to look for and so much more. In terms of Covid the cleanliness was excellent and we felt very safe to be there. Everyone should do this experience if in Rome!

Great cooking class - we really enjoyed the cooking class in an amazing location. The chef was welcoming and we learnt alot about making pizza and pasta and took away lots of knowledge and tips. The class is very relaxed and fun - recommend to all.

Mersad and Elena were both really friendly and welcoming. The location is lovely and overall the atmosphere was super chilled and we bond also with the rest of participants well over the local wine 😁
I found the cooking class truly interesting and plan to do my own pizza/pasta at home from now. Hopefully successfully, heh
Mersad had really great knowledge and was able to answer every question we had, highly recommending this experience!

Elena and Mersad enjoyed the cooking class. We got important basic knowledge of how to prepare pizza and pasta, and each participant was able to prepare their own pizza and pasta. With the professional tips from Mersad, it is now also possible for us to make excellent pizza and pasta at home. The atmosphere was very relaxed and it was fun to get in touch with the other participants. Highly recommended!

We had an amazing evening with Mersad and Elena. Very nice and friendly people 😊 The night was well structured and informative and it gave us a lot of new knowledge and technics that we have to try at home. Really recommendable — five stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
It was just amazing. We had Mersad as our second chef and Elena and had an incredible pleasure. I don't want to give away too much, so: super tasty, super fun, super interesting and super Bene
I've never made pasta before and it was a lovely experience to try it under the watchful eye of someone who knows what they're doing! Great food and nice to get out of the city for an evening.

This was an amazing experience and I would recommend it to anyone and everyone. Our family now has wonderful memories and are making home made pasta regularly! Our teens absolutely loved the experience and it was a highlight of our visit to Italy

This was a once in a lifetime experience for our family of four with a 15 and 11 year old. Elena was wonderful, gentle and kind. Mersad was an amazing teacher who engaged everyone personally and shared his amazing knowledge and talents while keeping us all laughing. Guiseppe was wonderful because I mixed up the booking and was very understanding and accomodated our family of four when I had only booked for once. My children have said it is their favourite memory of Rome, it was a wonderful experience for us all and I cannot recommend it enough.

Out of our stay in Rome, this was definitely one of the highlights. Mersad and Elena were very welcoming with great humour throughout. The class was perfectly taught and a great experience. The pizzas tasted perfect and the pasta making was extremely fun for a first time - which was unbelievable! We highly recommend this experience to everyone and anyone and cannot wait to recreate the dishes at home!

We had a great time during this cooking class! We have learnt a lot interesting things about making pizza and pasta. We hope we can improve our home made pizza thanks to all we've learned! Thank you again!

We had a great evening with Mersad and Eleanor. They made us feel super welcome and had great sense of humours which made the experience fun and interesting. They were both very skilled and we felt like we learned a lot which we didn’t expect, as well as the amazing food and wine! They were very generous and we went home very very happy :)) The best thing we’ve done all year!

It was one of the greatest experiences of my life !!! The class was amazing. Giuseppe was very considerate of me. Even though I had issues with my reservation, he rescheduled it without problem. Elena who also picked us up very kindly. The Chef was extremely smiling, attentive, thoughtful, wearing the mask at all times, pointed us to every step of the way, gave us all the info we need to make the pizza and pasta. The Experience is very complete. They teach you how to make various types of pasta, the names of the briefcases, offer you wine, water, all at ease. I was very well served and very well served. Really amazing !!!! I'll remember this experience for the rest of my life.

It was 10000 !!!! Definitely recommend this experience with closed eyes.

Mersad and Elena made this cooking class a wonderful experience for me! I was the only participant (as the other person didn’t show up, and they truly made me feel welcome. I had so much fun and learned a lot about making pizza and pasta. We laughed and ate together and I will always remember this experience :)

Wonderful. We went with our 3 year old toddler and the chef assistant went above and beyond to help her with the whole process. She felt like a real chef, and we had a blast. And the result... delicious! Thank you very much!

This was an amazing experience!!!!! We are so happy that we chose this class. Mercado and Elena were so kind and funny. We felt like a part of a wholesome pizza family. The place where the classes took place was very lovely and cute. We recommend it to everyone
Nice experience! Making pizza was very Nice to do. Past making was also very interesting but could have been More challenging eg making fillings/stuffed pasta. Nevertheless Nice and qualified people
Very interesting and fun experience. The hosts were really welcoming and warm people. The location was great, quiet and peaceful - outside of the city noise .
Super recommended! I spent a relaxed and pleasant afternoon learning, eating and chatting. I would take a workshop again with Belle and Elena!!

A wonderful place to escape the hustle and bustle of the big city. The techniques were well explained and super easy to do. Lots of thoughtful professional tips that you can only get from professionals.

Perfect perfect perfect, I made amazing friends! And it was such a special and beautiful experience. We laughed and chatted through the evening and I made friends from another country and this is what experiences like this are all about.

Messad and Elena was very professional, friendly and kind! We learn a lot but we also have fun... it was an amazing experience and last but not least .. we eat the best pasta, pizza and tiramisu of our life ! Good products, good place and good people !
Julia et Jessi

hosts were very accommodating and made the experience feel personal and helped us a lot. i really enjoyed the entirety of the time there and learned lots of new things. we were also sent all of the information after the class so that we can practice at home which is great! overall i have nothing bad to say.. 10/10

A wonderful experience from start to to finish, extremely kind hosts who make you feel welcome and assist you fully throughout the experience.
A beautiful location that can host a variety of group sizes along with equipment and produce that seemed to be of a very high standard. Would definitely recommend for the price could not fault my experience.

Giuseppe picked me up at the metro station and drove me to the cooking school/farm. He was a delight to chat with! Mersad taught my class - I was solo - and was a great teacher! He was very knowledgeable, friendly, and easy to be around. The location is magical! Just beside the Ancient Appian Way. It is amazing to be out in a natural environment, surrounded by olive and apricot trees. Lovely experience.

What a fantastic time! I thoroughly enjoyed my experience with Mersad and Guiseppe! From the get go, I knew this was going to be fun! As soon as we arrived, we had a warm welcome and as I did do this during Covid-19, all the necessary hygiene practices, precautions and safety measures were well in place!! The pizza making was much more in-depth than I expected and I really did walk away with knowledge that I can apply at home. The pasta making was technical and really an art! We had lots of laughs! I enjoyed Guiseppe and Mersad’s interaction with us and each other!! They are a great team! Thank you so much for a memorable experience! Highly recommended!

We've had a wonderful time making pasta and pizza while learning a lot about it. The team was very friendly and made us feel welcome.
The cooking class is located in a beautiful area. Afterwards we walked the ancient via appia on recommendation of Mersad and Giuseppe.
Also, the food was amazing!

We had a really nice day! The pizza was delicious that we made. My favorite part was making lots of different shapes with the pasta. They gave us tiramisu and limoncello which was a lovely touch. It was really a wonderful experience

Absolutely Perfect Experience
We had the class with Mersad today and everything was perfect. He was very personable - it was like we were speaking with a friend. You definitely leave feeling both accomplished and overstuffed. You’re going to go home wanting to open your own pizzeria and pasta shop.

I would highly recommend this experience.

-Khaled

Book it! Seriously one of the best things I’ve done while visiting Rome! Alessio and Mersad made us feel at home while learning how to make a delicious meal. It’s fun, informative and off the beaten path. It was great!

A unique and wonderful experience! From the space to Mersad's guidebook, we've learned how to make various kinds of pasta and authentic Neapolitan pizza (the best pizza!).
The class was warm, interactive and educational, the location unbeatable. After preparing the food we were able to taste it and the result was amazing. We would definitely repeat the experience, highly recommended for anyone looking for something different to do in Rome.

The Rome Pizza School experience was one we will remember for years to come. Guiseppe and his team were unbelievable in terms of hospitality, kindness, and they are clearly passionate and experts in the Italian cooking world. Aside from being educational and fascinating, the hosts made the atmosphere extremely welcoming, making it easy to connect with others who booked the trip as well. This experience was worth every penny and I will be recommending to all friends and family visiting Rome!

Super day outside the heart of Rome, really friendly hosts and made some of the best pizzas we've ever had! Really interesting learning all the different pasta shapes and then receiving all the recipes for the doughs and sauces. Would highly recommend this class.

The cooking itself was OK, the cooks were professional, actually learned some new things. But the venue is located far from the city centre and we expected ancient road and ancient mansion, but it actually turned around to be just a bumpy road and tiny house for cooking classes. There was no reason to spend one hour on the road to get there.

It was a wonderful experience! First, we had the pizza class. You learn how to prepare the dough, open it and set up the fillings... but the best part is to eat your own creation at the end! Then, you learn how to prepare different types of pasta and also taste it at the end. If this is not enough food for you, why not trying some of their homemade tiramissu and wine? Highly recommend this experience!
A fun session with two amusing experienced cooks. Relaxed and easygoing few hours with some good insights into making good pizzas and pasta.

This was one of the best things me and my partner did in Rome!! We always wanted to enjoy a pizza making class and this experience was everything and more! Essiano, our chef, was absolutely fantastic - so welcoming, friendly and really made our experience unique and something we’ll remember for a long time! We made delicious pizza from scratch, had fun creating our pasta (even if some of mine were a disaster haha!) and enjoyed tiramisu and wine too. Our class was totally private which was extra special - plus Essiano showed us the ancient Appian way after our class had finished - perfect!!
We loved this class. My family of five with kids 22, 19, 17 really enjoyed the whole event. Great value, great to get out of the city center! Highly recommend.

Beautiful little olive farm with chickens and cats running around. Learning how to handle the pizza dough and make the pasta shapes was really informative and I have some skills I'm ready to try at home!
Beautiful location! The class is great, you learn a lot and we didn’t want it to end. Mersad and Elena were great. They were very patient when we got lost in the way.
Great experience ! Filled with fun and laughter as well as learning. The food we created tasted amazing and the environment is so welcoming

5 star. One of the best experiences we have done. They really made you understand all processes of making pizza and pasta. The teaching was fun, but at the same time very informative. And the pizza you will create will be the best you've ever had. Thank you to everyone involved!

Wow!!! Book, don’t delay just book! We had the most wonderful time with the guys here, the cooking, the eating, the new skills, all in a beautiful rural setting, such great value for money, loved it! Thanks again for making Valentine’s Day one we will never forget!

The Pizza and Pasta school was amazing, great way to experience the Italian food culture and passion behind cooking.

Mersaad was a great teacher, very funny and helpful! Asset to the team.

Would recommend if you only have a few days in Rome.
Great location with a even better atmosphere! We had such a blast and the pizza was amazing! I give two thumbs up and would highly recommend this experience for everyone!!!

This experience is a must for anyone visiting Rome. The location is unique and gives you a great look into a different part of Rome. The food was fantastic and incredibly fun to make. The experience is both interactive and informative and provided skills I can use at home. The Chef was very friendly, funny and a joy to be around. It’s great to meet the people taking the class with you and learning about their stories. I couldn’t recommend this enough. Thank you!

This class was fantastic! It was our first time in Rome and such a great experience just outside the city. It was super easy to meet up with the class right outside the metro station and then we took a van to the beautiful yet modern countryside location—with chickens and all! The lessons were perfect for people looking to actually learn to try at home and tourists wanting to have some fun. The 2 chefs were so helpful and funny, although if you are not a fan of light public humiliation, this isn’t the class for you. Of course, the pizza and pasta were amazing. We started by making our own pizza from premade dough, baking in a brick oven, then eating it. Then learned how to make two types of pasta dough and then different pasta shapes. They also gave us instructions that we could use at home! Overall, such a memorable experience.

Everything was great and perfect! The team of Chef was very professional and kind . If you wanna learn how to do the best pizza and pasta in a beautiful nature area, do not hesitate to book that course !
Thank you again , it was a nice and fun experience :)
This was such an amazing experience. We had a wonderful time and left so excited to try out our new recipes and technique! I would highly recommend attending a class!!
We had a great time learning how to make real Italian Pizza and Pasta. I would definitely recommend taking this class if you're interested in learning how to make real Italian pizza and pasta
Great chef and knowledge. He was able to give ingredients preference relevant to my country. Great feed and guidance. Harmony between chef and helper.

This is the class you want to book! Stop looking at all others, cause this is the real deal. You get to learn how to cook Pizza AND Pasta in this long and wonderful class. Nestled in the outskirts of Rome countryside, this class was located on a nature preserve, where the old Roman Appian Way was once located. We had the pleasure of being taught by the experts Mersad and Essiano, two really funny and thoughtful guys. They knew how to make these Spanish dishes like an art, and it was very lovely watching them go through the journey of making the two staples of Italian cuisine. After the class, we were well taught, fed, and drank with their local wine! We would highly recommend this to any other person who would want to take the class!
Awesome classes! Perfect way to spend a day in Rome and learn how to make pizza & pasta from the best teachers! :)

If you’re debating between multiple cooking classes or experiences to have in Rome, just stop now. This is the one. What an amazing experience with knowledgeable, relatable and funny chefs. Not a boring moment in the day, and more fun than we would’ve ever thought. We were so pleased with the quality and value of the class, the true knowledge behind the technique, and the relationships we built during our time with them. Getting to eat the delicious food felt like an added bonus. We will definitely be looking for more classes from this group if we ever find ourselves back in Rome!
Even though I am a trained chef, I live to experience authentic cooking methods and styles from experts. The class was engaging, funny and most of all, a great learning experience.
Excellent experience is very worth it, to feel part of Italian culture, it is the best experience that exists, Italian cuisine

Would recommend this class for anyone visiting Italy for the first time. Giuseppe and his team made us feel at home while learning the different techniques of cooking pizza & pasta. Although it was muddy from the prior night's rain, Giuseppe and his team did not let that interfere from a remarkable bonding/cooking experience.
Ended up being our favorite part of our visit in Rome. These guys are the best of the best. Will always hold this experience near and dear to our hearts.

A MUST do in Rome! We booked this class for our final day in Rome. It was amazing and we had so much fun! You learn a lot in the four hours and eat a ton! Plus, the staff is incredibly friendly and hilarious to chat with. I would recommend this to anyone, especially at the price point!

This was a great cooking experience. The location was great and getting there was easy. Communication was a breeze and we were informed the whole time. The cooking was wonderful, both my partner and I really felt we had expanded our culinary repertoire. Essiano was friendly and knowledgeable and really made our experience special. Thank you.

This class was wonderful! My wife and I were a little anxious about the transportation to get to the class (rookie travelers) and man....the hosts really dissolved our frustrations and made us feel so at ease. We were needing that. And honestly, we were in Italy for 10 days, this was the best pizza we had the entire time. Great time!

We were there for a weekend to celebrate my husband's birthday. The class didn't disappoint us in any sense. Had an amazing. Made fresh pizza and pasta. Knowledge sharing with humour was fun. Had a wonderful time in the class. Thank You.

Really good expérience !! It was so nice to meet people from different places and we made tasty pasta and pizzas !😃
Funny and really nice chefs who learnt us a lot of things.
They even took us to Appia Antica after the class 😊

It was a delightful experience with an allganic. I was able to understand this by making my own pasta and hearth pizza! It was more special because it took place away from the center of Rome. I feel like I'm running out of time.

This experience was the highlight of my trip! At first I was unsure because we were driving into a questionable area, but it was amazing. The two hosts were so funny and knowledgeable about cooking. They made it a relaxing environment and made us all laugh. They provided us with material for once we got home and decided we wanted to cook. They sat and gave us some product insight about what may be in the stores in our own countries that’s good to buy or not so good to buy but is very popular. This is a must do experience. If I could improve one thing I would suggest some heat for the cold days.

I accidentally booked for the wrong day and they were very flexible to accommodate my family for the day which we wanted. Meet up was easy and it was a fun experience to make different styles of pasta shapes and make pizza ( dough is premade) but you get all the info on how to make it and what to get. Unique experience to explore Roma outside of the tourist attraction :) highly recommend for all that you get with the price.

It was a cool experience away from the city center of Rome. Definitely recommend. All of them are warm and friendly with good english so it makes it easy to understand each other even tho we’re from different countries.

Great experience! The pizza and pasta we learned to create was amazing and set the bar very high for the rest of our trip to Italy. The hosts were engaging and charming, and made us feel welcome. The setting was beautiful and the tiramisu was the best we had while in Rome. Highly recommend this experience!!

A great time meeting new people and learning new skills! The food was delicious and the hosts are hilarious! They manage the group size really well and ensure everyone has some personal attention. Would highly recommend to everyone!
Fantastic experience i would recommend to anyone visiting Rome! pizza and pasta were delicious!!! Mersad was a great teacher and lots of fun. great value also.

Amazing experience! When I was looking to book a pasta or pizza making class during my trip to Italy this was finally what I chose and I am so glad I did. Pizza, Pasta, Tiramisu, Limoncello, and wine-unbeatable! You get so much for what you pay for and the location is very special! Mersad is so skilled and hilarious too.
This is an absolutely incredible experience, the chefs are very personable and expert in their craft, the setting is beautiful and the food is awesome! If you come to Rome you must do this!

Absolutely amazing! My partner and myself had a great time and learned a lot about pasta and pizza! We loved the jokes and in a smaller group of 6 we felt we connected a lot more in the class and had a special experience! Thank you so much and couldn’t recommend this experience any higher! The location, the food, the wine and the friends we made was unforgettable 🇮🇹💃 Thank you!
If you're headed to Rome, I highly recommend booking this experience. We had so much fun, everyone was so friendly, and the food was DELICIOUS. Probably the best part of our trip.

My friend and I had some down time during our trip in Italy so we decided to take this class last minute. It was a great experience. We learned how to make different types of pasta and we made our own pizzas as well. It was lots of fun. They also offered free wine, limoncello and tiramisu. All was great!
Enjoyable experience. Would have been better with a smaller group, and more detail/hands on dough making. We loved the first part, which included making a pizza and eating the result!!

Our guides were funny , personable, and respectful. They gave us great understanding of how to make the food but what to look out for where we are eating outside in a public Italian restaurant. I loved it to a much I’m recommending this to my friends when they comes for their honeymoon.

ABSOLUTELY book this class!!!! Soooo beyond worth it. The chefs are so entertaining and make the experience a lot of fun - even when you’re not the best cook :). Highly recommend and would do it again!

Absolutely amazing! I made friends. It was super fun and inviting. The chef team taught me skills and were funny. Completely worth it. The food was delicious! And that was the best tiramisu of my life btw.

We had an incredible time learning to make pizza and pasta with Marsed and his crew! They were very personable and full of humor. We laughed a lot. They were Inclusive and accepting to all which we greatly appreciated.
Would absolutely recommend this experience - you will not regret it!!

I had such a great time learning how to make pasta and pizza with Chef Guiseppe. The added touch of providing us with instructions on how to make them at home was great. I would highly recommend taking this course.

Great experience! So much fun and great meeting other world travelers. We made the best pizza I’ve had in my life!!! So memorable. Absolutely worth the cost! Giuseppe and his assistant (I forgot his name.. omg) were so amazing, friendly and knowledgeable. I would actually take this class again. It was so much fun!!!

Lovely experience set in a lush landscape. Mersad was very friendly and informative and I learned a lot about the right techniques. Big bonus was that it was close to the Appian Way which only added to the ambiance and it was great to go for a walk after our workshop. Highly recommend.

Amazing and fun experience! Giuseppe and his team make you feel welcome and make learning how to make pizza and pasta very fun and interactive.
This would have to be a highlight of my time in Rome

I scheduled this experience for me and my mother at the end of our 2 weeks in Italy. It seemed like a good way to immerse ourselves in Italian culture after all of the sightseeing. However, for me personally I did not enjoy ther class as much as I had hoped. The description does not explain that the entire class is conducted outdoors. The area is covered but still outside. I have a sun allergy and definitely would not have booked this experience if I had known I would be outdoors for more than 4 hours. Upon arrival realizing we would be outdoors I only stayed for my mother's sake and the fact that we had traveled an hour outside of Rome. This did cause me to have quite a bit of discomfort after the class. Also the class was simply too crowded and fast paced. It was difficult to have any sort of personalized attention when there are 2 instructors for 25 people. Should also note that it is in a more rural area outside of Rome with uneven terrain that would be challenging for anyone with mobility issues and not accessible for those with wheelchairs or walkers. Overall, the class was adequate just not very accurately described and too crowded to feel like a special experience.
This experience was a lot of fun - the hosts were funny and knowledgable, and made everyone feel welcome. The ingredients were fresh and the location was awesome. Would definitely do it again!

I booked this pizza and pasta making experience for myself and my 2 kids (10 and 16 years old) and we all loved it! The class was fun but professionall at the same time.
Amazing experience and great hosts!

Just an amazing experience! We learned so much in a very friendly environment! Both Mersad and Essiano were great and funny! We felt really welcome. And... The recipes are delicious as well as the wine! Totally recommend! PS: great family activity - my 13 year old loved it! (and we know how difficult it can be to please them! Lol) 🤩😁

Had a wonderful time. Essaniso and Marce made the class fun and exciting. Would absolutely recommend from the meeting location to the materials and explanations the class was easy to follow and informative. We had a wonderful time and it was better than just learning fettuccine.

We both had a great morning and early afternoon at this activity. The team were obviously very experienced, knowledgeable and passionate. They were fun, and also experts at juggling a big group without it feeling impersonal or like too many people. We both had a really fun time, recommended!
This class was amazing! I learned a lot and the food was great. The chefs were always so funny and we had a great time with everyone!

This was a very great experience! Amazing teachers and food during the class. Can’t wait to start using the techniques I learned at my own home. Teachers were amazing and funny made the experience one to remember!
This is a must for people visiting Rome. My wife and I had an absolute blast, and couldn't have asked for a better experience.

My group of 4 had such a great time with Giuseppe and Mersad! They were both charming and the people in our class were a lot of fun! Absolutely loved making the pizza - I think that was our favorite part! Would definitely do this again....just be prepared with bug spray because of the flies.

This was a really cool experience that my fiancé and I did together. We were picked up from the station and taken to their farm, where we made our own personal pizzas (which were quite big and very delicious), then we handmade a selection of pastas and learned how to do it all at home. I’d say the pizza was the best thing we ate, and it was more fun to make the pizza than the pasta, but that’s just our preference.

Some things to note: the experience is not (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) Depending on the number of people who signed up, you are picked up in batches. So we were not picked up until 11am, and did not actually start our experience until about (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) am. We were worried this would cut into our food making time, but we ended up going until about 3pm, and waited to be taken back at maybe 330pm. So if you have a strict time schedule, keep in mind that you may be there past the scheduled time (which was fine with us).

Since we had quite a few people that day, I think the group was too big to feel truly personal. It moves along kind of fast, and the pasta making session is more about making a few pieces of different types of pasta instead of hand making a plate of your own, as you do with the pizza. I think some people may go into it with a different expectation and be disappointed, but we had a very fun time and made some good friends in the process.

I can’t speak for the other pasta making experiences available, but this was what we wanted and enjoyed it a lot. The only bad thing I can say is that there are soooo many bugs and mosquitos, but you’re outside cooking on a farm, so its unavoidable and not their fault. They do provide bug spray to help, though. Just keep it in mind when deciding what to wear or if you really can’t stand bugs around food. In that case, maybe look for an experience that cooks indoors. But this is a really solid experience that gives you a lot of bang for your buck.

This was the best part of our trip to Rome by far. The class was incredible & we had so much fun! Mersad & Giuseppe made the class such an experience & it was full of laughter.

Between the pizza we made, the 2 types of pasta, & tiramisu, you will leave this class immersed in Italian cooking & with a full stomach!
This was a great experience! Everyone running the class was awesome and welcoming. The group was a great size and we had a lot of fun!

The cooking class was a lot of fun and a good value for something different to do while in Rome. The pizza we made was incredible and the pasta was good as well - the pasta shape lesson in the middle could have been a little bit shorter, but all in all was a lot of fun and would recommend people to do it
10/10 would so highly recommend! The entire experience was fun, relaxing and seamless, from booking my spot, to getting picked up, to the class itself. I had a wonderful time.
My sister and I really enjoyed this class. My good friend had participated a few months ago and she recommended it. It did not disappoint

Wow. What a great experience. Our group learnt pizza and pasta making from experts. They really knew the technicalities of pasta but presented it with skill and humour. Even children would enjoy this course.
A highlight of our trip to Italy! The tour leaders kept us laughing all day and we learned so much about pizza & pasta making.
This cooking class is highly recommended. You learn a lot, the cooks are fantastic, and the food is super good. The wine is also very tasty. It's well arranged and the atmosphere is good.

Great experience! We really enjoyed the pizza making from scratch even baking the pizza ourselves using the pizza oven. I thought we’d go more into depth for pasta. We did learn the basic common types of pasta. The 3 chefs were very friendly and entertaining as well. We had a great memorable time. We’d come back again for sure! Giuseppe was Awesome!!! Thank you for a great time!

This was an amazing experience. I have a big passion for food and cooking, so I definitely wanted to learn how to make authentic pizza and pasta while in Italy! Giuseppe and Essiano did not disappoint. Not only were they super knowledgeable and encouraging, they were very funny and kept the groups entertained and moving along with the program! I definitely recommend. Everything was delicious, and the property was beautiful. Thank you guys for such a great time!

I was really glad that I booked this experience and to be away from the crowds in Rome for one day. I did not have any great expectations but the Class was SO COOL!! I can really recommend you to take it. Giuseppe and his team are so funny and warm hearted, but you really see that they have a deep knowledge about cooking. So it was perfect for Beginners but there was also a lot of information for people with cooking experience as well. 100% Recommended!

This was such a great experience! We were greeted with smiles and our instructors were knowledgeable along with having a great personality and were comical. It was so cool being able to make real pizza and learn how to make different pastas and being able to try them. A must do when in Rome!
It was a unique, fantastic and fun experience. The hosts were very knowledgeable and funny at the same time. A well day spent and great value for money. I would surely do it again

What a fun and wonderful experience! I will never eat Dominos or Pizza Hut again! (Haha). Seriously though, the pizza we made was so much fun and tasted so much better. I loved the technical learning and especially getting to eat our creations! Making pasta was equally fun and I loved sitting in the garden, drinking wine & eating the food we made. The Tiramisu at the end was soooo good!!! What a cool location and awesome experience to have in Rome!

The only thing I would suggest is not booking a tour immediately after this class. It says 10:30-2:30, however we didn’t actually get back to the meeting spot until just after 4pm. That was fine for us because our next plans weren’t until 5:30. Leave yourself some buffer time to get to your next activity.

Definitely worth the affordable price. The Chefs are funny, speak great English, and very interactive. A must do in Rome!

You should totally book this experience in Rome. The pizza and pasta we made was fantastic. The place is really beautiful and gets you immersed on a very “Italian” atmosphere, you are surrounded by a lot of nature and you cook outside while having a super nice time. The hosts are really fun to be with and they make everyone to get along and start a conversation. You use very fresh and tasty ingredients and I can assure that you will make pizza and pasta back home with their recipes :)

My husband and I had such a great time today! It was amazing and We learned a lot! Giuseppe, Mersad, & Essiano were all helpful and funny. Their engagement with everyone was incredible. The pizza was amazing (the marinara sauce incredible) also there was FRESH Basil and Mozzarella! We made the pasta by hand (I struggled lol) and the sauce that was prepared by Mersad and Essiano was PERFECTO! The Tiramisu was outstanding! And the homemade Wine... lets just say we had a great time! Please don’t miss the chance to take this experience!
this experience was one of our favorite things we did in Rome. Beautiful location, delicious food, and lots of laughter! This was exactly what we were hoping for.

From all the experiences I could have picked this was the one which probably had the most impact on me for my future live.
I can make my own pizza and pasta now!
The experience was so fun - the guys have such a great humour which made you feel included in the experience and not that someone just explains things very dry.
Recommend it to everyone!

My husband and I had such a fun time. We laughed a lot while making pizza and pasta. We also had a great group of fellow students. They served Tiramisu and a shot of Limoncello after we ate our own creations and it was delicious. We highly recommend this class.

Once in a lifetime experience, learned so many different techniques on how to make pasta. It was located in a secluded country side property. They have homemade wine and tiramisu which was amazing. They have kitties that roam around and are very friendly.
My husband and I had a great time. It was lots of fun, learned a lot and the pizza was amazing! The instructors were helpful and also funny 😊

When friends and family ask us what the highlight of our trip to Italy was, we share that it was this cooking class! A beautiful location with two incredibly gracious and hilarious hosts. The information we learned during this class is invaluable and we will do our best to recreate the endless fun and flavors in our own home for years to come!
If you’re looking for a once-in-a-lifetime experience, this is it. The food was phenomenal, our hosts were engaging, funny, and above all knowledgeable. My wife and I couldn’t recommend this more!

This experience is one of a kind! Not your typical try to make pizza while drinking class. This is a fully immersed, learn-this and-make-mamma-proud kind of class. They were welcoming and funny, and really wanted you to take this experience home with you!! Loved our hosts and had such great conversations with them after the experience. Plus we were able to take a walk behind the farm to the oldest Roman road. Highlight of our trip for sure!!!!

This was a really fun part of my vacation in Rome and I'm so glad I took part. It's a real hands on class! You learn a lot and do a lot and they created a very fun atmosphere where you weren't afraid to mess up - everyone was learning and making different mistakes! It was great to get out of the city of Rome and into a more rural and relaxed setting. After the class, they helped us figure out where to go next and how to get there. A group of us walked the nearby Appian Way - a great way to end the afternoon!
This was literally the best part of our trip!!! We learned so much and we were actually able to enjoy Rome instead of the hustle and bustle of things. You should really really do this.
Overall the experience was great! Loved making pizza, we got to know about different types of pasta, and then the chefs had prepared a couple of sauce to cook with the pasta we made. Thanks Giuseppe!

A wonderful day in the countryside learning how to cook the Italian way. The host was knowledgeable and had a wonderful sense of humour. Pick-up was exactly as described as was the entire experience. This was a highlight of our Rome trip.

The pizza and pasta making class was such a fun experience. I highly recommend it to everyone! Giuseppe and Essiano were the instructors on our visit and both of them were just super entertaining and created a wonderful environment . I also appreciated that this was vegetarian/vegan friendly.

It was a lot of fun making all the different shapes of pasta and learning from Giuseppe. I really appreciated all the little tips they shared with us. I can't wait to try and make it myself at home.
It was excellent. I feel like I learned so much and shared lots of laughs with the hosts and guests. The wine was indeed unlimited and the food was delicious. Would definitely do this again.

To start out whatever expectations you have of a class should be left at the door. Giuseppe was wonderful to open up his place and teach people the basics. That’s it the basics. For me it was well worth it and I loved every part to it. It may not be for you if this is your x amount of times that you have been to Rome and wanted a deepdive class to learn a 5 course Italian meal. He goes through making the dough for a pizza and takes time to show you how and then goes through the many pastas and how they are made. It is a great time and the food is so delicious. I highly recommend this class. It’s really a very unique experience and one you will cherish forever.Giuseppe, Mersad and Essiano thank you for everything!

When reading the incredible reviews for this experience, my partner and I knew we had to book the class! However, what is advertised is NOT necessarily what you get. The start time was originally listed as 10:30 and the class is “4 hours” - I can tell you it was not. The day before, we were told 11am start time and we were back in town by 2:30pm. Our driver Essiano was amazing, so sweet and friendly!! When we arrived at the class location, we were shocked to find 97% of the group already cooking....additionally, we needed to wander our way in and figure out what we were doing as no introduction or schedule was provided. We were quite upset about this. We began with pizza - the chef moved our hands where they needed to be - this was not fun. You didn’t really get to do this yourself - the chef did it for you. The pasta making was fine but we made two types that require fillings - no guidance or advice was given as to what fillings would work or go well. Additionally, the advertisement says you make pasta with 2 sauces .. don’t expect to know what the sauces are or how to make them - or even how to cook the pasta. None of this was talked about or shown to the group. Sooo how long do I cook pasta? Is it different for water versus egg? It is also advertised that you make 3 types of dough - NOT THE CASE. You personally make ONE. The 3 are made by the group but you don’t get to choose which one you make or see how the others are done. No way I could replicate what we did based off what little hands on experience we got. We really do not feel like we got what we were expecting based off what was advertised. The chef is very knowledgeable, but felt like he was rushing us through the motions and not ensuring we understood how to prepare the food again once we got home. A summary document is provided after the class but - you could also just go on YouTube. Was so excited for the class but was unfortunately not what we were expecting.

Incredible Experience!!!!
Worth the price and exceeded our expectations. Brought our kids with us and this is very kid friendly!!
The chefs were personable, informative and the food was awesome!

This was a 5 star experience. Location wonderful, structure of the day was great and we’ve come away having learnt a lot. The instructors Essianio and Mersad were incredibly funny, knowledgable and inclusive. The fellow guests were also lovely. A great vibe all round. You’ll go leaving with a fully belly, having had delicious pizza and pasta, tiramisu and copious amounts of wine. Genuinely the highlight of our trip to Rome - you must do this. Thanks guys!
Unique experience highly recommended by me. A special setting, the host offers you a lively and busy service. It was a pleasant time for me and my boyfriend.

Not too bad in general.
They know what to do in order to make bunch of people to cook something eatable.
Wine is okish, tiramisu is tiny slice.
Overall the experience is touristy and common, high level.
Just to spend few hours is ok.
We had lots of fun with the two men who ran the class - lots of laughs and great interaction with all the students.

Nice people, friendly atmosphere! The group was bigger than we expected but still very well organised. We learned a lot, laughed a lot and tasted great italian food. Making your own pizza is a must for every pizza lover! We could even put it in the owen by ourselves. There was wine and water, after first two hours we ate our pizzas, then after two next we had two kinds of pasta, tiramisu and limoncello. Highly recommend! Also nice touch that we got aprons with logos as a gift.
I really enjoyed the cooking class! It was an amazing experience that I would highly recommend to friends and family traveling to Rome!
Couldn't have asked for a better class. The guys who taught the class were personable and funny, and really made the class feel like a unit. Plus, the pizza we made was molto bene!

Unfortunately, each participant prepared only one dough and then worked with the other participants' doughs. All the information and tricks on the different forms of noodle and doughs could not be remembered sustainably, as there was no time to write down. You'll only be given the recipes, not a summary of the info.
The course still met expectations. The organizer and helpers were very nice, helpful and easy to communicate with. The quality of the ingredients was impeccable. Overall, it was a great atmosphere and a lot of fun. I can really recommend it!
Class is really wonderful for beginner cooks! Even if you are intermediate or have made pasta a few times you'll learn some great, simple sauces to take back home and tinker with.
Great way to quickly learn about Italian culture. Learnt lots of new techniques and really enjoyed the interaction with the hosts and other classmates.
The hosts were really nice and they teach you the basic knowledge of pasta and pizza. Overall, the class was fun and the hosts are very friendly!

The cooking course was a good experience, Giuseppe showed us how to make the perfekt pizza.
The first thing you do is receive dough, that you then form and decorate to your choice, this was great. then you make pasta dough and later pasta shapes. There is a lot of focus on different, rather complicated shapes, which I personally found a bit tricky for a beginner. We did not learn to make any of the sauces which I think would have been a little easier and more practical, as most of our first pasta forms weren’t even eatable. Also I would have liked to learn how to prepare the tiramisu myself, this is not done by the participants.
The main big con, is that the group is too big! We were about 26 people and for a relatively high price, that is just too many. Particularly if you only want Giuseppe to teach.
While this is not part of my rating, I would caution people about Giuseppes assistants they are nice enough, but have a strange sense of humor, that not everyone finds so funny!

Definitely recommend! The guys are nice and funny, the location is gorgeous, the experience is memorable!
The pizza was awesome, as well as the different kinds of pasta we made. The tiramisu is THE BEST! The cats are awesome bonus!
This was a fun experience. Giuseppe and staff were fun and joking around while teaching us the basics of pizza making. pasta making was fun and everyone got to participate

Giuseppe and the guys were absolutely amazing. They arrived at the meeting point perfectly on time and were very friendly during the whole experience. Food was excellent and the place is truly beautiful. I definetely recommend it to everyone!

Grazie!

I did the pizza & pasta class with my mom and sister and had the most wonderful time learning together. The teachers were both hilarious, entertaining and so insightful. A great cooking class for anyone wanting an authentic and fun way to learn.

I absolutely had the BEST time at this cooking class! I don’t normally do experiences like this, but I loved every minute of it. I also love that they use so many local products - I usually feel sick after eating gluten or dairy but I felt okay after eating all the meals here (probably because it was so fresh!). I would highly recommend this if you have a few hours in Rome for a cooking class!

One of the best experiences we had in Rome, these guys teach very well while keeping the class lively and funny with their jokes. Even though we were a big group, we did get personal attention and that made the experience great.

We had an amazing experience! Not only did we learn to make various forms of pasta but we also made new friends and shared many laughs together. We would recommend this to anyone going on vacation to Rome. We both think that this was the most fun experience in Rome! The two teachers we had were so hilarious and very caring. Thank you for a wonderful experience.
Our hosts were very knowledgeable and easy-going. The food was amazing and they really put it in the effort to make it enjoyable for everyone. It was a unique experience and we loved it!

A great experience in a beautiful area. A great escape from the busy centre but not far at all we had a great time! The hosts and other guests were great fun and the food delicious. I certainly learnt a lot!

Certainly something for good weather and I would say best when going with at least one other person.

It was a super fun experience! I mean you wouldn’t expect to be real professional after one class, but seeing your own pizza bubbled up in the wood oven was a real scene. Also our mentors were super fun, making everyone feel relaxed but serious about Italian food -that’s a great attitude. I liked especially the way they made efforts to talk to every single one participant as well as telling jokes related to different cultures and backgrounds. Definitely recommend this!
The place was very chuli, away from the city in the middle of the countryside. The chefs are really nice. For the price I expected a little more, but we made a pizza to eat!

Mersad and his team are great host of the class. Even though my parents could not speak English, they enjoyed it a lot. We learnt how to make Napoli pizza, different kinds of pasta, and tasted tiramisu, lemon/red wine. They even use home grown olive for the oil and eggs for pasta. Authentic and original way to get in touch with Italian gastronomy culture!

This class was so much fun! Not only did I learn new things and bring them back to the states with me but the chef’s just made us laugh and enjoy the moment. An experience of a lifetime and would definitely recommend!!

Absolutely amazing day, contact was very good before the meet up. The guys were funny and knowledgable, me and my wife had such a great time and met a few new friends on the day, very interesting very tasty food i cant reccomend this experience highly enough, if your in rome then do it!

If you’re looking to take a cooking class or even if you’re not (my girlfriend really wanted to do this) this is the experience you need to consider! We cooked, we ate, we drank and met some amazing people! Everyone came from different backgrounds and countries so it made the experience even more unique! I definitely recommend this if you’re in Rome!

This is a one of a kind experience! I didn’t know what to expect, but it exceeded all of our expectations. Mersad was knowledgeable and patient (which is much needed)! Essiano was a little less patient but hilarious nonetheless. We made delicious pizza, drank wine, ate (and made) pasta and met some great friends along the way. Overall, the day was full of laughter and fun!

Now, my boyfriend and I can’t wait to test our new cooking skills out at home!

This is such a great experience! Essiano and Mersad are so personable and knowledgeable. I really enjoyed meeting them. Special shout out to Essiano for waiting for me!! The day is well organized, very interactive and informative. I learned so much! No hesitation recommending this tour to other people.

It was a great experience to see how authentic Napoleon hand crafted Pizza was made, it was delicious, and good experience. Also the knowledge about flour and pastas Mersad gave are very good. I love it, even it was my 3rd cooking class in Rome. Lihong from NC USA.

These guys were so personable, knowledgeable, funny and passionate about the food they were teaching! We are so excited to try our newly learned authentic Italian recipes when we get home! Our food turned out delicious!!

We didn’t see Giuseppe but Mersad and Essensio were great and very funny. I thought there was a tiny bit too much detail about the types of flour but that is my only complaint and other people may like learning about it. Enjoyed it very much and would recommend.

Best experience I’ve had on my around the world European trip. He really knows about, and deafly makes you feel welcome. My only advice I would give is take the train to their meeting location. Do not driving yourself.

My boyfriend and I had a very nice day at the workshop. The two guys told us the secrets of the Italian kitchen and really did their best to create a nice atmosphere with their great sense of humor. Would really recommend this to anyone visiting Rome!

My friend and I were in Rome for the weekend and this was by far the highlight of our trip. Not only was the food spectacular but the staff and atmosphere made this experience a dream. We took a taxi there and would recommend doing so if you don't make the provided transportation on time. If you (Hidden by Airbnb) map public transportation straight there, there are a bunch of connecting busses and walking involved. We were very happy we took a taxi because the villa was deep in a neighborhood with dirt roads. They let us take their returning van transportation to the pick-up spot by the metro station which worked out perfectly. 110% would recommend this experience to anyone who wants an authentic Italian cooking experience!
Had a great time, the hosts were welcoming, funny and made me feel at ease the minute I got there. Learnt a lot. Would highly recommend!

Very nice experience that I would recommend to all pizza and pasta lovers. The hosts knew the material that was being transmitted extensively, and also knew how to provide the information to us. They were really friendly, made a few jokes with the group, had us laughing at times. The toping to this experience is wine, and the nice piece of delicious tiramisu which was served at the end as dessert.
Great day out! I highly recommend this! The team were engaging and very funny and the pizza we made was the best we have eaten in Italy!

We had a wonderful time on our cooking class experience with Giuseppe, Mersad, and Essiano. In addition to learning to make pizza and various types of pasta, we were kept laughing the whole time. The food was delicious, the instructors were a blast, and I can’t recommend this experience enough. It helped that we had a fun group of others with us. By far the highlight of our stay in Rome.
It was fantastic learning how to make pasta and pizza from them! Highly recommend this experience. My mom and I enjoyed it very much. Suitable for all ages. The team was warm and funny.
This was a great experience! Our hosts (Giuseppe, Mersad, and Essiano) were all fantastic and made this so much fun. Plus the food we made was amazing. Strongly recommend!

What can I say that has not already been said in previous reviews? This is a great experience. It’s why we use AirBnB.

It’s one thing to keep a bunch of adults occupied and interested while applying wine (which they do)... it’s another thing entirely to be able to keep the attention of a 10 year old. Our daughter loved this experience...

Please try this out... it will exceed your expectations
It was fun to learn how to shape pizza dough & make the different shapes of pasta. The pizza was simple but tasted very good. Giuseppe is very knowledgeable.

A wonderful class, the teachers were very welcoming and helpful. I went with a friend and we are so glad we signed up for the class! The location is a little tricky if you don't take the shuttle so I would recommend that! The end dishes were amazing.
Definitely a highlight! Mersad kept us laughing the whole time. Their passion was genuine and I learned a lot. I had a wonderful time!

This was such a great time!! My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. It was a big class but you didn't feel like you were ever forgotten about. They all tried to learn everyones names and where people were from. We learned a lot from them and will surely be recreating what we learned at home. All of the instructors were extremely friendly as well and had such great attitudes. Not to mention the pasta and pizza that's created taste amazing!

We thoroughly enjoyed our time at Giuseppe’s cooking class! We did this on our last day in Italy and it was the perfect way to end our trip. We loved connecting with the other participants and learning about making Italian food! Giuseppe’s team is wonderful and they all have a fun sense of humor! So much fun and worth every penny!

This was an amazing experience.l! Not only was it a day of learning from a very knowledgeable chef and his very knowledgeable and funny assistant chefs... it was a beautiful day, making wonderful friends. The food was good and we all made it from scratch. We learned different techniques and reasons for those techniques while being surrounded by humor and a relaxing environment. There was wine and water for refreshments and at the end, homemade Tiramisu and Limoncello. I absolutely recommend this class to anyone who’s wanting to learn - while making new friends! Wish I could give more than 5 stars!

We had a great day with the guys, they picked us up and took to a nice secluded place just outside the city. They made us feel welcome, had lots of laughs and I can't wait to return home and try making my own pasta and pizza dough. Thanks guys,

We had a great time learning to make pasta and pizza and lots of laughs. Would recommend the experience to everyone! Mersad, Essiano, and Giuseppe were welcoming, friendly and knowledgeable. Thank you for the experience!

We arrived excited and full of expectations; all of which were met to the max!! The staff was hilarious. The dynamic and progression of the class felt effortless. My boyfriend and I fell in love with the experience and will be back with family:)

Absolutely 100% recommend this class ! We weren't sure what to expect but it was an amazing experience. The guys made it fun, they're super funny, they help you if you need it (while somewhat making jokes at you). Very informative class. You get to eat the pizza you make! If you're not sure , just take the class. Very reasonable pricing for your time spent and what you get from it

If you have time, seriously make it a point to book this experience! My wife and I had a fantastic time learning how to make fresh pizza and pasta with folks from all over the world. Our teachers, Essiano and Mersad, are experts, not to mention lovely people with great senses of humor. The place, a small ranch, is tucked away from Rome (about 5 miles from where we are staying)—so idyllic and very serene. Enjoy your experience! Also, it is very POC and LGBT friendly.

AMAZING experience. The crew was engaging, personable, funny and overall just wonderful people. Learned a lot in a short time, really enjoyable experience, loved every minute of it and would recommend it to anyone. Would 100% book again!
It was a fun day we spent more time with his sous chef but he was fantastic. Really friendly and made the day fun for everyone

This was a once in a lifetime experience! The last event on our trip in Rome and I can not explain how wonderful this leaves my heart feeling. The staff was beyond inviting, the location was beautiful, and the lesson was perfect! The talent and skill they possess is astounding! And the fun and humor they melt into the lesson was a genuine touch of the culture. Learning how to make a pizza and pasta from these three was nothing less than perfect! Everyone going to Rome should take this class!

I would highly recommend this cooking class. My boyfriend and I had such a lovely afternoon and Giuseppe and his colleagues have mastered making this experience the perfect balance of fun, learning and hands on cooking!

Me and partner we had fun. We learn how to make pizza, pasta and the experience was wonderful.

The location is scenic and cozy country side.

I would recommend for those who consider this class.
We really enjoyed the day. The lessons were easy to follow and we know have a new, deeper appreciation for the Roman food. Thanks to the team for making it a memorable event.

My grandson and I had a great time at Giuseppe's school. We learnt how to form 10 different types of pasta, cooked a pizza and got to taste tiramisu and limoncello. Cooking outside was a lovely experience. It inspired us to give it a go upon our return home. Overall a fun experience - thank you to the team.

This is a must do experience, you will not experience how to do the pizza/pasta only, you are up to an unforgettable experience.
In this experience you will feel that all the people around you are your friends, that goes to Giuseppe and his co-assistants.

Loved it! So much fun! The pizza and pasta baking is both technical but also doable if you pay attention you definitely feel like a real Italian! The team is awesome lots of jokes and laughs to be had!
