Mersad and Essiano were fantastic. They are very knowledgeable about Italian cuisine and made everything accessible for us as guests. The atmosphere was welcoming and fun and we felt encouraged to give everything a go. Thank you guys we had a brilliant time.

My husband and I had the pleasure of taking this wonderful class on our honeymoon. It was honestly one of the highlights of the trip. It is much easier to get to the location than we expected and really so worth the time and money. We are home now and cannot wait to practice the new skills we learned abroad. We would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a good time as well as great learning experience.
It was an amazing experience, and I made my first pizza!!! Well, I dropped the first one, but the second one tasted great!!! I’d strongly recommend this event

Amazing! Absolutely the highlight of our trip. From the beginning our hosts made us feel welcome and at ease. They constantly crack jokes and make learning fun. Location is a great break from the hustle and bustle of rome (and only 20 mins via metro, although (Hidden by Airbnb) said 40.) Definitely recommend.

What an awesome experience! Gained a lot of information about pizza and pasta making. Both Mersad and Essiano were amazing hosts, very knowledgeable and quite funny! We really enjoyed this class and the location was superb. The food was good and the company was even better. It's definitely a highlight of our trip to Rome! Definitely recommend this!

Great experience and yummy pizza!
We had an amazing time with Mersad and lots of fun during the cooking class. Great location and nice participants from all over the world. It’s not an intimate event because of the big number of participants, but a we have learned a lot and enjoyed our stay there.

This was a terrible experience made worse by the reaction of the owner of the experience. The food was bad and inappropriate comments masked as poor attempts at humor were made at the experience. The owner also threatened me with legal action following my review.

Fun experience and you not only make your own pizza, but you learn to hand roll pasta in various complex shapes which was new, interesting for me. From arriving at the location, being transported to the class and waiting for the return to the meeting spot, be prepared for a long event and try to not have many time restrictions before and after.

Yesterday's cooking class was just brilliant! Chef Giuseppe and his team were so friendly, funny and patient. The logistics was well organized and the gentleman that was driving our car was too, very kind!! I recommend sincerely this experience. The place is in the middle of the nature, just to complete it!

Excellent! Giuseppe and co are very funny and the whole time you will be having fun. They really know how to make good pizza and pasta and they take time to make sure you get it right. Fully recommend.

This experience is really worth it! Great atmosphere, useful knowledge and sufficient time & place for practicing. You’ll learn to work your pizza dough, make different styles of pasta and the best part is that you got to eat it all at the end. The guys were super nice and entertaining.
Very good moment with our 3 hosts. We spent most of our class with Mersad who was very friendly and welcoming. He taught us lots of things with fun. The place was nice and original.
They were ALL amazing friendly and welcoming. Even though it was a first time experience, they made me feel super comfortable to make errors. And I would refer them as well as well as return.

This was an amazing experience. The chefs were very knowledgeable and created a fun environment. They not only showed us how to make pizza and pasta but educated us on each ingredient we used during our session. I would take this class again and I would definitely recommend it to friends. It was nice to get away from the city.

My sister and I will NEVER be chefs, but this brought us closer to an Italian kitchen than anything else. We even made some great friends from around the globe, including our wonderful chefs! We laughed, ate, and drank... what could be better?

5 star review! Attended the September 5, 10am class. Giuseppe wasn't there and Mersad was our chef! This was an amazing cooking class. I can't say enough good things about this class.

This was the highlight of my trip in Rome. First, I overslept missed the metro and had to taxito the location. Texted the host, Mersad answered and provided address to the Olive farm. I was there an hour late! Oh no, but received a warm welcome and caught up very quickly with the Pizza making.

There were 6 of us in the class, so very intimate. Our class was very diverse, with different nationalities and ethnicities. We had great conversations about our countries, traditions, diversity and acceptance. I learned so much about how to make pasta, about different types of pizza but also about the people at our table.
The host, Mersad, shared his background and made lots of jokes. He made us feel like old friends.

I couldn't believe, I made pasta from scratch - flour, egg and knead the dough, viola! We learned how to make different pasta shapes also. I appreciated the communal cooking experience and emphasis on hygiene, no phones or objects allowed on the table where we made pasta. We were asked to wash our hands several times! Our host, Mersad, cooked the pasta (boiled on an outside stove) and we ate what we made! It was delicious, a pesto dish and a Romano fettuccine. This was in addition to the wood grilled pizza we made and ate earlier.
We finished with Tiramisu that Mersad made. Mmm so good.

We received recipes and instructions via email within 2.5 hours of class ending. This is definitely something I'm trying at home!

The farm was very rustic (outdoor bathrooms etc) and we cooked outside. If you don't like the heat and this atmosphere, this class maybe isn't for you. If you want a new experience and an Authentic, italian cooking experience, sign up now!

Thanks again for the amazing class.
Ciao!

Awesome class! Mersad was knowledgeable, professional and organized. From start to finish it was a great experience. I feel like I learned authentic and genuine recipes + techniques. I appreciated that we were shown each step of the /preparation cooking process and we were able to do things ourselves. This is the best alternative if you want a break from touring and sightseeing while in Rome.

Thanks to Guiseppe and his team for a great day. The atmosphere was welcoming and relaxing. Everyone on Guiseppe’s team had a great sense of humour which made for a fun and relaxing way to spend the day. The food we made was delicious and I feel, even as a very novice cook, I learnt a lot! Definitely recommend if you are looking for a fun experience while in Rome.

Went on this experience with my husband and two kids (ages 7 and 10), we had a blast! The kids loved the hands-on parts and help offered by Giuseppe, who joked around with them a lot. Great food, fun time, would book again in a heartbeat, highly recommend!

I would highly recommend this experience! The location is lovely and Giuseppe and his team were extremely welcoming and humorous. Not to mention the food was incredible! Made some lovely friends as well, overall great experience.
Highly recommend this experience. We left excited to make our food with all of our new knowledge. Everyone has a great personality and very knowledgeable!

I have been to Rome several times and always wanted to learn to make pizza. It was a plus to make pasta and have dessert. My husband and I really enjoyed ourselves once we actually got to the location and got started, the staff was very friendly, good energy and helpful. The experience was fun and light, met some nice people.
And the pizza was one of the best pizza I had ever had. Learning to make Pasta was a good experience, I appreciate-enough to know that I will never make pasta from scratch and give credit to places that make it from scratch.

The location was outside of the city it wasn’t as I expected it but was okay a we had an idea it would be outside setting.
It did however need some up keep and perhaps an Italy rustic touch.

The wine was unlimited ( that was nice) , however don’t have high expectations as it tasted like a watered down Chianti ( notch below a cheap table wine). There were a few others that really kept on pouring and indulging so there is that appreciation if you just want to keep drinking. Sorry that was my opinion however we live near wine country so we have high standards of wine.

I did like the fact that an email with the recipes were sent to us thought it was a nice touch.
Great experience... Location is amazing, we went for a walk on the Appian way after the class. Met some nice people, had good food and wine... highly recommend!!

Such a great event that I would highly recommend everyone! The teachers have a great chemistry together that made for lots of laughs and fun while learning how to make a delicious pizza and different noodle shapes. It was great talking to many different people around the world and creating inside jokes that we could laugh about later. Loved this class!
My boyfriend and I wanted to follow a cooking class for a long time and this was the perfect opportunity. The experience was great and the heat was managed well with misters around the working area.

It was a wonderful experience. Mersad and Essiano are not only know there craft very well but they are super entertaining and helpful to their students. It was well organised and we learned so much. The group was fantastic and lots of interesting people to get to know. Would do it again. :)
My girlfriend is so happy about this she made a wonderful authentic Italian dinner the following weekend. Thanks to you guys.

Giuseppe and his team are truly experienced in making pasta and pizza doughs and we are grateful to have learnt some skills and techniques from them. While I may be a complete novice when it comes to cooking, I still thoroughly enjoyed the class. So does my mother who also attended the class with me - she did not really enjoy pizzas previously, but the class had absolutely changed her mind!

This experience was incredible! I am a total foodie, and wanted and experience that was authentic, fun and immersive. The entire team was so sweet, accommodating and fun. I really enjoyed the fact that when I went the group was not too big, and so it was a very intimate experience- from the history, technique, and so many more facets of food, so much was covered. I really enjoyed this class and would do it again. The food was incredibly delicious and this is a must do while in Rome!! Highly suggested!!

An absolutely fantastic experience that I would pay for a second time with another group of friends.
Giuseppe added his fantastic sense of humour to his expertise in helping us to create mouth watering pizzas and different types of hand-made pasta.

He made an effort to get to know each of our names and backgrounds in a big group of 9 people. He took us through each step of the delicate cooking process carefully, and he didn't lie when he said there would be no shortage of wine!
He was also well prepared with an alternative during an unexpected storm which brought the outdoor eating zone into our cucina.

Thank you for your thorough instruction, your charming personality and the recipes you sent to us which we've used multiple times since leaving Rome. We've been impressive everyone back home with our quality napolitana pizza making skills as well as our fresh pastas!

Now time to get back into a gym routine... Thanks for that too ;)

If you have a half day to spare, this is a must do experience in Rome! It makes a change from seeing the normal sights and getting involved in real Italian cooking with local ingredients which are delicious. The program is amazing, enthusiastic, informative, helpful and funny.

We were taught a between techniques and recipes throughout the day starting with a pizza making from start to finish, snacking on our own made pizzas, following with a pasta making lesson, and ending the class with our own pasta and tiramisu desert! We will never forget the amazing experience and the nice company we’ve met. We will make the recipes we learnt at home, and reference the given guide with everything we learned.

A great day in Rome, met lovely people, and learned new skills!

AMAZING!!! My friends and I had the best experience at the cooking class and we were so full afterwards! The food was delicious and the class was so fun. Loved every second and would highly recommend.

My friend and I had a fantastic experience with Giuseppe and his team. Their setup was beautiful. They came to pick us up at the station. We learned to make pizza from scratch and different shapes of pasta. There was free flowing wine and conversation. It felt very homely. The chef and his team were very professional and hygienic. This was a once in a lifetime experience and was totally worth the money.

My fiancé and I booked this experience to get a real taste of Italy - It was wonderful! From the homemade pizza, to the pasta making, + the staff. It was unique and different. As other reviews expressed, it will take up half of your day so plan accordingly. Also, plan for about 30 or so people to be in the class, as they are popular.

Piacere
This was a great experience! They really knew their stuff and were funny and personable ppl. Definitely recommend this to anyone thinking about doing it. You won’t regret it at all.
This was the most wonderful experience! My personal favourite was the pizza making and eating. This was one of the highlights of our trip 😊

Great experience, set outdoors but the heat was managed well with misters in the preparation area. The pizza was phenomenal, and the instructor was a wealth of knowledge in the preparation of pasta and pizza. They took the time to know us by name, get into what we wanted. This is a fairly time consuming event, driving to their property and traveling to he meeting point. But it was well worth it, just be sure to block out the time so you don’t feel rushed. The tiramisu sample at the end was good as well. 5 STARS!

This masterclass was the most amazing experience in my life! The explanation was perfect and we could easily repeat all. Pasta and pizza were very very tasty (especially when you know you cooked them yourself).
Thank you so much for this experience!

The most unique experience near Rome. This is something I will always remember. I’m so glad I did this with my family and I’m so happy I got to meet genuine and friendly Italians.

They truly care and this is shown through their passion and sense of humor.

A great way to get to know real Italian cuisine. I absolutely loved it!
One of the best experiences we had in Italy! So worth it, I would totally recommend to anyone wanting to learn about pizza and pasta while visiting Rome Italy!
This was one of the best things we did on our trip. Mersad and essiano were so much fun and the pizza and pasta were delicious
This experience was second to none! Their knowledge and humour was top level, and their generosity with the food was exceptional. This was a true highlight of our honeymoon. Highly recommended!

Wonderful experience. We've been making pizzas at home for 10 years and there were huge gaps in our knowledge. We'd effectively been making pizzas incorrectly. Well worth the money and effort.
Great team, friendly and engaging.

Really great experience! The food was delicious and the instructors were nice. Getting to know mersad was amazing. He has excellent insight on Italy. I was a little bummed we didn’t get to prepare the sauce with the pasta but it was still wonderful. The tiramisu and lemon cello at the end of the class were great touches!!
It was a really awesome place and so delicious food! We had a lot of fun and the wine was also very tasty!

The cooking class was really good an we had a lot of fun! Pizza and pasta were both great. It was very interesting to get to know how "real" pizzas are made and what differences there are for the dough. They were so delicious!
Everything was perfect and we really enjoyed this experience. Thank you very much!
This was a great pasta making class. It is definitely recommended to come hungry. They taught us the right way to make pasta and we are excited to take that experience home. Thanks!

we had an extraordinary experience with my wife. Mersad and his friend was an amazing host, we both had fun and learnt useful tips preparing pizza and pasta at home. In addition The location is nice and authentic.

As parents taking along five children (aged 12-3) I wondered how we would get on but Giuseppe and his staff were so welcoming, warm, friendly, helpful and funny. Our children loved him and the other staff. We all got involved and had so much fun! Everyone on the course was friendly and the conversations flowed. We really enjoyed making and eating the pizza and pasta and feel confident that we can recreate both at home. The tiramisu at the end was delicious as well! A fantastic day which we would highly recommend.
An amazing time with great chefs and other participants. Even as a solo-traveller, I felt very included and really enjoyed the class. Top notch experience!

We did the cooking class with our 3 teens, and had a great time learning to make pizza and pasta. Giuseppe and his team were wonderful from start to finish. We had a large group of 32, which they skillfully managed with ease and good humour. The pizza we made was delicious, and we are excited to try and recreate it at home. our son wants to return some day and work for Guiseppe! We were given clear instructions and help when needed. The pasta shapes were fun to make, and we learned 10 different shapes. We then made an amazing linguine and shell shaped dish with pesto sauce. The tiramisu we had for dessert was wonderful. It was definitely the highlight of our trip to Roma.

We had a lot of fun! The hosts went out of their way to make sure everyone had a good time (even when one of the guests dropped their pizza on the way to oven!). My fiancee swears that the pasta we made in the class was the best we had in Rome.

This was one of the most memorable moments of our three week vacation. We are so glad we signed up for this experience. Giuseppe and his crew are absolutely wonderful. Not only did we learn how to cook these great dishes but we felt immersed in the culture and just surrounded by lovely people in a one of a kind setting. Thanks so much for the memories!

Guiseppe’s pasta-making class was AMAZING! It was one of the most memorable experiences we have from Rome. They were very organized from the pickup to the train station, to the class itself, and the drop-off and the end. I learned so much about making pasta and pizza, and the entire team was so welcoming and fun to work with. Not to mention the food (and wine) was delicious! Awesome all around! I’d definitely do it again!

This was an amazing start of my first trip to Rome. The entire staff was so friendly and knowledgeable. The class was structured with breaks between pizza and posta that allowed for the experience to feel unrushed and pleasant. I got to learn so much from this experience and am excited to be able to utilize what I have learned.

Wonderful experience! The amount of time for the experience was great. The pick-up was right on time and just as described. We took a quick van ride to the location and promptly got started. We first started with the pizza - the dough was already prepared, so we got some great tips on how to stretch the dough without ruining it. After topping off the pizza and putting it into the pizza oven, we got to eat our individual pizzas - they even had pizza boxes for the leftover pizza since we didn't want to get too full before the pasta! After a short break of pizza + wine, we got to the pasta making and also learned about the different consistencies of dough for pizza and pasta. We first learned how to form several shapes of pasta before we got to make the one that we would actually be cooking and eating. We were able to enjoy 2 types of pasta with different pasta sauces. There was plenty to eat and there was even some left over. We finished up with a delicious piece of tiramisu and limoncello.
The amount of time was perfect and location was nice. The hosts were very entertaining and kept us laughing. Would recommend!

Giuseppe and his co-workers were so amazing. The food we made was delicious and their wine was also a bonus. This was a lovely experience for a solo traveler to feel welcome and meet friends. It is a little bit out of the way of Rome but transportation was very easy and being in the “country” made the experience feel very authentic and special. I would recommend this experience to anyone traveling to Rome!! Grazie Mille!!

Very special experience! I really enjoyed working with Giuseppe and especially with his co-chefs. The structure of the class is wonderful, the food is delicious, and my entire family was really glad to have taken part in this! I would definitely recommend this!

Amazing experience! We will take the skills we learned and put them into action at home! Learning the proper technique was very important to us as we both enjoy cooking and learning to make our favourite foods was amazing. The hosts are friendly, very skilled and funny. An amazing experience we won’t forget.
The experience was fun and interesting. They were funny and kind. I did learn a few things that I didn't know before. You get personalised help where needed.

I love it so much that I am writing this review in Spanish and English.

If you love pizza, I highly recommend to book with Giuseppe. Amazing guy, with his Italian sense of humor made this experience unforgettable.
Ps he gave me tips and places to visit for the rest of my stay that made the trip so much better.

Me encanto tanto esta experiencia que me tome el tiempo de escribirla en español e inglés.
Si te gusta la pizza y quieres una experiencia inolvidable vayan con Giuseppe.

This experience was great. This was the best activity we've ever had in Rôme. The host was nice funny as well as those assistants, they were very charming and nice. My husband and I were delighted. Now we're cooking Italian at home thanks to Giuseppe's class. I highly recommend. We made our own pizza, they were delicious. We learned how to make homemade pasta and enjoyed it with sauces at the end of the activity. It was a treat with the chef's tiramisu as a dessert. In short, you will have understood this activity is worth it, you will not be disappointed.

I also went with my child (8 years old) during a time when I had a lot of families with children.Hosts who provide detailed descriptions and sketches by Maestro will help us get through the process.Whether it's dough or baking in the pizza oven, it's hard to do it on your own...!
It was a class in an outdoor facility, but there was also a roof and air conditioning (mist), so it was comfortable even in mid-summer.Above all, people got to know each other and made good memories in Italy. Thanks, Maestro!

A beautiful experience on a summer day. We prepared a mouthwatering Pizza and got to know a lot about the process of it all, what flours to use etc. Then we went on to making the Pasta, which was a little more weary and less rewarding but still worth the while.
Would definitely recommend
Definitely recommend this class! It was interesting, interactive, delicious and we got to meet others from all over the world! One of my favorite things I did in Rome!

Great Class, it was hot but still fun. Drink lots of water. I would definitely recommend taking this class. The instructors are very sarcastic and funny. They were very passionate about the subject and want to make sure you pay attention. The class is very long but a great outing, just be prepared to come and learn.

It was hassle-free. We were picked up at Laurentia station on time. The hosts were all super friendly and humorous. Important know how to read what you can't read in a cookbook is superbly conveyed to you. They're consistently supported by hosts for issues such as noodle forms.
Unique experience. Definitely not to be missed in a visit to Rome!!! The food is all super delicious and you'll be in paperwork afterwards. If you can't make the pizza, you can take it with you.
We had some doubts about the relatively cheap price, but we were definitely proven a better one. Absolutely worth 5 stars.

This experience was amazing. 10/10 must do! It is completely hands on from start to finish! We started by making the pizza, stretching the dough and everything all the way to putting it on the peal and sliding it into the pizza oven. Then they showed us 10 different styles of pasta noodles and we in suit after watching. Then we made more pasta for the meal we had. From there they collected it all and made a white cream sauce pasta with pepper and a pesto pasta. Both were amazing! We finished it off the tiramissu. So glad we booked this, it was the best experience we had in Rome!

Excellent experience! Went with my family including one 8 year old, two teens and 4 adults. Giuseppe and his 2 assistants were very welcoming. They were particularly understanding when our son dropped the pizza he had just made on the ground while taking it out of the oven. He was sooooo disappointed. They did everything to console him and humour him back to a great mood :)

We got to practice making a great variety of pastas and a pizza with the toppings of our choice. We ate everything we made... plus tiramisu as dessert. Yum!

Everything was well organized including meeting up with the assistant at the metro station. All in all again, a great experience that we really recommend.

Giuseppe and his sous-chefs were very patient and friendly. The food was very fresh and our final products were delicious. The location was clean and had a true and deep italian cachet. It was a great experience overall.

This was really a great experience. We learned how to make pizza and pasta which was very delicious! The scenery was beautiful! It was all outdoors with tables and a hot oven set up for us. Very fun and educational experience. I can’t wait to make my own pizza and pasta!

It was an amazing experience & worth every penny! Transportation, plenty of food & wine, and tips on making it at home were included. They were great with kids too. We're excited to make pizza and pasta now that we are home! Giuseppe even sent us documents & pictures from the experience. It was a highlight of our trip!
Excellent communication and easy instructions for pick-up. They were so friendly with our young kids and very patient. Everyone had so much fun.
This was great! All the hosts were lots of fun and we learned so much about how to make pizza dough and pasta. It is in an outdoor kitchen so it is very hot in July, but the food was delicious!
Very fun!! The experience is outdoors in a wonderful setting. Time flies with class and jokes. Totally recommended. Thank you
Wonderful experience! My 11 year old son felt this was his favorite thing we did in Rome. The three men running the cooking school are quite entertaining and engaging.
Really cool experice with this crew. We enjoyed a lot the stories, the experiences and the good food. It made look everything super easy to do and the hosts were suuuuperb kind!
Giuseppe is a great teacher and is actually interested in helping you learn. Giuseppe also had a great group of assistants to help him and make it an overall great experience.

They really know a lot about dough and pasta, but they act very superior about it. The farm was not like the description - it was run down and in need of attention. If the temperatures are up, it’s a very hot, slow four hour experience. They only offer you basic ham, mushrooms, cheese, and basil leaves for toppings.
Guiseppe is harsh and overbearing in his teaching method during stretching the pizza dough, assuming up front you’re not going to listen and pay attention. I was turned off by his harshness during the first five minutes. He scolds you if you mess up. The others were more laid back and fun to learn from.
The tiramisu at the end was very tasty.

An all-round successful experience. The crew is simply sharpened with a lot of humor and expertise in the making of pizza and pasta. Not only do you have a great day, you can take it with you. I will now make my own pizza and pasta more often at home. Thank you!

Hands down the best part of our trip to Rome! As other comments mention this is a peaceful getaway from the craziness of Rome! My husband and I loved it! These guys are very passionate about what they do and it shows! Can’t wait to try it at home!!
Excellent experience making pasta and meeting people from different places, I recommend doing this activity great learnings and moments.

It was sensational! They picked us up from the agreed upon spot, the path is beautiful, the place is lovely. All absolutely organized by valuing every minute of our time and exceeding our expectations for learning. We laughed a lot, learned a lot, ate a lot in the end. I hope so many other people have the wonderful opportunity to have the same experience as my husband and I, in fact, who was actually up to the kitchen and now he was excited to help even for family lunches. Grazie Mille!

Amazing! I would recommend to anybody who wishes to learn the basics of pizza and pasta making in an interactive setting. The hosts were very engaging, good fun and expert. They clearly enjoyed getting to know their guests and sharing their experiences.

This was both educational and fun. Giuseppe and his team were knowledgeable, skillful, and fun to be around. The setting is a quiet outdoor kitchen outside the city. It was nice to get away from the traffic and noise of Rome for awhile. I strongly recommend this experience.

This class is a must do in Rome! It was in a beautiful setting and provided a nice respite from the hustle and bustle of the city. The chef and his assistants were funny and so helpful! I would recommend this class for anyone wanting to know more about cooking in Rome!
It was a very good experience in which we learned what we expected to prepare in our houses the recipes of pizza and pasta perfectly
It was an amazing experience!! I highly recommend it for someone who loves to cook and wants to bring a bit of Italy home with them. An extremely funny class!! It’s worth it!!

It was a wonderful experience all together. The lesson was easy to follow and i would recommend it to anyone. We were in a group which was also nice as we got to interact with different people. The environment surrounding was very peaceful and the pizza/pasta tasted great!

We had a wonderful time. We learned so much and enjoyed every moment.
It was fun to make our own Pizza and to create all different types of pasta.
The best part was nothing felt rushed. It was lovely to relax and connect with others from all over the world and indulge in the wonderful food we had made.
Thank you so much for a special experience !

AMAZING! This was one of the highlights of my trip & the best pizza I’ve ever had.... the hosts were amazing & funny.... made us feel welcomed & it was a personal experience. We enjoyed ourselves, thank you!!
It's a great experience. You learn about a different culture, and the vibe is top notch. And the food is delicious... everything is perfect!!

The mini van that the host traveled into had 2 unsafe back seats including no seat belts and seating not attached to the floor. Unfortunately, their van was under repair since the host had an accident a few days earlier. They should have found another van to travel safely.
My Partner and I had a great time making and eating Pizza and Pasta, and drinking lots of wine! Would recommend a visit.

This was one of our favourite experiences in Rome. A great opportunity to get away from the tourist traps and enjoy the Roman country side. As well as being able to enjoy an authentic Italian experience. Great value. Mersad was our instructor for the class, and he was very friendly and made the class a lot of fun. We also got time to interact and chat with the other guests, which was also a great part of the experience. Strongly recommend for food lovers.

This was one of our favorite parts of our trip to Rome! This class gives you some great insight, tips, and tricks to making awesome pizza and pasta. We learned so much (and ate so much) and are excited to try our newly acquired skills at home!
This was such a fun experience that I cannot recommend enough. We had such a great time and will be trying all of the recipes we learned at home.
This was so much fun and such a beautiful and fun way to end our trip in Rome. The hosts were funny and helpful, and the food was delicious!

We had so much fun with these guys. I would definitely recommend it if you’re looking for some engaging cooking lessons but also a leisurely outing. In-between pizza and pasta-making sessions, we spent some time hanging out on his farm where we drank wine. You’ll get to eat the dishes you learn to make. He’s got a wood fire pizza oven under a nice little shaded deck. The eggs we used came from the chicken coup a few yards away. Super unique, farm to table, fun and sassy chef. We would come again.

Amazing! I booked this experience as we wanted an authentic experience and to learn a lot in a short amount of time. We loved their sense of humor and my boyfriend ( who doesn’t cook) really enjoyed himself. Marcea was amazing and taught us so much. We absolutely would recommend to anyone looking to have a great time and do something different!

Really enjoyed our off-site activity. Great time making pizza & pasta with good dialogue and met fun people on the tour too! I'm glad we did this activity to get out of the city and do something out of the norm. Loved it!

Everyone was super friendly!! The chefs and even the other people who we had never met before. A great experience if you worry you might be uncomfortable with other groups of people. The staff do a great job of getting to know everyone and making everyone feel comfortable. This experience was so much fun!!
If you have any interest in learning to make pizza or pasta this is the absolute perfect class for you. Giuseppe gives great feedback and the class is fun and enjoyable.
I would recommend this journey into pizza and pasta world. The scenery is very local and nice. Host was great and food was delicious. Highly recommend!

This was an AMAZING class! You get to learn so much! I wanted to book this tour specifically because you learn pizza & pasta, you definitely do! You also learn to make different shapes of pasta! Don’t let the amount of people in your group deter you from booking. You are separated into smaller groups & it’s very one on one! The chef & spud-chef are amazing! They are so knowledgeable & they make it so much fun! We were all laughing & having such a great time! The land is beautiful & it’s just a perfect time making pizza & pasta! I would highly recommend this experience!!

Giuseppe’s class is an incredible experience. Giuseppe arranges the transport from the metro station to the class which is excellent. The class is very hands on and educational. Each person gets to get fully involved in creating their own pizza and pasta. The food is absolutely incredible and there is so much of it! I would 100% recommend Giuseppe’s class to anyone who wanted to have a one of a kind experience in Rome.

If you enjoy being insulted by men who run a 'cash cow' operation, then sign up for this and be treated like a stupid tourist (I speak fluent Italian and was astonished by what they thought they could get away with)! When Giuseppe finally understood that I speak the language he and his entire crew stopped doing this abhorrent behavior. Maybe they had an off day? I can't see how - he uses his little kid as a prop throughout the event, and thinks it's really cute, and his wife was hanging out in the background, so it seems this is the way they are used to running things. Very rude and I wished I could leave.

This was a great experience enjoyed by all of us; 2 adults and two aged 21 and 16. The sous chefs were friendly and got everyone involved and encouraged interaction with the other guests, who were all lovely and friendly too! We've since made homemade pizzas at a family party at home and they were actually really good! That in itself made the whole experience worthwhile and allowed us to carry on enjoying and sharing what we learned. Would definitely recommend this experience.
A must if you visit Rome! Learn all the secrets to making the BEST pizza and pasta you've ever had! Giuseppe and his crew were amazing instructors and we all had a blast!

What fun! I took my wife and two children (5 & 9). The boys in particular had a great time. Giuseppe and the entire crew were very nice, friendly and very funny. Their personalities added a lot to the experience.

Overall we had a really fun time, and we recommend it!

Cooking class with Giuseppe and Friends! This was a wonderful experience for my family of five! My children ages 15,13& 10 has a wonderful time and didn’t complain at all about being “ bored” which we tend to hear at home. It was a fun experience with lots of folks traveling. Everyone got a chance to socialize on their trip and experience wonderful food that we were instructed how to make. If you are considering a class this is the class for you! Thank you for teaching us today and sharing your beautiful land! Best of luck with you family and new baby!

This is an amazing experience! Giuseppe and his team did an amazing job at connecting with everyone. They were able to help individuals when needed, while still maintaining the attention of the other participants. I HIGHLY recommend this experience is you ever are in Rome. I would definitely sign up again! This was the highlight of my trip!

Our family of four (my wife and I and two young boys) had a great time at the cooking class! Giuseppe and Mersad and their team were wonderful! From the logistics of meeting up at the train station to get picked up, to the cooking class to dropping us back to the meeting point, every step was planned out nicely with thoughtful details. Everyone in the cooking class had the opportunity to be hands on on making the pizza and pasta which was a nice surprise. The food was wonderful. And a nice bonus was that Giuseppe was very funny which made the experience even better. Our family enjoyed the cooking class!

This was a good experience. Something unique to do when in Rome. However would we do it again? Probably not. We would look elsewhere for a few reasons. First this place is outdoors and it can get really hot in the summers. The location is very beautiful and in the country which I really liked but it’s a good 30-45 minutes from city center. It was very nice they picked us up from Laurentina Train Station. The second issue we had with this class was my wife and I (and pretty much every other person in the class) are beginners in making pizza. It is expected that people mess up. Naturally we messed up but I guess the cooking team did not like that much. They were likely joking but it came off as criticism. They did this to many of the participants. It was like picking on a little kid. That kind of feeling. Made us feel anxious and nervous during the entire class so we weren’t able to relax and enjoy this experience fully. Some positive notes: Pizza was delicious. The free wine and water were good. We got to keep the aprons which was very nice of them. 3 stars.

This was a truly amazing experience! It made our time in Rome absolutely wonderful! If you want a fun and exciting experience on the outskirts of Rome, definitely attend Giuseppe's class! I loved that we were cooking out in the open countryside. All of the staff were great- I highly encourage anyone to attend this cooking class!!!

This is a once in a lifetime experience. A few friends and I decided to go to this class, knowing that it would be great from the reviews, but we had no idea how much fun we would have! The food and wine is amazing, the people are personable and fun, and the setting is absolutely gorgeous. I would recommend this to anyone of any age who is visiting Rome.

I bought this experience as a birthday gift for my mum. It was a once in lifetime experience and Giuseppe knows exactly how to host. The day covered a lot of different techniques about pasta and pizza. The food that was prepared was delicious and the area we were in was beautiful and serene. I would go back day after day.

I would advise people looking for a fun and educational cooking class in Rome to look elsewhere since there are so many options. where to start?The setting is a piece of land that isn’t kept up at all and the class is entirely outside making a late June class unbearable. On top of that, we had to wait nearly 30 min at times to get more water provided to the group. More over, the class size was about 25 people which was way too many and the instructor and his assistants were not engaging or friendly. In fact, they were often condescending and sarcastic giving off a “frat like” vibe. Finally the pasta making portion of the class was nothing unique and dragged on. The moment the first bus came to take us back to Rome my gf and I booked it as fast as we could to get out of there.

Great experience! Best pizza I’ve ever eaten - and made! All the ingredients were so fresh and delicious. The chefs were personable and funny and made the experience great!!! We made 10 types of pasta including two types that we got to eat. We were also served delicious tiramisu! HIGHly recommend this experience!

This was a great experience! While the course started off a little rocky (I’m celiac and was travelling with family who wanted to take a pizza course. We had flagged that I was celiac and I was supposed to be able to make a gluten free pizza, however, we didn’t know that we had to remind the hosts 24 hours in advance so I wasn’t able to make a pizza), Giuseppe, Essiano, and Mersad did everything to try to make up for the hiccup. For lunch, they went into the garden to make me a delicious salad that couldn’t have had fresher ingredients. They also went out of their way to find Gf pasta that was cooked and made separately for me so that I could eat along with everyone else. I really appreciated the effort that was made to fix the mistake.

The hosts were amazing an extremely funny. Be prepared to be (Website hidden by Airbnb) part of the experience but is well played and adds to the class.

The location was beautiful.

Definitely recommend the experience.

This was a wonderful experience. Guisepe and his sous chefs were very friendly, knowledgeable and fun. We learned a lot about pizza and pasta making and can't wait to apply it at home. The setting is very different and unique. We did this experience in late June and it was very hot, but they kept us cool in a shaded area with a misting system. We would've loved more access to drinking water, but they replenished pitchers whenever they had the chance. The wine was easily accessible but not as much a part of the experience as we expected and advertised, it was more just a serve yourself situation. Tiramisu is not a part of the learning experience, it's just served as dessert at the end. The pace of the lesson is just a little bit slow, and we didn't realize there would be such a big group, but the team did a good job managing this for the most part. They were very accommodating to any extra questions and were attentive to our learning. The only struggle we had was getting there as we received a few different instructions, so just ensure you are super clear on those prior to your experience.

Amaaaaazing cooking class!! Thank you Giuseppe, and your wonderful team.
It was a fun and informative time in your authentic outdoor country kitchen!!
I will highly recommend the experience. The team are fun, and provide a happy environment to learn this skill.
The technique of preparing and cooking our pizzas felt very authentic. I was impressed with the detail in creating our pasta varieties. It was a brilliant insight into Italian cuisine.
A divine finish to the class, was the famous Tiramisu and limoncello!
Thank you for a wonderful day.
Libby

If you’re debating whether or not to do this experience, DO IT! I had so much fun learning about the process of pizza and pasta making. All of the hosts cracked jokes about the terrible mistakes that my friend and I made, but it made the experience so much more fun and enjoyable. We learned so much and I can’t wait to take these skills in to my own kitchen. The food was amazing, and we had the best tiramisu that I have ever had. On top of it all, Giuseppe and his staff were so accommodating when we ran in to issues regarding our transportation to the meeting point. I hope to return here some day! Thank you so much for this experience.

We had a wonderful experience with Giuseppe’s team. They were friendly, funny and interacted with all the guests. As for the experience, the event took place in a beautiful area outside the city. It was nice just being there. The cooking was great, we got to learn basics about pizza and pasta, def information that can be taken and used at home. Overall, would recommend.

This was an amazing cooking class! Giuseppe, Mersad, and the other staff were all so helpful and knowledgeable. When we were making the pizza and pasta they struck a good balance between helping us and letting us do it ourselves. I learned a lot about the right techniques for making pizza and pasta. We got to eat the food we worked on and it was delicious. It was also nice to get away from the city and be in a natural setting for a change. I would recommend this experience to anyone visiting Rome.
All three host were exceptional and very funny. They kept the class very entertaining and taught us the Italian culture. The food was delicious and I would definitely recommend it!
Awesome experience with a great hosts. We had a great time and truly will have memories for the rest of our life! It was one of our most memorable highlights on our trip.

This is an experience not to be missed! If you're interested in Italy, Italian culture, then learning about pasta and pizza making is a must! Best of all, these instructors were fun, knowledgable, and excellent teachers! This was a highlight of my third visit to Italy!

Whether it is your first time to Rome, or your eighth time, this pizza & pasta making experience will bring a smile to your face and leave you satisfied! Our experts had a perfect balance of knowledge, teaching technique, and hilarious criticism that made us feel successful. We definitely left with a new appreciation for some of our favorite foods. The location was charming, quiet, and beautiful — even on a warm summer day in Rome there was shade and mist. It was a fun and unique day and we are so glad we tried it out! Bravo!!

Fun! Our hosts were friendly (and patient!) and funny. Even if you've never made pizza or pasta from scratch, it's ok--they'll help you along the way and you don't have to be perfect. We enjoyed getting to know the other guests as well. The meeting point is not directly in the city, so if you are using public transportation from Rome, allow yourself extra time.

The cooking class was fantastic! We made several pasta and pizza and our instructors were very knowledgeable. A great way to spend a day outside of the normal site seeing and museums. I would highly recommend!

The class was informative, fun and delicious! For four hours you’re in the middle of nature cooking pasta and pizza with interesting professionals and after that you can relax and enjoy the food you cook with wine.

This awesome experience gets you away from the city where you learn how to make some amazing pizza and pasta. The chefs are funny, knowledgeable, and interact well with the customers.

WE HAD A BLAST!!! Starting with pre-made dough, we were taught the correct way to roll pizza dough, and then we each made our own pizzas and then shown how to place in the wood oven. After we finished eating, we made pizza & pasta dough (pasta- 2 different styles (one made with water vs one made with eggs) and then shaped the dough into various shapes. The chefs then cooked and served the pasta with 2 different sauces.

There was wine, water, tiramisu, and limoncello. This experience was amazing! It was such a nice way to spend the day. Our sons -20-year-old and 19-year-old loved it too! What also contributed to a great time - our fellow travelers who signed up for this amazing day - everyone was so nice, fun and friendly.
Pretty solid cooking class, every chef explained and showed how to make pizza/pasta perfectly. The environment was fun and the food was delicious!
We had an amazing time! He took his time and explained everything to us. The pizza was amazing and the little touches were really special.

I flunked “pizza dough” and Giuseppe personally guided me with a fresh dough while making me laugh til I was crying it was so funny! As a Special Education teacher, I now understand more of how my students feel when they try hard, but it does not work right. Giuseppe’s patience and humor made everyone feel “at home.”

What a hilarious class! Laughter non-stop! Also brilliant food. Pizza was amazing, such fun putting it in the ovens ourselves. Made lots of different types of pasta. They have just installed new mist sprayers which mean you don’t get too hot - even in 30 degree heat! Great staff and lovely group of people with us. Would highly recommend!

Book this now! I absolutely loved this pasta + pizza class! Giuseppe was an amazing host along with the two other sou chefs :) Loved every minute of this experience and I highly recommend to anyone looking into a cooking class near Rome!
Had such a fun day cooking pizza and pasta and eating all the food! The chefs were hilarious and everything was really well organised. Would highly recommend!

My Fiancé surprised me with this cooking class and it couldn't have been more perfect. I love to cook and I felt like I learned a ton- and we had so much fun doing it together! We also met really cool people in the process. The space is beautiful and it was nice to get a bit outside the city for the day. Highly recommend this class!

We had a wonderful experience with the exception of the terribly hot weather. Everyone was lighthearted and entertaining. The food was great, people were wonderful. I would definitely suggest going to this class for a wonderful experience. Hopefully it won't be 98 degrees that day
This was very nice experience! Giuseppe and his staff were hilarious and passionate teachers. Also the area was extremely beautiful. We would definately recommend this course, money well spent!

This course was really nice. Me and my friend really enjoyed. Giuseppe and his staff were really hilarious and passionate teachers. The area was really beautiful and nice change to hectic Rome. Would definitely recommend this!

It was a great class, we had so much fun learning how to make pizza and pasta. This was the highlight of our time in Rome!! Even though we had a big class, it was still a very intimate and enjoyable experience. Definitely worth checking out!

Our family enjoyed this experience with Chef Giuseppe and his fantastic sous chefs. They created a fun environment in which we enjoyed interacting with them and the other participants. The location is also beautiful.
A great experience! The organization and atmosphere are great, people are very friendly and open......and remember: coming hungry is essential!

Great experience, the pizza was beyond amazing and the pasta was great. Unlimited homemade red wine in a social setting. Very accommodating to vegans/ vegetarians (you can eat the pasta made from water and avoid the kind with egg)
Best Experience we did in Italy. Amazing fun and you really learn, get hands dirty, get recipes- and our 5-year-old daughter LOVED it. Highly recommend.

If you come to Rome you MUST do this. It was extremely fun . I had a great time with the instructors and met really awesome people during this experience. If i had to chose my top experience in Rome then this one would definitely win.

My husband and I loved the experience. Host was easy to find at the meeting point. We immediately started making pizza, had delicious wine, made pasta, and ate some more. Come hungry is my biggest tip.

Did this class with my son and nephew. We all had fun,laughs and learned how to make a better pizza, make pasta and enjoy a wonderful afternoon at their beautiful facility. Eating the food and wine between sessions was just as wonderful as we got to meet other interesting guests also taking the class. It is very relaxed and made for wonderful memories for our first time in Italy!

The class was so fun! I'll definitely be making some pizza and pasta for my mom when I get back (she'll be so impressed!)

I actually learned a lot of pasta making techniques which helped me for another cooking class that I took afterwards, which the other class didn't teach.

The hosts were incredibly funny and nice, engaging all the students. I would recommend this class if you would like to learn some pizza and pasta making skills!

What a fantastic class. Would highly recommend to anyone coming to Rome. Giuseppe and the guys are most welcoming and the class content was exceptional. We we laughing the whole time and the food was delicious (I made it myself with the help of Giuseppe).
The cooking class was amazing!! Everyone was so friendly and really wanted you to learn how to make the best pizza and pasta. So happy I did this experience! :)
Awesome experience, gets you outside of the city and teaches you how to make some amazing food. The head chef and the assistants are funny, knowledgeable, and interact well with the customers!

This class is fun, insightful, and really allows you to connect with the Italian culture. With the environment and structure of the class, it’s a unique experience that you wouldn’t be able to find anywhere else.

Wonderful experience! My husband and I booked this on our last day in Italy and it was so great to get out of the busy tourist sites and do something different. We got to make so many different types of pasta and our own pizza. The staff was so welcoming and entertaining! One of the highlights of our entire trip. They even arranged transportation for us to the airport to catch out flight after the class. SO happy we reserved this!

WE HAD A BLAST!!! We journeyed south of the city into the Roman countryside to learn the basics of pizza and pasta making. We got to roll out our pizza dough, although I’m sad we didn’t throw it up in the air, and they provided various toppings beyond the standard tomatoes sauce and cheese (ham or prosciutto, mushrooms, ground spices like red peppers & the Magic seasoning) so that we could personalize to our taste. We started with premise pizza dough to save on time, but after we finished with the pizza and had our first course we were then able to make both pizza & pasta dough from scratch. We made various pasta shapes in 2 different styles (pasta made with water vs eggs), AND we got to EAT WHAT WE MADE! They also gave us unlimited red wine 🙃 and a portion of tiramisu for dessert and limoncello for an after lunch drink. This experience was amazing!

Only sorta con: There were a few kids there today who were busy and it seemed like that was a little distraction away from the task at hand. However, our hosts did a wonderful job of 1. Easing the parents’ minds and allowed the kids to run around and have fun; 2. Incorporating the kids into the activities; and 3. Editing explanations a bit to keep the kids from getting bored (so this is very much so family friendly). I just hope that most of the explanations are provided in the resources that they are sending after the class so that I can connect the dots of missing information in my head.

I highly recommend this experience to anyone who wants to get out of the city into nature and just spend an awesome first half of the day learning about delicious food.

Such a wonderful experience this Pizza + Pasta class was. It was a real treat to have the chance to cook/prepare food outdoors surrounded by luscious garden. Their lively rescue puppy Gino was there to greet us upon arrival and when the second half of the group arrived the hosts kindly escorted Gino to the back of the garden as one family wasn't accustomed to having a dog around. The class was easy to follow, achievable for even first timers, and made enjoyable by the co-hosts and their witty banter. They generously catered to my vegan dietary needs- made me separate pasta sauces which were delicious- for which I am so grateful for. Post class, while we were waiting to be driven back to the station, Mersad let the chickens and Gino roam free. Personally, this was probably my favourite part because it was authentic, charming and lovable.
Thank you to the team of Rome Pizza School :)
I recommend making pizza with your own hands and cooking it in the wood-fired oven. The host and his associates are very fun.

My mom and I had so much fun making pizza and the different kinds of pasta. The chefs were helpful and funny, even when our pizza dough wasn’t quite up to their standards. The food was great and after the class we walked through the ancient Appian way which was lovely. After the class they sent us all the recipes in a PDF, including a tiramisu recipe which was a hit with my family! Definitely a fun and unique way to experience Rome. Highly recommend!

This cooking class was so fun! We learned how to make the perfect pizza and many different kinds of pasta. Giuseppe and his two other chefs were so funny and kept the class lively and entertaining. They took us down the road a little bit after the class so we could go see the catacombs, they were a little farther away than we were told and they were closed by the time we got there but it was an adventure! The transportation pickup was easy to figure out from the metro. I would definitely recommend this class if you are looking for something fun to do while in Rome.

I had a wonderful time on this airbnb experience! It was my sister and I’s first time in Rome and we were set on taking a cooking class so when we came across this one we knew it was it by the amazing reviews! (Thank you everyone for sharing such wonderful insight that helped influence our decision) We made wonderful pizza and learned 10 different pasta shape techniques as well as reviewed how to make different types of pasta and how long they can be stored. We got to enjoy our pizza and pasta on Guiseppe’s beautiful property while drinking homemade wine and after we finished with a delicious tiramisu. The special part of our time here was that after this was over we had the choice to go back to the metro or head over to the ancient appia way where we could see many Roman ruins. Of course we chose that! It was an all-around amazing experience and I highly recommend it to anyone of any age.

Giuseppe’s cooking guide was really amazing. We started by driving to his wonderful property with the most charming views. We were each able to taste the individual pies that we made. It was honestly the best pizza I’ve ever had. Followed by unlimited wine before the pasta making sessions. Don’t hesitate to book this Airbnb experience!

My husband and I really enjoyed this pizza and pasta class with Giuseppe! It was a highlight of our trip to Rome and the pizza was some of the best we've ever tasted. The class was a lot of fun and really informative. We would highly recommend it!

This was a fun evening making pizza and pasta. The hosts were friendly and it was a bit of a comedy show. I know people have raves about this but it was very long. We were met at 5 at the metro 10 mins from the venue and returned close to 10:30. The amount of instruction could have been condensed into 3 hours which would have made this more enjoyable, it was very long.

An experience not to be missed during your stay in Rome. Giuseppe, Essiano and friends were excellent hosts and made us all feel very welcome. The location is breathtaking and having booked the evening class, making pizza & pasta anywhere else will not be the same.. the sunset was beautiful. Not all of us grasped the art of using a pizza peel but Giuseppe's patience made sure we didn't go away disheartened. We can't wait to put what we learned in to practice with friends and family. I'd highly recommend making sure this experience is on your list when visiting Rome!

This was SO.MUCH.FUN!

They pick you up from Laurentina Metro Station and then drive you to their class, which was super convenient.

Once there we had an excellent time learning how to correctly make pizza and pasta. Food was amazing, I got a whole pizza to myself and then we all shared the pasta we made. Everyone got a big bowl. Afterwards they gave us tiramisu.

I had such a great time with Giuseppe and his sous chefs! They were funny and charismatic, and really made me feel welcome. I thoroughly enjoyed my time with the crew.

Giuseppe gave me by far my best Airbnb experience ever! Totally worth every dollar! Everything from the instructions, to the meeting point, to the activities well fantastically arranged. The land was very serene, which added to the perfect ambiance we were in. Giuseppe made us feel home, his hospitality is beyond words, and his sense of humor can not be missed. Mersad and Essiano were very helpful and added lots of energy to our experience. I think I can say that I had the best pizza during this trip :D This is a must try in Rome! No regrets.
Had a wonderful time that I will never forget, the guys were hilarious and really helped us learn about making pasta and pizza.

This is great experience for your time in Rome! Very beautiful surroundings and 2 knowledgeable and hilarious hosts. I had a great time making pizza, learning about pasta, sipping homemade wine and meeting new friends! Thanks guys!!

There was no better way to step away from the hustle and bustle, noise and people of Rome than to spend half a day at Giuseppe's land in the plush countryside, cooking, eating and joking about. The group were very easy going, the team were great teachers... Very professional but a lot of fun, and we enjoyed every minute!

The workshop consisted of a group of 15 people. We were picked up by a van from the metro station. The location had a quiet and rural feel to it, the workshop in a semi-outdoor space in a large garden with a chicken pen.

The chefs Mersad and Essiano had a witty sense of humour. They took time for questions. Explained it all clearly and actively involved everyone in the group.

The pizza’s were great, and the pasta we made very tasty. There was free wine and water and tiramisu as dessert. We received a lot of practical cooking tips that can be used in the home.
It was really fun, family friendly experience and we had lots of fun. Everything was very well organised and professional and the host and his colleagues were lovely!

We had a lovely day making pizza and pasta with Giuseppe and his team. Giuseppe has decades of experience as a chef. He is both highly skilled and very accessible. The whole team was genuine and friendly. We were in groups of about eight people with instructors for each group. Everything had been carefully prepared ahead of time and we were shown how to make pizzas: rolling out dough, adding toppings, and then cooking them in a wood burning pizza oven. We were also shown how to make pasta from scratch. Giuseppe and his team turned that collective effort into our second lunch. They also provided us with some delicious home made wine, and tiramisu. The location is a peaceful spot on the edge of the Appian way and you can easily continue on to it unless you want them to return you to the metro.

It was the best experience full of fun and new knowledges. I enjoyed so so much and I recommend it everybody! We had too many laughing and fun with people whom I saw first time in my life. It was great and very tasty😁😁 thanks a lot !

They were punctually in the meeting point, they really have experience managing the group not just to teach but also to get fun. We really enjoyed this experience and learn something we can do by our own going back home. These guys are fantastic.

The class was in an amazing location and Giuseppe and his colleagues were very knowledgeable and funny! We were laughing the whole class and learned a lot about making pizza and pasta from scratch! I would definitely recommend taking this class if you are in Rome, highlight of my trip!

Me and my family went to this in our first day of Italy. It was so much fun, I was worried it would be slightly too much for my son (7 years old) but he got so much help. He was so happy he even asked for a picture at the end with Mersad. He wouldn't stop talking about it when we got back especially when he got a round of applause. This is great for kids, individuals, couples or a family! Would highly recommend. X

Giuseppe's class was a highlight of our trip to Rome! We learnt (and ate) a huge amount during our class - pizza, two types of pasta, tiramisu and the lovely local wine. I left feeling confident to try out my new skills at home. The sous chefs were great too and made my seven year-old nephew feel very special (he said it was the best thing he did in Rome). Being on the farm and cooking outdoors felt so much more unique than your average cooking class. Definitely recommended.

This was one of our favorite parts of our trip to Italy! From the transportation pick up to the delicious food and great staff we had such a nice time. I cant forget to add you eat SOOO much. Thanks for a great time!
It was a very nice experience at a very beautiful place. We learned new ways of making pasta and will try it at home for sure. Thank you Giuseppe and team.

Giuseppe and his team are absolutely fantastic. Their sense of humour was apparent right from the off and they really went above and beyond to make the whole group feel very welcomed. We were picked up at the station by Giuseppe himself and driven to the location for the cooking class - a wonderful outdoor scene on the outskirts of the city.

We started off with how to work our pizza dough into the best pizza I've ever eaten (or had the pleasure of making)! Giuseppe's assistants were on-hand to help point us in the right direction with our new dough-shaping skills, offering tips on the best way to ensure our pizzas turned out perfect! Once our pizzas were cooked, we had some time to eat them, drink some fantastic wine (homemade by our hosts) and chat with the other guests.

After our pizza-eating break, we got into learning different ways to make pasta & pizza dough - our expert sharing his tips & knowledge on the subject. We learned 2 different approaches to pasta dough, made some pizza dough and then went on to learning how to make a whole host of different pasta shapes.

After learning about & making pasta shapes we had our second lunch whereby we ate the pasta we had made.

All-in-all, this was a brilliant experience and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend this to our friends, family and anyone else who will listen to us!

Giuseppe and his team really did go above and beyond to earn their 5 star rating!
Great job guys!

Adam & Amy

Giuseppe and his guys were wonderful, welcoming, and on top of it hilarious. I unfortunately had a very bad migraine that they and they were all very caring and understanding even letting me take all my food I couldn’t eat with me. To put it in perspective, even with a terrible migraine I had the best time and felt the experience was a once in a life time worth every penny kind of thing! You learn, you laugh, and you get to enjoy your creations at the end. Would 100% recommend!

We had an incredible time! Booked this excursion last minute as it was going to rain in Rome. Giuseppe was able to accommodate myself and my family without a problem. He and his team are very knowledgable and made it a fun experience for the whole group. Plenty of good food, good wine, good people, and good times! I would absolutely recommend this.

It was a neat class and you got to learn a lot, but the teachers were kind of rude. One teacher in particular continually called a mom of 4 lazy because she wasn't doing something correctly - you could tell she was getting upset and he just continued. They try to be funny and engaging but sometimes they took it too far. But as for everything else, it was great. You learn to make wood-fired pizzas, and several different shapes of pasta.
Absolutely wonderful! Such a unique experience and a charming chef and su chefs. Extremely entertaining and I am excited to return to the US and try out the recipes and techniques we learned.

Wow! This was such a fantastic class! I learned quite a bit about pizza and pasta making! It was so delicious and fun! I felt like and extended part of the family and would completely recommend this experience to everyone!!! Don’t hesitate! It’s worth every penny!

If you go to Italy and don’t do this, you are missing out. This is a genuine Italian experience.

The host is funny, nice and an expert cook. The host, his family and co-workers make you feel welcome and like friends.

He is a very helpful and patient teacher.

The host went beyond the cooking experience. He showed us his garden, and shared personal cooking and Italian experiences. And again, he is very funny.

This was a very unique and unforgettable experience! Ambiance where we cooked is very beautiful filled with colorful scenery. Much humor and felt as if it was a family reunion with a community of others coming together to make delectable pizza and pasta! This is absolutely a must! Chef Giuseppe has a strong passion for his cooking, teaching, and entertaining! His assistants and family were a great part of the experience!

This was my first Airbnb experience. I am so glad that my wife and i decided to do this. Giuseppe and his crew made us feel extremely welcome. I had more fun with them and our group and the pizza and pasta were the icing on the cake. We learned how to do everything pretty quick and easy. The atmosphere was great too.

We had a superb time with Giuseppe and Marsad! It was very well organized and a really fun and relaxing time out in Appia country. The instruction was very precise and the hosts had a great sense of humor which made the experience all the more fun! The weather was beautiful and it was pretty straight forward getting to the pick up point on the Metro. Highly recommended for a unique cooking experience!

This was one of the high points to our first trip to Italy. You're welcomed to a beautiful farm area and you're immersed with several professional chefs who teach you how to make dough, pizza, pasta and more. Great wine, great people, great food and you learn new things along the way. It was also a great way to meet other travelers interested the same things. I'd highly recommend this class to anyone!

What a great time!!! Very attentive staff, nice knowledge shared with guests. Very very well organized. Very well done. I loved it and would recommend this activity to food lovers. Thank you for everything and for this beautiful warm welcome. Danielle

This was a fun class in a beautiful location. We learned some good techniques for cooking pizza and pasta and enjoyed two tasty meals. The class ran a bit longer than expected, which made our transit back to the city center a little tricky, but otherwise it was a great time.

The Pizza and Pasta making class was outstanding! An incredibly memorable experience on a small farm in the hills... 3 great chefs, their little puppy, and cooking, eating, and drinking into the night as we listened to the rain fall! We did not have much interaction with Giuseppe but interacted mostly with his 2 sous chefs, who were wonderfully personable and knowledgeable, telling us stories of what led to their passion for cooking. We would recommend this class to ANYONE!
A beautiful experience my husband and son participated. She took care of the class in Spanish, an incredible attitude. super recommended, we learned how to make pizza and Italian pasta!!! Thank you

It was amazing and we had a lot of fun. Thank you for all. I really can recommend this cooking course.
They are both super friendly and it is a lot of fun. Thanks for all

Tim and Jasmin

This peaceful farm with a garden, chickens and picnic tables is so inviting. we got to learn and eat, drink wine, laugh, rub puppy bellies and eat some more. Love meeting people that love what they do and are so passionate. the hands on training is so amazing. Thank you for helping us continue our pasta dreams 😍

You especially learn how to kneel and form the dough and how to shape noodles.
Plus recipe of ingredients.

This is an amazing class to take! We had such a great time and appreciated the time they spent showing us how to improve our beginner’s techniques when making the pizza dough and types of pasta shapes. Beautiful place in the country to host the class too! Loved it!
This was definitely a highlight in the experience in Italy. My mom and I loved every bit of this excursion. And the food, wine and dessert was amazing.
I love it I will be back next years just to take this class again love it and will recommend to all my friend
The experience was great, we learned a lot and the best thing was, that we could actually taste what we made. The hosts were funny and professional.

This was an absolutely wonderful experience that I would recommend to everyone. We met sous-chef Essiano at the metro station and were driven about 5 minutes in their van to the location. There we were greeted by the cutest little puppy Gino. The sous-chef who led our group was Mersad. He was really funny and had our table laughing the whole time. We were given our own apron and towel. We were asked to wash our hands and then we jumped right in making our pizzas. Afterwards we ate together and had some free time to roam their property. Then we learned how to make over 10 different types of pasta shapes. Finishing off the lesson by eating our pasta creations and a delicious tiramisu they had prepared for us. We were given plenty of wine and water, and were even treated with some limoncello - which we thought was an absolute treat. Giuseppe and his team gave us great guidance and tips but allowed us to do all the work ourselves (even make our own mistakes) which we thoroughly enjoyed. The team was very professional and clean - always telling us to wash our hands. We absolutely loved this experience and would do it again!

This experience was a highlight of our trip. The setting is beautiful, all the chefs were knowledgeable and friendly. It's a great experience for (Website hidden by Airbnb) they a serious cook or just someone with a casual interest in learning to make a pizza! All three people in our group highly recommend this experience.
Lots of fun. Made lots of pizza and pastas, definitely tasted great! Learned a lot about dough and Italian food. Great time well spent. Highly recommended.
Taking this class was amazing! Very light hearted hosts and definitely worth the money. Now I feel confident I can make my own pasta and pizza! The tiramisu was sooo good!!
We had a great time making pizza and pasta. We spent half the time laughing and the other half eating great food. It was a fun experience and we would do it again, if we got the chance.

Giuseppe’s class was great! I left with some knowledge about pizza and pasta that i didn’t know in hopes of making it back home. Loved the humor from him and his team as it added some fun to the class.

This experience was definitely one of the highlights of my trip. We learned so much about the making of pasta and pizza. The class was very extensive and informative. The chef really knew his stuff and you can tell cooking is a passion of his that comes with second nature. We shared a lot of laughter during the class which allowed for an enjoyable en environment. We learned how to make several different pasta shapes and the finale meal was just simply amazing! Well worth the work. Thank you Chef for such a good time!

Must do! This was an amazing experience as a solo traveler. I met friendly people and Giuseppe and his sous chefs were very interactive. Not only did they provide excellent instructions, they also made us laugh during the entire class. Definitely not an easy task, especially considering they have two 4 hour classes a day. My class ran closer to 5 hours, but no complaints here!
Fun day out for something different. Learned a lot with helpful hints and tips about dough making, the hands on session was great for learning and hopefully I will be able to make some pasta at home!

I had an amazing time learning how to make pizza and pasta with Giuseppe and his assistants on their beautiful property.

The food was delicious, the wine plentiful and everyone involved was in good spirits. We even got to meet the puppy and turtle they had saved.
I would definitely recommend if you enjoy Italian food. Was 100% worth the price. You also get access to the recipes used during the class.

Great cooking class! We learned a lot and we laughed at least as much. Guiseppe and his sous chef Mersad are super nice and funny and explain very understandable in English what to do. Everybody bakes (and eats) their own pizza first, then you get to know the different doughs for pizza and pasta, and then they go to the different varieties of pasta. We learned how to make about 10 different varieties of pasta, and at the end, of course, they also had to eat. A great experience in Rome that definitely upgraded our holiday there!

Thanks to Chef Giuseppe and his staff, we enjoyed a fabulous day of learning and eating. It was a nice break to get out of the hectic pace of the city and typical tourist line-ups and enjoy such a beautiful setting. We had so much fun learning how to make authentic wood-fired pizzas and practice our pasta-making skills. I think we’re going to need a bit more practice but everything tasted delicious anyway! I would not hesitate to recommend this cooking class to anyone who likes eating and is looking for a relaxed, unique experience. Grazie mille, Chef!

Giuseppe’s class was amazing! He was very entertaining and knowledgeable. His food was amazing! He was so accommodating of one of our group members who has gluten intolerance. He had a special pizza dough ready for her to make pizzas during the class with us! Great experience.

We are staying in Rome for a week and have experienced everything from the Vatican to the Colosseum but this experience by far was the best! Giuseppe and his band of sous chefs Mersad and Essiano were passionate about their cooking and made our time together memorable! The hospitality was fantastic! We highly recommend taking the trip outside the city and learning how to make the beloved food of Roma!

First of all , great location , easy to get to the meeting point by public transportation and the place itself was very beautiful and clean .
The environment was the best we could’ve asked for, the host was patient and helpful with the entire group. The class was very well taught in a way everyone was able to understand. Giuseppe was very funny and made the experience very fun for everyone and we highly recommend this class to anyone.
