This class was very fun! We had a great time! I really enjoyed the laid back jokey atmosphere! We learned how to make several different types of pasta shapes and dough as well as pizza dough! My only wish is that we had a little bit more time to perfect each one (especially the one we used as our meal, which almost everyone had a hard time mastering) overall though it was an amazing day! I could barely focus on the class because the puppy, Gino, was so cute!

This was such a great course! I was happy with the pizza I made and Giuseppe and his team were great teachers. The location also added to the beauty as we were near the Old Appian Way. This was a great course!

Leaving 5 stars here to be eligible for Giuseppe's raffle drawing. The pizza part of the class (first) was excellent and delicious. However, we then switched to practicing making different dough, which included pizza and pasta. Our group was ready to move on to the pasta portion, so it was awkward for us to move back to pizza. Especially since not everyone will make pasta dough. As for the pasta part of the class, it was really fun and informative. However, I wished we had the opportunity to try good forms of our pasta before we were tasked to make it ourselves. Especially because the pasta meal is dependent on the class's ability to shape pasta. Also, it would've been nice to see how the pasta is cooked and prepared (including the sauces). We only learned how make dough and shape different pastas. Overall though, a very fun and unique experience! We left feeling very full and happy.

This was a great experience and we learnt a lot in few hours plus you get make your own pasta and pizza which was very cool, Giuseppe and his team were really patient and had a good sense of humor to keep us all entertained

Giuseppe and his staff were fun, knowledgeable and made it a great learning experience. If you have a free afternoon I highly recommend this. No prior cooking experience required. Fun for the whole family. One of our trips high points.
It was great to relax after with a glass of whine and pasta and get to know the other participants.
And Gino is the best!!
It was an amazing and unique experience. Everything was perfect, I was very well cared for by everyone, a peaceful and pleasant environment, I would do the course again.
This was definitely the highlight of our trip to Rome! The location was gorgeous, the food was incredible and Giuseppe was such a fun host. 10/10

This tour was one of my favorites out of our entire trip to Rome! It was so fun and memorable. Giuseppe has so much passion and knowledge it was so great to be able to learn from him and his assistants! The day was full of laughs and damn good food. We will recommend anyone who goes to Rome to 100% experience this tour!

Such a wonderful experience. Plenty of food, fun, and learning. It was such a good time and a unique experience that you don’t often come across. Great value, the location is beautiful, they give great recommendations, and they tailor the experience to suit everyone’s personality. So, so glad we did this. Directions to the meeting place were easy to follow and we were met on time. Loved this experience and can’t say enough good things about it.
We had a great time making pizza and pasta, and of course our favorite part was eating it! Delicious! kids are still talking about the experience. Thank you for your passion

What an amazing class from start to finish! I learn from doing and this experience is nothing short of that. Giuseppe provides an opportunity to learn the intricacies of making pizza and pasta from a true professional and artisan...this class gives you the little tricks of the trade, not something you can get from a recipe. If you're looking for something hands on, super fun, and a great experience with passionate artists, Giuseppe and the fellas will not disappoint. Ciao! ♥️♥️

An excellent experience and beautiful place to spend a few hours in Rome! Chef Giuseppe and his sous-chefs were welcoming hosts, very knowledgable, and clearly committed to creating an engaging and fun atmosphere! We were kept busy and full for this experience- come hungry! The food is delicious and the balance of learning and experiencing was perfect! The experience did run closer to 5 hours than 4, so be aware when you're making other plans that this might run a bit long. Seems to be an excellent experience for groups and individuals alike!
This was an amazing experience and the highlight of our time in Rome! The setting was beautiful and the food was delicious. We would highly recommend this cooking experience to everyone!
Had an awesome day of learning, eating amazing food, and just having a good time in a great setting. Thank you for a once in a lifetime experience!

We had the most fun day of our trip to Italy with Giuseppe and his team. The food was amazing and we thoroughly enjoyed the cooking. It was a perfect activity for my husband and myself as well as my 72 year old mother and 10 year old daughter. I would recommend this to everyone.

This was more a comedy show than a cooking class. We worked with pre made dough, were rushed through the “technical” portion, and spent a total of maybe 30 mins actually doing anything in the 3 hours. We were rushed through the steps making pasta, with no real help for folks that didn’t get the shapes within the first few tries. The same applied with the dough.

The host has a lot of 5 star reviews due to the fact he offers participants a free holiday for 2, drawn live every month. Don’t be mislead by this class. You can actually take a class and learn how to cook for the same price, in a more intimate setting and not sharing a class with 28 other people.

My son and I very much enjoyed this experience. We had a great time learning to make pizza and pasta. The hosts and assistants were wonderful and the memories made will be remembered forever. I would definitely recommend this fun experience.

Amazing experience in Rome! You will learn a lot of the science and art of making pasta and pizza. It’s taught in a way you truly understand it and can remember it so that you can take it back home with you!

It was an amazing experience. Except of learning a lot about different types of pizza, the names of all pasta forms and preparing it by ourselves, we had a very good time with chefs, who added a good atmosphere to our cooking class. Strongly recommend this wonderful experience and give 3 Michelin stars!

Once in a lifetime experience! I underestimated how much fun and value this kinda experience can add to my trip. Me and my girlfriend were amazed by the effort and joyfulness of the participants, including the travelers, but foremost le chefs. To Merzad, Ehsiano & Giuseppe (Our chefs): Mashalla & merci ✌️
We had the time of our life during this cooking class. We had a wonderful time and learned a ton! We made some amazing friends as well.

Giuseppe’s class, though extremely fun, would enable you to have a deeper understanding and appreciation of pizza and pasta. We couldn’t have asked for a better location; it was truly perfect for the occasion. There’s also a bonus: after the feast (as there would be plenty to eat and drink), they would offer to walk you towards the Appian Way (5-10 minute walk from the venue).

This experience was great! We loved the location, everything was super clean when cooking, the Chef was very nice and with alot of knowledge to share. Very fun experience! If you do a cooking class, it has to be with them!

A great opportunity whilst visiting Italy to experience the passion and enthusiasm of chefs to their craft in pizza making and pasta preparation leading to a fun picnic lunch with a lively crowd of 15 of us.

I had been looking forward to this experience since I first booked the tickets and it did not let me down!
My wife and I had a blast! The food was exceptional and the ambience was incredible. This is a definite must do anytime you’re in Rome!

Giuseppe and his team were awesome! Recommend this to anyone that’s keen for a good time and enjoy getting their hands dirty with pizza and pasta dough! All while having wine in a spectacular location. Also, Giuseppe’s tiramisú is the best in town! Going home with some really good memories! Thanks Giuseppe!!

It was great to leave the busy city centre of Rome and have this cooking class set in a nature environment. Giuseppe, Essiano and Mersad were a great team together, including and helping anyone if needed and bringing humour and fun to the class.
What I really liked as well - you can truly make everything you learn later at home. I definitely recommend this to everyone.
An amazing day. We made and ate so much. Giuseppe and his sous chefs has such a funny dynamic so don’t be afraid to try your best. Everything tasted delicious and I definitely learned something new!

My wife and I had a great time! Giuseppe and his team definitely made it an unforgettable experience. If you’re in Rome for a few days, signing up for the class is no brained. With Giuseppe, you’ll do pizza, pasta, and wine the Roman way!

What sold it to me was the area where we cooked. It was peaceful and out of the city which was a nice scenic change. The chefs were hilarious and had this banter between them throughout the class which made it more relaxed and joyful.

The cooking class is very interesting. We learned how to make pizza and also pasta. In our group were also some kids. They had also a good time. It is a good way to learn more about the Italian style of cooking.

Great food. Great people. And a great time. If you're looking for an opportunity for a hands on Italian food experience, I would highly recommend spending the day with Giuseppe. We learned a lot and had a great time doing it!
My mom and I had a great experience learning to make pizza and pasta with Giuseppe and Mersad. We laughed as we learned to make delicious food.

Our pizza and pasta class with Giuseppe was excellent... we learned how to make pizza dough + 8 different types of pasta all al fresco. Plus, our lunch was delicious! Great adventure just South of Rome!

Was an amazing experience in Rome. Made delicious pizza, learned to mix pasta dough, and learned to form many different pasta shapes. In our group alone there were people from at least 6 countries. Everyone was so nice and the farm/ location was beautiful with a garden and chickens. I’m very pleased with this experience and I would definitely recommend.

The cooking course was so much fun! Not only us, but even our 8 and 12 years old sons enjoyed it a lot! It was fun making our own pizza, we laughed a lot with Mersad and Giuseppe. Shapeing the pasta was fun too, and we had really good conversations with the other members of the group from different countries. We got soooo full at the end of the event, food and drinks were yummy! :)

I had two full days in Rome. I chose to spend the first part of the second day at Giuseppe's experience, because it's just that--an experience. Rather than fill the time with another museum, I opted to learn how to make pizza and pasta at the epicenter of both. Giuseppe and his team are not only very talented chefs, but completely hilarious and at ease with everyone. Everyone from an 8 year old boy to a middle-aged couple on a romantic getaway was actively involved in the class, enjoying the company of each other and our hosts. The pizza we made was also one of the best I have had in my life--truly delicious.

Experience was awesome, could not ask for a better experience for an Italy newbie. I have new found respect for home made pasta and was really proud of the pizza I made under his and his sous chef supervision. All in all, I definitely recommend this experience.

This was an amazing experience - I learned so much and thoroughly enjoyed it. Giuseppe, Mersad, and Essiano were all fantastic, very easy to get along with, and went above and beyond. Take this class for a fun break outside of the city!

Very nice experience while in Rome since you get briefed and you get to make the pizza dough, assemble your own pizza, bake it, prepare the pasta dough, different pasta shapes, eat the pizzas and pasta, and finish off with a yummy tiramisu!! The class is located in an amazing area right in the middle of nature and a walking distance from rome’s oldest road Appia Antica. Must try

What a wonderful experience !
Everybody was so friendly even if we were total beginners.
The food was yummy and we learned a lot.

We definitely recommend that experience :-)

LOVED this experience! I'd recommend this to everyone, no hesitation. I learned a lot about Neapolitan pizza making-- not only do you learn to make the crust and decorate your own pizza, but they let you put and take out your own pizza in the brick oven, too! We also learned a lot about pasta making. The class was well paced with a few breaks to enjoy the beautiful yard, water, house wine, etc. We all left feeling very happy, full and satisfied.

10/10 recommend, if you want to take a cooking class this one I highly recommend. You will gain knowledge from this experience that will be great throughout your life if pizza and/or pasta are a part of your life. Giuseppe is fun and provides a unique knowledge and sense of humor throughout the experience. The pizza you will make is amazing, the pasta is also very good. You will then try his tiramisu and wine. Which are the cherry on top of a wonderful experience.
We had an incredible afternoon with Giuseppe on the unique plot of land. It was so nice to feel separated from the noise of the city while learning how to make pizza and pasta. Everything was great!
As advertised. Family thoroughly enjoyed making pizza and pasta with Guiseppe and his helpers. Great experience and change of pace from touring Rome. Highly recommended.

Mersad, the sous chef, is the best! He was so patient with the kids. A nice get away from the city to make authentic Italian food with Italian chefs. Make sure you go to the Appian Way, it's less than 5 minutes away. Definitely recommend!
Giuseppe’s pizza and pasta experience was fantastic. A great way to spend the day learning to cook great pasta and pizza from a truly passionate chef. Oh and his homemade tiramisu was amazing!

What a great experience for our family of four! It was one of the highlights of our trip. Guiseppe and his team took us through the technical aspects of how to form pizza dough, how to correctly apply the sauce and how much cheese is just the right amount of mozzarella! After cooking, we enjoyed the fantastic pizzas with homemade wine outdoors - lovely.

We then learned about what makes a good dough and spent time trying to make pasta shapes and enjoyed two different pastas and some tiramisu to round out the day.

A very hands on and interactive experience our whole family enjoyed!

We had this experience on the outskirts of rome. We were with a small group which made it feel more personal. The food was delicious and theu were very enthousiastic and fun. After the experience they even dropped me of at appia antica.

This was one of the most enjoyable experiences I’ve ever had! Guiseppe is literally a world-class culinary teacher. He travels internationally teaching Italian cooking techniques. The setting for this experience is a little pocket of heaven near the ancient Appian road. There were outdoor tables beautifully set, an outdoor kitchen and pizza oven. The setting is wonderfully intimate. Guiseppe and his assistants are very friendly and good-natured, as well as incredibly knowledgeable and skilled They did a great job interacting with everyone, including my 9-year-old son. You are fully immersed in the experience. Your hands will get dirty and you’ll make lots of fun mistakes learning how to work with the pizza and pasta dough. The result is a delicious three course meal, enjoyed with delicious wine. I highly recommend this experience to anyone who loves cooking or just loves Italian food, lovely company and great memories.
This was a fun experience to do! We loved making pizza and pasta in a beautiful country side setting! Would recommend this if you’re in Rome and love food!

We had a wonderful time during this experience! The food was YUMMY!! I was able to make a pizza but then I killed it when trying to place it on the pizza peel.. So it turned into a calzone! Hands down the yummiest calzone! LOL!! The place was beautiful and the people that we got to work with were very friendly! :)
Wow! Some of the best pasta and pizza I have ever eaten. The class was in a quaint part of Rome and the entire class was hands on. I genuinely feel like I know how to make pasta now!

I wanted to take a cooking class while visiting Rome and thought I would have to go it alone but the temptation of Tiramisu convinced my husband to join me. The meet up point was a 30 minute metro ride from our lodging but easy to find. Giuseppe was there to drive us to his facility. The stations are set up as the pictures show - outside with a plastic enclosure to protect everyone from the cold. I'm sure the plastic is not used when there is nice weather; however, it rained the day we arrived and was quite chilly for a late March day. It would be wise to bring a sweater if you attend on a cold day. We started with a pizza dough and lots of playful banter to get everyone laughing and talking to one another. We each made a medium size pizza, which we ate once it was baked in the brick oven. (I would advise not to eat the whole pizza since you'll be eating pasta next and they provide boxes for leftovers.) Next we made two types of pasta; egg based and water based. We were taught various shapes for pasta with some of the water based pasta and moved on to using a chitarra to slice the egg pasta dough into Fettuccine. We didn't make the sauces or the Tiramisu but it was all delicious. There is a cabin type building for dining when the weather is chilly and picnic tables when the weather calls for outside dining. Pictures were taken during the class and posted on the (Hidden by Airbnb) site. I really enjoyed learning the tools used to make the fettuccine; in fact I ordered a chitarra when I returned home. Can't wait to use it with the recipes provided.

Great Italian cooking lesson held in a covered outdoor area in a rural setting. Great presentation and time to practice making different kinds of pasta and we also made and cooked our own pizza. A fun time was had by all.

The pizza and pasta cooking class with Giuseppe and his team was so fun! We learned a ton in a short amount of time, but the hands-on practice and coaching from the guys throughout really helped us to understand and remember everything they were teaching us. It was a super fun, light-hearted environment, and, of course, we got to enjoy eating everything we made, and it was so delicious. I would highly recommend this experience, and would do it again in a heartbeat!
Great experience in a wonderful detail location. The attention to detail was great and you received one on one attention. Glad I booked this!
Very fun experience. Giuseppe and his team made the entire experience enjoyable. The location was very unique. Would recommend this to anyone visiting Rome.

Such a fun time! The food was delicious, the setting was beautiful, and I learned so much! It was great to be able to ask Giuseppe and Mersad questions about how to recreate the pizza and pasta at home. Thanks a wonderful afternoon of food, drink, and laughter!
Great day with our 12 & 9 year old grandchildren. Went to the grocery store and found all the pasta shapes we made. Pizza was fantastic!

Giuseppe is very knowledgeable and professional and made the experience unique, his team and himself were fun, but they knew what they were doing. The cooking was real, very hands on and the food was amazing. It was a ~4 hr experience and I wasn't sure at the beginning if the kids were going to like it and be entertained for the 4 hours and they were , they learned a lot and for sure we created great memories!

Giuseppe and his team were wonderful hosts, they spoke great english so could joke with us and answer questions knowledgeably. The farm we went to was beautiful and exactly the calm and comforting type of fun we needed after a busy week of site seeing. We were hands-on from the very beginning, the group was lovely to work with and felt comfortable sharing the experience with complete strangers. The chefs were talented and welcoming. It was just perfect. Really the highlight of our trip.

Giuseppe class was an amazing experience! Him and his chefs were very knowledgeable about making pasta and pizza! They all had a sense of humor which my group and I loved! We felt very comfortable there and we really got to know the other group members in our class. My group and I learned so much from him when it came to making different styles of pasta and pizza. I highly recommend Giuseppe’s class to anyone who wants to learn how to make pasta and pizza in Italy! His place is a little bit outside of Rome which was nice to get away from the city for a couple hours! If you are in Rome you should do this class!

This was a wonderful experience. Bring your appetite and learn to make pizza and pasta from scratch. Giuseppe was patient and paid attention to detail to each one where possible to guide to cook. The food was delicious and ambience of the place was beautiful! I had the unique opportunity to make a calzone so it was creative. I would recommend this to other and reserve almost part of the day for this fun group experience.
We had a wonderful time, Giuseppe and his team are extremely knowledgeable and fun. They really do walk you through each step and you find yourself enjoying the process throughout. Great job!

Giuseppe and his team were fabulous and the experience was really well organized. We enjoyed ourselves thoroughly and wrapping up our trip to Rome having prepared pizza and pasta from scratch, under their expertise, was absolutely worth it. The tiramisu, wine, company and the sunshine made it even better. Via Appia Antica, one of the earliest roads of the Roman republic and a 10-min walk from Giuseppe's, is worth visiting after.
If you are taking a trip for longer then a week I would definitely suggest to take a break from the usual running around and have a day break by taking this relaxed workshop by Giuseppe and his team.

The cooking class was amazing and super fun, definitely one of the best experiences I've ever had! Belle and Mersad are lovely and they explained everything step by step: we made a pizza and many kinds of traditional style pasta...everything was delicious! Also, we really enjoyed the day in the countryside, just outside Rome.

On the other hand, I would like to highlight that we met beautiful people, who also took the class, and we were able to exchange beautiful experiences. At the end of the class we had the pleasure of the driver leaving us on the Appian Way, one of the most important roads in ancient Rome...spectacular! Without a doubt, if I had the opportunity to do this experience on my first trip to Rome I would have done it, totally recommended! Now I can say that I've learned to cook authentic Italian food with real chefs in Italy!

Thank you Belle and Mersad, see you soon!

Inés & Ivan :)

I absolutely loved this class! This class is really a one of a kind, unique experience and it really surpassed my expectations. Giuseppe was fun, engaging and extremely knowledgeable. We really felt like were learning from a world class chef. I studied abroad in Rome years ago and visited many times since but just started doing these experiences to try something new and this was well worth it. It was great to have a bit of an excursion just outside Rome proper. This class was amazing from start to finish and the whole group thoroughly enjoyed it. We made delicious pizza, pasta and then afterwards took a delightful stroll through the Appian Way - what more could you ask for. I highly recommend and can't wait to do it again!

We were a quite big group of 22 people. But there were two instructors with Giuseppe and so it worked perfect. The event takes place in a nice garden and a big tent. So there is a much space. Making pizza and pasta in this event is a lot of fun. We learned how to make the dough, to form the pizza ( it’s not so easy as we thought ;) ) and to make several pasta shapes. I have an intolerance of tomatoes and Guiseppe had for me an alternative for covering the pizza. There were many different people from different countries all interested in conversation too. So we had a good time together, talking, drinking wine, juice and water and eating our self-made meal! Kids are welcome too. We can highly recommend this event!

The cooking class with Giuseppe was a huge highlight of our trip! We absolutely loved it and had a blast! We learned a lot while on gorgeous property on a beautiful day. The food, wine, company, instruction and experience was wonderful! We highly recommend! When our trip was over and we all talked about what was our favorite thing we did, this class was #1 along with St. Peter's Basilica. Thanks!

Giuseppe's cooking experience was fantastic. My wife and I really had a great time learning from him. He was passionate and funny throughout the class. I would recommend this to anyone who wants to have fun and learn how to make authentic pasta at the same time.

I had a great time. Traveling solo can sometimes be precarious, but everything about this experience was ideal: the location (right at an easy metro stop), the fact that I didn’t have to bring anything with me, and certainly the atmosphere with the other participants was delightful. I had fun trying to make the pasta shapes, I was terrible at it but still enjoyed myself immensely. I have a new appreciation for those who can create these things!

Without exaggerating I think this class was the thing that made my stay in Rome really special. It was the best way to spend my last day: not only the given course was interesting but Giuseppe's great and fun spirit made it an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended!

Giuseppe’s class was one of a kind and I STRONGLY recommend it. He is such a nice and funny guy and the entire class is hands on. One of the reasons we chose this class was that it wasn’t in the middle of the city, but transportation was extremely easy. We just took the metro to the end of the line and he was there ready to pick us up! The class lasted longer than expected, but Giuseppe clearly wanted us to enjoy the time and answered all questions and gave us tips about visiting Rome. Not only did we all make our own pizza, but we learned how to make 10+ shapes of pasta, pizza dough, and two types of pasta dough. The entire time Giuseppe was warm and welcoming and explained everything very thoroughly. Not only is a great bang for your buck (and I mean GREAT), but we got to go to the catacombs after. When we were finally finished (around 3:15), Giuseppe offered to drop us off at the road that leads to the San Sebastiano catacombs. It was a gorgeous walk down the road and amazing visit when we arrived. I strongly recommend going if you can. Overall, it was an incredibly unique experience and I can guarantee that next time we come to Rome, we will be joining him again!

Excellent experience. She did the class in English and Spanish at the same time because my family did not have English. He was always attentive to explain everything very well. Excellent food and very good wine. 10/10!!!

Giuseppe and his team provided a great experience! He was well-prepared and we ate delicious food. On top of that he was hilarious. It was a blast. I would wholeheartedly recommend this experience when visiting Italy. It's a great taste of what modern Italians are doing and not just what they did hundreds of years ago! Specifically, Giuseppe provided a really fun environment. Probably the best tiramisu I had during my trip!
Giuseppe was very caring and a great teacher. It was an amazing experience. He was hilarious. And the food was delicious. Come with an appetite!!
This was a great experience! It was the highlight of our trip in Rome! I highly recommend it if you have half day during your vacation!

We really appreciate that Giuseppe took the extra time to accommodate my granddaughter’s gluten allergy. He researched the best ingredients and took time to work with her one on one to teach her. She was thrilled to learn how to make a gluten free pizza that tastes better than regular. Thank you Giuseppe and your team. It made the trip all the more memorable.

Yesterday we attended Giuseppe's class and we couldn't have had a better time.
There was a really friendly atmosphere and the pizza and pasta making experience was awesome.
We would definitely recommend if you are a lover of pizza and pasta.
The experience was great! The place is excellent, the food is wonderful! And the Giuseppe team is very attentive, as well as talented!

Excellent experience. She did the class in English and Spanish at the same time because my family does not speak English. He was always attentive to explain everything very well. Excellent food and very good wine. 10/10!!!

Giuseppe is a great guy with a very italian sense of humor(he teases people, so dont be offended) and his farm area is quite nice. The experience overall is great. Also, a big bonus is the his location is next to the Appian Way(which he can drop you off at) so you can stroll through there and catch a bus then train back into Rome. I highly recommend!
This was a great, fun and unique experience. Giuseppe made the class very fun and brought humor into the class. The food and cooking was great

What a great day! We chose this experience over the other Rome cooking classes because it was more remote and it looked different than the others. We were right. Giuseppe and his sous chef, Mersad (sp?), were not only knowledgeable and friendly, but the comedy and entertainment that they provided throughout the day was worth the price of admission on its own. The pasta was delicious and the pizza was even better. I can't wait to take my new cooking skills back home and make homemade fettuccine alfredo for my entire family!

Such a great experience! My husband and I were lucky enough to have the experience all to ourselves- at first we were a little nervous about the small group but it made it so personal and fun. We really loved it!

Giuseppe and his assistant are the coolest dynamic duo. Could not stop laughing with these two. The best pizza I’ve had since being here. You absolutely have to take his class. You won’t regret a minute of it.

Thank you Giuseppe for a great experience! It was so enjoyable not only to be on learning hands on with a master like Giuseppe but also a great location, with the beautiful farmland and cute chickens. Chef Giuseppe started with teaching us the pizza recipe, which was probably one of the best ive ever had. He showed us the technical process and the physical way to do it as long as explaining the importance of each steps. As someone who is greatly interested in Italian cuisine, this was a great more in depth start off. Having seen the way pasta is made fresh was truly an experience as someone who would def be too scared to try it by themselves. Giuseppe and his assitant are fun and ready to teach you.
I would definitely recommend taking this class! It was a really fun experience and the location allowed for a nice getaway from the city :)

It really was a fantastic experience. Giuseppe and Mersad really made the experience what it was - very funny and fantastic pace of learning. Really was one of the highlights of our trip to Rome! Fantastic food, wine and overall experience. Definitely would recommend!!!!

It was a really amazing experience! Scape a little bit from touristic and all hurry from the city, get connected with nature, land... learn about italian food, make it very special! Giuseppe is a wonderful teacher with good sense of humor, and made us to fell like home!

My fiancé and I had a good time while doing this experience. The pizza was great, the wine was really good and the pasta was delicious. The experience lasted a little longer than we would have liked as we spent time prepping food for the next group and a lot of time making different pastas that eventually went to feed chickens. Overall, we enjoyed ourselves and ate some really good food.

This was a great experience. Giuseppe and his assistants went out of their way to make sure everyone was having fun and learning. The setting, on a little farm just outside of Rome, next to the Appian Way was really charming.
I loved this class! We made some delicious food and laughed the entire time! I can’t wait to get back home and put my new skills to use. I highly recommend it!
Great experience , every dollar spent was worth it, thanks so much for the tips and for special hours cheff Giusepe , it really exceeded expectations 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻
Giuseppe and Mersad were a funny duo, they both helped the group make our pizza and pasta. Giuseppe Is a character full of energy, and likes to joke a lot. Overall I had a great time.

We had a great time learning simple techniques to cook basic Italian food. It was hands-on and we learnt how to make pizza and different types of pasta.

Loved the setting of the place, in the organic farm with the chickens.

Giuseppe was funny and knowledgable!

Overall a great fun experience for learning the traditional pasta and pizza techniques at a very affordable price. The location may seem far but it's less than 30 mins from rome city center by metro. Guiseppe provides transportation from the metro station to his farm. There's unlimited wine (for all you drinkers) and everyone gets to make their own pizza. Make sure you take your sense of humor along.
It was a very enjoyable day, hands on and learnt loads whilst having a laugh too! Both Giuseppe and Mersad were very helpful 😊

We had a great time as a family including two children, age 8 and 10, and my mother who does not even speak English! All of us had a great time with this course (my husband as well!). It was fun with great dynamic even with 13 of us in the class. If you have children, I would highly recommend this experience. Our children not only loved the learning of making pizza and pasta but also enjoyed very much of feeding the chickens on the farm!

A memorable experience. Good group dynamic, and it was an entertaining class where we learnt a lot and grateful Giuseppe accommodates for vegetarians. He was helpful in arranging a transfer for us to the airport too which was a nice touch. Thanks once again. Nik & Hiran
It was great local experience ;) I definitely recommend it! Very friendly and funny atmosphere (even with local chickens) , great food and wine!

I feel very lucky to have found this class, which not every visitor to Rome gets to experience. I very much liked the group dynamic that Giuseppe helped create that was welcoming and very inclusive to even a lone traveler like me. The food making process, the location, etc, every aspect of this class made my first trip to Italy more unique and memorable. Highly recommend!
This is very Italian experience in sense of trying to cook real tasty Italian pizza and pasta! Be ready to be easy going with the jokes :)
Giuseppe was fantastic! This was a wonderful experience and the food we made was so delicious. He created a fun group dynamic and the location was beautiful. Definitely recommend!

My husband and I had a wonderful time in this cooking class! Next time I come to Rome I want to bring more of my family members to this class. Giuseppe was an excellent teacher and made the whole event lots of fun for everyone involved. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Host was very arrogant. He talked down to people as if they were stupid. He made fun of my husband. His assistant tried to give us some one on one help and he chastised him. When he dropped us off at the original meeting place he side swiped and parked car then drove off!

Great experience! The class is within reach for everyone, the time is taken, you don't feel rushed, everything is done in humor and good humor. We made delicious pizza, and homemade pasta! And enjoy a good tiramisu. Finally, a class where you can do it yourself, it's much appreciated.

I recommend it without hesitation! The only small downside for those who are afraid of chickens like me... there are dozens of them, but they don't attack ah ah ah.

Thank you for a great time!

I really enjoyed this experience, although the main chef was sick so I cannot speak on his behalf. His assistant however did a wonderful job! I highly suggest this experience it was so much fun & was one of my favorite memories from Rome!!

What an epic day. Got to make the best pizza I’ve ever tasted from scratch, learn to make different pizza & pasta doughs, learn to make lots of different pasta shapes & then eat them! The tiramisu & wine we’re also welcome editions to the day. Our host was fantastic as well! I would recommend more expectations are set around it being outside. Loved my day & would do it again. Thanks.

We came with our 2 kids to have fun and to learn how to prepare Pizzas and Pasta the right way. The location is very interesting, in a very nice historical area. We had a lot of fun preparing and tasting both pizzas and Pasta; Ambiance was very good and our teacher was very precise and passionate to teach us all his best kept secrets! Thanks again, we loved it. Romain, Amandine, Juliette et Chloé

It was really original and we learned a lot to make pizza. The quality of the ingredients were outstanding! And the place was so cute.
It was cold so we recomend you to bring a good jacket.

My family and I felt that our cooking class experience was one of the highlights of our trip to Rome. We are still talking about the pizza’s and pasta we made. Joseph and Merced were great teachers with a lot of patience and humor. We will never forget our time and will definitely refer others to take the class. Thanks guys.

EN & ES
ENGLISH We can highly recommend this experience. After an overdose of Rome's religious art and the crowds of the city, the course and lunch were both a welcome respite and a chance to learn more about Italian cookery. Giuseppe is a total pro and managed the (all times boisterous) group very well, with the help of his assistant and also another chef, Sylvia. Have you ever been at a pizzeria and wanted to try shovelling your own pizza into the oven? Have you ever wondered just how the heck you make rigatoni by hand? Then this is the experience for you. Even if you think you're pretty proficient with dough, you'll learn something, and it's an opportunity to ask the professionals any questions. 5 stars!

SPANISH We can highly recommend this experience. After an overdo of religious art in Rome and the crowd in the city, this course and the food were a pleasant respite and an opportunity to learn more about Italian cuisine. Belle is a total professional and handled the group very well (sometimes a little bustling) with the help of her assistant and also another chef, Sylvia. Have you ever been to a pizzeria and wanted to try and throw your own pizza in the oven? Have you ever wondered how to make rigatoni by hand? Then this is the experience for you. Even if you think you're quite deft, you'll learn something, and it's an opportunity to ask the professionals any questions you have. Five stars!

What a fun and unique experience! It was fascinating and interesting to make your own pasta and pizza from scratch, and then it was fulfilling to eat the fruits of your labor afterwards. Giuseppe and company make you feel welcome and are really helpful whenever you have questions. Plus, the recipes they provide afterwards look amazing to try out. I definitely recommend!

The trip was exceptional! The Experience surpassed our expectations and the whole group enjoyed their time with the host and the unique experience, every person of our group talking about it like it is the highlight of their trip :D that’s Awesome, and the most important is how the host dealing and interacting with everyone with full passion and care , we will certainly come again to Rome and re - experience it again.

The experience was great! The chef was really kind and funny 😄 the process was interesting and informative! and it was the best pizza we tried in Rome! we weren't lucky with the weather so couldn't walk around and it was chilly (one cooking place is outside and the second is in a small wooden house). but it's definitely one of the greatest cultural experiences we had in Rome! thanks, God! ( we called him Guiseppe 😄)
The experience was a great intro to italian food making. Giuseppe makes pizza making experience looks effortlessly. I love the process and loved the outcome. it was joyful and useful.
The highlight of our trip! Make sure to take this class, you’d be missing out if you don’t. You’ll learn so much and the chefs are very kind and funny!
This experience was so cool and filling (If I might add). It was a full experience with not only the teachers (professionals) but the other guests. It was amazing! A MUST DO!

This class was better than expected. Even though it was raining, we went to a site, on a farm and cooked outside in the countryside. . Incredibly romantic and extremely informative. Even though it was raining Once Giuseppe broke everything down, it made everything so clear. Great for couples, and even though I was solo, and still felt like part of a family that was cooking. I would do this again the next time I am in Rome and bring my family.
What a great experience! Highly recommend this activity. We learned lots. Can’t wait to try out pizza and pasta making when we get home! The Appian Way is a must-do for the journey home. Loved it!

Great experience! The setting is very nice and it's very informative. The chef is a sacred character. Thank you for this culinary pleasure, you will come back with the guarantee of cooking paws and pizzas! I recommend it.

Amazing host, caring, funny and professional. Would recommend 5/5, also would come back again. Authentic atmosphere, plenty of individual attention and insider tips. Best food experience in Rome if you wanna work hands on ✌🏼😊

We had so much fun! Even though it was a cold day, we were fine because we were either by the pizza oven or inside most of the time. Giuseppe and his assistant were very fun and encouraging! They created the perfect balance between observation, hands-on experience, and relaxation. It was all delicious! Thank you for specifying vegetarians are welcome!
Excellent cooking class!! Learning to make pizza, so many different types of pasta was amazing!! Can not wait to get home and make everything again. Incredible venue as well. Thank you Guiseppe!!

This is one of the best experiences we’ve had in Italy...learning to make and cook pizza and pasta on a rural property with Giuseppe as our teacher. He’s a real hoot! Really knows his stuff and has a great sense of humour. He’s well set up and takes you through dough making, handling dough, making pizza bases, adding filling and baking in a pizza oven...cooked delicious pizza in the oven in less than a minute. You get to eat your pizza straight from the oven! It re-defines what pizza should taste like...hot, mouth watering and light.
Then we learnt how to make and handle pasta dough making all kinds of fancy shapes. These were cooked up for lunch.
We took our 14-year old daughter who was transfixed and totally engaged for the whole 4 hours. We were lucky to be in a small group of just 4 learners so we got individual attention and immediate feedback from Guiseppe and his sous-chef every step. We had tiramisu and home made liqueur to finish. Exquisite! Drinks, including house wine were provided. We took home the leftovers along with the gift of a sample of Guiseppe’s home-grown olive oil. We loved the whole rural setting including the wildlife. Pickup and drop off from Laurentina Station. This is a must-do if you have a spare day.

An educational and fun experience making tasty pizza and pasta.
Giuseppe and Mersad were great fun and made the day a really enjoyable. The food was amazing and I will be using the recipes at home
Giuseppe was incredibly knowledgable about pizza and pasta making and helped us learn the skills in a fun environment. The location is great and it was a fantastic day!

It was a wonderful experience! Everything was exactly as described, the hosts were welcoming, it was very easy to communicate. We really enjoyed every moment we spent there. Highly recommended! Thank you very much!

A great experience at Guiseppe's estate outside the gates of the city. We learned a lot about preparing pizza and pasta and had a lot of fun.
He worked with his assistant to solve every issue that arises, like the frozen water pipes (the first time ever!) in a humorous way.
This was an overall great experience! Learned a lot from Giuseppe and Mersad about pizza and pasta making techniques! Definitely worth the money spent to take the class!
We had a great day cooking with Giuseppe! The pizza was amazing and the two hosts are very entertaining! We will definitely remember this day!
Great experience learning how to make authentic pizza & pasta. Giuseppe and Merzad are great hosts and very entertaining. Enjoy! Looking forward to practicing what we learned.
Very fun experience! Ran a little longer than planned, but Giuseppe dropped us off at the Apian Way which led to alternative , but wonderful, plans.
We really loved the experience of learning Pizza and Pasta making from the Chef. This was one of the Highlights of our tour. We would definitely recommend everyone to try this out.

Great experience! Learned a lot about pizza and pasta making
The place is beautiful. Giuseppe was a great teacher and funny.
Thank you!

An amazing experience and cooking class!
Giuseppe is always prompt with responses to any questions before the booking. A day before the activity, he sent detailed instructions with pictures of the meeting details. There were 16 people in our class. He and another driver with two vans met us at the metro station. Then, they drive us to the location if the class (about 15 min ride). Giuseppe has his setting in the area of Appia Antica park. While we were there in December, we got lucky with sunny weather. There are two toilets with sinks. There is sitting table outside, eating tables inside and an area for pizza cooking with the stove. First, Giuseppe demonstrated to us making pizza and let us taste it (it was SO yummy!!). Then, he split us among three tables. Then we went off to prepare our own Pizza under guidance and supervision from Giuseppe and his assistant. In addition to basic pizza ingredients, we were given a lot of toppings we could add to our pizzas. After that we had a chance to eat our pizza back inside with a glass of wine. Pizzas were awesome, we also were given an opportunity to put leftovers in a box so they’re not going to go to waste. After that, Giuseppe provided a lot of information on preparing the dough for both Pizza and pasta. We also made dough for both pizza and pasta. He explained to us different techniques of making different shapes of pasta and we tried quite a few of them. It was fun and entertaining. After that we made our pasta and ate outside. It was really great, for the dessert we were given very yummy tiramisu. And then we were given an opportunity either to stay in the Appia Antica area for a walk or to be driven back to the metro station. For us personally it was great , since we were planning to get to Appia Antica for a while and haven’t had a chance , so we were happy to combine a cooking class and then enjoyed walk in the Appia Antica, at the end we caught bus back home. overall - an awesome experience. Highly recommend !!!

Delicious from start to finish. From the moment we were picked up we felt looked after. Giuseppe peppers his instruction with humour. The experience is accessible to varying levels of ability - everybody will make an outstanding pizza. Hands on activity and great eats - pizza / pasta and tiramisu. Delicious food in a local setting with lot’s of informative knowledge.

SPECIAL! This was one of the first times our family had done something like this together. The setting was rustic and beautiful, on protected land within the city limits. Giuseppe was extremely knowledgeable and patient with us all as he led us through the steps of making pizza. It was the most delicious pizza ever! We then went through the process of making pasta from scratch and creating the different shapes. Giuseppe was entertaining and made the group laugh throughout the entire 4+ hours. My family (with 2 teenagers) loved our experience with Giuseppe and will cherish it as a memory for years to come. I recommend doing this if you find yourself in Rome.

My wife and I were there with our 2 daughters and we all loved it. It's the 1st thing my children mention when giving a review of our trip to Rome... before Vatican City, or the Forum or the Coliseum. Giuseppe taught us some tricks of the trade and even gave a bit of purchase advice for wood burning pizza ovens. We'd do this again.

Fantastic experience! We took our kids to learn how to make pasta and pizza and it was the best pizza we have had in Italy. We cannot wait to try the recipes at home. Definitely recommend spending the day with Giuseppe and his assistant Mersad. They are very entertaining and we learned so much. We had a beautiful sunny afternoon and were able to eat outside even at the end of December.

The food was amazing, cute place outside the city you normally wouldn’t see - and some great tips even us people who make pasta all need. Def worth it. And the chickens... can’t get enough of the chickens running around. The kids loved feeding them

Giuseppe and his assistant were wonderful. It was an interesting location, and a surprising break from the city. We had our 3 kids ( 13,11,8) with us and they got to participate 100%. All hands on fun. And the most delicious pizza I have ever had. Please check out the Appia Way after to walk off some of the food.

That was a wonderful class .. Made Pizza and Pasta on our own , with the help of Giuseppe and his great assistant (special thanks to him) ..
Experience matches exactly the description , be sure about that ..

Chef Giuseppe and his assistant Mersad were amazing today with a very special Christmas Eve cooking class! They were both very genuine, easy to follow and so much fun to experience with my family. We appreciated our time together and are anxious to cook for our friends upon returning home with all we learned. Thank you for a wonderful time and all the laughs! Five stars ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

What a great start to our family vacation in Rome! From start to finish this experience could not have been more enjoyable! Guiseppe met us at the metro station and transported us to his property that is just minutes from the Appian Way. He has a unique teaching “facility” that has an indoor area for pasta making and an outdoor area for pizza making. We were surrounded by olive trees and a brood of chickens - all part of the fresh ingredients we used during the class. Guiseppe was knowledgeable, funny, and had an engaging way about him that pulled a group of class participants from all over the world (12 of us) together for an informative, fun hands on experience that we won’t soon forget. And his helper, Marsad, was a delight too!

This class was the highlight of my trip to Rome. Giuseppe’s outdoor kitchen was in the hidden gem just outside the city. The class was informative and also we had a lot of fun with Giuseppe and his helper Mersad. They both have a great sense of humor but also take the class seriously so you do everything in the right way.
After all I am inspired to make my perfect pasta and pizza just at home for my family and friends. And definitely I will join the class in my next visit to Rome. Just because it is a wonderful time among very nice people.
Just come hungry and you will be surprised!

It was an excellent experience at the cooking school. I liked that Giuseppe kept his own chickens and had olive trees around. You really feel like you are in the country side, although you are actually not too far from the city centre in Rome. Giuseppe kept the mood light and fun throughout.

such an amazing experience truly the highlight of our trip as we did spend an entire month in Rome. Real people teaching the correct ways of italian cooking with lots of fun. be prepared for some of the best for you will make and have during your entire trip and the best part is you can take what you leaned with you for the rest of your life highly recommend
A very lovely Sunday experience! The itinerary is exactly as described and Giuseppe is a knowledgeable and fun instructor. Overall we had a really nice time.
What a great time!! We had a blast and they even gave us a great recommendation to explore the local area after the experience. 10/10 would recommend!!!

Absolutely incredible! Not only is Giuseppe a knowledgeable and professional chef, but he is incredibly funny and an absolute blast to interact with... he makes sure you don’t take the experience too seriously; cooking is supposed to be fun! My wife and I booked this trip on a whim during our free day in Rome and we would absolutely do it again. If you’re looking for a “non-touristy” experience that’s off the beaten path, I highly recommend. Make sure you build in a couple hours after to walk down the Appian Way as well.

Giuseppe provided the most wonderful and authentic Italian food experience. Not only was the equipment and site used traditional, but also comfortable and accommodating. He also provided just the right portions of history, education, and humor to his lecturing about the cooking and other Italian cuisine. It was very nice that his assistant took photos of us during the class. He was NOT kidding when he said to arrive hungry. MANGIA MOLTO!!!!

So much fun, and some of the best food I had on my Italian vacation! Definitely come hungry! I appreciated that Giuseppe gave us a document after with the instructions for how to make the recipes at home! All in all very professional and fun experience!
We had such a blast! Our family of 6 laughed, learned, and loved our time with Giuseppe and his team... 5 stars and highly recommended on your next trip to Rome!

It was a very good experience, we had a great time
Very good and the explanation was quite plentiful, highly recommended Giusseppe and his cooking course

We had a blast with Guiseppe. Lots of fun throughout the learning process and it's always great to eat the pizza you prepared yourself. Be prepared to leave the place with traces of flour on your garments !
Idyllic setting, funny & experienced chefs and food to die for (take this from a foodie). Definitely an experience to try at least once in Rome!

Great experience!! Giuseppe was very accommodating and picked us up from the train station (very easy to follow meeting instructions). From there we were taken to his beautiful home where we had an immersive hands on pizza and pasta making experience. Giuseppe was very entertaining and knowledgeable in both arenas. After we finished he showed us how to get to the Appia Way which was a nice way to cap off the afternoon! Highly recommend!
Great experience! Food tasted amazing! Everyone was very friendly and had a great sense of humor. Would definitely sign up again if I return to Rome :)

My fiancé, Michael and I love cooking together at home, so naturally wanted to do an Italian cooking class on our travels. We are so glad we did and had such a wonderful experience with Giuseppe and his assistant Mersad. It was lighthearted, so fun and we learnt a lot. We can’t wait to make pizza and pasta for our friends back home in Australia. Thank you so much for sharing your time and skills with us, Giuseppe.. and that Tiramisu. YUM! It was one of the highlights of our trip to Rome! :)

This was absolutely the highlight of our trip to Rome, and we did lots of things that we loved while here.

First of all, the place is beautiful. The class is hosted in a wonderful tented outdoor kitchen just outside the city, as well as a very cute indoor classroom kitchen where we did the pasta shaping technical session. There are chickens on the property that produce the eggs used for the pasta. It's really an amazing experience just approaching the class area.

Giuseppe and his assistant were so much fun to work with. They were very engaging and both had a great sense of humor. The class was very informative and thorough, and I really feel like I learned enough to go home and make my own pizza and pasta, and we had a ton of fun while doing it.

The class is very well organized. I really can't say enough what an enjoyable experience this was.

Enjoyed the cooking class a lot.
Good friendly atmosphere with a combination of fun, cooking and eating.
Awesome location outside the city bustle makes the experience even better. Definitely worth trying it.

This class was a lot of fun! We learned how to make pizza and various types of pasta. The host was witty and made the class fun. I would highly recommend it to anyone, and look forward to taking it again during my next visit.

Come hungry! This was such a fun and delicious experience in the middle of nature. There is a real wood burning pizza oven that cooks your own pizza in a matter of minutes. Then you learn how to make both the pizza dough and the pasta dough, and then you learn about different types of pasta you can easily make at home. Giuseppe has a great sense of humor but also takes the class seriously so you learn the right way.

What a fun experience this was, especially for the kids- they loved creating, cooking and eating their own pizzas and we all loved to learn how to make so many different pasta shapes! We will definitely put this knowledge to use at home. :) Giuseppe is a knowledgeable and fun host/teacher!

Guiseppe and his assistant went above and beyond to make us feel cozy, welcome and part of the team. They answered all of our questions in a friendly and funny manner. The small number of participants facilitated a homey feeling where we could get to know each other!

Highly recommended experience in Rome!

Very good experiment, the experience went exactly as told. We got to make our own pizzas and learn how to make pizza and different kind of pastas. Giuseppe was very professional and everything went very smooth. Only one mistake we made - we didn't come hungry! :)

It was really nice
I learned how to make pizza help and make pasta.
It's really good to bake the pizza in the hearth and eat it. I think it would be more fun to come with a friend rather than alone.

We had such a wonderful experience with Giuseppe and Mersad learning to create various styles of pasta dough, pasta shapes & Neapolitan pizza. Together they made it such a fun experience full of laughter, joy, encouragement & smiles. If you are contemplating a cooking class in Rome, look no further.

Getting to learn the details/techniques about & being able to create by hand the different types of dough, the various pasta shapes and certainly the pizza - was a lot of fun and wasn’t intimidating at all. There was a lot of individualized training and plenty of time for questions, etc. We were able to enjoy such a great meal as a group and relaxed on a beautiful piece of property on a beautiful day.

Afterwards, they were able to drop us off at the Appia Antica near by and we explored this ancient road and were able to walk and enjoy the beautiful historic countryside. The catacombs are also just up that road.

Thank you again for such a wonderful experience and for welcoming us

The class was amazing. The place is so beautiful and everything was fine. Giuseppe is a really nice person and we have learnt to cook delicious Italian dishes. The classes are in a gorgeous place and it felt really good to know that part of Rome that is so beautiful.

Giuseppe provides a fun, informative experience on a cool little farmlet adjacent to one of the great sites of Rome, Via Appia Antica.

I rode my bike to the class — (apologies to Giuseppe for the miscommunication, which handled with aplomb), and given the absolutely brilliant day, I continued a couple miles more after class.

It all ranked as one of my favorite experiences on my trip.

Highly recommend. Thank you Giuseppe!

I booked this on my last day in Rome. I didn’t want to do anymore touristy stuff so I opted for a cooking class. I’m glad I did! This class was so much fun, I travel solo but didn’t feel left out. Giuseppe was an amazing teacher with great sense of humor together with Mersad! Amazing duo. Wine was great. And we even got limoncello shots at the end. I learned so much and my favorite was the setting. It has cabin in the woods feel (lol) TAKE THIS CLASS, you wont regret!

It was a lovely experience and I highly recommend it ! Giuseppe treated us as friends while teaching us the correct way of making pizza and pasta ! He was patient ,funny full of knowledge eager to share !

This was a lot of fun. Giuseppe's outdoor kitchen is awesome, a great escape from the bustle of center of Rome! We made pizza first then learned how to make the dough and many different types of pasta. The delicious tiramisu was already made and he shared the recipe, but that was not part of the class. One thing worth noting: while Airbnb says the class size is 10, our class was bigger and it seems that's common for Giuseppe - he said only 10 people book through Airbnb but people book it other ways too. Our class was about 16-18 people, and he has done classes as big as 40s - worth knowing if you are really wanting an intimate small group experience. For me the duration was a bit long - listed at 4hrs but it ran closer to 5hrs including travel. Could have been a bit more organized to keep us on time, but overall it was a relaxing fun time. (Just be aware if you have a flight to catch or other engagements, the times are approximate.) There was a fair amount of lighthearted teasing in this class, which is all fun, but some questions were answered with a joke rather than instruction, and I'm not sure I'm much better at making pizza at the end. Would consider this a fun evening experience more than a hardcore cooking lesson... but who could expect to be a master chef after 4 hours? :) This was enjoyable and I'm glad we did it. Thank you Giuseppe!

Such a fun and tasty experience! The place is super relaxing, in an archeological reserve. We did delicious neapolitan style pizzas, and then prepared different doughs to be used for pasta, that we later used to practice some different shapes and finally hand shape the pasta we'd have for dinner. The wine and tiramisu were great too! The group was nice and energetic, which was nice for me as i went alone. Giuseppe was funny, knowledgeable and kind, and a plus for accommodating my tight hours. Really recommended!

We absolutely loved our time making pizza and pasta! We met people from all over the world! The tomatoes and basil that we put into our pizza cane from Giuseppe's farm. Our hosts we friendly and interactive. Highly recommend this adventure.
Wonderful experience! We had a very diverse group and had a blast! Lots of great tips on how to make the items and where to find the ingredient!
The cooking class was Fun, and I enjoy meeting people and cooking, and most importantly eating the most delicious pizza. 😍 it Worths my time 👌🏽

Thanks for the enjoyable experience, waiting to try ourselves at home.
we learn a lot from you.
the place is fantastic with a good atmosphere.

It was so much fun! I learned a lot and the food was delicious. Giuseppe was super friendly and a great teacher. I'd highly recommend it if you enjoy cooking and want to get away from the busy part of Rome.

An experience, in short, awesome. My partner and I have loved making pizzas and different types of pasta, learning from Belle and her helper, having fun with each step between laughing and wine. I definitely recommend trying this cooking class for anyone who wants to have a good time and try the Italian food.

It's been exceptional, one of the best we've ever done in Rome. Giusseppe is a real master, he makes you feel very comfortable and makes the class enjoyable, considering we were with two little ones, 10 and 12 years old, they left marvelled and delighted with the pizza and pasta they made. We would repeat it again. Totally recommended and more being in the country of pasta and pizza!!

Giuseppe was a ton of fun. He and his assistant are a great duo. They have a great sense of humor and it’s a very relaxed experience, good for all ages. Giuseppe even taught the class in both English and Spanish, as there was a non-English speaking family with two children there, and their experience was equally as good as ours.

It was fun and educational for everyone, and the food was we made was very good. You will learn techniques for a dozen or so different pasta types, and of course, wood fired pizza.

He included wine and water as you ate your pizza and pasta. The whole thing took about 4 hours.

Afterwards, we opted to walk back from the farm toward the city with the whole class, via the Appia Antica way (an ancient road with many ruins along the way) — which was only about 2km. We caught a bus at the end of the road, where there is a historic catacombs site. There is a bus stop there, but is no place to purchase a bus ticket in this area. However, as we quickly found out, no one pays for bus fare in Rome. You just get on. Only tourists worry about paying for the bus. So just jump on and sit down.

This was an absolutely amazing experience and I feel like I could recommend it to almost anyone who is spending more than a day in Rome!

Giuseppe was personable, funny, knowledgeable and an incredible teacher and chef. We had 10 people in our group in total, 4 of whom were parents with two young kids. Giuseppe not only taught in both English and Spanish, but also made it fun for adults and kids alike. (Honestly, I was nervous about the kids, but they were super sweet and into participating.)

We made pizzas right off the bat, then did three different kinds of dough and learned 10+ pasta shapes. Giuseppe was the perfect mix of funny with a little light teasing (he will critique your pasta till you get it “perfecto” ;) haha), but also a great teacher and really knowledgeable about the area and history of the region.

Hands down, a not to miss experience for those who want to do something outside of the typical touristy stuff.

Was a really fun experience ! Truly exceeded expectations. We made some absolutely delicious food, learnt lots of skills and different ways to make pasta. Giuseppe And his helper made it very light hearted and fun. Very funny! Overall was one if the best experiences you can do in rome! Learnt lots 10/10 would recommend to any one looking to have a great time and learn some cool skills

Thoroughly enjoyed this class and would highly recommend! I took this with my mom while on vacation as the weather prevented us from doing outdoor activities. One thing I wished however was to learn how to make the pasta sauces but I think that would have been difficult to show based on weather conditions as the pasta was cooked outside. Thank you, Giuseppe!

My friend and I had a great time at Giuseppe's cooking class! It was our first time booking an experience off of airbnb and it did not disappoint. The whole experience was amazing and I would highly recommend it!
The experience was great from beginning to end even with our weather conditions he still made it happen. Its definitely a must do if your in Italy. Thanks Giuseppe for sharing your expertise with us!

Let me start by saying, for the amount of information you learn in the lesson, and the amount of various recipes you're taught during your time with Giuseppe, the price of his lesson is unbeatable. He gives you knowledgeable information regarding the ways to make the various recipes you'll be taught during the lesson. He takes the time to work with you one on one to help you perfect your form and technique on how to prepare the pizza and pasta you'll be making. Granted the lesson does last several hours as stated in the description. Regardless if you're time in Rome is limited, as mine was, Giuseppe is dedicated to teaching you how to make authentic Italian dishes unique to Rome's gastronomy. It offers a special experience to learn more about Rome's culture from a local established chef all while eating phenomenal food. If any of this peaks your interest then this is the place for you!
We had a lot of fun during the cooking class with Guiseppe. It was the right balance between learning some ground rules and enjoying the food and bella Italia!

We had a great experience with Guiseppe. This is a great value! He explains everything well and you will be sent the recipes/instructions afterwards so that they will really help you at home. Also very nice that you do pizza and pasta and not one or the other.
You can really tell that Guiseppe has a lot of knowledge. Guiseppe's English is also very good, so communication is also smooth. The setting was idyllic and really contributed to the whole experience.
In short, this workshop is highly recommended!

Giuseppe class was REALLY fantastic! You learn to do roman and napoli pizza and pasta, and he gives you the recipe for the tiramisu. He and his assistant (that I don’t know how to spell the name) are very funny and easygoing. It was my birthday and I got a candle and they sang happy birthday to me! It was a day to remember forever
This cozy gastronomy experienced was all the money worth it. Giuseppe was a great host and made the day a lot of fun. It is highly recommended if you want one in the Italian cuisine.

This was one of the best experiences that we have had in Europe. Giuseppe was incredibly knowledgable and the class was very fun. If you're looking for something a little more technical than some of the other pasta classes then this is perfect.

We made a pizza and 2 pastas, which were all incredibly and learned techniques to do it in our own home.

What set this apart was the venue. It was in a gorgeous yard near a park that was incredibly to walk around. It was a beautiful way to spend the day.

My time with Giuseppe, learning to make pizza and handmade pasta, was fabulous. The class takes place in a beautiful setting, minutes away from the famed and lovely Appian Way. Giuseppe is a total expert at pizza dough and is an excellent teacher; I am ready to do it at home now. Making beautiful pasta shapes was lots of fun too.
Don’t miss the chance to relax, learn and feast during this wonderful Roman experience!

This class was everything I expected it to be. Giuseppe was very accommodating and taught us how to make pizzas and pastas (7-8 different shapes) and was clearly a great teacher since the food we ate (that we made) was incredible. I would recommend this to anyone visiting Rome!

We had a great time with Giuseppe and his assistant, making several different shapes of pasta and fantastic pizza. They were very patient and also fun.
We met some very friendly and interesting people on the class too.
It was an ideal way to learn more about Italian culture in a lovely setting, not to mention eating the spoils of our labour!
Would highly recommend.

We thought the class was fantastic! We learned a lot, plenty of food and plenty of wine! We are looking forward to getting the recipes so we can make them at home. Great tastes and wonderful conversations with all of the other participants. We learned more about special pasta styles and techniques in 3 hrs than in a week long class in Tuscany. Can wait to try out the pizza at home. Great staff as well, we enjoyed working with you both. We will be posting an excellent review on trip advisor too.

What a fabulous way to spend a day in a beautiful part of Rome! We learnt so much from Giuseppe. He is a great teacher and a great host. He has pitched just right and provides delicious food from the very start. As he says, do come very very very hungry!

The class with Giuseppe was a great experience and way to end our holiday. We learnt a lot and had plenty of help and advice on trickier parts. The class was also full of fun and laughter and in a lovely location.
Would definitely recommend to anyone.

Set in a bucolic landscape, Giuseppe's cooking class is the perfect Roman learning experience away from the city crowds.

Giuseppe and his co-facilitator Merced are very generous with their culinary knowledge and will guide you through every step with humour and playfulness.

As per Giuseppe's suggestion, we followed the class with a stroll through the Via Appia Antica, just a few minutes away, for an enhanced Roman experience.

Had an amazing time!

This was such a fun cooking class! Very hands on learning how to make pizza and pasta from scratch. My wife and I had a great experience with Chef Giuseppe who was extremely entertaining. It was a great value! Perfect location. I looking for other cooking classes in Rome but this was by far the best value and taught so many cooking techniques to bring back home. I highly recommend doing this cooking class!!! Made my trip memorable!

It was worth experience during our stay in Rome and we really enjoyed this class. The experience started with a small trip to a lovely open backyard kitchen, where we learned how to make traditional pizza and pasta. Giuseppe and his assistant was very helpful, and neathless to say, food was delicious. I would recommend this for tourists who are interested in getting off the beaten tourist place as well as expats who would like to know more about cooking with local ingredients.
Fun and educational experience! Giuseppe and his class were not only entertaining but a great way to learn about pasta techniques and cooking. My boyfriend and I had a great time!

It's an experience that I am going to cherish for a long long time to come.
It was an absolute fun workshop! Giuseppe is such a light hearted person and a wonderful chef ofc. We had great time kneading dough and making pasta and pizza. The site where he conducts this workshop is bliss to your senses. I highly recommend this workshop if cooking is your thing.
I will let out a little secret, once you are done making pasta and pizza, you all sit togetehr and eat it. I suggest all to save their appetite a little for tiramisu in the end. It's a little piece of heaven :)
A fun class in a beautiful area! I enjoyed learning the intricacies of making pasta and pizza. This was a great way to spend a day in Rome.

Is a great experience quote of good food and enjoyable, Giuseppe make this experience an easy and funny time in a good place. It's worth coming with Giuseppe and making your own pizza and pasta and then enjoying it with a good wine and group!!!

The most amazing experience. I arrived with a headache as I was looking forward to this and did not want to miss out. I soon forgot about my headache. The rustic atmosphere was peaceful and allowed for focus on the experience. The Appian Way is beautiful, a perfect place to learn something new. A brilliant blend of fun and focus, Giuseppe has both my appreciation and recommendation. Don't miss this.

One of the best thing I did in Rome! Giuseppe is a lively and funny guy, he really makes your day. This course makes me appreciate fresh hand made pasta and pizza. What a wonderful way to immerse with the Italian culture!

A truly fabulous time. We learnt how to make amazing pizza from a wood oven and all different types of pasta from scratch. Giuseppe is an amazing host - fabulous chef and one of the funniest people on the planet. Can’t recommend highly enough.

This class was so much fun, the perfect way to spend a Sunday evening in Rome! Giuseppe was incredibly knowledgeable and FUN. He and his assistant made sure that there was never a dull moment and we left with SO many incredible techniques and recipes to take home with us, plus some wonderful memories. Grazie mille Giuseppe!

for the same to do as the Romans do seeing all of the ancient sites is wonderful but the Romans had to eat too so it's good to take a cooking class with a wonderful chef. Giuseppe became a friend in a very short time made me and my friends feel welcome and we learned many things we didn't know about Food: pasta and pizza making. Take some time from your day and go and enjoy this wonderful cooking class.

We really enjoyed our experience with Giuseppe! Held in a great setting outdoors, where Giuseppe taught us the inside scoop on pizza making, as well as pasta of many types and shapes. This was all done in a lighthearted way, and then we got to eat the delicious food we made, along with wine. I really liked Giuseppe’s knowledge and expertise, plus he made it a fun time for all.

An excellent experience with an excellent knowledgeable chef. Giuseppe leads the group in a step by step preparation of making the perfect pizza and pasta. A lot of fun and laughs and good food. A definite must do when visiting Rome

It’s absolutely a fun experience for me...highly recommend it.

Please give Chef Giuseppe a TV show. He’s such a character! I also learned a lot about pizza and pasta from him. Thank you! And the wine is pretty good!

We loved learning how to make the pizza. I do wish we would have each had the opportunity to make the pizza dough. Our class was larger than we expected (16) so maybe that's why only half the class made pizza dough and the other half made the pasta dough. The pasta making was very detailed and you learned how to make a lot of different types of pasta. Giuseppe and his assistant were very informative and fun.

We had a really great time in this class! The location was absolutely beautiful and the food was delicious :-). All cooking will be done outside (unless it’s raining) so dress comfortably and bring big spray.

So much fun! Best day! Giuseppe is so funny and witty! Food was great and location was beautiful! I would recommend this to anyone. Easy to get to and he is so good at teaching! Can’t wait to go home and try what I learned!
This was a fun and entertaining class! We made a bunch of different types of pasta and a pizza. It’s in a beautiful setting on Giuseppe’s farm south of Rome.

This was one of our favorite experiences in Rome. Giuseppe and his assistant were welcoming, funny and great teachers which made for an awesome cooking experience! Very well organized, great food, good company and an experience that you will remember for many years.

First experience when we arrived in Rome. True to the experience description on Airbnb. Easy access by metro. Giuseppe was waiting for us with his dilapidated white van which does not predict the following. You'll find yourself in a cute backyard where pizza can't be waited. Giuseppe is very attentive to each of his guests and takes the time with each of them. The ingredients are fresh, the explanations clear, the atmosphere relaxed. The pasta crafting reminded us of our curiosity and excitement during our first school day. The tiramitsu was just grand.
This class was so much fun and delicious! The setting is beautiful and Giuseppe was a knowledgeable and entertaining host and teacher. A great way to immerse yourself in Italian food culture.
