Chef Giuseppe was kind enough to pick the group up from the Metro station and took us to his food lab - a really nice farmhouse on the outskirts of Rome - all of the equipment and supplies were already paid out for us. We suited up in aprons and got to work.

First thing we were shown was an Italian classic - pizza. I really appreciated chef's hands on approach and how he paid individual attention when showing each one of us how to craft the right shape and consistency of our dough bases. We got to top our pizzas how we liked, picking Basil straight from chef's plants. There's a lot more technique required than Domino's would lead you to believe.

We spent the bulk of the class learning how to make pasta in different shapes and styles. This was not easy but chef was able to break down instructions to easily understood bits.

The banter between chef and his assistant, Mersad kept our entire class of 12 engaged and in stitches. A word of caution, their sense of humour is...edgy. It is not for everyone but it is all in good fun. Actions speak louder than words and their bond as friends and colleagues is apparent. It was very fun and engaging. In fact, the meals we made under chef's guidance were the best we had in Rome. It was quite possibly one of the highlights of our entire trip. It does take up a huge portion of your day so you'd want to plan your sightseeing and tour of Rome accordingly, especially if you don't have a lot of time there. Otherwise, this experience is highly recommended.

This is an entertaining experience outside the hustle and bustle of downtown Roma with a very entertaining chef. You take a short ride to his farm and make pizza, pasta, and try some of his amazing tiramisu. It was a fun and relaxing experience and we didn’t leave hungry!

This was a wonderful way to spend a half of a day in Rome. Giuseppe was very clear and knowledgeable about his craft. We made pizza to rival anything we ate at the restaurants.
I would suggest this for anyone who enjoys cooking.

First off the arrival and transport let’s you know you are about to embark on an adventure! Giuseppe himself is warm, charismatic and super engaging. I thorough enjoyed his teaching style and how he arranged his out door kitchen. His assistant is also fantastic and their dynamic is fun and playful. It was a great day- his pizza dough was perfect and the easy simple pasta technique took all my fear out of making pasta!!

This was such a fun day!!! Truly an authentic Italian experience. Giuseppe was so good from the start with contacting us and giving specific instructions on meeting point and being punctual.

The class was so much fun and we felt like we couldn’t have had a better teacher! Highly recommend

Belle is very fun and pleasant!

We had a little detail with our reservation due to our own mistake, however it was understanding and I took the opportunity to joke around with that haha ;D

The activity is fun and interesting, he is a professional chef with a great race around different places in the world so his tips and advice were very helpful, with him the pizza and pasta comes out because it comes out haha

The place is very nice and the activity is outdoors which makes it a great experience, the pizzas, the pastas and the wine were delicious and the Tiramisu de Dios!!

We definitely recommend this experience <3

We wanted to learn more about making pizza in a wood burning oven and pasta as well. We got that and so much more. Giuseppe and his assistant Mersad have a relaxed teaching method but their passion for cooking is evident in their knowledge and skill. They laughed with us and had a joking banter between them. It was a great experience and one we would highly recommend.

Fantastic day spent with Giuseppe and company! From the pick up and throughout the entire time we were laughing, singing and enjoying great company. Learned a lot about pizza and pasta, and the amazing tiramisu at the end. Grazie Giuseppe and Forza nap... Liverpool ;)

My friend Hannah and I went for a pizza and master class with Giuseppe and had a fantastic time! He’s a great teacher, with a brilliant sense of humour and is excellent fun. Learnt a lot and a memorable experience too. Thanks for a great time to him and his assistant! 😊

Definitely if you like cooking you should take it, you will learn the secrets of the real pizza and pasta

The service is very good. You will always be in communication with the host and the service is very good

You'll eat a lot so don't have breakfast, and in the end the dessert will be the best

It was a great time spent outside of Rome. Giuseppe was very knowledgeable and pretty entertaining as well. Spent as much time laughing as cooking and eating. Very informal, fun time, and the food was fantastic...I can’t believe we made it! Wonderful experience!

I would do this again and again and again!!!! Transportation was very simple - Giuseppe picks you up at the last stop of a train line. The area he brought us to for the class was beautiful, you have to see it for yourself. You will then make and eat your own pizza which was PHENOMENAL, Giuseppe’s ingredients were truly perfecto 👌🏻. Then you learn how to make dough for pizza and for pasta. Then you practice making different types of noodles which was so much fun. I never knew my terrible art skills could make a decent noodle. Lastly, everyone in the group makes noodles to be cooked and eaten together. This experience is a must. P.S. wine included. Ciao!
Giuseppe was the best! He and his assistant has a big sense of humour and helped us all with our pastas and pizzas. Will definitely share stories of our cooking class to friends and family!

We had a wonderful time at this cooking class. Great teaching from Giuseppe and his assistant. Everything was very professionally done and well-planned. Most importantly, they made it fun. It's in a beautiful setting too. Highly recommend.

Spending the afternoon with Giuseppe learning to make pizza and pasta was so much fun! He has so much experience and knowledge to share and uses his great sense of humour to convey it. Highly recommend this experience to anyone spending time in Rome. Thanks Giuseppe!

Had a great time! Learned lots. Very fun. We had a very small group which enchanced the experience. He picked up us at train terminal and took us to his home. Guiseppe was terrific, information, great sense of humor. We each made dough, I made pizza dough that would be used the next day. The others made pasta dough for use that day. We then cooked the pizza in his outdoor pizza oven - ate what we wanted and took home the rest. We then made pasta from the dough. Learned to make many different shapes. He cooked the pasta and we dined on pasta with two different sauces and wine. Delivered us back to train station (actually took us to a great Gelato place near station).Highly recommend this class. Lots of fun and very informative.

Chef Giuseppe Class was an awesome learning experience. The class was fun, and delicious. You can say Giuseppe is a chef and a comedian. I definitely learn a lot about pizza and the process of making hand made pasta! I now have a new appreciation for pasta after learning how to make it myself. I would definitely recommend this class to anyone who wants to learn to how to make pizza and pasta. This was a great experience for couple! Me and my girlfriend love it
Great food, great atmosphere and a phenomenal instructor. Giuseppe is a world class teach and chef and would recommend to everyone to take a class from him.

We were looking at a few separate pasta and pizza classes and eventually settled on going all in on this one, and we are so glad that we did.

The class takes place outdoors in beautiful italian weather and starts with learning the secrets of authentic pizza, which you then cook in a wood fired pizza oven. From there you move on to making different types of dough from scratch, pizza and two kinds of pasta dough, as well as learning many different ways to shape and craft pasta.

Guiseppe and his assistant were great fun, very involved and made everyone feel welcome. This course is a great hands on lesson in authentic italian cooking, and great fun even if you've never cooked before.

We made sure to ask Guiseppe for some recommendations for the rest of our stay and were not disappointed. We left with a list of dozens of places to visit and things to taste which have so far been some of the best food I have had in my life.

Come hungry, as you'll be eating pizza, pasta and tiramisu (Although Guiseppe was kind enough to provide pizza boxes to take home any left overs). Once the lesson is over, Giuseppe drops you at the local metro station, but gave us one last tip about a local gelateria which we could not pass on.

If you're on the fence about a cooking lesson while in Rome, you will not regret booking this one.

This class was great. The first thing we did is was made our own pizza, which was a nice way to start. Then we learned how to make the dough for the pizza and pasta. We learned how to make a lot of different kinds of pasta. Then we got to eat the pasta we made. A lot of fun plus we learned something. Also you get instructions sent to you later so you don't have to worry about remembering all the details. Giuseppe has a great personality and is an excellent host, as was his assistant. Plus the setting is perfect. It's by the Appian Way and feels very secluded and peaceful despite being so close to the center of Rome.
Unique and wonderful experience. An incredible chef, both for his professionalism and for his friendliness, thank you for sharing your talent. See you soon

Oh my God!!!! This class was everything I wanted to do at a Cooking class in Italy. Right from being picked up from the Metro, to the drive by the countryside and finally arriving at the beautiful location. The host is a funny and brilliant teacher. His humour, his style of teaching and feeding just makes it a brilliant experience.
A special mention of his assistant who helped us get many of our pasta shapes right, so thank you for that.
This is a must do for anyone who wants to do something more than the the regular touristy things in Rome.
FYI - the metro from Roma Termini is a direct train to his location. So it is absolutely no problem finding his place.
P.S. Please do leave space for the Tiramisu. It was divine!!
Such a good experience. We made pizza and two types of pasta. It was so fun and Giuseppe was lovely. Highly recommend it!

Giuseppe is an absolute legend and makes the day what it is! The food is great, you meet great people and well worth the money.

If you’re looking for a good experience with a great chef then 100% book this!

This cooking class was so fun! Giuseppe was very funny and he is a good teacher! We appreciate a lot the time we spent there. It was like a family cooking together. The location is wonderful! The class takes place outside, on Giuseppe's land. You can even take ingredients from his garden! Good wine, good food and nice people! What's more to ask? I recommend this class to everyone who wants to learn how to make pastas and pizzas and have fun!

Giuseppes class was was amazing! My husband and I took the class and Giuseppe was very communicative and easy to reach. He met ya at the train station and took us and others to his class- just wow! It was outdoors and so beautiful. The class was so much fun and very interactive. The food was phenomenal! You can actually eat the pasta and pizza you make as well as get the recipe so you can follow yourself at home. One of our favorite parts of our trip. Don’t hesitate, just book- you won’t regret it!! Thank you Giuseppe for a wonderful time. :)

You will absolutely miss out if you do not take part in this experience! Giuseppe is warm and hilarious and makes learning the techniques fun and easy. His property is gorgeous, the ingredients he uses are top, and I would say it's one of the highlights of my recent trip! Buon appetito! ;o)

This was an excellent day!
Giuseppe is perfect for this role.
The location is such a treat after the hustle of Roma.
If you are looking for a pasta and pizza cooking class you gotta go here.

Amazing! Giuseppe created a fantastic experience for our class. We met people from all around the world and learnt so much from Giuseppe. It was easy to get to the class and he even dropped us off at the Appian Way on the way home. I would highly recommend this class as the best you can do.

Giuseppe is very serious about his food but he brings laughter to his cooking class. His class takes place out in the country side just outside of Rome. The location is truly beautiful and the experience is one you will never forget. We learned so much about authentic Italian cooking and had a truly engaging and memorable experience. This is totally worth the time and I recommend hitting up the Colosseum and the Roman Forum on the way home as they are only a few train stops away and you will have plenty of time to see both attractions after class!
Authentic Italian experience!! A fabulous way to spend a day in Rome, food was delicious, instructions were great and Giuseppe was very entertaining! I highly recommend to anyone coming to Rome!
Best day in Rome! Giuseppe and his assistant were both so nice and funny, hands on experience, and learned a lot. Would definitely do it again!
We learned the basics of pizza and pasta. The class was interesting. Giuseppe is very fun and welcoming!

The cooking experience with Giuseppe was excellent. We were taught and laughed in a relaxed country setting outside in southern Rome. It was all hands on as he demonstrated and as we each made our own pizza dough and pizzas from fresh ingredients and cooked them right there (no more mushy, smothered American pizza for us). Who knew it only takes 3 minutes to cook a correctly made pizza.
We then learned to make two kinds of pasta dough and 6-7 different shapes. Tortellini, capellini, penne, rigatoni, linguine, shells with and without ridges!!
All with fun discussions and a lot of singing by Giuseppe. (He loves the hokey pokey, at least the tune)
We then made masses of shells and linguine and he supplied the pesto Alfredo with caccio and sale and we ate well.
He loves what he does. And does it well. We learned to relax and and enjoy the experience of cooking.
We would take the class again to refine how we made everything but it is so enjoyable to talk and interact with people especially Giuseppe. We had 9 in our group from all over the world. Food brings people together.
Very good experience with Giuseppe and his assistant also excellent. We learned a lot and ate well in a nice environment. Thank you!!
This course was amazing! Lovely people to chat with, in a park with a wonderful host. This experience shouldn't be missed out when going to rome!
We had the most wonderful time with Giuseppe. We learned so much and he is hilarious and made the time so much more memorable. Highly recommend if you have half a day to spend in Rome!!!!
The cooking class is amazing!!!! Giuseppe is funny and professional! You’ll spend a great day, learn a lot and eat even more! Great experience!

Giuseppe is an excellent, knowledgeable teacher who gave us such an enjoyable cooking experience. We had a wonderful time! He clearly loves what he does and makes the class entertaining, interactive and delicious (of course). Although a bit out of the city center, the location is a refreshing break from the busy tourists sites and Giuseppe offers a pick-up location that’s easily accessible. I would certainly recommend for anyone interested in a unique half day culinary experience.

Guiseppe's cooking class was great! We made pizza, learned how to make multiple types of dough (pizza and pasta) and many pasta shapes. All of the food and wine was delicious and Guiseppe was very entertaining!
I would highly recommend this experience if you are looking for a cooking class in Rome! The only thing that would have made it better would have been if we received the recipes to the pasta dough and pesto sauce! It was great to learn and eat, but I would like to try to recreate it back home to impress some dinner guests. :)

Rustic experience out of the main city. Fun outside group activity, but the day we went was hot with lots of mosquitos and flies, so be prepared. You make the pasta and pizza dough, but no toppings and no dessert.
We had a great time learning how to make pizza and pasta. A little far away from the city center to get to, but a really cool setting. Giuseppe has a great personality and makes it a fun class.
This is a must! We had such a lovely day, the hosts are amazing and the food was top notch. The class is suitable for couples and friends, its a fun filled day! Highly recommend.

Easily one of the best things we did in Rome. Loved everything about Giuseppe’s special place, the pasta, the pizza, the wine... he also gave us an amazing gelato recommendation when he dropped us off. Loved everything about this and highly highly recommend!!!
Fun hands-on experience. Make your own pizza, prepare dough and learn to shape pastas. Everything was easy to follow. Pretty enjoyable class lead by knowledgeable chef.

Overall enjoyed this cooking class as there was a lot of actual teaching and hands-on experience within a sizeable class of 13 people. Chef Guiseppe really takes the time to teach and show you the techniques to ensure you're getting the full authentic experience on his private land. My favorite part was the pizza making, especially when you can pick your own basil and put your pizza in the oven to cook. Learning how to make different kinds of pasta was also very enjoyable.
Very fun and enjoyable cooking class. We learned how to make pizza, and various types of pasta. I will definitely use the techniques and recipes I learned in this class!

This was an entertaining and informative class, and both my daughter and I especially enjoyed the pizza making portion. Giuseppe is very knowledgeable and provided a lot of great info on the importance of ingredients that go into pasta and pizza making. The only downside was just not being properly warned that the class would be entirely outdoors in a woodsy area, and that bugs could potentially be a problem. Between my daughter and I, we had about 40 mosquito bites that left us completely miserable during and after the class. To be fair, Giuseppe did provide some repellant wipes but it wasn’t strong enough for us. So, for those who are very susceptible to bug bites, BE PREPARED WITH YOUR OWN REPELLANT in this environment.

We had a wonderful day eating delicious food and drinking much wine.

Our highlight was making and learning the art of Pizza.
Come hungry because you won’t want to stop eating.

Thanks for the day

A very charismatic Chef , with exceptional culinary knowledge .
We thoroughly enjoyed making pizza , pasta and enjoying a delicious tiramisu .

Would highly recommend !
Giuseppe is fun, makes great food, and he, like my 10th grade math teacher, won't let you leave until you've done everything the correct way. You're gonna like it.

This authentic experience was exactly what we wanted to have in Italy. Learning how to prepare Italian food, from a chef, on his land, surrounded by olive trees was a privilege. Going to the usual tourist attractions is exciting but this was the highlight of our trip. Giuseppe really cares about each student learning the techniques so he patiently coaches and uses humour to make the class even more fun.

My husband and I had one full day in Rome before heading to Amsterdam. We’ve both already seen the major attractions in the city center and wanted something different to do, something authentic and off the beaten path. This was a last minute decision and the best decision we’ve made! Although you’re still in Rome it doesn’t feel anything like Rome.

Giuseppe brought us to his Italian bohemian kitchen and we felt like family! I learned so much about what goes into making a successful pizza (it’s all about the dough) and making pasta dough 2 ways one using egg and one with water. He’s hysterically funny! We laughed with the others in the group the entire time.

If you’ve taken cooking classes before, its nothing like the experience you’ll be immersed in with Giuseppe. You’ll use all of your senses. You’re hands on from the start. It’s organized and the learning/lecture to hands on ratio is perfect. Trust me, you’ll never get bored. Do come hungry! You will get to make you’re own individual pizza, shape pasta from scratch that you’ll then cook and eat in two well known Italian sauces & finish the day with Giuseppe’s tiramisu. I don’t like tiramisu in the states but this was something special!

I’m so grateful for this experience and if I could stay there all day I would have!

- Amanda Kelly

Exceptional!
This is a must when you are in Rome!
Put the tourist sites aside, and spend some time learning from Giuseppe at his wonderful outside kitchen studio. Small classes (6 people +/-) give you the ability to ask the “stupid” questions that we all are all afraid to ask, and get shown and taught the answers . All hands on deck in this course, as you get to create a pizza for lunch, and are shown tons of different pastas and make one dinner. His humor and personality make this course that much better. Giuseppe is a wonderful teacher and even better chef. Truly a wonderful experience and very affordable given the amount of food, water/wine and length of the course. Perfect to do in the morning, and you have the rest of your day to explore and experience Roma. As a tourist from USA, his English is perfect, so know you’ll understand everything he’s teaching. He is also fluent in other languages. This course is also vegetarian friendly which was great for my wife. His information throughout the course are tidbits that will stick a lifetime, and we took his advice and went to Eataly (massive fine grocery store). If you have never been, GO! Thank you Giuseppe for this, my wife and I spent the rest of day exploring, trying and buying local and regional groceries for our trip home. Fit this course into your schedule you will not regret it.

We had lots of fun in this hands on cooking lessons. Chef Giuseppe giving us some demo & sharing us a lot of tips in doing pizza & pasta in the italian way. Though chef is very hilarious & fun throughout the lessons, he will still be as serious as your teacher in your school days, as he wants us to really get the knowledge & do it right way. Thanks Chef!

Cooking in al fresco in the middle of the farm is such an amazing experience for us. Ingredients has been fully prepared & every one of us had to do our own pizza & different type of pasta. We cook & taste our cooking, it so so good with free flow of wine.

I will definitely recommend you guys to join this fun cooking lessons when you are in Rome.

Thanks Chef Giuseppe!

Giuseppe was so friendly and the whole class was so much fun! He picked us up from the metro and drove us to his home where we cooked outside in the garden. First was pizza which was delicious then we made lots of different pasta shapes before enjoying the final pasta meal finished off with the best tiramisu I have ever had. He was so thorough and made sure we knew the difference between different kinds of pizza bases and pasta mixes so that we could take those lessons home with us, and he shared a thorough document with us after that had all of the recipes and more in so that we wouldn’t forget. My first Airbnb experience and it was 5*. Thank you Giuseppe!

Giuseppe was amazing. I would take this class again if I had the chance, it was that good! The food was delicious and I walked away learning so much. If you’re interested in taking a cooking class while in Rome, this is hands-down the best choice.

We had a great time learning how to make pizza and pasta with Giuseppe. The food was delicious, and he was very enthusiastic and friendly to everyone. It was one of the highlights of our trip. If you're looking to learn how to cook authentic Italian food, this is a class that you don't want to miss!

This experience was fun and easy to follow. We were able to make our own pizza and made a bunch of pasta shapes. We ate our pizza and finished off the class with some great tasting pasta and tiramisu!!!! I would recommend this class to anyone who wants to make some traditional pasta and pizza. I look forward to the recipes to try and do at home. Thanks for your hospitality Giuseppe! Ciao!

What a great experience.... Giuseppe is very kind and warm hearted when you first meet him . His property is beautiful... you can smell the freshness of the ingredients and see he takes what hes doing very seriously and with so much love and passion. He also is a great teacher .. he explain things very well and takes the time to demonstrate again if you're having trouble . Now for the best part, the food is AMAZING !! The Tiramisu is some of the best I ever had!! You definitely will want to be greedy so please do not do this class on a full stomach. The endless wine and water is a huge plus ... overall this class is worth every cent or euro lol ... would definitely do this class again . .. Definitely an honor and pleasure to meet Giuseppe .. thank again for everything!!

I had a great time taking Giuseppe's class! We got to make our own pizza as well as practice several types of pasta. It was a fun relaxing experience on a beautiful expansive piece of land. It also helped that we were attending with some other fun guests. Would definitely recommend this experience if you stop in Rome.

The experience was just incredible.
Giuseppe is very knowledgeable, and he gave us a lot of tips and tricks to make the best pasta and pizza on our own.
Moreover, the experience was really well organized, and Giuseppe made it super fun and unforgettable.
We recommend it from the bottom of our hearts.
Excellent experience, I think when you are in Rome you should live this experience, which is also learned and eat a lot.

It was super fun. We had a great time. Giuseppe is a very good teacher and charismatic guy. We learned how to make delicious pizza and many types of pasta. We ate homemade pizza, two types of pasta, and tiramisu. Everything was absolutely scrumptious. The location of the class was in the beautiful countryside. We got to know people from various countries and enjoyed a wonderful time. We absolutely recommend this experience.

Giuseppe's class was great. He's very knowledgable, and we learned a ton. The class was fun, and we had great food, but still spent plenty of time learning, discussing, and improving how to improve our cooking. This class was a great value and a highlight or our trip. Also, getting to his place by metro was easy, and it was interesting to get out of city center. We walked from his place down the old Appian Way back to a bus afterwords, which was also a really cool but uncrowded experience.
Great cooking class with lots of explanation and detail. All the basics for pizza and pasta doughs. The setting is nice as it feels remote but is still easily accessible.
Nice experience to learn a bit about pizza making, the Neapolitan style, and some techniques for pasta variants. We had a good time!

Giuseppe made this experience quite unique and shared a wonderfully warm sense of welcome and humor. An added bonus was the hospitality and great group present for the evening. Great communication, easy to get to the beautiful home. You get to really divulge and learn quite a few tricks that Giuseppe has mastered. As simple as pizza sounds with ingredients, you really get to break it down and learn what to do and not, to give you a foundation to continue and grow. Same with the unique styles of pasta, methods of construction and ultimately cooking/eating. The night also had some wonderful twists and surprises, which really set it off. Afterwards, we all relaxed... listened to some incredible music and mellowed out. If you want a cool experience with a down to earth and hysterical dude, Giuseppe is the man

This was a wonderful experience - out in the country, beautiful weather, and our particular group was unforgettably exceptional. Giuseppe is a kind and big hearted person, he is funny and quite a chef performer, and we really enjoyed spending time at his beautiful property and the van ride with new friends. As described, this is an opportunity to get away from the big city and big crowds - and Giuseppe and team provide very personalized attention. Bravo!

The experience was amazing! With help from Chef Giuseppe and his assistant I surprised everyone in our group and my now Fiancé with a marriage proposal. We had so much fun making the pizza and pasta and his homemade tiramisu was wonderful! Fate played a role when I left my cell phone in the van and he gladly brought me back to get it and back to the train station. The personal touches he puts into everything is why everyone should have this experience!

This experience is an absolute gem of Rome! Giuseppe is hilarious, warm and passionate. The whole experience was entertaining and enjoyable from start to finish. We had a really lovely group for our cooking session, which helped expand on the positive atmosphere created for us by our hosts. The skills and recipes shared were amazing - Giuseppe’s pizza was the best we’d had on our trip to Italy and the pasta was by far the best I remember eating! Magical evening with some fantastic memories, made and shared. If you want a relaxed and fun evening learning some fantastic cooking skills, this is the experience to do! Thanks again 😊

Giuseppe was a great host! He was super nice, welcoming, and you can easily tell he's passionate about cooking...literally, best pizza I had in all of Italy (not mine, his haha)! Obviously, he is very informative and knowledgable about his profession and he was a natural when it came to teaching the subject. The class was well-structured and it flowed great. Always had time for questions, sampling, wine and water breaks, and we never felt rushed. Definitely recommended for anyone looking to have a unique experience while in Rome! Just FYI though: it is outside (going to want to wear pants and shoes). Moreover, he's a local so if you go at the beginning of your trip, he has several recommendations on places to eat throughout Rome.
Giuseppe was very welcoming and an amazing chef. He goes over everything in depth prior to asking you to do anything. The pizza, pasta, and tiramisu were all excellent!

Belle is an expert. Be sure to do yourself a favor and take this class. Cucinavo per un tempo, ma ho imparato molto da lui!

Giuseppe is super knowledgeable! I'd recommend that you do yourself a flavor/favor and take this really helpful course. I've cooked Italian food for a while, but I learned a lot from him! My pizza dough has already come so far!

Such a fun evening and a great opportunity to take something different home from Rome-some cooking skills! Guiseppe was a great host and teacher and we enjoyed learning from him. Has realty motivated us to put in our own pizza oven and have a go at making homemade pasta. Thank you!

This was a great experience! My husband and I really enjoyed learning and cooking. We had a lot of fun during the class and interacting with the other guests. The pizza, pasta and tiramisu were all delicious!!
We started by making pizza from dough already risen. Then we learned how to make the pizza dough as well as the pasta dough. We then made 10 different shapes of pasta. We made linguini then cooked 2 different types of pasta and tried 2 different sauces. We concluded with having some tiramisu!
There was definitely no shortage of great food and wine!
We would highly recommend this experience!

Giuseppe was great. Extremely knowledgeable and thorough with the different methods of making pasta and pizza dough. The process of making our own pizza was AMAZING and the taste was spectacular. Our group had a great time which we will cherish forever. Thank you Giuseppe.

A highlight to our vacation! Giuseppe’s cooking class is a must. We had so much fun and learned a lot. We’ve been home only a few days and have already made pasta and pizza. His document he sends you afterwards is great.

And his land is spectacular! We went in the evening and it was picture perfect.

Thanks Giuseppe!

For sure we got what we came for. We learned how to make fresh pasta and pizza from scratch and liked the uniqueness of the experience in the outskirts of Rome in a very natural area. Giuseppe knows his profession and is very good at teaching it. Very hands on. I look forward to sharing the pizza and pasta dishes with our friends and family at home. Heat, humidity and mosquitos did affect the mood and could have made the experience a little less enjoyable as it would be on other occasions.

It was my brother, boyfriend, and I and it was a wonderful experience. It was rescheduled for a later time since it was so hot, and it worked out great! We cooked pizza and pasta, and at the end of the meal he served tiramisu! It does go a bit over the time frame mentioned, so don’t have anything else planned. Either way it was a great experience. He shows you step by step on how to make things, and he is very experienced and you can tell he knows what he’s doing.

The cons, we wished he shared a little history in the beginning. About himself, about the class, etc. Just an introduction. And he was in a little bit of a mood, which wasn’t awful since it’s hot and at the end of the day. Some things just came off as passive aggressive.

It was still a wonderful time and look forward to using the things and methods we learned. He sent us information for us to access the things we learned.
We had a great evening at Giuseppe’s pizza e pasta school, learnt a lot about pizza and pasta making, exercised it and afterwards enjoyed the eating. Really fun to do while in Rome!

We loved learning how to make a pizza and pasta. We definitely want to continue when we get back home and entertain guests with our new skills. We also liked getting out side of Rome and cook in the fresh air.

We also noticed that the host seemed tired of giving the class or providing for this experience. There’s nothing like learning from somebody that is passionate, and passion was not there.

The experience started with a cold welcome as we got in the car and it was radio silence in the van until we reach the premises. We are not sure how We can explain all of the positive reviews for this experience. Comments or jokes were made that were just a bit off and not friendly. At the end of the night, while we were eating our pasta, the host was waiting with his keys in his hands leaning on the side of the door. We started asking questions about him and the property but quickly felt that he wanted to leave and end the class. As we were only ten, we also thought it was odd and not authentic to be eating our food in cheap plastic plates and utensils...

Overall we are pleased that we have learn how to make pasta, but we have to be honest, this was not a five stars experience

A nice and fun experience. We were in Rome for a week and it was nice to get a little bit outside of the city for a while with a fun activity planned! My favorite part was Giuseppe teaching us the various pasta shapes - all of the couples in the class with us had a lot of fun with it!

Belle is very friendly. It was a very pleasant experience. I learned different ways of making pasta and the best thing was to make pizza in the wood-fired oven. Spectacular Tiramisu. The best I've had so far.

We had a fun time on this course, Giuseppe is very knowledgeable and we learnt some great tricks and the techniques required to make delicious pizza and pasta. It was a very relaxed setting in the outdoor garden style area and generally just a tasty and interesting day for a food lover. Grazie Mille Giuseppe!

Giuseppe was WONDERFUL and so knowledgeable about his craft! We had such a great experience. He gave clear explanations on meeting locations, expectations, and outline of the course. We began with a drive through the outskirts of Rome up to a private location on a beautiful piece of land. Giuseppe teaches by example and always shows you the correct technique before asking you to begin. His teaching style utilizes humor and clear direction making it easily attainable for all. We were taught to make pizza dough, pizza, pasta dough, and several different shapes of pasta. We made our own pasta for dinner and it was amazing! There is something special about creating a dish from scratch. We were also provided with wine, water, tiramisu and a misting fan (which was an extra special touch on such a hot Roman day). Overall, the food was wonderful, the lessons were insightful and well taught, and the experience was second to none! I HIGHLY recommend taking this course if you find yourself in Rome. You will not regret it!

Amazing, one of a kind experience in an outdoor setting on the country side away from the city. The Chef was knowledgable and entertaining. This experience was a pleasant break from all the sightseeing and city noise.

Interesting class in a cool, rustic farm setting. Great food and wine. Also, plenty of water was provided, which was appreciated. Giuseppe is an engaging host and told good stories. He offered suggestions for restaurants and things to see around Rome as well. Be sure not to be late for the pick up time, however. My girlfriend and I were 10 minutes late, but Giuseppe did not wait and made us take a cab to meet him at the venue.

We had a wonderful time at this pizza and pasta making class with Guiseppe. He has a beautiful setup on his property and had all the amenities we needed while there. Guiseppe was kind and funny and made the experience very enjoyable. We loved the food that we all made together and look forward to making pasta again at home. We also loved that Guiseppe's land is next to the Appian way. He dropped us at the Appian way after his class and we enjoyed a 40 minute walk down to the bus stop that took us back into the city. We highly recommend his class when you visit Rome!

Giuseppe was very friendly and informative form the moment he collected us and dropped us off. Food was amazing and plenty of it and location was beautiful. Highly recommend for other visitors to Rome.
A nice retreat into nature for a cooking class that covered how to make some of the amazing food you see all over Rome. A very unique and enjoyable experience for all travelers!

This class was awesome! It was Out in the beautiful country side where we were able to relax under his terrace. Giuseppe was very fun and charismatic! He made the process and learning very enjoyable. We learned a lot about pizza and the many kinds of pasta! And then were able to enjoy the fruits of our labor :) I would highly suggest this to anyone !

LOVED the pizza and pasta making class with Giuseppe; he was not kidding when he said it'll be the highlight of your trip, it was really was! His place is amazing; a nice break from the bustling city and it's clear that Giuseppe put of a lot of thought and heart into the place with little touches. We had a wonderful time making pizza and pasta and can't wait to try his recipes at home; you can't beat picking fresh basil from the garden to put on your pizza. He has a great sense of humor and kept the class fun and interesting. Would highly recommend to anyone!
It was a fun event. Pasta is more diverse than pizza. The charcoal grilled pizza is delicious. Pasta making is also interesting. Well worth a visit.

Giuseppe is fantastic. Had such a great time. He makes you feel as if you’ve known him for some time and really makes you feel at home within the class. Great drink, food, and dessert, as well as some great simple recipes! Definitely a memorable experience.
Wonderful tips on making pasta and pizza. Very nice venue and Giuseppe is a very good chef. I and my little daughter enjoy the class very much.

Hmm where do I start, this experience was really great for me!

Giuseppe is amazing, friendly, funny, and overall really nice guy!

His class was a wonderful experience and I recommend anyone to take it!

The best way to know what I meant is to book a class with him.

Thank you again Giuseppe! To new friends and experiences!

Unique experience! Fun, delicious and very informative about Italian cuisine; it's an exceptional type! Don't hesitate to take the class, just a tip: Try to have a light breakfast before class, you'll eat like a king. //Unique experience! Fun, delicious and very informative about Italian cuisine; Giuseppe an exceptional guy! Don’t hesitate to take the class, I only give you one piece of advice: try to have a light breakfast before class, you will eat like a king.

Giuseppe made this experience unforgettable!
With his hilarious humor, a really tasty pasta and an amazing pizza and tiramisu.
Do yourself a favor and don’t miss this class!

Giuseppe is a great host, who could make any experience worth your while. Of course the experience itself is also great. Making pizza and pasta in a great scenery away from the hassle of the city. Despite having eaten more than enough with the pizza, pasta and tiramisu, I went for a delicious ice cream by Giuseppe's recommendation at Gelateria Torce.

Giuseppe's cooking class was a nice getaway from the bustling streets of Rome and a fun learning experience. He is somewhat of a comedian yet clearly passionate about cooking and sharing that. My father who has trouble walking and with hand movements also joined us on this excursion and Giuseppe did all he could to make sure he had as great experience as anyone else. We thoroughly enjoyed this experience and will definitely recommend to everyone we know. Thanks Giuseppe!

Fantastic day! One of our top highlights of visiting Rome. Giuseppe’s vivacious personality is contagious and will have you smiling and enjoying yourself from the minute you get there. The pizza & pasta making was really fun and so relaxing in the outdoor environment. Food was delicious and the small group setting very lovely! Would definitely recommend!

The afternoon with Giuseppe was fantastic! It was truly the highlight of our trip so far. He offered an authentic Italian cooking class with a great sense of humour. He really made us feel at home in his beautiful countryside surroundings and went above and beyond to make all the guests feel welcome. Thank you SO much for this experience, we can't wait to create the delicious pasta and pizza dishes back home in Australia!
Giuseppe is a very great guy! The cooking experience was very hands on and Giuseppe took the time to teach us without rushing. The evening was very relaxed and enjoyable.
Truly enjoyed the experience — very hands on, with some good tips to make better pizza and pasta. It is worth it and quite fun.
Informative and fun! We had a great time. Giuseppe is good teacher and made the day very enjoyable. Certainly recommend this to our friends.

Making pasta and pizza with Giuseppe was one of the highlights of our trip. His knowledge of food and great sense of humor made for a memorable experience. If you want to spend a day in the Italian country side making and eating delicious food with great company, then look no further than booking with Giuseppe. Grazie Giuseppe!
Spent an excellent day with Guseppe. He's a great chef with an even greater sense of humor. I would call this a 'cooking experience', rather than anything else.

We had a great time and enjoyed some wonderful hours with a very nice and professional host. We made good food which we enjoyed with wine. We also had a very good Tiramisu at the end. We thought we was going to make the cake ourselves, but anyway....
We was waiting for two people in the van in the beginning, but they didn’t show up. Luckily Guiseppe was strict with the time so we didn’t have to wait too long. Hopefully the late people learned a lesson and will be at time from now :)
We highly recommend this wonderful experience.

We had a fantastic experience today! The pizza and pasta were not only tons of fun to make but also delicious! The setting is unique. It gets pretty hot in the summer but was shaded with a misty fan blowing so that helped. We met people from all over. The tiramisu at the end was superb.

Excellent cooking session with a passionate Italian chef! Extremely entertaining and food was fantastically satisfying, nice red wine also. Hosted at Giuseppe's beautiful allotment of land at an outdoor setting, it was a nice natural escape from the hustle and bustle of Roma city centre. Excellent group vibe with great social aspect. Highly recommended!
Great experience with Giuseppe on his beautiful property. Learned the technique to make many different types of pasta in a very entertaining manner.

If you are looking for a relaxing experience and to get away from the city without having to travel very far and to learn the basics of Neapolitan pizza and pasta making then BOOK THIS NOW! The class is in an incredibly beautiful area and Giuseppe is an excellent teacher and I'm looking forward to getting the recipes and tutorials to try it all myself at home and, since I work in a restaurant with a pizza oven, in work too! Thank you Giuseppe for a lovely afternoon and sharing your culinary knowledge!

Giuseppe was wonderful! We had so much fun. This was one of the highlights of our visit to Rome. The cooking class was a nice change of pace compared to the busy city. The food we made was delicious! I can’t wait to try some of what we learned at home. Thank you so much, Giuseppe!!

This experience was one of my favorite parts of my trip to Rome. Guiseppe is a delight. Even parts hilarious and informational, you’ll be engaged for the entire experience. I would recommend this to everyone.
A fun filled experience. Giuseppe was a great chef and teacher and loves a good joke. When he says come hungry, he means it!

Outstanding!

I took my family of 10 to learn how to make pasta from Giuseppe. Giuseppe was well prepared and was a pleasure to learn from. His witty personality mixed with light humor made the experience that much more enjoyable.

We started by making traditional Napoli pizza. We learned about the difference between Roman and Napoli pizza types. We had a great time making the pizza and cooking it in his 1200 degree pizza oven.

After pizza, we made pasta. Giuseppe has a knack for teaching and was able to provide excellent instruction. We learned how to make a variety of pastas and how to use the hand pasta making tools. Giuseppe cooked the pasta and we dined.

We then had dessert of Tiramisu and were full.

A good time was had by all and I would recommend the event to anyone wanting to have a good time in Roma.

Prego Giuseppe!

Giuseppe's pizza and pasta class was a highlight of my trip to Italy. His rustic farm just a short distance from the Metro station was an idyllic setting for learning traditional techniques of pasta and pizza making, capped off with delicious tiramisu. The demonstrations for each hands-on opportunity were excellent. The size of the group was perfect - not too large, we had a very congenial group. Be sure to go VERY hungry!

It was really nice!!! Giuseppe picked us up promptly at the agreed upon location. The location of the class is very nice and the class was 1000! At first he showed off the way pizza and pasta cooked and then it was our turn.. and we made a lot of mistakes which ended up being fun, and Giuseppe was always looking forward to orienting us. And the best part is the PDF he then sends with all the recipes!! Come hungry, it really is a lot of food!!!

We had a very pleasant experience from start to finish with host Giuseppe. We have learned how to make various mass formats, with different pasta recipes (with eggs and with water). There was also a class on how to make pizza (pasta, stuffing, handling, etc.). The main thing is Giuseppe's warmth and good spirits that turn the class into a fun program with friends.

Class was held in a very peacful nice farm ambiance, Arrived on an empty stomach and left with bunch of learnings and a bulging belly. Giuseppe was precise and straightforward with the topics and learned alot for a short span.

Guiseppe's property is only about 15 minutes outside of the city, but feels like the country. It was a great place to spend 1/2 of a day learning how to make pizza and pasta and eating a ton of delicious things!

The Pizza and Pasta making class were awesome. Giuseppe shows us how to make a traditional Naples style pie which was awesome. He then had us making pasta dough and how to make the different shapes of pasta. We ate 2 different kinds of pasta in addition to pizza. Highly recommend!

Giuseppe's experience was fantastic! I went to the evening class and we worked outdoors, ate outdoors, and got eaten outdoors (by mosquitoes) so just be prepared to bring some bug spray depending on the season. He took us to his compound on an ancient Roman cemetery and at first you think that you could be become an unmarked feature there but don't worry! While there, he feeds you well and you get to learn how to make pizza and different types of pasta and then you eat some more. Definitely come hungry. Thank you Giuseppe for your good company and humour. It was a very fun! 😀
It was a nice and funny experience. It was the best pizza I tried during my time in Italy, excellent tiramisu. Really enjoyed the time.

Giuseppe was an incredible host! He had us laughing the whole time. It was great making all the different pasta shapes. Also, we got to use many different tools to create the pastas! The food was delicious. All of us made individual pizzas and then as a group made two different pastas. We were provided with plenty of water and wine as well! I highly recommend this experience. The whole thing from start to finish was extremely enjoyable :) thanks Giuseppe!!

Me, my husband, and my daughter truly enjoyed this experience. Be ready to eat and to learn a ton! The location was top notch as well. It’s out in the country and has a cabin like set up...we loved it! A wonderful thing to see just outside of Rome. Just bring some bug spray. Giuseppe has some but a good idea to bring if you have your own. My daughter said this was a highlight of our 2 week trip in Italy and now my husband wants to buy a pizza oven. We are looking forward to trying to make our own pizza and pasta when we returned home. Thank you Giuseppe!

Giuseppe is a fantastic teacher and even great with children. He carefully showed step-by-step many different types of pasta and the famous Napoletano pizza.

He took the time to explain the science behind the cooking, which helps with why it's made a certain way. All the steps were easy to follow.

The course was a lot of fun and I would easily recommend it to everyone....even if you already think you know everything about pasta.

We met "G" outside of the train station. He took us to his home, which was outside in a beautiful garden area. He's spent a lot of time making it welcoming (very nice set up). Our family made fresh pizza and learned a little about Roman history. We moved on to fresh pasta and more dough. Making the shapes was fun and intense! We sipped wine, laughed, relaxed and chatted while making the pasta. Best part? We were able to eat all of our hard work (and even had a to go box for later). Highly recommended.

We absolutely loved our afternoon with Giuseppe and the other guests making pizza and pasta! Giuseppe brought us to his little slice of heaven just outside of Rome. We enjoyed making fresh pizza (YUM!!), learning about pasta dough, making the dough, and then making over 10 different shapes! We learned so much that afternoon and really enjoyed our day with the other guests. Highly recommend this experience as a nice slow down from the bustle of Rome to make and eat Italian cuisine!

What an amazing first Airbnb tour experience!!! I couldn’t have asked for a better cooking class, especially hosted by the hilarious Giuseppe. Had so much fun making pizza & pasta, all surrounded by such a beautiful property ... Italy at its finest! Would suggest to anyone who loves food & wants an authentic Italian experience.

5 stars Giuseppe!!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

This was the highlight of the trip!

Giuseppe lead an amazing experience. Came and picked us all up from the Metro station (which is super easy to get to from central Rome)

He taught us everything from Dough Making, Pizza creation and techniques, to Pasta dough and the art of making various types of shapes.

Giuseppe was amazing to be around and gave the group some great stories, laughs, techniques and some of the best Tiramisu we have ever eaten.

If you’re on visit to Rome, make sure you book this — you won’t regret it!

Giuseppe’s class was a great opportunity to learn how different types of pasta is made. While the class is located a bit far from center Rome, it is in a beautiful outdoor setting that is very peaceful.

We had a wonderful time and loved all the delicious food! Not only did we leave full of incredible pasta and pizza, we also learned so much! It was a fantastic addition to our trip to Rome. We would love to go again if we are back in Rome!
Wonderful experience with Giuseppe!!! He is so knowledgeable, the food was delicious, and the entire 4 hours was so much fun. Would highly, highly recommend.

The session was informational and could have been a lot of fun. The pizza portion was nice and relaxed and the pizza was delicious. Come pasta time, Giuseppe tried to teach us 7-8 pasta variations. We were all new to this. He became short and impatient and did not respond well to questions. The day went from fun to awkward suddenly and we were ready for it to end about half way through.
If you’re thinking maybe, just do it! Four hours blew by making and prepping different dishes. Definitely do it for the experience! La clase me encantó!

Loooooved it! Pizza and tiramisu were my favorite. And enjoyed the AMAZING music playing while cooking. Learned a lot about spaghetti while making it. And during breaks enjoyed playing games. Thanks so much Guiseppe! So glad we found your class on Airbnb. Can’t wait to try to make it all again at home.

Just. Wow. WOW! So informative and incredibly enjoyable. Giuseppe has the warmest friendliest personality and his music rocked! The pizza was absolutely amazing and it was so fun to make the pizza and pasta. I learned how to make all the different types of pasta I’ve eaten over the years. Giuseppe is very knowledgeable and makes the day better with his fun personality. 10 out of 10 would recommend for anyone who just wants to have a nice relaxing day learning how to make traditional Italian dishes (and eat some bomb food of course).

This was the highlight of our two days in Rome. If you are not so big on huge crowds and tourist attractions and want to expererience something authentic-this is ideal. Giuseppe is a master of pizza and pasta and took us through every step in making our own, while making it really fun and easy. We loved his wine. The pizza was delicious. Pasta was cooked to perfection. His tiramisu is also the best we had. The different pasta shapes is quite interesting but way too much effort to make at home though. Loved every minute! Would definitely recommend
Very informative and fun cooking class with Giuseppe! I especially learnt a lot about how to prepare your pizza dough 24 hours before cooking. Giuseppe is also very friendly and fun to work with!
This was an awesome experience!! I've learned more about pasta and it's always fun if you are making your own! Besides, Giu's music was a blast!! :)

This was my first airbnb experience and it did not disappointment. Giuseppe's location for the class was a wonderful break from the bustle of Rome - what a peaceful and lovely outdoor space designed by Giuseppe in the Appian Way.

What I loved most about Giuseppe was his passion for pasta and pizza. He has a straightforward and playful style to how teaches. I learned a lot about what it takes to make a classic Margherita pizza. I also enjoyed learning how to make the different pasta shapes.

The food was delicious and more than enough - so come hungry!

Giuseppe was also kind to drop me off by the Appian Way which was a great way to work off the food. I walked along the Appian and visited the catacombs - which I highly recommend since you are in the area.

Definitely one of my highlights for Rome.
Had a fun time learning to make pizza and a variety of pasta. Giuseppe was funny and knowledgeable. The location was very relaxing. Highly recommended.
We loved Giuseppe’s class. We got to learn how to make pizza dough, pasta dough and how to bake a pizza in a brick oven. The farm was a wonderful venue and Giuseppe was a really fun host.

Cooking with Giuseppe and the rest of the group was a blast. This was our first ever Airbnb experience and it was a great one! We learned some interesting new techniques and can’t wait to get home and make some more delicious pizza! The wine was also delicious!
Amazing cooking class! Highlight of our trip in Roma. Really waiting I can try pizza and pasta making in home. Giuseppe was awesome person and I higly recommend this class.

We loved our class with Giuseppe! We learned a lot about how to make classic pizzas and making pasta dough. We've already put our new skills to work after our return home and our pizzas are already turning out better than before! If you show up ready to learn you'll have a great time!

Guiseppe was very rude and condscending. The food was not good, and the food we made was the dough he would for his next class. He did not teach us how to cook the pasta that he made, and the pizza dough was pre-made before we got there. All we learned was how to make different pasta shapes. Not enjoyable and not worth the money.

Giuseppe was great! The experience was fantastic. Thoroughly enjoyed the setting. Outside the city and in a rustic location but still nice clean bathrooms. Beautiful landscape with roses and an herb garden. The course was very educational but extremely fun as well. We made pizza and pasta dough. Created our own personal pizzas and got to eat it all. Plenty of wine and water accompanied the food and Guiseppe was quite entertaining himself. Had looked at other cooking experiences and are happy we chose this one!

Giuseppe was absolutely incredible from the start! Our initial plans got canceled VERY last minute and Giuseppe was happy to accommodate us immediately, and we are so happy that he did! Easy pick up location and drive to his gorgeous lot. We had a blast learning about the ingredients to a perfect pizza and pasta combo and got to make everything ourselves! Amazing food, wine, and company. This tour definitely will not disappoint! I recommend it to everyone!

Giuseppe showed us how to flatten dough and add ingredients to make a pizza first. After eating our pizzas, we learned how to make the dough used for both pizza and pasta. Then we learned how to make different types of pasta noodles. And lastly we are the pasta we shaped with some tiramisu made by Giuseppe for dessert. It was an overall fun experience. But if you’re on a tight schedule, you should know that your class might last longer than you expected. My class was supposed to be from 4pm to 8pm, but I didn’t get out until 8:40pm.

We were picked promptly at the advised pick location, by Giuseppe in his van. From there we were taken to his beautiful open air kitchen in his orchard.
Giuseppe’s method of teaching is hands on with jovial anecdotes added for entertainment.
The pizza and pasta we made were well explained in the tuition and delicious to eat. I feel confident that I can reproduce the items made at home.
Thoroughly enjoyed the lesson and the would recommend to anyone who would like to know how to make pizza bases, pizza and pasta dough.

Great experience! We loved everything we learned. The food was amazing! It was nice to get out of the city for a while. The only negative was the bugs were very bad the day we went. Just make sure to bring some bug spray and it will be perfect!
This experience with Giuseppe was great. Lots of fun, amazing pizza and pasta, and his tiramisu was to die for! Highly recommend this experience!
Giuseppe was a class act! Funny, informative and sincere. The food and instruction were great. I’d recommend this for anybody traveling to Rome!

Giuseppe was a great host. We really enjoyed making pizza and pasta with him and learning the best techniques! He was very patient and we enjoyed conversing with him. His location is amazing and it is very relaxing. I would recommend to anyone wanting a fun and interesting few hours away from the brilliant chaos of central Rome!

Giuseppe was an incredible host and the perfect teacher! We had a session filled with teaching, laughing and eating. Giuseppe’s atmosphere, talent and humor made for an experience I won’t forget. I would love to learn more from him

We are so grateful for such an amazing opportunity! This class was so much fun, and we both can't to get home to make fresh pasta and pizza for our family. Giuseppe was so kind, patient and loves to share his knowledge of cooking! I couldn't have asked for a better cooking class. We talked about it all night how happy we were to have chosen this class! I'm not much of a dessert lover, however the tiramisu was so delicious that even though I was full from pizza and pasta I couldn't put it down. What a beautiful experience, thank you so very much Giuseppe!!!
I loved the class. Belle is friendly and patient. The place where the activity is carried out is a natural environment, all recommended.

An amazing experience which topped off our trip to Rome. Guiseppe is a fantastically talented chef and the experience he hosts is truly unique and something to remember. Myself and my partner attended the 4 hour Pizza, Pasta & Tiramisù on the final day of our holiday. It was a great way to end the trip. We have talked about the experience non-stop since we got back home to the UK. Highly recommend this as a must have for anyone visiting Rome wanting a truly authentic Italian. Guiseppe is a lovely man, extremely talented and tremendously passionate about cooking. We made 2 pasta dishes, a pizza each and then we got to eat his home made tiramisu for dessert. It was without a doubt, the best pasta, pizza AND tiramisu I have ever eaten/tasted in my life. We learnt so much from the 4 hour class as well, more than I thought we would learn. We have been putting our new skills to practice and already made several different pasta options since getting home. A big thank you to Guiseppe for giving us a magical experience that we will never forget.

Loved the Cooking class - food was great and loved getting to see the neighbourhood - after the class we walked the Appia Way and visited the catacombs there - what a great way to spend a day. Looking forward to the recipes so I can try these dishes at home too.

We had an amazing time with Giuseppe! He is super knowledgeable and a ton of fun. We learned a lot and ate amazing food in a beautiful place. After the class, we got to see one of Rome’s hidden ruins that only had locals. Overall a blast! Thanks Giuseppe! We already added ‘Cindy’ to our Amazon cart!

The initial date that was organised had been changed, which worked well. We were picked up and spent the afternoon learning about local pasta and pizza dishes. Giuesssi was a great host who showed us how to make good Italian food, highly recommend this if you are looking to get out of the hustle and bustle of the busy city centre.

We had a blast learning to make pasta and pizza with Giuseppe. He has a great sense of humor to make the whole thing enjoyable. Plus you get to enjoy the fruits of your labor for lunch, followed by tiramisu for dessert!

Both my husband and I look forward to making the different kinds and shapes of pasta when we return home, although we can only with it was in half as scenic a location as this class was.

It was a great class. It was fun to try to make our own pizzas in a woodoven (although most people don't have such facilities at their disposal) . He taught us the Italian way of cooking: "Simple is better". We then proceeded to make pasta and pizza dough and then we made pasta shapes from our own dough. We ate the pasta which we had made (and got to experience the difference between thickness of pasta firsthand). Finally Giuseppe offered us his homemade tiramisu which was wonderful. We sat in his large garden while we ate and he told us about the olive industry and pizza making. I thought he was quite funny. When he was teaching us he had this Gordon Ramsey vibe about him. It did not appeal to me but the others in the group seemed to enjoy it a lot and found it very funny. Remember to arrive at the train station 10 minutes before the scheduled time.

Wonderful class with an amazing teacher. I definitely learned a lot and ate a lot, Giuseppe is extremely knowledgeable about cooking and our group enjoyed every minute of this cooking class experience. Highly recommend if you are visiting Rome! So worth the money too!

It was amazing!!! We had a group of 4, and other two couple from Iceland and United States . Giuseppe picked us up from train station, it was an adventure from there on! His property is breath taking, the location is still in city just very green, we made pizza first then ate it, then we made pasta and then ate that with some delicious tiramisu , not to mention great sense of humor. It was nothing but good time. We all enjoyed every bit of it, we learned so much! And I would highly recommend this class!

Giuseppe was an exceptional host! He picked us up from the nearest Metro and drove us to his land, which was tucked away from all the craziness of the city. Unfortunately, I fell ill the day before and was unable to participate for a large portion of the class- but Giuseppe went out of his way to make sure I was comfortable and I appreciated that greatly. My husband loved the class- four hours of learning how to make Napoleon style pizza, handmade pasta-followed by tasting courses of each. It was a great way to break up all the sightseeing Rome has to offer and learn from a talented chef. Afterward, we were sent links to his blog, which included recipes and videos to use when cooking at home. Would definitely recommend!
A unique experience, very good option for food lovers. Ideal for getting up with children, they have an excellent time and eat really well. Very educational and fun. I recommend it.

Giuseppe met us promptly at the bus station and transported us to his private compound. Once inside the gate we learned we were close to yet another ancient roman city although it felt like we were in the country we were still in Rome. After chatting about it we were given aprons and proceeded to watch Giuseppe make a pizza. Next was our turn to make our own pizza, rolling out the dough, adding the sauce and choosing our toppings then off to the wood fired pizza oven. Sampling our own pizzas with a glass of wine came next then into the kitchen to make pizza and pasta dough. The dough we made was divided out and we learned to roll and make a dozen or more different kinds of pasta. Next Guiseppe whipped up a couple of amazing sauces to top our pastas and we ate our homemade treasures with some wine then had a great Tiramisu to end our meal. I would highly recommend this experience to anyone who has a culinary interest. It is an experience I will not soon forget and can't wait to put what I learnt into a meal at home for family and friends.

We had an excellent experience with Giuseppe! He was a great teacher who took the time to explain each part of the preparation and cooking process. You get to make pizza (from kneading the dough to actually picking it up and placing it within a hot stone oven) and pasta under the careful supervision of Giuseppe. For pasta - you learn to make multiple types of pasta - not just one type so that was awesome. Note that you do not make Tiramisu - it’s just something you get to have as dessert. Would highly recommend as a great way to learn how to make homemade pizza and pasta!
The highlight of my trip so far. Giuseppes property is stunning. The food we prepared was to die for. Giuseppe is knoledable and an excellent teacher with a great sense of humour. Highly recommended.

I just want to start this review, From Rome with Love... Chef Giuseppe know how to share the passion, the care about Italian cooking, that was amazing day from head to toe, start with the place that we had the gastronomic tour, was AMAZING, PEACEFUL AND MAGICAL. Chef Giuseppe transport everybody there on a magical world of Italian food, patience and of course he share the passion and knowledge about Italian cooking... if we have 10 stars or more I will give it more of that... Highly Recommend!
Belle is a great host. We made a great pizza outdoors and the group we shared with was so much fun.

This was the highlight of our trip to Rome! We thoroughly enjoyed the class; learning to make pizza, various types of pasta and then indulging with others and and our chief was terrific. Location was superior and so authentic. I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS EXPERIENCE!!!

I recently traveled to Rome with some friends. We were looking for an authentic cooking experience. Guiseppe did not disappoint! We had a wonderful experience making pizza, pasta and drinking wine outside on a lovely piece of property outside of Rome. Guiseppe is very passionate about cooking and had us laughing the whole time.
We traveled to Sicily, Malta and Tuscany and this was by far one of the funnest things we did!!

Giuseppe was a knowledgeable host. His teaching style was very hands-on and he made sure that everyone was having fun. That said, do not expect to master the art of making pizza, pasta and tiramisu. Rather, look it as an opportunity to be educated about the process.

Ok so the run down metro area and getting into a white van with people I didn’t know was a little sketch. Lol but when Giuseppe took us to his cooking location in the middle of a field surrounding by ancient archeological surroundings and bambo fences, fruit trees, beautiful wooden structures I was at ease. We began by eating incredible pizza we learned to make, then learned several ways to make pasta shapes and had a great lunch we prepared to finish it off by his amazing tiramisu. Thanks for the great day!

This was a fantastic experience which me and my wife booked as part of our honeymoon in Rome and we could not be more glad that we did. It was interesting, fun and the setting at Giuseppe's farm in the archeological park of the ancient Appian Way was stunningly beautiful. We learned how to make real, traditional Neapolitan pizza and our own pasta from scratch, with expert guidance from the world-class chef himself. Giuseppe was funny, friendly and a genuinely fantastic host who made everyone feel welcome and was very patient when our amateur efforts fell way short of his own elite skills! 😁 I would definitely recommend this to anyone staying in Rome and looking for something different to do, aside from the usual sightseeing etc. It gave us a new appreciation for the fantastic food we had been enjoying in Italy and Giuseppe himself was a truly excellent host. We would definitely consider a refresher course on our next trip to Rome.

Giuseppe was great and would recommend this experience to anyone. The day was a blast and the food is amazing. I plan to use what I learned and get better at making pasta. Be prepared to laugh a lot and leave wanting to use the new skills immediately. It’s a very cool location too.

What a great experience! Giuseppe was funny and hospitable. I definitely recommend this to anyone who enjoys cooking. Nice way to take a break from the busy city experience. He is not kidding when he says to come hungry!

Giuseppe’s class was fantastic and will leave you with skills to bring home and a full belly. He is a friendly and fascinating person who’s passion for cooking shows. My wife and had so much fun making pizza, pasta and chatting with Giuseppe. I highly recommend this class.
Giuseppe was great! He gave my parents an authentic Italian experience they claimed was their favorite part of the trip. I highly reccomend!

Firstly, Giuseppe is a talented chef and it was quite fun working on pizza and pasta in his garden and Giuseppe is an amiable guy. A couple of thoughts

1) While unclear, we did not make Tiramisu. While Giuseppe provided tiramisu at the end and it was delicious it would have been nice to learn how to make this - it is the reason why I chose this class over others

2. The pizza was a bit salty - it would have been nice to make this adjustment whilst preparing the food

3. We didn't get to see how the amazing pasta sauce was made - I think that would have been helpful.

These are 'small' matters - the food was nice as was the experience and I would have given Giuseppe probably 4.5 stars for this outing but that is not an option. I think with a few tweaks, this could be a phenomenal class.

I'm glad I spent my time with Giuseppe and the group of participants in this pizza and pasta making experience.

Giuseppe first demonstrated the preparation of a traditional neapolitan pizza and we had opportunities to subsequently make our own pizza (of different toppings). The taste of the pizza was one of the better ones I've tasted.

We then went on to prepare pasta doughs and got introduced to the many different pasta shapes/types. He also provided good details (in terms of food science) during the course of preparation, providing us with a better understanding of why things are as such (dough resting time etc.).

Giuseppe then prepared two pasta bases for our pasta meals, which tasted awesome. Lastly, we were given a plate of tiramisu as dessert, which was delicious.

Giuseppe also provides the recipe on his blogsite. However, I felt it would be better if it comes in hardcopy so that it is more accessible to participants who are less IT savvy.

Overall, I felt that the class was enjoyable and I did learnt quite a bit from Giuseppe. I had only one-and-a-half day in Rome and I decided to spend 4 hours attending this class and I did not regret it. Thanks Giuseppe!
Not only is the location of Giuseppe's class beautiful, it is also an extremely informative and delicious experience. I would recommend to anyone!

It's been a lovely session with Giuseppe.
All was well organized, we arrived in a very charming place, in the Rome countryside.
The weather was sunny and it helps to better learn how to make pizza and pasta !
Giuseppe is a very funny guy and the way he teaches you how to make pizza and pasta was very playful and not boring! Sometimes, the way the cooking lessons are done are very boring and at the end you didn't remember, here it wasn't the case !
All was very good because what you cook you eat it, obviously! We become keen on cacio e pepe sauce and my friend Jeremy, was please to have this birthday gift !!!
A funny and nice experience i would recommend !!!!

The cooking class was outside in a beautiful setting. We happened to have a perfect weather day so the entire class was held outside. The pizza making portion of the class was my favorite and the end result was delicious. For the pasta making portion of the class, first we all learned to make various shapes of pasta and then we made the real thing. The part of the class I would change is instead of us all making the real thing and having 17 different people making pasta of all varying thickness, I would just do the part of the class where we learn to make the pasta shapes. Then I would have liked the pasta to have been already prepared by the chef and cooked. By having so many different people making the pasta, it was all different thicknesses and didn't cook evenly. The sauces were just ok. Overall we had an amazing time.

A bit of taxi ride for us from Trestevere. We used “My Taxi” app easily while in Rome. He picked us up at the train station & we had a nice ride to his pizza garden area. Giuseppe demonstrated master knowledge of subject. He was patient with us fumble-fingered pasta makers. Delicious pizza, pasta (wonderful sauce by Giuseppe), wine, & Tiramisu. Lovely meeting other travelers. As a bonus - we asked to be dropped off on Apia’s Way when he said it was close by. A long walk back to Rome but amazing sites. Especially Catacombs of St. Sebastian tour. Would do it all again - & take notes!

This was a excellent experience for me and my family. The chief was very outgoing and extremely patient when teaching us how to prepare all the meals...that we actually ate. I wood recommend this to anyone traveling to Rome. Thank you so much for the entire experience.

Giuseppe was an amazing host and teacher for this experience. He met us promptly at the train station and brought us to his beautiful property to teach us all the ins and outs of making (and eating!) traditional pizza and pasta. Come hungry as there is a ton of food to eat! I would absolutely recommend this experience to anyone looking to learn more about traditional Italian cooking and Giuseppe is the perfect teacher.

My husband and I LOVED learning from Giuseppe about pizza and pasta! Both tasted amazing, and I learned a lot about the variations in ingredients to achieve different doughs. The videos afterward are awesome because he had so much information to share. I will definitely be recommending this class to everyone I know!

My boyfriend and I had a wonderful time making pizza and pasta with Giuseppe. The pizza is so delicious and very easy and interesting to make! Giuseppe is really friendly and funny. His workshop is located in the beautiful suburb. After the lesson, we took a walk along the nearby Appian Way, as Giuseppe recommended, and enjoyed some stunning views. Thank you so much for such an amazing experience, Giuseppe!
和Giuseppe制作披萨的过程十分轻松愉悦。Giuseppe特别友好风趣。他的小屋坐落在美丽的郊区。体验结束后，我们按照他的建议沿着附近的Appian Way散步并欣赏到了迷人的风景。非常感谢Giuseppe给我们带来的美好时光！

We had the best time with Giuseppe! He made it so easy for us from the get-go. He picked us up at the train station and took us to his beautiful home. We ate the most delicious food, had a great time learning how to make pasta and pizza, and most of all we had the best company that made the whole experience magical! Thank you Giuseppe for your hospitality and kindness! All the best!

Giuseppe was an awesome teacher! He was funny and very knowledgeable on cooking and Rome in general! I will definitely come back for my next time in Rome. The Pizza we made here was much better than the kind served at local pizzerias.

The tour was really wonderful, he has been an incredible host for the tour, he was right at the indicated time where he picked us up that day and took us by car to his house, the incredible landscape, his house very cozy, the wonderful class, Giuseppe was always willing to show us at all times and with his great friendliness and humor towards the most entertaining and welcoming afternoon, in addition to a very good group of people, all friendly and nice, exquisite food, pizzas and pastries, and most importantly he taught us step by step on how to make these typical dishes of Italy

I highly recommend this tour, it was a great and wonderful experience where you can learn a little more about the culinary culture of this city and meet wonderful and friendly people from all over the world
👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻Marco - Eduardo
