Giuseppe is an engaging host and a great instructor. You will feel comfortable at the rustic site with an outdoor pizza oven that gets so hot that individual pizzas are cooked in lays than 2 minutes. When Giuseppe says to take it out of the oven it is important to do so immediately to it may burn. We had a great time and will try to our newly acquired skills at home.

A really fun departure from your usual Roman historian walking tour. You get to escape to the protected lands around the ancient Appian way learning fun cooking techniques with a very friendly, warm host. Be prepared to cover yourself in flour, sip some wine, laugh at stories, and feel closer to classic Italian culture.

Had a great time learning hands-on from Giuseppe how to make pizza and pasta from scratch! He shared wonderful tricks of the trade, and of course there’s the added bonus of getting to eat the fruits of your labor!

The class was engaging and honestly the 4 hours flew by. I’d recommend this to anyone visiting Rome in a heartbeat - it was a truly wonderful experience. Grazie mille, Giuseppe!
Belle is a great host. She was on time, explained everything in great detail, and shared anecdotes. A great experience.

I received notification that this event was being cancelled at 11:30pm the night before the event. I was already asleep at this time and was unable to reach the host until an hour before the event. I was told I would receive a full refund. The host never officially cancelled the event on Airbnb and has not issued a refund or replied to my message about it. I'm very disappointed with the handling of this issue.
It was a very personal and great experience. The place was wonderful, we learned a lot and enjoyed it. I definitely recommend it :)

This was my first time in Italy and Rome for that matter. Me and my partner did all the touristy type things, the colosseum, the Vatican the Spanish steps, Trevi fountain etc. But this cooking course/experience was by far the high point of our 5day trip. The idyllic setting, amazing facilities, world class chef and even better food. Any one travel to Rome I would decently recommend this. Thank you Giuseppe

Everything was exceptional, the food, the place in the countryside and of course he who gave us a warm welcome, it was a fun day where we learned to make several types of pasta and of course we tried the best pizza, I recommend it 100

Giuseppe’s class was so fun!! We made pizza and pasta. and we ate tiramisu and wine. Everything sooo delicious!!!
I really recommend this experience!! Giuseppe was good teacher. Thank you for great time!!!
The experience was great. Giuseppe picked us up from the agreed upon spot and we had a fun day and lots of good food. I really recommend it to everyone

Amazing. This experience was our first on Airbnb and certainly will be hard to top. From the start, you get to make, and eat, delicious pizza. Then on to pasta. We learned how to make different shapes and kinds of pasta and throughout the whole process Giuseppe’s sense of humor is contagious. You get to interact with other guest from different countries and it was all together a fabulous experience. We left not only very full in our stomachs, but also in our hearts!

P.S. Giuseppe’s tiramisu is the best in Rome.. you will just have to try it for yourself!

Giuseppe, his property, and his class are all fantastic. Giuseppe is really funny and has this sarcastic sense of humor that adds to the authentic experience. His property is outside of the hustle and bustle of Rome while still being pretty easily accessible. The class itself is informative, fun, and filled with delicious food.

My mouth is still watering as I write this review.....

What an amazing experience. Being in a beautiful city like Rome and learning how to cook authentic Italian food with the wonderful Chef Giuseppe is an experience I will never forget. Highly recommend taking the time to take Giuseppe’s class if you’re traveling through Rome.

The meeting point is very easy to access from the metro and the estate where the class is taught is a beautiful getaway from the Rome inner city life.

The food, wine & teachings in the class is an experience you’ll never forget.

Can’t wait to take his class again and thank you Chef Giuseppe for all your hospitality!

Cheers!

This was a fun day of cooking and eating! The best part was the memories and getting to experience everything with new friends. Giuseppe is very good at leading groups of people through these cooking exercises. He also keeps everything simple. The class is very well-designed, with the most gratifying part - cooking a Neapolitan pizza in a wood-fired oven - first, so that the more complex tasks of making dough and rolling pasta by hand can come afterwards, when you’re not so hungry and you have more patience to try something more sophisticated. Finishing with a pasta meal and tiramisu is quite a treat.

Giuseppe is a warm and friendly host who has passion for cooking and genuine desire to teach his guests the art of cooking. We had a super good time!
The location of his school was beautiful and a refreshing escape from the city.

He's not just a cook ready to reveal every secret of his kitchen, he's also a person who loves what he does. I also found that this is not an experience exclusively for foreigners visiting the Belpaese, as the "Pizza" topic is addressed in all its aspects, including tips for preparing at home. I can recommend this experience to anyone who wants to have a nice day making (and eating) pizza!

It was a great experience being able to prepare pizza and pasta while being in Italy, enjoying a good conversation with Giuseppe and other travelers. I would recommend this experience for doing with friends or family. And being in the southern part of Rome, it is a good idea to visit Appia Antica and the Catacombs. So basically it’s a great day!

Perfect!! He met us and took us to this quaint kitchen in the country. He was warm and friendly and educated and very charming!! The day couldn't have been more Perfect!! It was a great group of people. Lots to learn and plenty to eat (Website hidden by Airbnb) Thanks Giuseppe!
Likable host/chef. It was a good program that kept us engaged. We learned a lot about pizza and pasta. We can't wait to try the recipes at home after linking to his blog.
This class is wonderful! Giuseppe is amazing! The food and wine were very good. If you want something different to try while you're in Rome, this is definitely a must try.

Giuseppe is one of a kind. This is the first Airbnb experience we purchased, and if the rest are anything like this then we will keep doing them everywhere we travel. If you think it's not worth the money, I'm here to tell you that it is! He picks you and the rest of the group up from a Metro stop, teaches you everything in such a fun way and really makes you feel connected with your group. I felt like I was smiling the whole way through! There are many things to see and do in Rome, but one thing you won't want to miss is this class. Would HIGHLY recommend to anyone! Grazie :)

It was such a great experience, from the food, to the location, to the company. Giuseppe is extremely knowledgeable and really takes the time to show you how to make the pizza and pasta properly. My husband and I learned a great deal and can't wait to put our new knowledge to the test! Highly recommend for anyone traveling in Rome!!

We are a family of 4 and loved our day making pizza and pasta with Giuseppe! We enjoyed being out in the countryside and meeting others in our group too. He is passionate about what he does and really made it fun learning! Everything was delicious and it was a nice treat to take a break from the fast pace of sight seeing to have this unique and worthwhile experience. Would highly recommend!
The food was delicious! It was great to learn how to make many different kinds of pasta. Giuseppe was very funny and helpful.

What a fabulous experience!! Giuseppe is a very kind and entertaining man (also very patient with our group, who struggled with the pizza a bit!).. and he knows how to make exceptional food! I would highly recommend this experience, a brilliant day out! I can't wait to try out everything I have learnt when I go home!
It was an amaizing expérience! We learnt how to make delicious pizza and pasta and had a chance to taste Giuseppe’s tiramisu. We also had fin with the other members of the group!I recommand!

We were picked up at the metro station Laurentina and brought to his small garden house about 20 mins away.

We immediately startet to prepare pizza. The dough was ready - we afterwards made new dough that has to rest for 24h. Giuseppe precisely introduced us into the art of pizzamaking. Everyone gets to choose what they want on their very own pizza. Afterwards he shows you how to bake it yourself in his stunning pizza oven. Hands down. That was the best pizza i ever enjoyed.

After that which was already worth the workshop we were introduced into making pizza and pasta dough, the latter in two different ways - with egg and without.

We made a lot of different pasta styles. It was very funny in the group.

We then had two pasta dishes and Giuseppes tiramisú. When he states that you have to come very hungry, that is to be taken literally. You basically eat all the time and more than you probably should. But don't worry
- we found out that this particular food goes right into your soul ;)

Would definitely recommend it. It was a very funny group and a marvellous day. Thank you guys and thank you Giuseppe!

Giuseppe puts on a great show and shares his genuine passion for food. He is both knowledgeable and talented and introduced us to the joys of making pasta and pizza. I enjoy cooking and took away many ideas and tips that will definitely improve my dishes. I look forward to trying what I learned.
We had a really good time with Giuseppe. It was fun making pizza with him and learning how simple and delicious it can be. Certainly, an experience that I will recommend to everyone - yum yum!

The cooking class with Giuseppe was amazing! I can only recommend it! The organization was good and the food just delicious! I am still full when I think about it.:-) Now I only need to try it at home as well!!

I enjoyed making our own pizza with Giuseppe. However, in the pasta-making portion of the class, it would have been even greater to have a lesson/thorough run down on the sauces, not just the pasta itself - considering how long the class is. Overall for me, it was most interesting to meet the different people taking part in the class of the day.

This was such a haven outside the bustling city of Rome. A cooking class in a quaint cabin on the outskirts of Rome. It was a highlight for us! We learned so much, our favorite of which was making little pasta shapes! (Tortellini, penne, rigatoni) Giuseppe kept us laughing the entire time, played great music playlists, and quickly became one of the most friendly and down to earth Italians that we met! You can tell he is passionate about teaching people how to make good Italian food. Worth the time and money spent, hands down!
Was a really good class. We learnt about pasta and pizza dough and lots of shapes of pasta. Wish there was information about the pasta sauces also but overall very informative.
Giuseppe was a great host, and the class was exceptional! Great recipes and fun to make everything he taught. Absolutely recommend for a fun day in Rome.
LOVED IT! Giuseppe is a great chef and great teacher! We had tons of fun and loved the food so much! Highly recommend!

The afternoon of Pizza, Pasta and Tiramisu with Belle was amazing. We enjoyed the last days of fall in the garden of Belle, surrounded by olive trees and pearls. The wood oven pizza, which she greeted us with, was delicious. The bread from the pizza is definitely the Neapolitan style and seasoned with ingredients from the same garden.

For all the texture of recipes, he takes us all over Italy with different forms of pasta and between music and jokes, you learn to make many of them.

Fully recommended,
thank you very much!

So my boyfriend picked this tour and i honestly had no clue what to expect. However Pizza, wine, pasta and tiramisu how could you go wrong with that?!
So the fact that we get picked up and driven by Giuseppe makes things super easy. It was a short drive from the city however you could not tell you were still technically in the city. The property Giuseppe host things on is absolutely lovely. He has a ton of olive trees, pear tress and flowers all around with cabins.
So we began with a demonstration on how to make a pizaa and shortly after got to make our own. We got to pick our own toppings and learned the whole oven process allowing is to make the best pizzas. The set up for the pizza is super easy and cooked in minutes so of course it was not long until we got to sit down and enjoy our pizza and wine.
After hanging out with the other people on the tour we started the pasta class. We learned how to make the pizza and pasta dough as well as every pasta shape possible! Some shapes I’ve never seen that are super fancy. Once class ended we went back to our wine while our chef started to cook two options of pasta (definitely do not eat breakfast before this tour lol) The pasta was absolutely delicious!

The thing i loved best about this tour was its something i can definitely make at home! I can’t wait to cook a family dinner with what I’ve learned.

After everything, we had of course more wine and the dessert!

I highly recommend this tour! It’s a great time with great people and Giuseppe is an absolute joy to be around.

Ok, you MUST make time for this on your visit. From start to finish, I was laughing, enjoying great food, and having a ton of fun making the pizza and pasta. Guiseppe is quite the entertaining teacher and engages with everyone in the group in a fun way that makes you laugh and smile quite often. And on top of all of that, you get to learn how to make pizza, pasta, and then eat it with some wine on his amazing and beautiful property!

Giuseppe is awesome guy. You will love his funny way how to teach you secrets of pizza and pasta. We were with him about 4 hours and it was well spent time. I can only recommend this awesome experience.

What a wonderful experience Giuseppe's cooking class was. He ensured everyone had an amazing time while learning traditional techniques and enjoying delicious food along with his homemade wine. I highly recommend taking his class and learning a new thing or two to bring back to your home kitchen.

I have taken cooking classes, workshops and food tours around the world. I'd have to rate Giuseppe's as one of the most entertaining I have been involved with. He is a completely engaging and entertaining and kept the 10 of us fully involved the entire four hours.

He also passes on some very valuable information related to the creation of both pizza and pasta dough. That is one thing I always look for with any cooking class/workshop - meaningful takeaways that I can apply to my own cooking.

However, I think that the statement in the listing, "I will teach you a lot of different shapes and all the secrets to go back at home as a Master Chef" is a bit of hyperbole. I have been making both pizza and pasta from scratch for some time and as I said above came away with new knowledge. But if you've no experience in these and you just take this class, you are NOT going to be a Master Chef. These are hard techniques to master.

That said, I think this is a very good value for the money and if you participate you will learn, you will eat well, and you will have a very good time.

Giuseppe's pizza making class was amazing and delicious! We only had 3 days in Rome so hesitated about taking a 4 hour class. DO NOT hesitate! Giuseppe is so much fun and his venue out in the countryside is not to be missed. A 5 star experience.
It was an amazing day, together with Giuseppe and not least the 6 American attendees 🇺🇸🇩🇰🌞

I really enjoyed my class with Giuseppe! He is a cool guy and his property is beautiful. The food we made was delicious and it gave me an appreciation for pasta making. The pizza we made was nearly as good as the one I had in Naples the day before. I highly recommend this experience if you enjoy Italian food.

I loved the taste of everything we made. In fact, we have been in Italy for over two weeks and I had been disappointed in the pizza until we made his Naples style pizza today! It was the best pizza I ever tasted, and I made it myself! I wasn’t as good as making pasta, but it tasted great anyway. Throw in the fresh ingredients that he we literally picked off the plants right there, and it made for a great environment.

We had a lot of fun during the class. It was nice to get out of tourist areas and have this local experience.

Giuseppe provided clear instructions during the class.
Fun, food, wine. Giuseppe provides it all in a four hour entertaining fest. We made pizza and pasta, and ate it all! We would do it again, and we certainly recommend it.

Giuseppe is a friendly, boisterous and highly entertaining host who had us in splits during our cooking class at his beautiful outhouse. We learnt to make our own pizza and pasta dough, how to make about 8 kinds of pasta shapes and even made our own pizzas in his wood fired oven. We finished off with delicious pesto and carbonara pastas that he whipped up for us with the pasta we made during his class and his wonderful tiramisu. All in all, it was a great day spent eating, drinking and laughing under the gorgeous Italian sun.

Giuseppe was an amazing host for this experience. He is extremely knowledgable in homemade pasta and pizza. This was an amazing day being able to make pasta from scratch and our own Neapolitan pizzas. Delicious and interactive! Also a great way to get out of the touristy city for the day, would highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Rome!

This was really a highlight of our trip to Italy. Giuseppe picked us up from the subway station and took us to his land where he has a whole outdoor setup for this class. The weather was perfect, the scenery was beautiful and the food was delicious. Giuseppe was very knowledgeable and taught us how to make pizza and many different types of pasta. He was friendly and kept the vibes lighthearted and fun - we all ended up playing foosball before we were driven back to the subway. I would definitely recommend signing up for a class!

The experience with Giuseppe has everything to become amazing. There are only a few things left for him to adjust. The youngsters have a good time, but I was more picky. After numerous attempts to confirm the exact location of the meetup, we found that we will be taken by van or car to a kind of “ place” in a field outside of the city. The place that has everything to be beautiful looks like abandoned. The tents that Giuseppe puts together to be the venue of the experience could be cleaner. Mosquitoes are very disruptive and he didn't have an off or anything similar to give us. I was bitten quite a bit. The bathroom is totally impromptu. He abuses some of the jokes of bad taste, goes above and beyond in his troubling with students, and his didactics is impaired. She's been impeccable a few times throughout the class. For me who doesn't really master English, he had promised to explain in Spanish, he completely forgot about it. It was boring to have to ask. Other than that, the pizza in the wood-fired oven was good . The folder was ok, and the tiramissu advertised is not taught but a gift.
Giuseppe is very intelligent and passionate about cooking. He has a great sense of humor and kept us entertained the whole time. Delicious pasta and pizza! The outdoor vibe is nice too.

Giuseppe was a great instructor (and a really good foosball player). Our afternoon was very educational and we had fun making pizza and various pastas. It’s a fun, outdoor and relaxed atmosphere. Totally recommend this experience. We had perfect weather but Be advised the class is outdoor so dress accordingly.

Giuseppe is a funny man with a great sense of humour. He speaks English fluently and also can speak Spanish. The experience is in a place near the city, but it seems like the countryside, you can see it’s his gem, it’s where he’s been doing the courses for a long time. The pasta was delicious and my pizza was an authentic Italian one. It was a funny day, great experience. First we made pizza, then the pasta, then we had lunch. By the end he serves you his tiramisu, which we don’t learn how to prepare but there wouldn’t be enough time to do so! Aos brasileiros, valeu muito a pena, se tiverem tempo em Roma, venham a Giuseppe!

We had such a fabulous time with Giuseppe! He was funny, charming and so knowledgeable. The food we cooked was delicious - all down to Giuseppe. We made pizza, pasta and got to spend a lovely few hours on Giuseppe's land. He even dropped us off at the nearby Appian Way from where we walked back into Rome. A fantastic day all in all.

I didn't realize this before I attended but the whole lesson takes place outside on beautiful land near Rome with an outdoor wood-fired oven, that's very special because you get to enjoy not only the amazingly delicious food you make but also the beautiful nature that's very close to Rome. If you are like me and have your own method of transportation (I was on a scooter) make sure to read all the instructions and meet Chef Giuseppe at the meeting point near the metro station because he will drive you to the land where the lesson takes place. Everything about the experience was really fun and delicious and my only regret is it wasn't longer because I felt like we were only getting to experience a small taste of Giuseppe's wealth of knowledge and experience. But there is only so much one could fit in during this time and already it's a lot to learn in one day. This is definitely one of the main highlights of my trip.

Pizza, pasta, and tiramisu with Giuseppe was informative, fun, and tasty. In a charming outdoor kitchen he teaches hands-on technique in pizza dough mixing and shaping, filling, and baking. He teaches technique in forming various pasta forms. And then you get to eat! He helped everyone make a delicious pizza, and he transformed our first-time pasta shells into yummy pesto and made pasta cacio e pepe. He capped it off with cool tiramisu. tiramisu. Giuseppe makes it fun and delicious. I recommend this experience!

Had a great day in the cooking class with Giuseppe! The pizza was so delicious and it was great fun learning to make all the different shapes of pasta. After the class finished Giuseppe suggested he drop us at the Appian Way and we walked along that, able to see the old ruins and catacombs before catching a bus back into the centre. Truely fantastic day. Thanks Giuseppe!

This is definitely a five star Pizza and Pasta experience you will never forget. Giuseppe does an amazing job from the beginning to the end. From being on time picking us up to making our pizza dough and using a wood fired pizza oven, it was amazing. The whole experience was outside on his property with surrounding of beautiful old trees and lush greenery very close to many Roman ruins. Giuseppe is a chef of many experiences and it is most enjoyable hearing him talk about them. Thank you Giuseppe for a most memoable and fun experience!

Giuseppe's class was a lot of fun. The pizza and pasta were fantastic and a lot of fun to make. I was traveling alone and it was also a great way to meet other travelers. Thanks for the fantasic evening Giuseppe!

This was a truly wonderful experience. We laughed, ate drank and cooked our way into the night. Giuseppe is a wonderful teacher who takes his time with showing you each step no matter what skill level. I was recommended to this class by some friends that took it, and would absolutely keep that going and recommended it to a friend. Worth every penny!
Giuseppe was an excellent host and a very hands-on instructor. Truly wonderful experience cooking in an outdoor atmosphere and the food was delicious!

Set in a beautiful garden setting, this experience was one of the highlights of our honeymoon in Rome. The pizza and pasta were both delicious, as well as the homemade wine that was provided. Giuseppe is knowledgeable and passionate about his craft, and he brings it to life in this class. I would highly recommend this class to anyone that likes pizza, pasta, or wine (and let's be honest, why are you going to Rome if you don't?!).

What a delightful experience! Giuseppe was well organized, knowledgeable, and fun from start to finish! It was nice to get out of the busy City and be surrounded by a more peaceful, low key setting. The weather was nice, so we were outside under canopies and trees for shade. That aspect combined with Giuseppe's honest critiques of our cooking skills made me feel like I was in the British Baking Show (but Italian style). It was all good and fun, though, and we enjoyed meeting new people and eating incredibly delicious food!

You will feel like family as you learn pizza, pasta and other fun cooking facts with Giuseppe. He is a gracious host and we are now italian cooking experts! ok maybe a little more practice is needed :) but we learned lots and the pizza and pasta we made was fabulous, not to mention met some new friends from all over the world in the small intimate class. Highly recommend this experience for anyone visiting Rome, you will not be disappointed~!
Was a highlight of our honeymoon! Giuseppe was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. The homemade wine was fantastic! Shared such a great time and laughs with new friends

Giuseppe was a fantastic host and was sharing his expertise in making pasta and pizza with a smile. The whole afternoon was full of laughter, discussions, tips and trix and of course wonderful food to eat!

The whole experience was very well organised and enjoyable from beginning to end.

Giuseppe was amazing. Very knowledgeable, funny and a great chef. I didn't expect the cooking to be outdoor which was a really great surprise. The food was wonderful and I am leaving excited to try out things at home. Great to be taught about authentic Napoli pizza while in Rome. He spent time talking about the ingredients and how to use the right techniques. I highly recommend it.
Giuseppe is very knowledge about pizza and pasta making. He is a well traveled chef and it was very fun to make pizza in his outdoor oven.

Giuseppe made making pasta and pizza (as well as eating it) so much fun and educational! You meet at a metro station and from there are whisked off to an outdoor kitchen where the experience takes place. Taking photos and videos is encouraged, but so is getting your hands dirty (or delicious). You learn how to make a Roman or Neapolitan style pizza and later taught the various techniques to making pasta dough and its forms.

By the end of the experience your belly is full, you've made new friends and you leave with a lasting sense of happiness. Giuseppe really captures Italian warmth and hospitality through food and education. This is a "must do" when in Rome!

Fantastic cooking class with an outstanding chef! Quiet, rustic location and a truely immersive class. Guiseppe will tell you all you need to know about pizza and pasta. He has great stories and a great sense of humour. Highly recommended!

We have not stopped raving about this experience to friends and family; it was by far, the best part of our trip to Rome! Giuseppe was welcoming, knowledgeable and funny, and the food we made (and ate) was exceptional. He was good at showing us what to do, what not to do and he included some interesting facts that were fascinating as well. Definitely give this a go, you won't regret it!

When can you make pizza with a certified pizzaiolo while in Rome? Well by booking this AirBnB experience. We started with a tutorial on how to properly roll and prepare a pizza. After enjoying the fruits of our labor, we moved onto pasta. Farfalloni, Penne, Strozzapreti, Spaghetti alla Chitarra, and Cavatelli, to name a few. We personally made them all. Giuseppe then prepared our handmade pasta for us to enjoy. Lucky for us Giuseppe made us pasta as well, because our rolling skills weren't quite up to par;) We then finished the day off with Giuseppe's homemade Tiramisu. Personally the best I've tasted while in Italy. This was one of the highlights of my entire trip. For all those foodies and pizza lovers out there, this is not to be missed.

Super friendly and relaxing atmosphere! great wine and people all around the world to share lunch with;) cooking class is basic, do not expect to upgrade your skills enormously, but still useful and sometimes funny

The experience was exceptional! It was placed in a beautiful outdoor setting and you really learn a lot, as well as get hands on experience. Giuseppe is very entertaining as he teaches the class, which provided many laughs. It was great meeting new people and overall a very enjoyable experience :)

Chef Giuseppe was extremely fun and informative! We learnt how to make two varieties of pizza bases and over ten varieties of pasta. The pizza, pasta and wine (the latter was also made by Chef Giuseppe) were delicious! A beautiful setting and great company made for a truly wonderful experience. Thanks Chef Giuseppe!!!
It was an amazing experience! Truly delicious food! The chef was also very funny and kept the experience really fun!! Totally recommend to anyone!!

This was just AMAZING! Giuseppe was a phenomenal host. His techniques in cooking exceeded our already high expectations. We learned to make Pizza, both Roman and Napolitan, and afterwards all kinds of pasta. Giuseppe served us his homemade red wine, wich was one of the best we had ever tasted. All in all, a "must" experience if you come to Rome! Thanks alot Giuseppe. We hope to see you soon!

This was delightful from beginning to end. Giuseppe is extremely knowledgeable, and presented information in a clear, amusing and accessible manner. Everything was delicious....pizza, pastas and tiramisu, not to mention the homemade wine. I am eager to make fresh pasta, and thanks to Giuseppe, feel confident that I can. Grazie!!
Just arriving we made our pizza and eat it with some wine, then Giuseppe teached us how to make all types of pasta! The place was a garden outside of Rome, it was lovely

This is an absolutely amazing experience of making dough and decorating for Roma&Napoli pizza in a peaceful and quiet sunny big garden. Giuseppe very kind and friendly helped us to bake such very delicious pizza in wood fired oven ourselves.

Giuseppe was a great teacher and the man makes delicious wine!

Had a great time, excellent food and would recommend.

Keep in mind that the venue is outside and there are quite a lot of flies in the area, other than that, it was perfect.

We totally loved it! He has a vibrant personality which made the learning so much fun! And we did learn so much..the food we made was the best I have tasted ever!! Fabulous people in our group made it extra special.
Thank you so much Giuseppe..highly recommended

It was really nice to switch it up and spend the day out in the country! Giuseppe was very entertaining and knowledgeable. We learned a lot we will take back home with us! The pizza was amazing and so was his wine! It is outside so dress weather appropriate and bring bug spray if you have it

Awesome experience in a super quite place, away from all de noisy Rome. It is a good way to relax and make a pause from all the "must do", "must visit". Giuseppe taught us how to make home made pizza and lots of tricks for pasta. Of course, all you prepare, you will eat it!! ;). I super recommend this experience.

Giuseppe's class is a blast. The food is fantastic, his personality is big and fun and we really enjoyed socializing with the other peeps in the class. I would definitely recommend and advise to come hungry!

This class was a highlight for my trip to Rome. Giuseppe was a great host and teacher. The food was delicious and his techniques are simple enough to follow along to. I met a great group of people during the experience as well which made for an extremely enjoyable and memorable time.

A day full of the most delicious hand-made food, great wine, and beautiful outdoor setting. What impressed me most was Giuseppe's ability to balance learning and engagement with a relaxed, fun atmosphere. He's got an excellent personality, and great way with people. Highly recommended.

It was an authentic experience in the suburbs of Rome. We had an awesome time with a fun and charming Italian.
The food was just delicious with no big fuzz about it.

We had a fantastic time with Giuseppe this afternoon. His rustic kitchen, land, and Italian flare were an amazing touch of authentic whilst visiting a large city. By the end...the group is famiglia! Would highly recommend this experience to anyone who'd like a touch of Italy outside of typical hustle and bustle of tourist travel. Spot on teacher, great guy, wonderful day!
Really special experience and my favorite part of my trip to Rome. The pizza was the best I've ever had. Can't wait to try out the pasta making techniques at home!

Giuseppe is a very knowledgeable, engaging and passionate chef. He took us through the basics of preparing pizza and pasta dough, talked about the differences between Neapolitan and Roman pizza and we got to eat our own creations. It was a fun day and one of the highlights of our stay in Rome
It was pouring rain during our experience and Giuseppe made the experience unforgettable. Great teacher, personality and sense of humor. I highly recommend this experience!

If you're seeking to experience a change of pace from sightseeing in Rome you can't go wrong with a day with Giuseppe. Despite a rainy start he made the process of making pizza and pasta entertaining and insightful. Spent in the company of fellow travellers we got to share and learn about each other's adventures and cultures. Highly recommend giving this a shot even if the weather isn't great.

Despite the crazy downpour of rain on the day, we had a blast at this class! We got to make our own pizzas, and learnt how to make pizza dough and pasta from scratch after we devoured the pizzas. Giuseppe was a fantastic host and was lots of fun! It was definitely worth the time and money, and I would highly recommend this for anyone after something a little different to do in Rome. Thanks Giuseppe! :)

This was an amazing experience with Giuseppe! He picked us up at a meeting spot and drove our group to his home in the beautiful Italian countryside.

There, Giuseppe, with his exceptional cooking skills and humor, taught us how to make "Roman" and "Neapolitan" style pizzas (I didn't know there are regional differences!).

We then learned how to make different types of pasta noodles (my favorite part) with our hands and various instruments, like the pasta guitar.

We cooked, ate (of course) and topped it all off with tiramisu and wine. The other people in the group were fun and there were definitely bonds made by the end of the trip.

I would highly recommend this to anyone who loves food and enjoys a good time!
Giuseppe was great! We made really delicious food and had lots of laughs and fun. A very memorable experience and a must do when in Rome!

The four hours I spent today with Giuseppe (and a lovely group of ten other people) was exceptional. The rural setting for the class was a pleasant surprise and made the day quite idyllic. It is remarkable how much was covered in the time and how much we achieved in only half a day.

I feel confidant that I'll be able to reproduce back home everything we did today, particularly after I review the follow-up information that will be made available on his website. Giuseppe is a very good and engaging teacher, it was a great day, and I would recommend this Airbnb Experience to all the foodies out there!

Informative and fun experience. The location was unique- quiet and "Italian" with olive trees around. Learned a new techniques for pizza making, and a great intro to pasta! Giuseppe was a fun and entertaining host! We hope to see him again the next time we are in Roma

It was a great experience! Me and my partner are not that much into cooking but we had amazing time nonetheless. Giuseppe is a lovely host and a great fun. Making handmade pasta was a highlight. Great company, great experience, great day! Thank you so much!

Cooking with chef Giuseppe was a blast. It was one of the first things my girlfriend and I did when in Rome, and we wouldn't change a thing.

We met at 10:25 and all together were driven to the site which is secluded forest for an afternoon worth of laughs, great food and information. Giuseppe is a lot of fun. A few reviews mention that he could be kinder in constructive criticism. This made me laugh before the experience, and still does. Giuseppe is very kind and yes he pokes fun but is of the best intention and this made the whole thing funny and helped get all of the group loose. The pizzas were fantastic, we enjoyed sharing our time with the other guests. Do not doubt that this will be one of the most memorable experiences of our trip.

This experience was really cool. Giuseppe has taught in many countries, so this was just a pleasure to take a lesson in his own backyard. From making your own Italian pizza to learning how to make the various pasta noodles, this experience is perfect for anyone who wants to dive a little deeper into the Italian culinary arts. Giuseppe was a true master, showing plenty of patience while providing a relaxing environment. In addition, there was endless house wine!

Giuseppe, what an expert, what an entertainer! In this genre of experience, I really wasn't expecting much. I came away with a whole new fascination in pasta preparation, and totally educated in pizza making. 5 stars! Highly recommended

Hi Guiseppie. The setting was perfectly unexpected...the company was lovely...the realisation of how pasta shapes are made, was interesting and a lot of fun. To meet someone like you who is living their passion, infectious . Probably the best pizza base I've ever tasted! May you enjoy continued success..thanks for a great day x

We went there with our 17mth toddler and he love the huge area and the toys that belongs to Chef Giuseppe's son! That helps to keep my son entertain whilst both husband and I make pizza!

His place has a garden with olive trees and an outdoor firewood oven for the pizza. We had our class conducted outside.

We had lots of fun in the class!He gave clear instructions and demonstrated the steps to us.
It was a great experience for us! We were super filled up & advise you to come hungry!

Besides how delicious the food (and wine) was, Giuseppe is absolutely awesome. He's hilarious while being super helpful. The setting is really cool too - he's got a sweet outdoor pizza oven. Strongly recommend!
This was beyond my expectations. Giuseppe was kind and extremely knowledgable. The perfect relaxing get away for the day. Forget the competitors. THIS is the ultimate experience.

I brought my son to Chef Giuseppe for a pizza and pasta making lesson. My son has problems with finger dexterity being a Down's Syndrome special boy. In spite of other students in the class, Chef made special efforts to make my son make his own pizza, cook it and prepare different kinds of pasta forms. My son had so much fun, he was so proud of himself and very happy. Chef Giuseppe is a very versatile teacher. Beneath his humor, you can see him study each student making sure everyone goes home knowing the art of pizza and pasta making. Imagine making your own pizza, eating it by yourself. Then making your own pasta and eating it again. Then there is the Tiramisu which is the best I tasted in Rome. An added bonus of home made wine to top it all. We were in a countryside atmosphere with a beautiful scenery in his huge property filled with olive trees and herb plants, one can spend a whole day not only cooking, but enjoying nature. And to think it is less than an hour by Metro, then he picks his students from the Laurentina Metro and personally drives all of us to his property.
Thank you, Chef.my son shall come back.

This experience was phenomenal and by far the best part of our stay in Rome. Giuseppe was a great teacher, but also so funny and incredibly entertaining. I really enjoyed hearing about his experiences as a former chef and now a teacher. You can tell that he really puts a lot of thought into his classes and enjoys what he does, it was inspiring. The class itself was organized, well prepared and very informative. I never knew there were so many different pasta shapes. The pasta and pizza were delicious, but to me the experience was worth so much more. Thank you so much Giuseppe! Please look us up if you are ever in Seattle.

Amazing experience! We enjoyed a lot preparing both pizza and pasta and of course eating it 😊. Giuseppe and his assistant are really nice and full of knowledge! The location is really Nice and well organized. Definetly highly recomended experience for those trying to get a taste of the italian cuisine. Keep This spirit Giuseppe! Grazie mille!
Jordi

We had such a great time at this experience. Giuseppe and his wife picked us all up at the train station right on time. We all went to the location and immediately had wine and fresh bruschetta which had the most fresh tomatoes I've ever seen. We started with making the pizza dough and he taught us about the ingredients, different styles of recipes, and tips on how to make it. We all took turns making our pizzas and cooking them in the wood burning oven. We all tried each others' while enjoying Giuseppe's homemade wine (unlimited). All at a leisurely pace, we then began the pasta making portion of the experience. At this point, we were all pretty "jolly" from the wine and became friends with each other. The pasta making was a lot more intimate and Giuseppe taught us how to make all the pasta shapes while his favorite music played in the background and he sang along. His wife came out and was chatting with us while we learned also and she was such a sweetheart. Giuseppe cooked the pasta we made and served it to us in two different styles (carbonara and pesto) while we enjoyed more wine. At that point we were completely exhausted but still enjoyed more food. Giuseppe and his wife then took us back to the train station and we exchanged warm goodbyes.

Giuseppe's assistant, victoria, was phenomenal also. She spoke perfect English and gave us tips and pointers along the way.

We had a lovely time at this experience and highly recommend at the tail end of your Rome trip. Make sure you come with energy as Giuseppe will definitely have you work! Also make sure you arrive at the metro station on time. Definitely do this experience if you want to meet some lovely people from around the world, drink and eat a ton, and escape the city for a few hours. Thank you Giuseppe!

My nephews, sister and I had a great time with Giuseppe and his assistant whose name is escaping me. It was great getting out of city center to a semi-rural area. Our class was outside in an open air kitchen. We especially enjoyed making pizzas and learning from Giuseppe. His assistant was very helpful and both she and Giuseppe were fun to be with for an afternoon. We learned how to make different pastas. As other reviewers have indicated, Giuseppe prepared the pasta we made two different styles, Carbonara and pesto. Both were excellent. His tiramisu was heavenly. This is a great class for all ages. My young adult nephews really enjoyed the experience and interacting with Giuseppe, his assistant and a friend of theirs who asked to join the class as an observer.

Giuseppe and his assistant are masters of the art of pasta and pizza. You'll learn how to make Neapolitan and Roman-style pizzas, as well as the difference between them. Not to mention how to make multiple shapes of pasta and what types of sauces each pairs with best. The only thing that rubbed me the wrong way was their method of correcting people. It was certainly done with good intentions and to make everyone more skilled in these arts, but corrections came off as critical and mean rather than constructive. Again - they are truly masters and overall it was a great experience, but maybe just a little rough around the edges.

A very educational experience that takes places in a scenic setting off the beaten path and away from the overly touristy areas of Rome. Giuseppe and his team are very accommodating hosts who helped push us to learn the right way to make traditional Rome/Naples pizza and pasta. They do an excellent job of helping to correct errors and offer constructive criticism. Also a fun way to meet like minded travelers from throughout the world. Would definitely recommend this experience.

Giuseppe was a great host arriving on time to pick us all up to start the day. The location was lovely and the weather was perfect for us to prepare our food outside. The instructions for rolling pizza dough were clear and we had great fun with the other people on the trip trying to make the perfect base. The toppings were all so fresh and it was a proud moment to bite into a slice of our own homemade pizza. The pasta lesson was equally fun (although our skills lie more with pizza than pasta it seems!) and very interesting. The pasta meals (carbonara and pesto) were delicious! We were ready to burst by the time tiramisu arrived but it was delicious enough to finish! An amazing experience and one I'd recommend to anybody going to Rome.

We loved our experience with Giuseppe! I really feel like we learned a ton, and I feel like we were learning from a friend that happens to be an expert. Guiseppe and his assistant were both able to answer many questions, show us techniques, and have fun!

We got to Laurentina on our own (via Roma Termini) and he and a driver were waiting for us and the rest of our group promptly. We drove out to the space, two large tents (with sides in case of rain, wood floor raised a bit), running water and working bathroom. We jumped right in and everyone made dough, then split and everyone was able to make their own pizza, put it in the oven, and enjoy! We moved into pasta, learned how to make many kinds and finally made some for ourselves, eating carbonara and pesto (from fresh basil growing around!). We had plenty of water, wine, juice, and food to go around. Large fan that also throws water (in case it's hot, like for us!). Would recommend without hesitation!!

It was easy to
find. It was so nice to pick us up at the subway
station. It was so friendly and fun.
I loved the experience of making and baking fire pit pizza myself.
It was a great experience to learn to cook traditional Italian dishes.
Thank you, Juseppe!

This was a great experience and a lovely addition to our honeymoon ! The transportation to and from the venue was very nice. We learned a lot and ate a lot. Our group was very friendly and small. We didn't learn how to cook the pasta but we had a lot of fun making it! Some take home information or dough recipes would have been nice and would make the price more worth it.

A fantastic way to spend a few hours learning about the secrets of making amazing Pizza & Pasta!!
The group size is limited to about 8 people, which meant you were able to ask questions and receive hands on help from Giuseppe...
Once you have made your Pizza & Pasta, you get to sit down and eat your produce whilst enjoying a glass of Vino!!
A great tour, and one I highly recommend to anyone visiting Rome!!

This sounds like a lot of fun, but I hope you don't encounter any delays on the way to this experience - There will be no mercy. You'll be out hundreds of dollars and left very disappointed. We never got to go to this experience because we couldn't get there in time. We weren't able to make it to the location until about 30 minutes after the scheduled meeting time. We were sad to have missed the first 30 minutes but were looking forward to jumping in for the remaining three and a half hours we had paid for. Unfortunately the host would not allow us to join late. And he refused to refund the hundreds of dollars we had already paid and would not reschedule.

Giuseppe is a great personality worth knowing just for that... then on top the guy knows how to make pizze and la pasta! Check in easy and comfortable and for me who has an underground level in cooking I feel a lot smarter now !

We were picked up at the metro station and taken to Giuseppe's land where there was a beautiful outdoor kitchen setup with a pizza oven. Giuseppe was hilarious and friendly and very knowledgeable about not only how to make pizza and pasta, but the science behind the ingredients and cooking. It we laughed with him and he laughed at us when we would mess up. It was really fun and I can't wait to come back and take another class with him!

Giuseppe was like a great friend who also happens to own a pizza oven and be awesome at making pizza. Plan for at least 6 hours. His tours of Italian carbs are decidedly nap-inducing. That is, because you make so much pizza and pasta and stuff yourself so much that a siesta is mandatory. So four hours of cooking and eating and then two hours of napping.
You're missing out if you don't go hang with Giuseppe! He is a wonderful, funny guy! Homemade wine to enjoy while you cook ... it's delicious. We love Giuseppe and Vittoria! NOT ViCtoria.

Expect to learn how to make pizza (you learn how to prepare Romana and Napoletana styles, but choose one to make for yourself) and a variety of different pasta types, all by hand. Giuseppe is a good host and provides all participants with a short history of the foods they are preparing. Our group had to cut the experience short by an hour due to other conflicting arrangements, but Giuseppe made some changes to the line-up to allow us all to learn the process for all the foods (we only missed out on trying the cooked pasta). The location is out in the countryside and was a good change of scenery after 4 days of exploring the central parts of Rome. Would recommend to those seeking a laid-back cooking experience.

Thoroughly enjoyed this experience was in a lovely relaxing setting. Was very informative and now have a good understanding of how to make italian pizza and pasta although thought we may have learnt about the pasta sauces.

A really nice experience. We made great and tasty pizza and I learned a lot of great skills. However, I had a problem with finding the place. I didn't find the meeting point, so I had to find the road to their house on my own, which was really hard

Giuseppe is a very lively and fun person. We really enjoyed cooking with him in the middle of nowhere. It was great to be able to explore the idyllic side of Rome. Guiseppe definitely knows how to make pizza & pasta delicious and in general we enjoyed the day very much. Absolutely recommended. :-)

Guiseppe is very friendly and the class is short but the place and media are not adequate. It was in an outdoor environment (so hot) and the means to do so were greatly improved in terms of the price of the experience. I think it should be done in another environment.

I would definitely recommend this class to anyone wanting to learn how to cook beautiful pizzas and pastas and enjoy a beautiful day outside of Rome! 10/10 experience! Thanks Giuseppe!! :)

It was so much fun. Giuseppe is very knowledgeable on everything and good attitude is amazing. Joking around having fun making everyone laugh but also making sure everyone is learing how to make fresh pizza and pasta. I would recommend this to everyone who visits Rome.

The group size of 12 was a bit too much. In the beginning, you waited a little too long until you were making the pizza.

This class is a MUST do if you are in Rome! Giuseppe hosts an such an incredible and fun class that you don't want it to end! This was by far one of the best things my husband and I did on our honeymoon!

This experience and staff were truly phenomenal and I would recommend anyone who wants a real taste of Italy to go here!

Because of the heat Giuseppe moved the experience to later in the day which really made it so much more enjoyable. Would recommend to anyone and can't wait to try the recipes at home!

We had a great time cooking with Giuseppe! He taught us quite a bit about pasta shapes, different types of dough, pasta vs. pizza dough/kneading, and more. First, we got to make our own pizzas and use the pizza oven. Then (after eating the first part), we practiced making pasta, decided what pasta/sauce combinations to make, and got to work!

What I really loved is that Giuseppe provides tutorials online later- you don't have to take notes, remember times/temperatures/ratios/etc.

From a practical standpoint, it's something you need to make sure you've allotted quite a bit of time for. As the description states, it takes 4+hours- that's because you meet at the end of one of the metro lines and take a ride from there. It is also outside, so if you're easily bitten by flies/bugs, I'd spray yourself down with bug spray first- I'm not sure if I missed this in the description or not, but it wasn't entirely what I expected.

All in all, a great visit!
